title: Toward Collective-Centric Evaluation of Preference Inference for Participatory Democracy
summary: To scale up collective decision-making, participatory democracy platforms such as Polis and Remesh enable online deliberation among thousands of participants. However, at this scale, participants cannot review every opinion submitted by others, producing highly sparse voting data that misrepresent patterns of consensus, conflict, and minority support. Platforms therefore increasingly rely on Preference Inference (PI) models to predict missing votes. Yet this automation is not neutral: inferred preferences can artificially amplify, suppress, or reorder existing patterns of support, ultimately reshaping how the outcomes of a deliberation are interpreted. More generally, we lack a systematic understanding of how existing PI methods affect the collective preference landscape. To address this gap, we benchmark several existing PI approaches in this context. Moving beyond conventional user-centric evaluations centered on the accuracy of individual predictions, we introduce a collective-centric evaluation framework that measures whether inferred votes preserve salient properties of the broader preference landscape. We further contribute the largest multilingual dataset of its kind: four consultations spanning over 90k participants, 1M votes, and 22 languages. Our experiments show that models with comparable predictive accuracy can differ substantially in the degree to which they preserve the collective structure. These results demonstrate that accuracy alone is insufficient for evaluating \emph{PI} in democratic settings. By contributing a novel comprehensive and collective-centric evaluation benchmark for the task of PI, this work aims to support the development of AI systems that scale deliberation without compromising the integrity of its democratic outcomes.

title: TRACE: Spatiotemporal Contact Memory Graph Network Simulator for Granular Dynamics
summary: Learned graph simulators provide an efficient alternative to high-fidelity solvers for granular dynamics. However, granular motion depends strongly on inter-granular contact history, which is difficult to preserve when particle contacts form, break, and rearrange. Existing simulators mainly store temporal information in node features or node-level memory. Here we introduce TRACE, a graph-network simulator that stores interaction history directly on contact edges. Each edge maintains a persistent memory updated by attention-based message passing and a gated recurrent unit, while an edge-identity dictionary preserves this memory as the contact graph changes. A physics-structured decoder predicts inter-granular normal and tangential contact forces, enforces the Coulomb friction limit, and applies equal-and-opposite internal forces. The model is trained with single-step pretraining followed by autoregressive rollout fine-tuning. We evaluate TRACE on 2D and 3D granular column-collapse benchmarks. In both cases, TRACE produces stable, physically consistent long-horizon rollouts, closely reproducing the final deposit geometry and the kinetic energy released during collapse. Compared with graph network simulator (GNS) and node-memory graph neural simulator (NMGNS), TRACE reduces long-rollout position error by 31-62% and final-deposit error by 58-89% across the two benchmarks, while using fewer parameters and maintaining near-zero particle interpenetration. TRACE also achieves 12.2$\times$ and 8.9$\times$ speedups over the material point method (MPM) reference solver in 2D and 3D, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/Data-Driven-Computational-Geotechnics/TRACE.

title: No-Regret Bayesian Optimization with Finite-Library Input-Warped Kernels
summary: Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization (GP-BO) excels at black-box optimization of costly functions, e.g., hyperparameter optimization (HPO) and multi-agent system (MAS) design. Convergence-rate guarantees exist for select methods, notably GP upper confidence bound (GP-UCB), but require a fixed kernel. Critically, the kernel encodes how input proximity affects objective value similarity. When raw coordinates poorly match this geometry - as with log-scaled hyperparameters or localized peaks - input warping can greatly improve sample efficiency, yet known GP-UCB proofs require a fixed kernel. We propose Finite-Library Input-Warped Bayesian Optimization (FLIWBO), which selects warps from a finite library of smooth input maps by any history-dependent rule. It adapts the input geometry to accelerate learning while retaining high-probability convergence guarantees under mild hypotheses, with an explicit $\sqrt(N_\varepsilon)$ library-size cost. Controlled diagnostics show that finite-library warping repairs planted geometry mismatches and identify FLIWBO failure cases. Across four repeated benchmarks - warped synthetic objectives, a confidence-fence trap, and Fashion-MNIST HPO - FLIWBO-UCB beats raw-coordinate GP-UCB under misspecified geometry, escapes traps that defeat even oracle-warp expected improvement, and recovers much of the gain from manual log scaling, while leading the tested methods that admit a matching regret guarantee. A 20-dimensional MAS design study further shows feasibility under costly noisy evaluations. Code for experiments is available: https://github.com/edvin-ketabati/bogp-paper-experiments.

title: Evaluating Graph Neural Networks for Change-Criticality Classification in Maritime Navigation Charts
comments: Accepted at IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are a class of neural networks suitable for learning on graph-structured data. Their application to spatial data is a natural extension, however its relatively unclear which message-passing operations, architectural configurations, and graph representation is best suited for classifying changes to objects in electronic navigational charts (ENCs)--geospatial vector datasets used for marine navigation. Maintaining these datasets is a challenge, and categorizing changes to objects in the ENC based on their significance to navigational safety is of particular importance. Here, we propose to represent these vector navigation datasets as a graph structure where the spatial objects serve as nodes and their spatial and semantic relationships form edges. We encode both the old ENC dataset and new ENC dataset into a pair of graphs and frame the task as a graph-pair classification problem. Building on this representation, we investigate the use of GNN architectures to classify whether the encoded graphs constitutes a critical or non-critical risk to navigational safety. We train and evaluate several GNN architectures and model configurations on ENC changes reviewed by maritime experts. Our results demonstrate that graph-based representations improve the classification of ENC updates, providing a scalable approach for automating or improving ENC maintenance workflows.
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026

title: Verify Before You Distill: Prompt-Level Teacher Gating for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) accelerates post-training by providing dense token-level supervision from a frozen teacher on the student's own rollouts. Vanilla OPD applies this supervision uniformly across prompts, without checking whether the teacher is reliable for each prompt. Because reverse KL is mode-seeking, a confidently wrong teacher can induce a strong yet misleading update. Distributional proxies, such as entropy or teacher-student likelihood agreement, measure uncertainty or agreement but do not directly verify outcome correctness. We introduce Teacher-Gated On-Policy Distillation (TGOPD), built on the principle that teacher reliability should be verified at the prompt level before dense supervision is admitted. TGOPD estimates reliability from a small set of verifier-scored teacher probes and routes each prompt exclusively to dense OPD when the reliability check passes or to verifier-grounded GRPO otherwise. Across 4B and 35B students in mathematics, code, and instruction following, TGOPD outperforms Vanilla OPD in all six single-domain settings and achieves higher seven-benchmark averages at both scales under multi-domain training. By using otherwise-idle teacher capacity for reliability estimation, TGOPD also reduces teacher-side compute waste in asynchronous OPD, increasing teacher-node GPU utilization from 9.8% to 78.9% in the measured 4B single-domain run.

title: Causal Foundation Models
summary: Causal inference is the practice of estimating the effect of a treatment or intervention from data. It traditionally requires a bespoke pipeline for every new problem: first proposing a causal mechanism, selecting a compatible estimator, and finally training it. Meanwhile, across diverse settings and modalities, much of machine learning has shifted to the paradigm of foundation models: networks pretrained once at scale and applied to new tasks without fine-tuning. Causal foundation models (CFMs) bring this paradigm to causal inference. CFMs are pretrained neural networks that estimate causal quantities, such as the average treatment effect, on entirely new datasets using in-context learning without requiring model updates. This work provides a practical introduction to this emerging area. We summarize the necessary background in causal inference and machine learning before discussing CFMs. Throughout, we include example code and Jupyter notebooks.

title: Unifying Conformal Language Tasks with In-Context Ensembles
comments: Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/conformal-relevance
summary: Many NLP tasks, such as summarization and extractive question answering, reduce to retrieving relevant content from documents under two constraints: coverage, retaining enough pertinent information to achieve some goal, and conciseness, removing as much irrelevant information as possible. Conformal prediction methods have been used to guarantee coverage, and must be optimized for conciseness through design of a score function. State-of-the-art scoring functions use hand-engineered LLM prompts asking the model to rate the importance of content, but manual prompt engineering is labor-intensive and task-specific. We introduce the Conformal Relevance framework which uses in-context learning example curation and ensembling to create a score function which maintains coverage while improving conciseness with minimal manual input. We demonstrate this framework's application on seven NLP tasks, and also theoretically study the impact of diversity for ensembled conformal scores, giving a complementarity condition that characterizes when ensembling improves worst-case sentence scores, and a saturation bound on ensemble improvement.
comment: Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/conformal-relevance

title: ObserverBench: Testing Mechanistic Estimates for Intervention and Control
comments: 28 pages, 4 figures. Code, benchmark, leaderboards, and submission interface: https://kwisatzh.github.io/observerbench/. Frozen artifact release: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22136091
summary:
Mechanistic interpretability is increasingly used to guide interventions such as activation steering, circuit removal, and safety monitoring. Yet an internal estimate that is accurate on average can still choose a poor action.
  We present ObserverBench, a benchmark framework for testing whether an internal estimator---an observer---is adequate for the intervention, control, or safety task it directs. Each task fixes the model, information boundary, allowed actions, decision rule, held-out cases, and loss. The benchmark reports estimation accuracy separately from the loss caused by the chosen action.
  Theory and experiments show why both are needed. In closed-loop control, observer errors matter at the starting point and along directions the allowed intervention can reach. On circuit-intervention tasks in GPT-2-small and Qwen2.5-7B, pairwise observers predict unseen effects more accurately without always choosing better actions; observers trained on action loss choose lower-loss actions. In safety triage, a score that perfectly separates violations can allocate a fixed intervention budget poorly when violations have different costs. Across Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma-2-9B-it, and prospectively frozen Qwen3.5-9B APPS tasks, AUROC can rank monitors differently from deployment loss, and the best information source changes across models. Sparse SAE readouts also trail their layer-matched dense controls on the reported Qwen panels, under disclosed activation-density or checkpoint mismatches.
  ObserverBench provides fixed task contracts, runnable baselines, and table-based submissions for evaluating interpretability methods through the actions they enable.
comment: 28 pages, 4 figures. Code, benchmark, leaderboards, and submission interface: https://kwisatzh.github.io/observerbench/. Frozen artifact release: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22136091

title: Requirements After the First Edit: Mining Late Requirement Emergence and Rework in Real-World Coding-Agent Sessions
summary: Coding agents often implement changes before users have fully articulated their requirements, echoing a pattern from requirements engineering: stakeholders cannot express a constraint until part of the system exists to react to. This volatility is associated with schedule and budget overruns in traditional projects, but only at release-cycle granularity. Existing work on coding agents narrows this gap only partway: curated benchmarks fix requirements before implementation by design, and observational studies report pushback frequency without linking arrivals to the code invalidation they cause. We address this using 3,553 eligible SWE-chat sessions, coding post-implementation requirement arrivals along three dimensions and, where repository state can be replayed, linking each arrival to a proxy: deletion or replacement of prior agent-authored lines. A requirement's arrival is followed by roughly twice as much invalidation as matched non-requirement edits, robust to user-turn and net-deletion checks, though not demonstrated as causal. This burden shows no detectable decline over a session and no detected association with operation type once multiplicity is accounted for; several intervals remain wide. A controlled experiment shows delayed disclosure relocates implementation post-reveal, while advance warning produces no detected effect on overwriting. These results establish late requirement emergence as a measurable source of code invalidation.

title: Hosting Capacity Assessment of Data Centers with Voltage Ride-Through Capability in Power Systems
summary: Large data centers are emerging as concentrated, power-electronic grid loads whose abrupt disconnection or transfer to on-site backup supply during voltage disturbances can remove large demand from the power system, and may create a system-level stability problem. Their interconnection feasibility therefore depends not only on steady-state thermal and voltage limits, but also on whether internal power-conditioning systems can maintain IT service while limiting customer-initiated load reduction. This paper presents a voltage ride-through (VRT)-aware data center and grid co-planning framework that couples transmission-level fault simulation with an internal data center ride-through model. Python-based dynamic simulations generate point-of-interconnection (POI) voltage trajectories under selected network faults, and the resulting waveforms drive an internal model incorporating IT and cooling-load dynamics, DC-link, Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) response, and converter apparent power limits. The IEEE 118-bus case study shows that internal VRT capability can become a binding interconnection constraint: steady-state planning alone can overestimate feasible data center capacity, whereas increased UPS converter headroom progressively restores hosting capacity. Under the reduced-order response models studied, the grid-forming mode provides greater ride-through margin than the current-limited grid-following mode under the same network fault conditions. The results further show that VRT constraints can materially change both the total hosting capacity of data centers and its spatial allocation across candidate interconnection buses.

title: You Can't Escape Your Own Activations : Evaluation Awareness and Multi-Agent Monitoring
summary: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems, where they can collude while keeping their actions benign. Output monitors designed to detect such collusions can be fooled by obfuscation and steganography, motivating the use of probes trained on internal activations. However, these probes are usually evaluated on agents that do not know they are being watched. We study how activation-based detection changes when agents are explicitly informed that their internal activations are being monitored, and when they additionally receive feedback from the monitor. We keep the models, probes, and thresholds fixed and change only what the agents are told: nothing (baseline), that an activation monitor is present (aware), or that a monitor is present together with the previous round's score (feedback). We test two games, a four-agent blackjack game and a two-agent Simmons prisoners game, using Qwen3-32B-AWQ and GPT-OSS-20B in homogeneous and mixed pairings. Telling agents about the monitor does not hide them. The best probes stay accurate in all three conditions, and the agents keep colluding.

title: Population-Calibrated Graph Screening at 835-Million-Address Scale, with Label-Free Transfer to New Chains
comments: 25 pages, 9 tables. Code and evaluation harness: https://github.com/ai-decisions
summary: Compliance screening of blockchain addresses is, in practice, a lookup against sanctions registries plus clustering heuristics; it fails on unlabelled addresses and on chains with no label coverage at all. We describe a deployed system that scores an address by its position in a multi-chain transaction graph rather than by its presence in a list. The substrate is a single graph of 835,330,427 addresses and 15,826,261,934 edges across five EVM chains; a shared inductive encoder with per-chain normalisation feeds two scoring heads. Decision thresholds are exact quantiles of the score distribution over the full population, scanned per chain segment, so the alert volume is known in advance. We report: label-free transfer: heads trained on two chains recall 0.8598 / 0.8182 / 0.9967 of held-out positives on Base, Arbitrum and Gnosis at a $10^{-3}$ population alert rate, with no target-chain labels in head training; a static lead-time replay over 68 external registry events: 40 of 68 (58.8%) flagged at the 0.1% budget, $\times$152 over an event-level random-flagging baseline, with first on-chain appearance a median of 528.8 days (Ethereum) / 647.8 days (Tron) before public designation; a serving path whose score is bit-identical to the offline artefact at end-to-end p50 151 ms, gated by a 2,882-address drift panel; and an adversarial harness of eight recurrent reinforcement-learned archetypes that passes an 8-criterion degeneracy audit and, on a detector-independent snapshot, exposes a measured blind spot of the deployed heads against synthesised behaviour.
comment: 25 pages, 9 tables. Code and evaluation harness: https://github.com/ai-decisions

title: SHELF: A Synthetic Harness for Multi-Task Bibliographic Benchmarking
comments: 17 pages, 15 tables. Code available at https://github.com/mjbommar/shelf-benchmark ; data available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mjbommar/SHELF
summary: Libraries and archives manage large collections with limited staff and computing budgets, yet common benchmarks do not systematically test their bibliographic work. They need to know which methods work for their tasks and what those methods require to run. SHELF, the Synthetic Harness for Evaluating LLM Fitness, addresses this gap. It is a Python system that turns labelled taxonomies, writing specifications, and a generation budget into controlled benchmark data and evaluation tasks. This first release contains 62,899 model-written documents based on Library of Congress vocabularies, with tasks for classification, clustering, retrieval, pair classification, and instruction retrieval. We compare TF, TF-IDF, BM25, popular encoders, and, on subject classification only, zero-shot decoders; each method appears only on tasks that support it. Subject classification reaches 0.8887, while genre-form classification reaches only 0.2605, and several pair and clustering tasks remain near chance. Sparse methods remain competitive on classification, while TF-IDF is the fastest measured arm in the subject timing experiment. SHELF also varies bibliographic facets independently and can generate new, verifiably unseen documents after a model's training cutoff. Comparisons with LCSHBench and Project Gutenberg show that model rankings transfer more reliably than absolute scores, but SHELF scores do not estimate accuracy on production catalogue data. We release all source code and data under permissive licenses on GitHub and Hugging Face.
comment: 17 pages, 15 tables. Code available at https://github.com/mjbommar/shelf-benchmark ; data available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mjbommar/SHELF

title: IDSPACE: A Novel Document Generator for Reliable Evaluation of Digital Identity Verification Systems [Extended Technical Report]
summary: As services move online, trust institutions such as banks, lenders, and governments must verify the identity of remote users. Fraud detection tools are widely available, but evaluating and fine-tuning them remains difficult because identity documents are sensitive and therefore scarce. Synthetic data generation offers a path forward, and demand is clear: our prior work in this area has been downloaded over $11{,}000$ times (aggregated from eight parts). We introduce IDSpace, extending this line of research in three directions. First, we propose model-guided Bayesian optimization, which tunes generation parameters to maximize both visual similarity and prediction consistency with target-domain models given only a few samples from a target domain. Second, we decouple user-specified metadata (demographics, fraud patterns, capture device) from automatically tuned control parameters (font styles, noise levels, image quality), allowing users to configure evaluations without low-level expertise. Third, we expand beyond template images to support scanned and mobile-captured documents. Experiments show IDSpace improves evaluation consistency by $15-45\%$ over baselines including CycleGAN, diffusion inpainting, and non-guided optimization, using only a few real samples, while improving training accuracy by up to $9\%$ and SSIM similarity with the target domain by $10\%$. We also released a new dataset consisting of $359{,}240$ high-quality synthetic documents across ten European ID types.

title: Seeing Less Is Not Seeing Safely: Privacy Leakage from Task-Scoped Robot Perception Exports
summary: Domestic robots rely on rich perception to operate in private homes, but privacy risk persists even when raw sensor data remain local. Structured representations exported to downstream planners, cloud services, logs, or learning pipelines can still reveal household information through semantics, geometry, spatial structure, and task targets. We introduce Task-Functional Perception Distillation (TFPD), a task-scoped representation-export framework that keeps rich perception local and profiles downstream exports according to task utility, direct exposure, and multiple residual inference risks. Using 120 AI2-THOR scenes with scene-disjoint train/validation/test splits, frozen attacker selection, and representation-aware held-out attacks, we evaluate navigation, collision checking, and object-goal execution. Three navigation exports achieve identical success (1.000) and mean path ratio (0.898), yet representation-level linkability ranges from 0.532 to 0.970. Replacing an explicit target label with a target region reduces target-category macro-F1 from 1.000 to 0.077 while preserving success at 0.995, while geometric coarsening reduces object-category macro-F1 from 0.704 to 0.556 at a measurable collision-utility cost. A ProcTHOR replication preserves the navigation task-equivalence/privacy-inequivalence finding while changing the relative ordering of normalized and topological exports. These results show that neither field removal nor stronger abstraction induces a universal privacy ordering and motivate task-specific, multi-risk evaluation of the complete public representation.

title: Fully Fluctuating Sleepy Consensus from Minimal Assumptions
summary:
Bitcoin's proof-of-work (PoW)-based protocol is remarkable for how little it asks of its participants. Not only can miners take breaks from work whenever they please, but it is almost unique in offering a path of contrition: corrupt miners can reclaim honest status simply by resuming mining on the longest chain. The protocol only requires that honest miners hold the majority of computational power at any given time. Analogous proof-of-stake (PoS) protocols, usually formalized via the sleepy model of Pass and Shi (2017), have fallen short of matching this robustness. In fact, sleepy consensus protocols in the plain PKI model must heavily restrict fluctuations in adversarial participation over time. The recent work of Efron, Neu, and Pitassi (2025) enables fully fluctuating participation in the sleepy model by introducing the external adversary model. Their protocol, however, relies on verifiable delay functions (VDFs), a strong cryptographic primitive that somewhat resembles PoW, by assuming that the adversary cannot compute sequential work significantly faster than honest nodes.
  In this work, we design a sleepy consensus protocol for fully fluctuating participation with an external adversary under an honest majority, from minimal assumptions: a public key infrastructure (PKI) and a verifiable random function (VRF). In particular, we make no VDF or hardware assumptions. Our key technique is graded wakeness, a novel primitive that allows nodes to form consistent opinions on which other nodes are awake. We further extend our protocol to handle uncorruption, where corrupt nodes return to honesty. This extension requires only a mild additional assumption on the unpredictability of VRF outputs for liveness.

title: Differentially private federated learning with Byzantine-robust aggregation: A cross-domain framework for secure model training in banking and healthcare systems
summary: Federated learning allows banks, hospitals, and other regulated organizations to train a shared model without moving raw records off their own servers, which is attractive wherever data protection law or competitive sensitivity rules out pooling data centrally. Two problems limit how far this promise can be trusted in practice. First, the parameter updates that clients exchange still leak information about local records through gradient inversion and membership inference attacks. Second, an honest averaging rule such as FedAvg has no defense against a subset of clients that submit corrupted or adversarial updates, so a small number of malicious or compromised participants can quietly steer the shared model off course. This paper presents a federated learning framework, DP-BR-FedAvg, that combines a Gaussian-mechanism differential privacy layer with a coordinate-wise trimmed-mean Byzantine-robust aggregation rule, evaluated on a simulated cross-institutional classification task resembling fraud and clinical-risk scoring. Across sixty communication rounds with twenty clients, a quarter of them Byzantine, plain FedAvg collapses on the minority class (F1-score 0.030) while the proposed framework recovers substantially more of the signal (F1-score 0.119) while bounding the privacy loss of any single client's contribution. A Byzantine-robust aggregator with no privacy layer performs best in raw accuracy, quantifying the cost privacy imposes on robustness. The results show that privacy and robustness mechanisms interact rather than simply add, and that system design for regulated, adversarial, cross-institutional settings needs to budget for that interaction.

AI.title_translation: 差分隐私联邦学习与拜占庭鲁棒聚合：银行和医疗系统安全模型训练的跨领域框架
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合差分隐私和拜占庭鲁棒聚合的联邦学习框架DP-BR-FedAvg，用于在银行和医疗等受监管环境中安全训练模型，解决了数据泄露和恶意客户端攻击问题。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在数据保护法规严格的银行和医院等机构中很有吸引力，但存在两个问题：1. 客户端交换的参数更新会通过梯度反演和成员推断攻击泄露本地记录信息。2. 联邦平均（FedAvg）等聚合规则无法防御恶意或受损客户端提交的损坏或对抗性更新，导致共享模型偏离轨道。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个名为DP-BR-FedAvg的联邦学习框架。该框架结合了高斯机制差分隐私层与坐标级截断均值拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则。研究在模拟的跨机构分类任务（如欺诈和临床风险评分）上进行了评估。
AI.result: 在与二十个客户端（其中四分之一是拜占庭式）进行的六十轮通信中，普通的FedAvg在少数类别上崩溃（F1-score 0.030），而所提出的DP-BR-FedAvg框架显著恢复了更多信号（F1-score 0.119），同时限制了任何单个客户端贡献的隐私损失。没有隐私层的拜占庭鲁棒聚合器在原始准确性方面表现最佳，这量化了隐私对鲁棒性造成的成本。结果表明，隐私和鲁棒性机制是相互作用而非简单叠加的。
AI.conclusion: 隐私和鲁棒性机制是相互作用而非简单叠加的，因此在受监管、对抗性、跨机构环境中的系统设计需要预算这种相互作用。DP-BR-FedAvg框架能有效解决联邦学习中的隐私泄露和拜占庭攻击问题。
AI.translation: 联邦学习允许银行、医院和其他受监管组织在不将原始记录移出其自身服务器的情况下训练共享模型，这在数据保护法律或竞争敏感性规则排除集中数据池的情况下极具吸引力。然而，在实践中，这一承诺的可信度受到两个问题的限制。首先，客户端交换的参数更新仍然会通过梯度反演和成员推断攻击泄露有关本地记录的信息。其次，像FedAvg这样的诚实平均规则无法防御提交损坏或对抗性更新的客户端子集，因此少数恶意或受损参与者可以悄悄地使共享模型偏离轨道。本文提出了一个联邦学习框架，DP-BR-FedAvg，它将高斯机制差分隐私层与坐标级截断均值拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则相结合，并在模拟的跨机构分类任务（类似于欺诈和临床风险评分）上进行了评估。在与二十个客户端（其中四分之一是拜占庭式）进行的六十轮通信中，普通的FedAvg在少数类别上崩溃（F1-score 0.030），而所提出的框架显著恢复了更多信号（F1-score 0.119），同时限制了任何单个客户端贡献的隐私损失。没有隐私层的拜占庭鲁棒聚合器在原始准确性方面表现最佳，量化了隐私对鲁棒性造成的成本。结果表明，隐私和鲁棒性机制是相互作用而非简单叠加的，并且在受监管、对抗性、跨机构环境中进行系统设计需要考虑这种相互作用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个名为DP-BR-FedAvg的联邦学习框架，旨在解决银行和医疗等受监管环境中联邦学习面临的隐私泄露和恶意客户端攻击问题。该框架结合了高斯机制差分隐私和拜占庭鲁棒聚合，以确保模型训练的安全性和数据的私密性。实验结果表明，DP-BR-FedAvg在存在拜占庭攻击的情况下显著优于传统的FedAvg，同时平衡了隐私保护和模型性能，并揭示了隐私与鲁棒性机制之间的复杂相互作用。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 差分隐私, 拜占庭鲁棒性, 安全模型训练, 跨领域
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将差分隐私和拜占庭鲁棒聚合机制有机结合，形成一个全面的联邦学习框架，特别适用于数据敏感的行业。其重要性在于为在严格监管环境下实现安全、可靠的联邦学习提供了实用解决方案。论文还强调了隐私和鲁棒性机制并非简单叠加，而是存在复杂交互，这对未来的系统设计具有指导意义。

title: Dynamic Operational Reserve Margin Assessment from Risk-Constrained Unit Commitment States
summary: We propose Dynamic Reserve Margin (DRM) as a time-varying operational adequacy metric derived from risk-constrained unit commitment (RCUC) states. DRM quantifies reserve adequacy using the additional generation capacity that committed generators can provide within a 5-minute response window relative to uncertainty and contingency reserve requirements. We introduce a complementary Reserve Risk Envelope (RRE) metric to quantify operational reserve headroom in directly interpretable MW terms. A low-margin duration metric is further developed to quantify the persistence of reserve stress over an operating horizon. We use an IEEE 14-bus example to illustrate these concepts, followed by large-scale RCUC case studies under multiple operating scenarios. Results demonstrate that reserve requirements and ramp-accessible reserve capability can vary substantially across operating conditions, and that commitment decisions adapt to maintain reserve adequacy under changing system conditions. The proposed DRM and RRE metrics provide an interpretable operational characterization of reserve adequacy, reveal reserve accessibility and stress persistence that are not captured by conventional reserve margin metrics.

AI.title_translation: 基于风险约束机组组合状态的动态运行备用裕度评估
AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于风险约束机组组合状态的动态备用裕度（DRM）和备用风险包络（RRE）指标，用于在考虑短时爬坡能力和压力持续性的情况下精确评估电力系统运行备用充裕度。
AI.motivation: 传统的备用裕度指标无法有效捕捉备用的短时可达性（如爬坡能力受限）以及整个运行周期内备用压力的持续性。
AI.method: 提出基于风险约束机组组合（RCUC）状态的时变运行充裕度指标——动态备用裕度（DRM），结合5分钟响应窗口内的爬坡可达容量评估备用；引入以MW表示的备用风险包络（RRE）量化运行备用裕量；提出低裕度持续时间指标量化备用压力持续性；并在IEEE 14节点及大规模系统案例中进行验证。
AI.result: 备用需求和爬坡可达备用能力在不同运行工况下差异显著；机组组合决策能够自适应调整以维持动态系统条件下的备用充裕度；该指标成功揭示了传统指标忽视的备用可达性与压力持续性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的DRM和RRE等指标为运行备用充裕度提供了直观且可解释的表征手段，能够有效揭示传统备用裕度指标所无法体现的备用可达性及系统备用压力持续性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了动态备用裕度（DRM）作为一种源自风险约束机组组合（RCUC）状态的时变运行充裕度指标。DRM通过在5分钟响应窗口内已开机机组可提供的额外发电容量（相对于不确定性和事故备用需求）来量化备用充裕度。我们还引入了一种互补的备用风险包络（RRE）指标，以直接可解释的兆瓦（MW）形式量化运行备用裕量。此外，进一步开发了低裕度持续时间指标，以量化运行周期内备用压力的持续性。我们采用IEEE 14节点算例对这些概念进行阐述，随后在多种运行场景下开展了大规模RCUC案例研究。结果表明，备用需求和受爬坡约束的备用能力在不同运行工况下存在显著差异，且机组组合决策能够自适应调整以在变化的系统条件下保持备用充裕度。所提出的DRM和RRE指标为备用充裕度提供了可解释的运行表征，揭示了传统备用裕度指标无法捕捉的备用可达性和压力持续性。
AI.summary: 本文针对传统备用指标无法反映备用可达性与压力持续性的问题，提出了基于风险约束机组组合（RCUC）状态的动态备用裕度（DRM）指标，该指标考虑了5分钟响应窗口内的可达容量。同时提出了备用风险包络（RRE）与低裕度持续时间指标，算例分析验证了这些指标在表征时变备用充裕度和指导机组组合决策中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 动态备用裕度, 风险约束机组组合, 运行充裕度, 备用风险包络, 低裕度持续时间
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于跳出了传统静态、总量备用指标的局限，结合RCUC状态引入了考虑机组5分钟短时爬坡响应能力的动态备用裕度（DRM）及直观的MW级备用风险包络（RRE），并提出了低裕度持续时间指标以反映压力持续性。其局限在于摘要未详细说明应对多重不确定性建模的具体计算复杂度。

title: GPU-Accelerated Astrodynamics World Models for Spacecraft Rendezvous and Proximity Operations
comments: 20 pages, 12 figures, 5 tables, Presented at Advanced Maui Optical and Space Surveillance Technologies Conference 2026
summary: World models are an emerging paradigm in representation learning in which an agent jointly learns state-action dynamics and observation models from offline trajectory data, enabling multi-step planning and trajectory prediction with uncertainty estimates. They have shown strong results in robotics and game environments, but, to the best of our knowledge, have not previously been applied to the space domain. This paper introduces a world model-based approach to cooperative and non-cooperative spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations. First, we introduce an open-source, JAX-based International Space Station (ISS) docking environment supporting parallel GPU simulation of spacecraft orbit and attitude dynamics, generating the thousands of state-action transitions that world model training requires. Second, we introduce Out-of-this-World-Model, a transformer-based world model that encodes relative kinematic states and body-fixed camera imagery into a latent state and predicts its evolution under commanded thrusts and torques using one-step flow matching. It produces a distribution over future observations, capturing stochastic dynamics and per-timestep uncertainty, and outperforms DreamerV3-style posterior-correction baselines with fewer trainable parameters and hyperparameters. Third, we apply the approach to a capsule autonomously docking with the ISS under keep-out-zone constraints, demonstrating improved sample efficiency and task performance over reinforcement learning baselines (53% versus 29% docking success across ports), better out-of-distribution generalization (on held-out ports the world model more than doubles baseline success, 40% versus 17%), and detection of anomalous objects encountered during approach with 98% classification accuracy. We open-source the simulation environment and model architecture to enable further study of this paradigm.
comment: 20 pages, 12 figures, 5 tables, Presented at Advanced Maui Optical and Space Surveillance Technologies Conference 2026

AI.title_translation: GPU加速的天体动力学世界模型用于航天器交会与近距离操作
AI.tldr: 本文提出并开源了GPU加速的天体动力学世界模型，用于航天器交会与近距离操作，并在新的ISS对接模拟中展示了比强化学习基线更好的性能和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 世界模型在机器人和游戏环境中取得了显著成果，但尚未应用于航天领域。本文旨在弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 首先，本文引入了一个基于JAX的开源国际空间站（ISS）对接环境，支持航天器轨道和姿态动力学的并行GPU模拟。其次，提出了一个名为“Out-of-this-World-Model”的基于Transformer的世界模型，该模型将相对运动状态和体固相机图像编码为潜在状态，并使用一步流匹配预测其在指令推力和扭矩下的演变，生成未来观测的分布。最后，将该方法应用于在禁区约束下胶囊与ISS的自主对接。
AI.result: 1. 相较于强化学习基线，样本效率和任务性能有所提高（跨端口对接成功率从29%提高到53%）。2. 具有更好的域外泛化能力（在保留端口上，世界模型的成功率是基线的两倍多，从17%提高到40%）。3. 在接近过程中异常物体检测的分类准确率达到98%。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地将基于世界模型的方法引入并应用于航天器交会和近距离操作，与传统的强化学习基线相比，展示了卓越的性能和泛化能力，并开源了相关工具以促进进一步研究。
AI.translation: 世界模型是一种新兴的表征学习范式，其中智能体从离线轨迹数据中共同学习状态-动作动力学和观测模型，从而能够进行多步规划和带有不确定性估计的轨迹预测。它们在机器人和游戏环境中显示出强大的结果，但据我们所知，以前尚未应用于航天领域。本文介绍了一种基于世界模型的方法，用于合作和非合作航天器交会与近距离操作。首先，我们引入了一个开源的、基于JAX的国际空间站（ISS）对接环境，支持航天器轨道和姿态动力学的并行GPU模拟，生成世界模型训练所需的数千个状态-动作转换。其次，我们引入了“Out-of-this-World-Model”，这是一个基于Transformer的世界模型，它将相对运动状态和体固相机图像编码为潜在状态，并使用一步流匹配预测其在指令推力和扭矩下的演变。它生成未来观测的分布，捕获随机动力学和每个时间步的不确定性，并且在更少的训练参数和超参数下，性能优于DreamerV3风格的后验校正基线。第三，我们将该方法应用于在禁区约束下胶囊与ISS的自主对接，与强化学习基线相比，展示了改进的样本效率和任务性能（跨端口对接成功率分别为53%和29%），更好的域外泛化能力（在保留端口上，世界模型成功率是基线的两倍多，分别为40%和17%），以及在接近过程中以98%的分类准确率检测异常物体。我们开源了仿真环境和模型架构，以促进对该范式的进一步研究。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于世界模型的方法，用于航天器交会与近距离操作，填补了世界模型在该领域应用的空白。研究开发了一个开源的、基于JAX的ISS对接仿真环境，以及一个基于Transformer的“Out-of-this-World-Model”，用于从轨迹数据中学习天体动力学。在自主对接场景中，该方法在性能、样本效率、域外泛化能力和异常物体检测方面均优于强化学习基线，突显了世界模型在航天应用中的巨大潜力。
AI.keywords: GPU加速, 天体动力学, 世界模型, 航天器交会, 近距离操作
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于首次将世界模型应用于航天领域，特别是航天器交会与近距离操作。开发一个开源的、GPU加速的基于JAX的仿真环境是一个重要的贡献，为未来的研究奠定了基础。“Out-of-this-World-Model”在参数更少的情况下，比现有基线表现出显著的性能提升，表明这是一种更高效、更鲁棒的复杂天体动力学任务方法。仿真环境和模型架构的开源值得称赞，将极大地有益于研究社区。

title: Dimensional hyperreduction of nonlinear finite element models via empirical cubature with manifold-adaptive weights
summary: Nonlinear-manifold reduced-order models for parametrized finite element problems can achieve substantial compression both in the number of generalized (latent) coordinates and, through sampling-and-weighting hyperreduction, in the number of sampled elements/integration points. Yet current sampling-and-weighting approaches employ weights that remain fixed over the solution manifold. We contend that this restriction leaves hyperreduction potential untapped: allowing the weights to vary continuously and nonlinearly with the latent coordinates can further decrease the number of sampled spatial entities. To exploit this possibility, we propose the Manifold-Adaptive-Weight Empirical Cubature Method (MAW-ECM). Starting from a feasible fixed-weight ECM rule, a greedy pruning strategy removes sampled entities through convex quadratic weight-redistribution problems enforcing local conditions and positivity. The method is assessed on two nonlinear benchmarks: homogenization of a metamaterial unit cell exhibiting negative incremental stiffness, and a history-dependent continuum-damage problem. In both cases, the nonlinear manifold is constructed from an initial linear compression followed by an input-informed identification of the latent coordinates as general linear combinations of the retained modal amplitudes, incorporating graph information when relevant to seek the intrinsic dimensionality of the solution manifold. We show that combining the nonlinear-manifold representation with MAW-ECM reduces the number of sampled integration points by more than two orders of magnitude relative to the corresponding standard linear reduced model. Relative to the fixed-weight manifold models alone, the adaptive weights eliminate approximately 80% of the remaining points in the homogenization benchmark and more than 97% in the damage benchmark, while essentially preserving their accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 非线性有限元模型的维数超降维：基于流形自适应权重的经验求积法
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的超降维方法MAW-ECM，用于非线性有限元模型，通过流形自适应权重显著减少采样积分点数量，同时保持精度，优于固定权重方法。
AI.motivation: 当前用于非线性流形降阶模型的采样和加权超降维方法采用固定权重，未能充分利用超降维潜力。本文旨在通过允许权重随潜在坐标连续非线性地变化，进一步减少采样空间实体的数量。
AI.method: 提出流形自适应权重经验求积法（MAW-ECM）。从可行的固定权重ECM规则开始，采用贪婪剪枝策略，通过强制执行局部条件和正性的凸二次权重再分配问题来移除采样实体。非线性流形通过初始线性压缩构建，随后是输入信息驱动的潜在坐标识别，作为保留模态振幅的广义线性组合，并在相关时纳入图信息以寻求解流形的内在维度。
AI.result: 结合非线性流形表示与MAW-ECM，相对于相应的标准线性降阶模型，采样积分点的数量减少了两个数量级以上。相对于单独的固定权重流形模型，自适应权重在均质化基准中消除了大约80%的剩余点，在损伤基准中消除了超过97%的剩余点，同时基本保持了它们的准确性。
AI.conclusion: MAW-ECM通过流形自适应权重有效减少了非线性有限元模型中的采样积分点数量，显著优于固定权重方法，同时保持了精度。
AI.translation: 非线性流形降阶模型用于参数化有限元问题，可以在广义（潜在）坐标的数量上，以及通过采样和加权超降维在采样单元/积分点的数量上实现实质性压缩。然而，当前的采样和加权方法采用的权重在解流形上保持固定。我们认为这种限制未能充分利用超降维的潜力：允许权重随潜在坐标连续非线性地变化可以进一步减少采样空间实体的数量。为了利用这种可能性，我们提出了流形自适应权重经验求积法（Manifold-Adaptive-Weight Empirical Cubature Method, MAW-ECM）。从一个可行的固定权重ECM规则开始，贪婪剪枝策略通过凸二次权重再分配问题移除采样实体，该问题强制执行局部条件和正性。该方法在两个非线性基准上进行了评估：表现出负增量刚度的超材料晶胞的均质化，以及历史依赖的连续损伤问题。在这两种情况下，非线性流形通过初始线性压缩构建，随后是输入信息驱动的潜在坐标识别，作为保留模态振幅的广义线性组合，并在相关时纳入图信息以寻求解流形的内在维度。我们表明，将非线性流形表示与MAW-ECM结合，相对于相应的标准线性降阶模型，采样积分点的数量减少了两个数量级以上。相对于单独的固定权重流形模型，自适应权重在均质化基准中消除了大约80%的剩余点，在损伤基准中消除了超过97%的剩余点，同时基本保持了它们的准确性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于非线性有限元模型超降维的流形自适应权重经验求积法（MAW-ECM）。与现有固定权重采样方法不同，MAW-ECM允许权重随潜在坐标连续非线性地自适应，从而通过贪婪剪枝策略显著减少采样空间实体的数量。该方法在均质化和连续损伤问题上进行了测试，MAW-ECM结合非线性流形表示，与线性模型相比，采样积分点减少了两个数量级以上；与固定权重流形模型相比，减少了80-97%的采样点，同时保持了精度。
AI.keywords: 超降维, 非线性有限元模型, 经验求积法, 流形自适应权重, 降阶模型
AI.comments: 该论文在非线性有限元模型的超降维技术方面取得了显著进展。其创新之处在于引入了流形自适应权重，解决了以往固定权重方法的局限性，并进一步释放了数据压缩的潜力。该方法在保持精度的同时大幅减少采样点的能力，对于复杂模拟中的计算效率至关重要。

title: Learnable composition for neural operators
summary: Neural operators are fast, differentiable surrogates for physical simulation, but their accuracy often degrades when domain geometry, size, or operating conditions differ from training. Supervised adaptation can recover accuracy, but even a small target set requires costly high-fidelity simulations. We therefore ask how pretraining and transfer can be designed together to reduce this deployment cost. LatentDDM first pretrains a neural operator to predict fields on small subdomains. For a new setting, it freezes this operator and trains only a lightweight module that composes the local predictions. We evaluate our method on two complementary problems: steady Darcy flow, where long-range pressure coupling must extend across increasingly large porous domains, and unsteady incompressible flow around a pitching airfoil, where rollout errors compound as target pitching frequencies exceed the training range. Compared with the capacity-matched models that process the full domain at once, LatentDDM's error is 36-56% lower on larger Darcy domains after adaptation with 16 target simulations. It also improves 20-step field rollouts in fast-pitching airfoil flow, both zero-shot and after few-shot calibration. These results identify the co-designed local pretraining and composition-level transfer as a promising design principle for physical foundation models.

AI.title_translation: 神经算子的可学习组合
AI.tldr: 本文提出LatentDDM，通过在小子域上预训练神经算子，并训练一个轻量级模块来组合局部预测，从而在不同于训练条件的新物理模拟设置中，显著降低了神经算子的部署成本并提高了准确性。
AI.motivation: 神经算子在物理模拟中作为快速、可微分的替代品，但在领域几何、大小或操作条件与训练不同时，其准确性会显著下降。传统的监督适应方法需要昂贵的高精度模拟数据，即使是小目标集也成本高昂。因此，本文旨在探索如何协同设计预训练和迁移策略以降低部署成本。
AI.method: 本文提出了LatentDDM方法。该方法首先预训练一个神经算子，使其能够预测小子域上的场。对于新的设置，该神经算子被冻结，仅训练一个轻量级的模块来组合这些局部预测。这种方法旨在通过局部预训练和组合层面的迁移来解决部署成本和泛化性问题。
AI.result: LatentDDM在达西流问题上，在经过16次目标模拟适应后，在较大的达西域上的误差比全域处理的容量匹配模型低36-56%。在俯仰翼型非定常不可压缩流中，无论是在零样本还是少样本校准后，它都改善了快速俯仰流中的20步场展开。这些结果表明，协同设计的局部预训练和组合级迁移是一种有前景的物理基础模型设计原则。
AI.conclusion: 本文的结论是，协同设计的局部预训练和组合层面的迁移是物理基础模型的一种有前景的设计原则。LatentDDM通过在小区域上预训练神经算子并只训练一个轻量级模块来组合局部预测，有效解决了神经算子在不同训练条件下的准确性下降和部署成本高昂的问题。
AI.translation: 神经算子是物理模拟的快速、可微分的替代品，但当领域几何、大小或操作条件与训练不同时，其准确性通常会下降。监督适应可以恢复准确性，但即使是小的目标集也需要昂贵的高保真模拟。因此，我们提出如何协同设计预训练和迁移以降低部署成本。LatentDDM首先预训练一个神经算子，以预测小子域上的场。对于新的设置，它冻结该算子，并仅训练一个轻量级模块来组合局部预测。我们通过两个互补问题评估了我们的方法：稳定达西流，其中长程压力耦合必须扩展到越来越大的多孔域；以及俯仰翼型周围的非定常不可压缩流，其中当目标俯仰频率超过训练范围时，展开误差会累积。与同时处理整个域的容量匹配模型相比，LatentDDM在经过16次目标模拟适应后，在较大达西域上的误差降低了36-56%。它还改善了快速俯仰翼型流中的20步场展开，无论是零样本还是少样本校准后。这些结果表明，协同设计的局部预训练和组合级迁移是物理基础模型的一种有前景的设计原则。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为LatentDDM的新方法，旨在解决神经算子在面对与训练条件不同的物理模拟时准确性下降和部署成本高昂的问题。LatentDDM通过在小子域上预训练一个神经算子，并在新任务中冻结该算子，仅训练一个轻量级模块来组合局部预测。实验结果表明，该方法在达西流和俯仰翼型流问题上显著提高了准确性，并降低了误差，证明了局部预训练和组合级迁移作为物理基础模型设计原则的有效性。
AI.keywords: 神经算子, 可学习组合, 迁移学习, 物理模拟, 预训练
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了“可学习组合”的概念，通过将神经算子的预训练限制在小子域上，并引入一个轻量级的组合模块进行迁移学习，有效解决了神经算子在大规模和不同工况下的泛化性与部署成本问题。这种局部预训练与全局组合的协同设计，为构建更高效、更通用的物理基础模型提供了新的思路，对于推动AI在科学计算领域的应用具有重要意义。

title: Finite-Sample Limits of Entropy-Based Structure Identification in Discretized Nonlinear Systems
summary: Discretization fundamentally limits structure identification in stochastic systems. When system stochasticity exceeds the discretization resolution, entropy-based methods lose their ability to distinguish which input drives the output. We study this in Fuzzy Inductive Reasoning (FIR), a nonparametric framework for learning dynamical systems from discretized measurements, where the choice of input variables determines both predictive accuracy and the interpretability of the learned input--output relationships. Entropy-based selection targets explainability, i.e., identifying which variables causally drive the output, while mean-squared-error-based selection targets prediction. We introduce a resolution-stochasticity ratio that governs when entropy-based selection is reliable. Three results follow. First, entropy-based selection is consistent below this threshold but loses discriminative power above it, regardless of sample size. Second, using the entropy-selected variables for prediction instead of the MSE-selected ones incurs a closed-form excess prediction risk that grows with input complexity and shrinks with sample size. Third, reliable identification of the causally relevant inputs requires data that scales with the number of input combinations and inversely with the strength of the entropy signal. The theory is validated on a two-state Markov model and demonstrated on a distribution grid reliability dataset analyzing the impact of infrastructure investment, where the goal is to explain which investments drive reliability improvements rather than merely predict outcomes.

AI.title_translation: 离散化非线性系统中基于熵的结构识别的有限样本极限
AI.tldr: 本文研究了离散化非线性系统中基于熵的结构识别的有限样本极限，揭示了系统随机性与离散化分辨率对因果变量识别可靠性的制约机制。
AI.motivation: 离散化本质上限制了随机系统中的结构识别，当系统随机性超过离散化分辨率时，基于熵的方法会失效。研究旨在通过理论分析明确基于熵的选择方法何时可靠，并探究解释性与预测性目标之间的权衡。
AI.method: 引入分辨率-随机性比率（resolution-stochasticity ratio），分析其对模糊归纳推理（FIR）中熵基与均方误差基变量选择的影响，推导出过剩预测风险及样本复杂度界限，并在Markov模型和配电网数据集上进行验证。
AI.result: 1. 低于阈值时熵基选择具有一致性，高于阈值则丧失判别力（与样本量无关）；2. 用熵选择变量代替MSE选择变量会导致可计算的过剩预测风险；3. 可靠识别因果输入所需的数据量随输入组合数增加，并与熵信号强度成反比。
AI.conclusion: 离散化和系统随机性的相对大小决定了基于熵的结构识别的有效性，超越阈值后无视样本量均会失效，且解释性选择与预测性选择之间存在可量化的权衡。
AI.translation: 离散化从根本上限制了随机系统中的结构识别。当系统随机性超过离散化分辨率时，基于熵的方法就会失去区分哪个输入驱动输出的能力。我们在模糊归纳推理（FIR）中研究了这一点，FIR是一种从离散化测量中学习动力系统的非参数框架，其中输入变量的选择决定了所学习的输入-输出关系的预测准确性和可解释性。基于熵的选择侧重于可解释性，即识别哪些变量因果驱动输出，而基于均方误差的选择则侧重于预测。我们引入了一个控制基于熵的选择何时可靠的分辨率-随机性比率。得出三个结果。首先，基于熵的选择在该阈值以下是一致的，但在阈值以上会失去判别力，无论样本大小如何。其次，使用熵选择的变量进行预测而不是MSE选择的变量会产生一个随输入复杂度增长而随样本大小缩小的闭式过剩预测风险。第三，可靠识别因果相关的输入需要与输入组合数量成正比、与熵信号强度成反比的数据。该理论在一个两状态马尔可夫模型上得到了验证，并在一个分析基础设施投资影响的配电网可靠性数据集上进行了演示，其目标是解释哪些投资推动了可靠性的提高，而不仅仅是预测结果。
AI.summary: 本文研究了离散化非线性系统中基于熵的结构识别的有限样本极限。通过引入分辨率-随机性比率，揭示了系统随机性超过离散化分辨率时熵基方法失效的机理，量化了其与均方误差选择在预测风险上的差异，并给出了可靠因果输入识别所需的样本规模边界。
AI.keywords: 离散化非线性系统, 结构识别, 模糊归纳推理, 熵基选择, 有限样本极限
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了离散化对非线性系统中基于熵的结构识别的根本限制，引入了解辨率-随机性比率，并定量给出了有限样本下的理论边界与过剩预测风险，具有重要的理论和实际应用价值。

title: Position: Unlabeled IS NOT Equal to No Human Supervision in Visual Learning
summary: This position paper argues that the absence of labels does not imply the absence of human supervision in visual learning, and urges the research community to identify sources of supervision more explicitly. Many recent methods in computer vision build upon representations learned from large-scale unlabeled data, and are therefore grouped under the same umbrella term ``unsupervised.'' However, different data curation schemes and training objectives embed substantially different human priors on which models rely, and we argue that one ``unsupervised'' umbrella term is no longer capturing these distinctions. This ambiguity makes it harder to compare unsupervised learning research conducted under different assumptions, coinciding with a sharp decline in papers titled with ``unsupervised'' in flagship computer vision conferences since 2021, despite continued growth of the field. While we fully embrace pre-training as a strong foundation for modern computer vision, we advocate for a community-level effort toward greater conceptual clarity: authors are encouraged to disclose priors in data selection and learning objectives, and to specify which components of a learning pipeline depend on which assumptions. Standardized disclosure practices can improve academic communication, ensure fairer comparisons, and preserve methodological diversity in unsupervised learning.

AI.title_translation: 立场：在视觉学习中，无标记并不等于没有人类监督
AI.tldr: 本文主张取消笼统的“无监督”学习称呼，呼吁计算机视觉研究人员明确公开视觉学习模型中包含的人类先验和假设。
AI.motivation: 指出当前计算机视觉中将所有基于大规模未标记数据的学习方法统称为“无监督”的现象掩盖了不同数据策划方案和训练目标中嵌入的显著人类先验，导致概念模糊和比较困难。
AI.method: 通过立场论文的形式，分析当前计算机视觉中“无监督”概念的模糊性，呼吁建立更明确的监督来源识别和标准化的先验披露实践。
AI.result: 指出了“无监督”术语在旗舰计算机视觉会议上自2021年以来呈急剧下降趋势的现状，并提出了改进学术交流、确保公平比较及保持方法多样性的建议。
AI.conclusion: 无监督视觉学习并没有真正脱离人类监督，研究界应当采用更加精确和标准化的披露实践来明确其人类先验和假设。
AI.translation: 这篇立场论文认为，在视觉学习中，没有标签并不意味着没有人类监督，并敦促研究界更明确地识别监督来源。计算机视觉中的许多最新方法建立在从大规模未标记数据中学习到的表征之上，因此被归入“无监督”这一统称之下。然而，不同的数据策划方案和训练目标嵌入了本质上不同的人类先验，模型依赖于这些先验，我们认为单一的“无监督”统称已无法捕捉这些区别。这种模糊性使得在不同假设下进行的无监督学习研究更难进行比较，这与2021年以来旗舰计算机视觉会议上标题带有“无监督”的论文急剧下降的趋势相吻合，尽管该领域仍在持续增长。虽然我们完全支持将预训练作为现代计算机视觉的坚强基石，但我们倡导全行业共同努力以实现更大的概念清晰度：鼓励作者披露数据选择和学习目标中的先验，并指定学习管道的哪些部分依赖于哪些假设。标准化的披露实践可以改善学术交流，确保更公平的比较，并保持无监督学习的方法论多样性。
AI.summary: 本文是一篇立场论文，探讨了视觉学习中“无监督”并不等于没有人类监督的观点。作者指出，当前将各种依赖未标记数据的学习方法统称为“无监督”模糊了不同人类先验的区别。为了提高概念清晰度并促进公平比较，文章呼吁研究人员明确披露数据选择和学习目标中的先验假设。
AI.keywords: 计算机视觉, 无监督学习, 人类监督, 数据先验, 方法论
AI.comments: 该立场论文切中当前计算机视觉领域“无监督学习”命名泛化、概念模糊的痛点，呼吁研究界更加清晰地披露数据选择和学习目标中的人类先验，对规范该领域的学术交流和方法评估具有重要意义。

title: Practical Threshold-based Tree Edit Distance Lower-Bounds
summary: Threshold-based similarity search over tree-structured data using tree edit distance (TED) is computationally intensive. Given a query tree and a database of trees, the goal is to retrieve all trees within a predefined TED threshold $τ$. Because exact TED computation is expensive, practical methods employ lower-bounds to prune dissimilar candidates before verification. Existing lower-bounds exhibit a fundamental trade-off: inexpensive statistical and structural bounds provide limited pruning power, whereas the more precise traversal-based string edit distance (SED) bound is expensive to compute using standard quadratic dynamic programming. Moreover, previous comparative studies do not cover recent structural filters or threshold-aware SED implementations, leaving their practical trade-offs unclear. In this article, we first provide a comprehensive experimental comparison of state-of-the-art TED lower-bounds in terms of pruning precision and computational cost. We then accelerate the SED lower-bound using Ukkonen's bounded string edit distance algorithm, substantially reducing its runtime without affecting its pruning power. Finally, we introduce the SED-struct threshold filter, which strengthens SED with axes-aware constraints capturing structural relationships among tree nodes. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that SED-struct consistently achieves the highest filtering precision while retaining practical filtering costs. The results suggest that SED-struct is particularly beneficial for heterogeneous tree collections in which the standard SED lower-bound achieves relatively low precision.

AI.title_translation: 实用的基于阈值的树编辑距离下界
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SED-struct的新型树编辑距离下界滤波器，通过结合字符串编辑距离和轴感知结构约束，显著提高了树相似性搜索的剪枝精度和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的树编辑距离（TED）下界存在根本性的权衡：廉价的统计和结构界限过滤能力有限，而更精确的基于遍历的字符串编辑距离（SED）界限计算代价高昂，且缺乏对最新结构滤波器和阈值感知SED实现的全面比较。
AI.method: 首先对最先进的TED下界进行了全面的实验比较；其次利用Ukkonen的有界字符串编辑距离算法加速SED下界；最后引入SED-struct阈值滤波器，通过轴感知约束增强SED以捕捉树节点间的结构关系。
AI.result: 实验表明，SED-struct在合成和真实数据集上始终实现最高的过滤精度，同时保持了实用的过滤成本，特别适合标准SED下界精度相对较低的异构树集合。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的SED-struct阈值滤波器在保持实用过滤成本的同时，显著提高了树编辑距离下界的过滤精度，特别适用于异构树集合。
AI.translation: 基于树编辑距离（TED）的树结构数据阈值相似性搜索计算量极大。给定查询树和树数据库，目标是检索预定义TED阈值 $\tau$ 内的所有树。由于精确的TED计算代价高昂，实际方法采用下界在验证前剪枝不相似的候选对象。现有的下界表现出一种根本性的权衡：廉价的统计和结构界限提供的剪枝能力有限，而更精确的基于遍历的字符串编辑距离（SED）界限使用标准二次动态规划计算代价高昂。此外，先前的比较研究并未涵盖最新的结构滤波器或阈值感知SED实现，导致其实际权衡尚不明确。在本文中，我们首先对最先进的TED下界的过滤精度和计算成本进行了全面的实验比较。然后，我们使用Ukkonen的有界字符串编辑距离算法加速SED下界，在不影响其剪枝能力的情况下大幅减少了运行时间。最后，我们引入了SED-struct阈值滤波器，它通过捕捉树节点之间结构关系的轴感知约束来增强SED。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，SED-struct在保持实用的过滤成本的同时，始终实现了最高的过滤精度。结果表明，SED-struct特别有利于标准SED下界实现相对较低精度的异构树集合。
AI.summary: 本文研究了树编辑距离（TED）的阈值相似性搜索，全面评估了现有下界算法，并提出使用Ukkonen算法加速SED下界以及引入结合结构约束的SED-struct滤波器，实验证明该方法在异构树上具有极高的过滤精度和实用性。
AI.keywords: Tree Edit Distance, Threshold-based Similarity Search, Lower-Bounds, String Edit Distance, Pruning Precision
AI.comments: 本文针对树编辑距离（TED）的阈值相似性搜索问题，对现有的下界算法进行了全面的实验评估，并提出了Ukkonen算法加速的SED下界以及结合结构约束的SED-struct滤波器，显著提升了异构树集合上的过滤精度和计算效率。创新性强，实用价值高。

title: LeanStream: A Speculate-and-Refine Streaming Framework for Efficient on-Device LLM Inference
comments: 6 pages, 13 figures. To appear in the Proceedings of the 32nd Annual International Conference on Mobile Computing and Networking (MobiCom '26)
summary: On-device LLM inference is attractive for privacy and responsiveness, but remains challenging on mobile and embedded devices because model weights far exceed available DRAM. Prior systems exploit activation sparsity and offload weights to SSD or flash storage, but face a fundamental systems trade-off: accurate sparse execution decisions require the latest context, whereas efficient computation-I/O overlap requires early prediction. As a result, existing designs either serialize execution or incur redundant weight fetches, extra computation, and large cache overheads. We present LeanStream, a streaming speculate-and-refine framework for efficient on-device LLM inference. LeanStream progressively refines computation, loading, and cache-retention priorities using partial GPU results, enabling fine-grained overlap between GPU execution and storage I/O. We implement LeanStream on both mobile and embedded platforms. Compared with prior on-device LLM inference systems, LeanStream reduces memory usage by 4.8$\times$ to 7.5$\times$ at the best throughput achieved by prior work, while further improving token generation throughput by 1.6$\times$ to 2.1$\times$.
comment: 6 pages, 13 figures. To appear in the Proceedings of the 32nd Annual International Conference on Mobile Computing and Networking (MobiCom '26)

AI.title_translation: LeanStream：一种用于高效设备端LLM推理的推测-细化流式框架
AI.tldr: LeanStream通过推测-细化流式框架，在移动和嵌入式设备上显著减少LLM推理的内存使用并提高吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 设备端LLM推理因隐私和响应性而具有吸引力，但在移动和嵌入式设备上仍面临挑战，因为模型权重远超可用DRAM。现有系统在准确的稀疏执行决策（需要最新上下文）与高效的计算-I/O重叠（需要早期预测）之间存在基本权衡，导致串行执行或冗余权重获取、额外计算和高缓存开销。
AI.method: 本文提出了LeanStream，一个用于高效设备端LLM推理的流式推测-细化框架。LeanStream利用部分GPU结果逐步细化计算、加载和缓存保留优先级，实现GPU执行和存储I/O之间的细粒度重叠。该框架已在移动和嵌入式平台实现。
AI.result: 与现有设备端LLM推理系统相比，LeanStream在现有工作的最佳吞吐量下将内存使用量减少4.8倍到7.5倍，同时将令牌生成吞吐量提高1.6倍到2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: LeanStream显著提高了设备端LLM推理的效率，有效解决了内存限制和计算-I/O重叠的固有矛盾，并通过减少内存使用和提高吞吐量来优化移动和嵌入式设备上的LLM推理性能。
AI.translation: 设备端LLM推理因隐私和响应性而具有吸引力，但在移动和嵌入式设备上仍面临挑战，因为模型权重远超可用DRAM。现有系统利用激活稀疏性并将权重卸载到SSD或闪存，但面临一个基本的系统权衡：准确的稀疏执行决策需要最新的上下文，而高效的计算-I/O重叠需要早期预测。因此，现有设计要么串行执行，要么导致冗余的权重获取、额外的计算和大量的缓存开销。我们提出了LeanStream，一个用于高效设备端LLM推理的流式推测-细化框架。LeanStream利用部分GPU结果逐步细化计算、加载和缓存保留优先级，从而实现GPU执行和存储I/O之间的细粒度重叠。我们在移动和嵌入式平台都实现了LeanStream。与现有设备端LLM推理系统相比，LeanStream在现有工作达到的最佳吞吐量下将内存使用量减少4.8倍到7.5倍，同时将令牌生成吞吐量进一步提高1.6倍到2.1倍。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了LeanStream，一个为高效设备端LLM推理设计的推测-细化流式框架。该框架旨在解决移动和嵌入式设备上LLM推理因模型权重超出DRAM限制以及现有系统在稀疏执行决策和计算-I/O重叠之间存在的权衡问题。LeanStream通过利用部分GPU结果逐步细化计算、加载和缓存保留优先级，实现了GPU执行和存储I/O之间的细粒度重叠。实验结果表明，LeanStream在与现有工作最佳吞吐量相当的情况下，将内存使用量减少了4.8到7.5倍，并将令牌生成吞吐量提高了1.6到2.1倍。
AI.keywords: 设备端LLM推理, 流式框架, 推测-细化, 内存优化, 吞吐量提升
AI.comments: LeanStream的创新之处在于其推测-细化流式框架，它巧妙地解决了设备端LLM推理中内存限制和计算-I/O重叠的固有矛盾。通过精细化地管理计算、加载和缓存保留优先级，该系统显著提升了资源利用率和整体性能，为移动和嵌入式设备上的LLM部署提供了重要进展。

title: Exemplar: Classical Priors Complement Frozen Features for Few-Shot Microscopy Segmentation at Native Resolution
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code, configurations, and the per-image score records behind every reported number: https://github.com/michalprusek/Exemplar
summary: Segmenting a new biomedical dataset usually means a domain-specific model trained on substantial annotation, or a foundation model steered at inference time. We present Exemplar, a few-shot segmenter that fuses a frozen DINOv3 backbone with a fixed bank of classical native-resolution filter responses in one lightweight head, fitted from the support masks alone. In the few-mask, native-resolution regime, classical priors and frozen self-supervised features are complementary: fused in one head, a single fixed configuration spans eleven biomedical imaging datasets. Under the same head, the classical bank alone reaches 0.693 on the eleven-dataset panel, scored by foreground intersection-over-union or centreline Dice, and the frozen features alone 0.672; the bank leads on seven of the eleven and the features on the rest, and fused they reach 0.782. Against five forward-pass few-shot methods, Exemplar leads in 54 of 55 method-dataset comparisons, 52 of them significant after Holm correction. From a single annotated mask it reaches 0.703 on the same panel, against 0.682 for a from-scratch nnU-Net trained on that same mask. At eight masks nnU-Net overtakes it on the panel mean, chiefly on centreline agreement, but takes 16-77x longer to fit.

AI.title_translation: Exemplar：经典先验在原生分辨率下的少样本显微图像分割中互补冻结特征
AI.tldr: Exemplar结合了经典图像先验和冻结的自监督特征，在少样本生物医学显微图像分割任务中实现了极高精度和卓越的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 在新的生物医学数据集中进行分割通常需要大量标注训练领域特定模型，或者在推理时引导基础模型。为了解决少样本、原生分辨率下的分割难题，论文旨在探讨经典先验与冻结的自监督特征是否能够互补并有效融合。
AI.method: 提出Exemplar方法，将冻结的DINOv3骨干网络与固定的经典原生分辨率滤波器响应库在单个轻量级头部中进行融合，该头部仅通过支持掩膜进行拟合。
AI.result: 在包含11个生物医学数据集的测试中，单独的经典滤波器组达到0.693的分数，冻结特征达到0.672，而二者融合后达到0.782。在与5种前向传播少样本方法的55次比较中，Exemplar在54次中领先（其中52次经Holm校正后显著）。在单掩膜情况下达到0.703，优于从头训练的nnU-Net（0.682），且拟合速度快16-77倍。
AI.conclusion: Exemplar方法成功地将经典先验与冻结特征相结合，在少样本生物医学图像分割任务中展现出卓越的性能、跨数据集的鲁棒性以及远超传统从头训练模型的速度。
AI.translation: 分割一个新的生物医学数据集通常意味着需要训练一个特定领域的模型并进行大量的标注，或者在推理时引导基础模型。我们提出了Exemplar，一个少样本分割器，它将一个冻结的DINOv3骨干网络与一个固定的经典原生分辨率滤波器响应库融合在一个轻量级头部中，该头部仅从支持掩膜中拟合。在少掩膜、原生分辨率的设定下，经典先验和冻结的自监督特征是互补的：在同一个头部中融合后，单一的固定配置可以横跨十一个生物医学图像数据集。在同一个头部下，仅凭经典滤波器库在前台交并比或中心线Dice评分标准下达到了0.693，仅凭冻结特征达到了0.672；滤波器库在十一个数据集中的七个上领先，特征在其余数据集上领先，而两者融合后达到了0.782。与五种前向传递少样本方法相比，Exemplar在55次方法-数据集比较中的54次领先，其中52次在Holm校正后具有显著性。从单个注释掩膜开始，它在同一数据集面板上达到了0.703，而使用同一掩膜从头训练的nnU-Net为0.682。在八个掩膜时，nnU-Net在面板平均值上超越了它，主要是在中心线契合度上，但其拟合时间要长16-77倍。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了Exemplar，一种少样本图像分割器，它将冻结的DINOv3特征与经典滤波器先验融合在一个轻量级头部中，仅需极少支持掩膜即可在原生分辨率下跨多个生物医学数据集实现卓越且高效的分割性能。
AI.keywords: 少样本分割, 显微图像, 经典先验, 自监督特征, 迁移学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了传统图像滤波器的先验知识与冻结的自监督特征（DINOv3），通过一个轻量级头部在极少标注样本下实现了高效的少样本显微图像分割。该方法无需复杂的微调即可跨多个生物医学数据集表现出色，展现了极强的泛化能力和计算效率。

title: Solving the Needle-in-a-Haystack Problem in Mammography Vision-Language Model with Differentiable Subset Sampling
summary: There is growing interest in adopting CLIP-style vision--language model (VLM) pretraining for mammography. However, models that directly employ the standard CLIP architecture and training objective exhibit limited zero-shot performance in clinically important tasks such as cancer, finding-type, and BI-RADS predictions. We argue that this underwhelming performance is due to neglecting two characteristics of mammography data: (1) its high-res nature, and (2) homogeneity of radiology reports, largely driven by a predominance of negative/benign findings on examinations. We propose TopKSigLIP, a VLM designed to address these two limitations through a novel architecture and learning objectives. Instead of downscaling high-res mammography images to satisfy GPU memory constraints, TopKSigLIP introduces TopK-Patch module that learns to sample a sparse set of high-res patches likely to contain lesions, sidestepping the resolution--batch size tradeoff of VLM training. The sampled patch locations additionally serve as a built-in localization tool. To address report homogeneity, we replace the contrastive loss, which falsely repels semantically similar pairs, with a Sup-sigmoid loss. Sup-sigmoid loss extends the sigmoid loss from SigLIP with soft labels derived from structured data. TopKSigLIP outperforms existing open-source mammography and general medical VLMs on both internal and external benchmarks on density assessment, BI-RADS classification, finding subtyping, and cancer prediction under zero-shot evaluation. TopKSigLIP remains competitive under linear probing despite using a significantly smaller vision encoder and smaller training batches than baselines. The TopK-Patch module additionally achieves superior lesion localization over post-hoc Grad-CAM. Code and weights are made public:https://github.com/Youngseok0001/TopKSigLIP.

AI.title_translation: 利用可微分子集采样解决乳腺X线摄影视觉语言模型中的大海捞针问题
AI.tldr: TopKSigLIP通过引入可微分稀疏补丁采样和改进的损失函数，解决了乳腺X线摄影视觉语言模型中高分辨率和报告同质化的难题，显著提升了零样本预测和病灶定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的CLIP风格乳腺X线摄影视觉语言模型在癌症、病变类型和BI-RADS预测等临床重要任务上表现出有限的零样本性能，主要是因为忽视了乳腺X线数据的高分辨率特性以及放射学报告的同质化（阴性/良性结果占主导）这两个特征。
AI.method: 提出TopKSigLIP模型，包含两个核心组件：（1）TopK-Patch模块，用于采样高分辨率图像中的稀疏病变补丁，以解决分辨率与批次大小的权衡；（2）Sup-sigmoid损失函数，扩展了SigLIP的sigmoid损失，利用结构化数据的软标签来应对放射学报告的同质化。
AI.result: TopKSigLIP在内部和外部基准的密度评估、BI-RADS分类、病变亚型分类和癌症预测的零样本评估中均优于现有的开源乳腺X线及通用医学VLM；在显著较小的视觉编码器和较小训练批次下，线性探测仍保持竞争力；且TopK-Patch模块实现了优于事后Grad-CAM的病灶定位能力。
AI.conclusion: TopKSigLIP有效克服了乳腺X线摄影VLM训练中的高分辨率瓶颈与报告同质化问题，在零样本临床任务和病灶定位方面表现优异，树立了新的基准。
AI.translation: 人们对在乳腺X线摄影中采用CLIP风格的视觉-语言模型（VLM）预训练越来越感兴趣。然而，直接采用标准CLIP架构和训练目标的模型在癌症、发现类型和BI-RADS预测等临床重要任务中表现出有限的零样本性能。我们认为，这种不尽如人意的性能归因于忽视了乳腺X线数据的两个特征：（1）其高分辨率性质，以及（2）放射学报告的同质化，这主要是由检查中阴性/良性结果占主导地位所驱动的。我们提出了TopKSigLIP，这是一个通过新颖的架构和学习目标旨在解决这两个限制的VLM。TopKSigLIP没有将高分辨率乳腺X线图像降采样以满足GPU内存限制，而是引入了TopK-Patch模块，该模块学习采样包含病变的稀疏高分辨率补丁集，从而避开了VLM训练的分辨率与批次大小的权衡。采样的补丁位置还可以作为内置的定位工具。为了解决报告同质化问题，我们用Sup-sigmoid损失取代了错误排斥语义相似对的对比损失。Sup-sigmoid损失将SigLIP中的sigmoid损失扩展为源自结构化数据的软标签。在密度评估、BI-RADS分类、发现亚型分类和癌症预测的零样本评估中，TopKSigLIP在内部和外部基准测试中均优于现有的开源乳腺X线和通用医学VLM。尽管使用了明显较小的视觉编码器和比基线更小的训练批次，TopKSigLIP在线性探测下依然保持竞争力。此外，TopK-Patch模块实现了优于事后Grad-CAM的卓越病灶定位能力。代码和权重已公开：https://github.com/Youngseok0001/TopKSigLIP。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TopKSigLIP，一种专为乳腺X线摄影设计的视觉语言模型。它通过TopK-Patch模块解决高分辨率图像的采样问题，并利用Sup-sigmoid损失应对报告同质化，从而在零样本临床任务和病灶定位上取得了优异性能。
AI.keywords: 乳腺X线摄影, 视觉语言模型, 可微分子集采样, 监督Sigmoid损失, 病灶定位
AI.comments: 该论文针对乳腺X线摄影视觉语言模型（VLM）中高分辨率图像处理与报告同质化两大核心痛点，创新性地提出了TopKSigLIP模型。通过可微分的稀疏补丁采样（TopK-Patch）和监督Sigmoid损失函数（Sup-sigmoid loss），该方法在零样本迁移和病灶定位上取得了显著突破，具有很高的临床应用价值。

title: Large Language Models and Language Server Protocol: a match made in context
summary: This article introduces Eiffel-tools, a language server protocol (LSP) implementation for the Eiffel programming language that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to aid the development of statically verified software. The tool provides various interactive and non-interactive commands to produce code and specifications. It uses language and project specific knowledge to precisely direct the LLM and verifies the output using a static verifier. It crafts rich programmatic prompts for the input and corrects or rejects the output. Furthermore, it handles the retries until the program passes verification. The tool's bug fixing capability is evaluated on 2 public datasets using 3 models. The tool can fix 76% to 95% of bugs by combining LLMs and a formal verifier depending on the model and prompts used. The results show the trade-off between the number of fixing attempts and the success rate.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型与语言服务器协议：上下文中的完美结合
AI.tldr: Eiffel-tools结合LLM和LSP，通过静态验证器辅助Eiffel编程语言的软件开发和bug修复，实现了高成功率的bug修复。
AI.motivation: 旨在利用大型语言模型（LLMs）辅助静态验证软件的开发，并通过语言服务器协议（LSP）提供工具支持，提高代码和规范的生成与验证效率。
AI.method: 本文介绍了Eiffel-tools，一个针对Eiffel编程语言的语言服务器协议（LSP）实现。该工具使用大型语言模型（LLM）生成代码和规范，并通过语言和项目特定知识精确指导LLM。它使用静态验证器验证LLM的输出，并能制作丰富的程序化提示，纠正或拒绝输出，并处理重试直到程序通过验证。其bug修复能力在两个公共数据集上使用三个模型进行了评估。
AI.result: 该工具结合LLM和形式化验证器，能够修复76%到95%的bug，具体取决于使用的模型和提示。结果还显示了修复尝试次数与成功率之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，结合大型语言模型和形式化验证器，通过语言服务器协议工具（Eiffel-tools）可以有效地辅助静态验证软件的开发和bug修复，达到较高的成功率。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了Eiffel-tools，一个针对Eiffel编程语言的语言服务器协议（LSP）实现，它利用大型语言模型（LLM）来辅助静态验证软件的开发。该工具提供了各种交互式和非交互式命令来生成代码和规范。它利用语言和项目特定的知识来精确指导LLM，并使用静态验证器验证输出。它为输入精心设计了丰富的程序化提示，并纠正或拒绝输出。此外，它还处理重试，直到程序通过验证。该工具的错误修复能力在两个公共数据集上使用三个模型进行了评估。该工具结合LLM和形式化验证器，根据使用的模型和提示，可以修复76%到95%的错误。结果显示了修复尝试次数与成功率之间的权衡。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Eiffel-tools，一个结合大型语言模型（LLM）和语言服务器协议（LSP）的工具，旨在辅助Eiffel编程语言的静态验证软件开发。该工具利用语言和项目特定知识指导LLM生成代码和规范，并通过静态验证器验证输出，实现错误修复和代码生成。在错误修复能力评估中，Eiffel-tools结合LLM和形式化验证器，能修复76%至95%的错误，并揭示了修复尝试次数与成功率之间的权衡关系。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 语言服务器协议, Eiffel, 静态验证, 错误修复
AI.comments: 这项工作创新性地将大型语言模型与语言服务器协议和静态验证器结合，为Eiffel等强调形式化验证的编程语言提供了强大的开发辅助工具。其在bug修复方面的高成功率展示了LLM在软件工程中的巨大潜力，特别是与严格的验证机制结合时。这种结合为提高软件质量和开发效率提供了一条新途径。

title: The Gradient Does Not See Rank: Rank-Indifference in Matrix-CODI on ProsQA
comments: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop, https://openreview.net/forum?id=Spof4PusVI. 9 pages. Corrects a data-entry error in the workshop version: the seed-1337 accuracy in the three-seed replication was reported as 80.47% (a control run); the archived value is 78.91%, so the three-seed mean is 81.0 +/- 2.0pp (was 81.5 +/- 1.2pp). All other results are unchanged
summary: Continuous chain-of-thought models compress reasoning into latent tokens. Matrix-valued variants, which route each latent token through a d x d matrix bottleneck, introduce rank as a single-sample structural observable on the latent matrix Z. If matrix latents carry parallel reasoning paths via superposition, rank should track them, and truncating Z to low rank should hurt accuracy on tasks whose solutions plausibly require multiple components. Across four training regimes of a matrix-CODI model (three on ProsQA, one on GSM8K-Aug below the learning threshold), the rank-k projection ablation curve is flat to within 0.6 percentage points. A three-seed replication yields 81.0 +/- 2.0 percentage points accuracy while the final effective rank of Z spans {4, 12, 13}; the loss does not reward any particular rank. To test whether rank-blindness arises from the flatten-then-project readout alone, we trained four readouts: a bilinear reparametrization, a bilinear-plus-GELU readout nonlinear in Z, an SVD-augmented readout feeding singular values through an MLP, and a quadratic readout in Z Z^T. All four rank-k curves remain flat (Spearman p-values 0.63, 0.14, 0.82, 0.46). The flat curves persist for readouts nonlinear in Z. A linear probe on Z underperforms a raw pretrained hidden state at target prediction (AUC 0.673 vs. 0.846). A negative control on vanilla GPT-2 SFT (no matrix bottleneck, no Z, three seeds, n=500) reproduces a flat rank-k curve under the same intervention paradigm with pooled-mean range 0.20pp, and a random-h sensitivity floor lands at the same accuracy: the rank-k ablation alone conflates rank-blindness with position-irrelevance.
