AI.title_translation: 类型化柔性变元槽位E-图：一个完备性构造和Alloy案例研究
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了类型化柔性变元槽位E-图，将开放项与代数运算符结合，证明了其等式完备性，并提供了一个Alloy案例研究，比较了不同的管道分支。
AI.motivation: 本文的动机是在规范层面结合槽位E-图（用于表示模一致重命名的开放项）和代数运算符（受益于规范的子项），并证明这种组合的完备性。
AI.method: 该方法涉及在运算符声明的端口中组合类型化槽映射调用，分别认证兄弟商和递归扁平化许可，证明通用有限商表示的最小轨道范式的精确性，使用认证记录指定有效支持的核提取和冲突，并为承载局部端点证书的抽象义务跟踪证明有限展开的等式完备性。通过Alloy案例研究比较了相关的管道分支。
AI.result: 通用有限商表示证明了其最小轨道范式的精确性。为抽象义务跟踪证明了有限展开的等式完备性。Alloy案例研究表征了有界能力和结构整合，但并未建立Java工件的细化或针对形式模型的实验重放。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功构建了类型化柔性变元槽位E-图，证明了其等式完备性，并提供了一个Alloy案例研究来展示其特性，尽管指出尚未建立对实际工件的进一步验证。
AI.translation: 槽位E-图表示模一致重命名的开放项，而代数运算符则受益于规范的序列、包或集合子项。我们将两者在规范层面进行组合：类型化槽映射调用存在于运算符声明的端口中，其兄弟商和递归扁平化许可分别经过认证。通用的有限商表示证明了其最小轨道范式的精确性，而认证记录则指定了有效支持的核提取和冲突。对于承载局部端点证书的抽象义务跟踪，我们证明了有限展开的等式完备性。一项Alloy案例研究比较了冷冻语料库和受控转换套件上的七个相关管道分支。其测量结果表征了有界能力和结构整合；它们并未建立Java工件的细化或针对形式模型的实验重放。
AI.summary: 本文引入了类型化柔性变元槽位E-图，这是一种结合了槽位E-图和代数运算符的新颖组合。它详细阐述了规范层面的集成，认证了组件许可，并提供了一个通用的有限商表示来证明精确性。这项工作为抽象义务跟踪建立了有限展开的等式完备性。Alloy案例研究评估了管道分支，表征了有界能力和结构整合，但指出在Java工件的直接细化或针对形式模型的实验重放方面存在局限性。
AI.keywords: 槽位E-图, 柔性变元, 完备性, Alloy, 等式推理
AI.comments: 本文为E-图中的术语表示和操作的不同方面结合提供了一个理论上严谨的构造。使用“类型化柔性变元槽位E-图”和详细的完备性证明具有重要意义。Alloy案例研究提供了对系统特性的实践洞察，即使它也突出了未来验证的领域。形式模型与工件细化之间的区别很重要。

title: Shifting from Injection to Interaction: Rethinking Web Security in the Age of LLMs and Beyond
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming integral to web applications and browser agents, transforming online interactions while introducing new attack vectors and reshaping longstanding web vulnerabilities. Classical threats such as cross-site scripting (XSS) can be amplified through LLM-mediated interactions, while LLM-specific vulnerabilities can propagate across web applications, introducing attacks such as prompt injection. Securing modern web systems therefore requires understanding interactions between traditional and LLM-specific threats across the system lifecycle. Unlike prior surveys treating web and LLM security separately, this survey provides a unified analysis of how LLMs amplify web vulnerabilities across client-side, server-side, and pipeline layers while evaluating defenses and their limitations. The analysis examines extending NIST and ISO/IEC AI security frameworks to the security needs of LLM-enabled web environments. Three unresolved challenges are identified: adversarial natural-language instructions, autonomous agent security, and post-deployment security through continuous monitoring and adaptation. An LLM-aware monitoring and control framework is proposed, integrating semantic input validation, prompt integrity protection, output isolation, agent governance, and runtime monitoring. This unified perspective characterizes the evolving threat landscape and outlines future directions for secure AI-enabled web systems.

AI.title_translation: 从注入到交互的转变：大模型时代及未来的Web安全再思考
AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了LLM与Web安全交织下的复合交互威胁，指出了三大未决挑战，并提出了一个集成了多层防护的LLM感知监控与控制框架。
AI.motivation: LLM深度融入Web应用和浏览器智能体，既放大了XSS等传统漏洞，又引入了提示词注入等新威胁，而以往研究将Web安全与LLM安全割裂，缺乏对两者在系统生命周期中复合交互威胁的统一分析。
AI.method: 提出跨客户端、服务端和处理管道层的统一分析框架，评估现有防御的局限性；扩展NIST与ISO/IEC AI安全标准至Web环境；提出包含语义输入验证、提示词完整性保护、输出隔离、智能体治理与运行时监控的LLM感知监控控制框架。
AI.result: 明确梳理了LLM放大Web漏洞的跨层传播机制，识别出三大未解决挑战（对抗性自然语言指令、自主智能体安全、部署后持续监控与适应），并构建了端到端的LLM感知综合防护框架。
AI.conclusion: 现代Web安全需要从单纯的“防注入”范式转变为全面的“交互与治理”视角，通过统一且持续自适应的框架才能有效应对LLM驱动的Web系统所面临的安全挑战。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）正逐步融入Web应用和浏览器智能体中，在革新在线交互方式的同时，也引入了新的攻击向量并重塑了长期存在的Web漏洞。跨站脚本（XSS）等传统威胁可能通过LLM介入的交互被放大，而提示词注入等LLM特有的漏洞也会在Web应用中扩散。因此，保护现代Web系统需要理解整个系统生命周期中传统威胁与LLM特有威胁之间的相互作用。与以往分别对待Web安全和LLM安全的研究不同，本综述提供了一个统一的分析框架，探讨LLM如何在客户端、服务端和处理管道层放大Web漏洞，并评估了现有防御措施及其局限性。本分析还探讨了将NIST和ISO/IEC AI安全框架扩展至支持LLM的Web环境的安全需求。研究指出了三大尚未解决的挑战：对抗性自然语言指令、自主智能体安全，以及通过持续监控和自适应实现的部署后安全。文中提出了一个LLM感知的监控与控制框架，该框架集成了语义输入验证、提示词完整性保护、输出隔离、智能体治理和运行时监控。这一统重视角描绘了不断演变的安全威胁格局，并指明了未来构建安全AI使能Web系统的方向。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了LLM融入Web应用引发的新旧安全威胁交织问题。不同于以往将Web与LLM安全分开研究的工作，论文提出了一个跨层级统一分析框架，评估了现有防御机制，并扩展了NIST与ISO/IEC标准；同时指出三大未决挑战，提出了涵盖输入验证、提示词保护、输出隔离与智能体治理的监控框架，为构建安全的AI-Web系统提供了全面指引。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, Web安全, 提示词注入, 智能体安全, 威胁建模
AI.comments: 该综述立足于大模型深度赋能Web应用的关键节点，创新性地打破了传统Web安全与AI安全的孤岛，将安全视角从被动的“注入防御”升级为动态复杂的“交互治理”。其提出的监控与控制框架具有较强的系统性与前瞻性，对指导新一代AI-Web集成系统的安全架构设计具有重要参考价值。

title: Closure complexity of longest-edge bisection for triangular meshes
summary: On triangular meshes, we analyze local mesh refinement based on longest-edge bisection equipped with the serial longest-edge propagation-path closure. Ties are resolved by terminal priority: if the incoming shared edge is a longest edge of the neighboring triangle, the pair is declared terminal and that edge is bisected. For every adaptive mesh sequence $\mathcal{T}_0, \mathcal{T}_1, \ldots, \mathcal{T}_L$ with marked subset sequence $\mathcal{M}_0, \mathcal{M}_1, \ldots, \mathcal{M}_{L-1}$, we prove the cumulative closure estimate $\#\mathcal{T}_L - \#\mathcal{T}_0 \lesssim \sum_{\ell=0}^{L-1}\#\mathcal{M}_\ell$. The proof has two ingredients. First, the finite-similarity-class theorem for planar longest-edge bisection turns the set of possible diameters into a finite union of $\sqrt{2}$-geometric lattices. Hence diameters grow by a uniform strict factor at every nonterminal step. This yields generation and spatial locality for all triangles created by a single mark. Second, a Binev--Dahmen--DeVore type charging argument converts this single-mark locality into the cumulative estimate.

AI.title_translation: 三角网格最长边二等分闭合复杂性
AI.tldr: 本文分析了基于最长边二等分的三角网格局部细化算法的闭合复杂性，并证明了一个累积闭合估计。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在分析和理解基于最长边二等分的三角网格局部细化方法的效率和复杂性，特别是其串行最长边传播路径闭合机制。
AI.method: 该研究采用了基于最长边二等分的局部网格细化方法，并结合了串行最长边传播路径闭合机制。证明过程包含两个主要部分：首先，利用平面最长边二等分的有限相似类定理，将可能的直径集转化为有限个 $\sqrt{2}$-几何格的并集，从而得到由单个标记创建的所有三角形的生成和空间局部性；其次，使用 Binev--Dahmen--DeVore 型充电论证将这种单标记局部性转化为累积估计。
AI.result: 本文证明了对于任意自适应网格序列，累积闭合估计为 $#\mathcal{T}_L - #\mathcal{T}_0 \lesssim \sum_{\ell=0}^{L-1}#\mathcal{M}_\ell$。此外，证明表明由单个标记创建的所有三角形具有生成和空间局部性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功证明了基于最长边二等分和串行最长边传播路径闭合的三角网格局部细化方法的累积闭合估计。
AI.translation: 在三角网格上，我们分析了基于最长边二等分并配备串行最长边传播路径闭合的局部网格细化。通过终端优先级解决冲突：如果传入的共享边是相邻三角形的最长边，则该对被声明为终端，并对该边进行二等分。对于每个带有标记子集序列 $\mathcal{M}_0, \mathcal{M}_1, \ldots, \mathcal{M}_{L-1}$ 的自适应网格序列 $\mathcal{T}_0, \mathcal{T}_1, \ldots, \mathcal{T}_L$，我们证明了累积闭合估计 $#\mathcal{T}_L - #\mathcal{T}_0 \lesssim \sum_{\ell=0}^{L-1}#\mathcal{M}_\ell$。证明包含两个要素。首先，平面最长边二等分的有限相似类定理将可能的直径集转化为 $\sqrt{2}$-几何格的有限并集。因此，在每个非终端步骤中，直径以统一的严格因子增长。这产生了由单个标记创建的所有三角形的生成和空间局部性。其次，Binev--Dahmen--DeVore 型充电论证将这种单标记局部性转化为累积估计。
AI.summary: 本文分析了三角网格上基于最长边二等分和串行最长边传播路径闭合的局部网格细化方法。研究引入了终端优先级来解决冲突，并证明了一个关键的累积闭合估计：$#\mathcal{T}_L - #\mathcal{T}_0 \lesssim \sum_{\ell=0}^{L-1}#\mathcal{M}_\ell$。该证明利用了平面最长边二等分的有限相似类定理，以确保三角形的生成和空间局部性，并结合了 Binev--Dahmen--DeVore 型充电论证来推导累积估计。
AI.keywords: 三角网格, 最长边二等分, 网格细化, 闭合复杂性, 累积估计
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于，它为一种重要的局部网格细化策略——最长边二等分法——提供了严谨的理论分析和复杂度估计。通过结合有限相似类定理和充电论证，作者成功地证明了网格增长的累积闭合估计，这对于理解和改进自适应网格算法的效率具有重要意义。

title: On the Impact of Site-Specific Training for a Real-World 5G NR System
comments: This work has been accepted for presentation at the 60th Asilomar Conference on Signals, Systems, and Computers 2026
summary: Site-specific training can improve wireless receiver performance without increasing computational complexity. However, real-world results have so far focused on fully trainable neural receivers and single-layer transmissions. We study site-specific finetuning of three receiver architectures: fully trainable neural, model-driven neural, and model-based. We train and evaluate these receivers using new measurements from a standard-compliant 5G NR testbed at ETH Zurich with dual-layer uplink transmission, including measurement campaigns conducted more than six months apart. Our results show that site-specific finetuning (i) substantially improves fully trainable and model-driven neural receivers, while resulting in only marginal gains for the less tunable model-based receiver; (ii) enables a single neural receiver jointly finetuned for single- and dual-layer transmission to closely match receivers finetuned separately for each configuration; and (iii) remains effective across measurement campaigns separated by more than six months. We also investigate site-specific linear minimum mean-square error channel estimation using covariance matrices estimated from either synthetic channels or site-specific measurements. When combined with iterative detection and decoding, site-specific channel estimation achieves the lowest error rate observed in our datasets. Our finetuning code and measurement datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/IIP-Group/site_specific_training
comment: This work has been accepted for presentation at the 60th Asilomar Conference on Signals, Systems, and Computers 2026

AI.title_translation: 关于特定地点训练对真实世界5G NR系统影响的研究
AI.tldr: 特定地点微调显著提升了真实世界5G NR系统中神经接收器的性能，并对时间变化具有鲁棒性，结合特定地点信道估计可进一步降低错误率。
AI.motivation: 特定地点训练可以在不增加计算复杂度的前提下提高无线接收器性能，但现有真实世界研究主要集中在完全可训练神经接收器和单层传输，本研究旨在探索其对更复杂5G NR系统和多种接收器架构的影响。
AI.method: 本研究对三种接收器架构（完全可训练神经、模型驱动神经和基于模型）进行了特定地点微调。使用来自苏黎世联邦理工学院符合标准5G NR测试平台的新测量数据进行训练和评估，该平台支持双层上行传输，并包含间隔超过六个月的测量活动。此外，还研究了利用合成信道或特定地点测量数据估计协方差矩阵的特定地点线性最小均方误差（LMMSE）信道估计，并将其与迭代检测和解码结合。
AI.result: 1. 特定地点微调显著改善了完全可训练和模型驱动的神经接收器，而对基于模型的接收器增益微小。2. 一个针对单层和双层传输联合微调的神经接收器能与单独微调的接收器性能接近。3. 微调在间隔超过六个月的测量活动中仍然有效。4. 结合迭代检测和解码的特定地点LMMSE信道估计实现了最低的错误率。
AI.conclusion: 特定地点训练，无论是通过微调神经接收器还是特定地点信道估计，都能显著提升真实世界5G NR系统的性能和鲁棒性，即使在长时间跨度下也保持有效。
AI.translation: 特定地点训练可以在不增加计算复杂度的前提下提高无线接收器性能。然而，迄今为止，真实世界的结果主要集中在完全可训练的神经接收器和单层传输上。我们研究了三种接收器架构的特定地点微调：完全可训练神经、模型驱动神经和基于模型的接收器。我们使用来自苏黎士联邦理工学院符合标准5G NR测试平台的新测量数据对这些接收器进行训练和评估，该测试平台支持双层上行传输，包括间隔超过六个月进行的测量活动。我们的结果表明，特定地点微调 (i) 大幅改善了完全可训练和模型驱动的神经接收器，而对于可调性较差的基于模型的接收器仅带来微小增益；(ii) 使一个针对单层和双层传输联合微调的神经接收器能够与针对每种配置单独微调的接收器性能非常接近；(iii) 在间隔超过六个月的测量活动中仍然有效。我们还研究了使用从合成信道或特定地点测量数据估计的协方差矩阵进行特定地点线性最小均方误差信道估计。当与迭代检测和解码结合时，特定地点信道估计在我们的数据集中实现了最低的错误率。我们的微调代码和测量数据集可在 https://github.com/IIP-Group/site_specific_training 公开获取。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了特定地点训练对真实世界5G NR系统接收器性能的影响。通过在苏黎世联邦理工学院的5G NR测试平台上对三种接收器架构（完全可训练神经、模型驱动神经和基于模型）进行微调，并结合双层上行传输的长期测量数据，结果显示特定地点微调显著提升了神经接收器的性能，并能保持长期有效。此外，结合迭代检测和解码的特定地点信道估计实现了最低的错误率。研究强调了特定地点训练在提升5G NR系统性能和鲁棒性方面的潜力。
AI.keywords: 特定地点训练, 5G NR, 神经接收器, 信道估计, 微调
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于将特定地点训练应用于更复杂的真实世界5G NR系统，包括双层上行传输和多种接收器架构，并验证了其在时间上的鲁棒性。其重要性在于证明了该方法在不增加计算复杂度的前提下显著提升了无线接收器性能，并提供了公开数据集和代码，有利于后续研究。

title: The Dually Flat Geometry of Planning as Inference
summary: We present an alternative characterization of the occupancy measure of reinforcement learning, obtained by embedding the planning criterion into the dynamics through a resetting planning process. Its stationary measure, which we term visitation measure, is the object on which the information geometry of decision making is most naturally expressed. The achievable visitation measures form a dually flat statistical manifold whose two affine charts are the visitation probabilities and the log-policies, dual under the conditional entropy. This structure makes planning-as-inference generalize from linear rewards to nonlinear functionals of the visitation, each iterate solved by one natural-gradient step, and gives the temporal-difference error the interpretation of a marginal-utility estimate. We develop the geometry and its consequences for reinforcement learning and theoretical neuroscience.

AI.title_translation: 推理即规划的对偶平坦几何
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种强化学习中占用测度的替代表征，即访问测度，并在此基础上发展了决策信息几何的对偶平坦结构，从而将推理即规划泛化到非线性奖励，并为时序差分误差提供了新解释。
AI.motivation: 旨在提供强化学习中占用测度的替代表征，并在此基础上更自然地表达决策的信息几何。
AI.method: 通过重置规划过程将规划准则嵌入到动力学中，得到一个平稳测度，称之为访问测度。可实现的访问测度形成一个对偶平坦统计流形，其两个仿射图是访问概率和对数策略。利用这种几何结构将推理即规划从线性奖励推广到访问的非线性泛函。
AI.result: 可实现的访问测度形成了一个对偶平坦统计流形，其仿射图是访问概率和对数策略，在条件熵下是对偶的。这种结构使得推理即规划可以从线性奖励泛化到访问的非线性泛函，每个迭代步骤通过一个自然梯度步骤解决。时序差分误差被解释为边际效用估计。
AI.conclusion: 本文发展了这种几何结构及其对强化学习和理论神经科学的影响。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种强化学习中占用测度的替代表征，通过重置规划过程将规划准则嵌入到动力学中获得。其平稳测度，我们称之为访问测度，是决策信息几何最自然表达的对象。可实现的访问测度形成一个对偶平坦统计流形，其两个仿射图是访问概率和对数策略，在条件熵下是对偶的。这种结构使得推理即规划可以从线性奖励泛化到访问的非线性泛函，每个迭代步骤通过一个自然梯度步骤解决，并赋予时序差分误差边际效用估计的解释。我们发展了这种几何结构及其对强化学习和理论神经科学的影响。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种强化学习中占用测度的新表征，即访问测度。在此基础上，作者发现可实现的访问测度构成一个对偶平坦统计流形，其仿射图是访问概率和对数策略。这一几何结构使得推理即规划能够推广到非线性奖励，并通过自然梯度步骤求解，并为时序差分误差提供了边际效用估计的新解释。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 信息几何, 规划即推理, 占用测度, 对偶平坦流形
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入访问测度和发展其对偶平坦几何结构，为强化学习中的推理即规划提供了一个新颖且强大的理论框架。它不仅将该方法泛化到更广泛的问题（非线性奖励），还提供了对核心概念（如TD误差）的深刻几何解释，具有重要的理论意义，并可能对算法设计和理论神经科学产生影响。

title: RobustSeiz: An Open-Source Framework for Benchmarking the Robustness of EEG Seizure Detection Models
comments: 28 pages, 13 numbered figures, 9 tables; full-page graphical abstract and supplementary material included. Submitted to the Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association (JAMIA)
summary: Despite strong performance on held-out electroencephalography (EEG) data, seizure detectors may fail under real-world acquisition variability, artifacts, and adversarial inputs. We introduce RobustSeiz, an open-source, model-agnostic framework that provides a standardized, reproducible protocol for stress-testing and comparing seizure detectors under controlled, clinically motivated distribution shifts before deployment. We standardize four public scalp-EEG corpora (CHB-MIT, TUSZ, Siena, and SeizeIT1) into BIDS-EEG trees and evaluate subject-independent detectors on held-out splits. Environment, noise, and adversarial transforms are swept over predefined hyperparameter grids. Each run reports sample- and event-level sensitivity, precision, F1, false positives per 24 h, Lead and Lag onset timing, and Monte Carlo dropout predictive agreement. RobustSeiz includes a Dockerized GPU pipeline, experiment registry, and full-evaluation and research-subset modes. We demonstrate the framework with a contemporary seizure detector on TUSZ across the complete implemented shift grid; an AWGN analysis illustrates how perturbation severity changes detection quality, onset timing, and predictive agreement. RobustSeiz provides a shared benchmarking standard for evaluating seizure-detector robustness under realistic clinical stressors, extending pre-deployment assessment beyond clean-data accuracy.

AI.title_translation: RobustSeiz: 一个用于评估脑电图癫痫检测模型鲁棒性的开源框架
AI.tldr: RobustSeiz是一个开源框架，用于在部署前，通过模拟真实世界的变异性、伪影和对抗性输入，标准化、可重现地测试和比较脑电图癫痫检测模型的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 当前的癫痫检测器在干净的脑电图数据上表现良好，但在真实世界的采集变异性、伪影和对抗性输入下可能会失效。因此，需要一个框架来在部署前评估这些模型在受控、临床相关的分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: RobustSeiz是一个开源、模型无关的框架，它标准化了四个公共头皮脑电图语料库（CHB-MIT, TUSZ, Siena, SeizeIT1）为BIDS-EEG树，并评估了独立于受试者的检测器。它通过预定义的超参数网格对环境、噪声和对抗性变换进行扫描，并报告样本和事件级别的敏感性、精确度、F1、每24小时假阳性、领先和滞后发作时间以及蒙特卡洛dropout预测一致性。该框架包括一个Docker化的GPU管道、实验注册表和完整评估及研究子集模式。

AI.conclusion: RobustSeiz提供了一个共享的基准测试标准，用于在现实临床压力下评估癫痫检测器的鲁棒性，将部署前评估扩展到仅基于干净数据准确性之外。
AI.translation: 尽管在保留的脑电图（EEG）数据上表现强劲，但癫痫检测器在真实世界的采集变异性、伪影和对抗性输入下可能会失效。我们引入了RobustSeiz，一个开源的、模型无关的框架，它提供了一个标准化、可重现的协议，用于在部署前在受控的、临床驱动的分布偏移下对癫痫检测器进行压力测试和比较。我们将四个公共头皮脑电图语料库（CHB-MIT、TUSZ、Siena和SeizeIT1）标准化为BIDS-EEG树，并评估了保留分割上的独立于受试者的检测器。环境、噪声和对抗性变换在预定义的超参数网格上进行扫描。每次运行报告样本和事件级别的敏感性、精确度、F1、每24小时假阳性、领先和滞后发作时间以及蒙特卡洛dropout预测一致性。RobustSeiz包括一个Docker化的GPU管道、实验注册表以及完整评估和研究子集模式。我们使用一个现代癫痫检测器在TUSZ数据集上演示了该框架在完整的实现偏移网格上的应用；AWGN分析说明了扰动严重性如何改变检测质量、发作时间和预测一致性。RobustSeiz为在现实临床压力下评估癫痫检测器的鲁棒性提供了一个共享的基准测试标准，将部署前评估扩展到仅基于干净数据准确性之外。
AI.summary: 本论文介绍了RobustSeiz，一个开源、模型无关的框架，旨在标准化和重现性地评估脑电图（EEG）癫痫检测模型在部署前的鲁棒性。该框架通过模拟真实世界的采集变异性、伪影和对抗性输入来创建受控的临床相关分布偏移。它整合了多个公共EEG语料库，并提供了一套全面的评估指标，包括Dockerized GPU管道和实验注册功能。通过案例研究，RobustSeiz展示了其在评估模型在不同扰动下的性能、发作时间检测和预测一致性方面的能力，从而为癫痫检测器的预部署评估提供了一个重要的共享基准。
AI.keywords: EEG, 癫痫检测, 鲁棒性, 开源框架, 基准测试
AI.comments: RobustSeiz的创新之处在于它提供了一个标准化、可重现的框架，用于在部署前系统地评估癫痫检测模型在真实世界条件下的鲁棒性，而不仅仅是依赖于干净数据的准确性。其模型无关的特性和对多种临床相关分布偏移的测试能力，使其成为一个重要的工具，有助于提升癫痫检测技术在实际应用中的可靠性和安全性。

title: The Blind Spot in 2D Infants' Pose Estimation:Robust Learning from Noisy Annotations
summary: Noisy annotations pose a significant challenge for supervised deep learning, as neural networks rely on large-scale, high-quality labeled data whose corruption can severely impair model performance. Although robustness to label noise has been extensively studied for classification tasks, it remains relatively underexplored in Pose Estimation (PE). This limitation becomes critical in clinical contexts, including neonatology, where PE of preterm infants is used to support the assessment of spontaneous motility, a key indicator of neurodevelopmental trajectories. In such settings, infants' images labeling is further hindered by visual challenges (e.g., keypoint self-occlusions, caregiver interference), making the annotation process inherently susceptible to errors. To tackle noisy annotations in PE, we introduce REliable keypoint selection via Memory of traINing Dynamics (REMIND), a clustering-based keypoint-selection strategy that exploits keypoint-wise training dynamics to identify noisy labels without assuming any prior knowledge of the noise distribution, thus enabling noise-free model training. When evaluated on the proprietary NeoPose dataset, comprising 46 videos of 46 preterm infants recorded in real clinical settings, REMIND correctly identifies noisy annotations across multiple corruption scenarios, achieving up to 93\% Area Under the Curve (AUC) with three different PE architectures used in the relevant literature. To our knowledge, this is the first study to explicitly address label noise in preterm infants' PE, paving the way for the design of trustworthy learning-based algorithms for infants'monitoring support when data quality cannot be guaranteed.

AI.title_translation: 2D婴儿姿态估计中的盲点：从带噪声标注中进行鲁棒学习
AI.tldr: 本研究引入了REMIND，一种基于聚类的关键点选择策略，通过利用关键点训练动态来识别姿态估计中的噪声标注，无需预先了解噪声分布。在NeoPose数据集上，REMIND在多种损坏场景下能准确识别噪声标注，AUC高达93%，为婴儿监测支持设计可靠的基于学习的算法铺平了道路。
AI.motivation: 监督深度学习在姿态估计（PE）中面临噪声标注的严峻挑战，尤其是在新生儿学等临床环境中，早产儿PE用于评估自发运动，而图像标注易受视觉挑战（如关键点自遮挡、看护人干扰）影响，导致标注固有的错误。尽管分类任务中的标签噪声鲁棒性已得到广泛研究，但在PE领域仍相对未被充分探索。
AI.method: 我们引入了REliable keypoint selection via Memory of traINing Dynamics (REMIND)，这是一种基于聚类的关键点选择策略。它利用关键点级别的训练动态来识别噪声标签，无需假设任何噪声分布的先验知识，从而实现无噪声的模型训练。
AI.result: 在包含46个早产儿视频的NeoPose专有数据集上进行评估时，REMIND在多种损坏场景下都能正确识别噪声标注，使用文献中三种不同的PE架构，其曲线下面积（AUC）高达93%。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次明确解决了早产儿姿态估计中的标签噪声问题，为在数据质量无法保证的情况下，设计用于婴儿监测支持的值得信赖的基于学习的算法奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 噪声标注对监督深度学习构成了严峻挑战，因为神经网络依赖于大规模、高质量的标注数据，数据的损坏会严重损害模型性能。尽管标签噪声的鲁棒性在分类任务中已得到广泛研究，但在姿态估计（PE）领域仍相对未被充分探索。这种局限性在临床环境中变得至关重要，包括新生儿学，其中早产儿的PE用于支持自发运动的评估，自发运动是神经发育轨迹的关键指标。在这种情况下，婴儿图像的标注进一步受到视觉挑战（例如，关键点自遮挡，看护人干扰）的阻碍，使得标注过程固有地容易出错。为了解决PE中的噪声标注问题，我们引入了通过训练动态记忆进行可靠关键点选择（REliable keypoint selection via Memory of traINing Dynamics，REMIND），这是一种基于聚类的关键点选择策略，它利用关键点级别的训练动态来识别噪声标签，而无需假设任何噪声分布的先验知识，从而实现无噪声的模型训练。当在专有的NeoPose数据集上进行评估时，该数据集包含在真实临床环境中记录的46名早产儿的46个视频，REMIND在多种损坏场景下都能正确识别噪声标注，使用相关文献中使用的三种不同PE架构，其曲线下面积（AUC）高达93%。据我们所知，这是第一项明确解决早产儿PE中标签噪声问题的研究，为在数据质量无法保证时设计值得信赖的基于学习的婴儿监测支持算法铺平了道路。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决2D婴儿姿态估计中由于噪声标注导致的性能下降问题，尤其是在临床环境中。作者提出了REMIND，一种基于聚类的关键点选择策略，通过分析关键点训练动态来识别并过滤噪声标签，从而实现鲁棒的模型训练，且无需预设噪声分布。在包含46个早产儿视频的NeoPose数据集上，REMIND在多种噪声场景下表现出色，AUC高达93%，证明了其在解决早产儿PE中标签噪声的有效性，为可靠的婴儿监测算法提供了支持。
AI.keywords: 姿态估计, 噪声标注, 早产儿, 鲁棒学习, 关键点选择
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于首次明确将标签噪声问题引入到早产儿姿态估计领域，并提出了一个无需先验噪声知识的解决方案REMIND。其在临床背景下的应用具有重要意义，有助于提高婴儿监测支持系统的可靠性。该方法通过分析训练动态来识别噪声，提供了一种新颖且实用的途径来处理真实世界中难以避免的低质量标注数据。

title: Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) owe much of their success to next-token prediction (NTP), but their autoregressive (AR) structure requires slow, sequential token generation. To overcome this bottleneck, we introduce diffusion-augmented LLMs, a new class of models that defines an AR model distribution while using diffusion to draw multiple tokens in parallel from that distribution. We decouple the parameters of these models into two sets: AR weights, trained using the standard NTP objective, and lightweight diffusion weights, trained to generate multiple tokens simultaneously. The diffusion weights are learned through a simple Diffusion Distillation phase that adds negligible overhead to existing LLM training pipelines. We also introduce $Ψ$-Spec, a family of samplers that enables lossless acceleration and inference-time scaling at a fixed context length. Unlike speculative decoding, our method requires no separate draft model. Unlike diffusion LLMs (d-LLMs), it accelerates generation without sacrificing the quality of the underlying AR model. The resulting models, called Uno, can be trained from scratch or built by augmenting existing open-weight AR LLMs. Uno achieves higher throughput than leading speculative-decoding methods at every evaluated batch size and delivers up to $3\times$ speedups over the base AR model, including at the largest batch size supported by the device. Notably, our 8B Uno model outperforms the leading open d-LLM, the 26B DiffusionGemma, and the proprietary Mercury 2 across all evaluated benchmarks in agentic tool use, coding, and long-context reasoning. We release code and checkpoints at: https://s-sahoo.github.io/uno/

AI.title_translation: 通过离散扩散解锁LLM的无损加速
AI.tldr: 本文引入了扩散增强型大型语言模型（Uno），通过将自回归权重与轻量级扩散权重解耦，并利用扩散蒸馏和Ψ-Spec采样器，实现了LLM的无损并行多令牌生成，显著提高了生成速度，同时保持了基础AR模型的质量，并且无需草稿模型。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的成功主要归功于下一令牌预测（NTP），但其自回归（AR）结构导致了缓慢的顺序令牌生成，这是一个主要的性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 本文引入了扩散增强型LLM，它定义了一个AR模型分布，并使用扩散从该分布中并行抽取多个令牌。模型参数解耦为两部分：使用标准NTP目标训练的AR权重，以及通过简单的扩散蒸馏阶段训练的轻量级扩散权重，用于同时生成多个令牌。此外，还引入了Ψ-Spec采样器家族，实现了固定上下文长度下的无损加速和推理时扩展。该方法不需要单独的草稿模型，也无需牺牲底层AR模型的质量。
AI.result: 本文提出的Uno模型在所有评估的批次大小下，实现了比领先的推测解码方法更高的吞吐量，并且相比基础AR模型，速度提升高达3倍，即使在设备支持的最大批次大小下也是如此。值得注意的是，8B的Uno模型在代理工具使用、编码和长上下文推理的所有评估基准上，均优于领先的开源扩散LLM（26B DiffusionGemma）和专有模型Mercury 2。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入扩散增强型LLMs（Uno），本文成功克服了LLMs缓慢的自回归生成瓶颈，实现了无损加速，同时保持了高质量的生成，并在多个基准测试中超越了现有先进方法。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的成功很大程度上归功于下一令牌预测（NTP），但其自回归（AR）结构需要缓慢的顺序令牌生成。为了克服这一瓶颈，我们引入了扩散增强型LLMs，这是一种新型模型，它定义了一个AR模型分布，同时使用扩散从该分布中并行抽取多个令牌。我们将这些模型的参数解耦为两组：使用标准NTP目标训练的AR权重，以及训练用于同时生成多个令牌的轻量级扩散权重。扩散权重通过一个简单的扩散蒸馏阶段学习，该阶段对现有LLM训练流程的开销可忽略不计。我们还引入了Ψ-Spec，一个采样器家族，它能够在固定上下文长度下实现无损加速和推理时扩展。与推测解码不同，我们的方法不需要单独的草稿模型。与扩散LLMs（d-LLMs）不同，它在加速生成的同时，不牺牲底层AR模型的质量。由此产生的模型，称为Uno，可以从头开始训练，也可以通过增强现有的开源AR LLMs构建。Uno在每个评估的批次大小下都比领先的推测解码方法实现更高的吞吐量，并且比基础AR模型提速高达3倍，包括在设备支持的最大批次大小下。值得注意的是，我们的8B Uno模型在代理工具使用、编码和长上下文推理的所有评估基准上，均优于领先的开源d-LLM（26B DiffusionGemma）和专有模型Mercury 2。我们发布了代码和检查点：https://s-sahoo.github.io/uno/
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Uno的新型扩散增强型大型语言模型，旨在解决传统LLM自回归生成缓慢的问题。通过将自回归权重与轻量级扩散权重解耦，并利用扩散蒸馏技术，Uno模型能够并行生成多个令牌，从而实现无损加速。结合Ψ-Spec采样器，该方法在不牺牲生成质量的前提下，显著提高了LLM的吞吐量和推理速度，最高可达3倍加速，并超越了现有的推测解码和扩散LLM方法。
AI.keywords: LLMs, 离散扩散, 无损加速, 并行生成, Uno模型
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖且高效的LLM加速方法，其创新之处在于将扩散模型与传统自回归模型相结合，实现了并行多令牌生成，同时避免了传统推测解码对草稿模型的依赖以及扩散LLM可能带来的质量损失。其“无损加速”的特性非常吸引人，有望显著提升LLM在实际应用中的性能。实验结果也展示了其在多个基准上的优越性，具有重要的研究价值和应用前景。

title: Differentiable Hybrid Modelling for Learning and Optimising Chemical Transport Processes from Experimental Data
summary: Reliable transport models are essential when modelling and optimising many chemical engineering processes, yet, most models assume hand-picked constitutive laws which may not reflect reality, and often assume initial conditions are known exactly. Both restrictions can significantly bias model predictions and lead to systematic error when used in predictive and control settings. Black-box neural surrogate alternatives for modelling can better match real example data, but are confined to the task they were trained on and cannot be interrogated for physical consistency. Here we introduce a general-purpose differentiable hybrid modelling framework for transport processes, specifically for the case of population balance equations. Our framework integrates a JAX finite volume population balance solver with learnable neural network components which are trained to both discover constitutive laws and fit initial conditions from real experimental data, allowing us to better model real experimental transport systems. Furthermore, we use our framework for process optimisation, using its differentiability to allow us to direct optimising experimental settings for quantities of interest. This work highlights the huge potential of such differentiable hybrid modelling frameworks for learning and optimising any given chemical separation which involves mass, energy, and/or momentum transport.

AI.title_translation: 用于从实验数据学习和优化化学传递过程的可微分混合建模
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合物理求解器与神经网络的可微分混合建模框架，用于从实验数据中精确建模和优化化学传递过程。
AI.motivation: 传统的化学传递过程模型依赖于人工挑选的本构律且假设初始条件已知，这会导致预测偏差和系统误差；而纯黑箱神经网络则缺乏物理一致性且泛航能力受限。因此需要一种能够结合物理规律与数据驱动优势的通用可微分混合建模框架。
AI.method: 集成了一个JAX有限体积粒子群平衡求解器与可学习的神经网络组件，通过真实实验数据训练以发现本构律并拟合初始条件，同时利用其可微分特性进行过程优化。
AI.result: 成功从真实实验数据中发现本构律并拟合初始条件，提升了真实实验传递系统的建模准确性，并实现了针对特定目标的最优实验设置导向优化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效利用真实实验数据学习并优化包含质量、能量或动量传递的化学分离过程，展现出巨大的应用潜力。
AI.translation: 可靠的传递过程模型对于许多化学工程过程的建模和优化至关重要，然而，大多数模型假设可能无法反映现实的人工挑选本构定律，并且通常假设初始条件是完全已知的。这两个限制都会显著偏置模型预测，并在预测和控制设置中导致系统误差。用于建模的黑盒神经替代方案可以更好地匹配真实示例数据，但它们局限于其训练的任务，并且无法被质疑物理一致性。在这里，我们引入了一个用于传递过程的通用可微分混合建模框架，特别是针对粒子群平衡方程的情况。我们的框架将 JAX 有限体积粒子群平衡求解器与可训练的神经网络组件集成在一起，这些组件经过训练既可以发现本构定律又可以从真实实验数据中拟合初始条件，使我们能够更好地模拟真实的实验传递系统。此外，我们将我们的框架用于过程优化，利用其可微分性使我们能够指导优化感兴趣数量的实验设置。这项工作突出了这种可微分混合建模框架在学习和优化涉及质量、能量和/或动量传递的任何给定化学分离方面的巨大潜力。
AI.summary: 本文引入了一种通用的可微分混合建模框架用于化学传递过程（特别是粒子群平衡方程），通过结合JAX有限体积求解器与神经网络，实现了从实验数据中学习本构律、拟合初始条件以及进行过程优化。
AI.keywords: 可微分混合建模, 传递过程, 粒子群平衡方程, 神经网络代理, 过程优化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种结合可微分编程（JAX）与物理模型的混合建模框架，能同时学习本构律和初始条件，对化学工程中的传递过程及过程优化具有重要意义。

title: LLM4CKD: Large Language Models for Early Stage Chronic Kidney Disease Screening
summary: Early screening of chronic kidney disease (CKD) is critical for timely intervention, yet most machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches require labeled data and model training, limiting their use in real-world screening settings. This study evaluates the effectiveness of large language models (LLMs) for CKD screening under zero-shot and few-shot in-context learning settings and compares them with traditional ML and DL methods. We propose a framework that uses clinically selected tabular features and structured prompt templates to enable LLM-based inference without task-specific training. LLM performance is evaluated across multiple prompt styles, feature configurations, and data settings, and compared with standard ML, DL, and tabular foundation model (TFM) baselines, and existing CKD screening tools. The results show that LLMs can achieve competitive performance using only a small number of examples, often matching or outperforming traditional approaches in low-data settings. However, their performance remains model-dependent and less stable as input complexity increases. In contrast, ML, DL, and TFM models show more consistent improvement with larger training data. Overall, the findings highlight a trade-off between data efficiency and stability, suggesting that LLMs may serve as a flexible complementary approach for CKD screening when labeled data are limited.

AI.title_translation: LLM4CKD：用于早期慢性肾病筛查的大语言模型
AI.tldr: 本研究评估了无需训练的大语言模型在早期慢性肾病（CKD）筛查中的应用，发现其在数据稀缺时表现优异，但稳定性随输入复杂度增加而下降。
AI.motivation: 传统的机器学习和深度学习方法在慢性肾病早期筛查中需要大量的标注数据和模型训练，这限制了它们在现实世界筛查场景中的应用，因此需要评估无需任务特定训练的大语言模型的有效性。
AI.method: 提出一个利用临床筛选的表格特征和结构化提示词模板的框架，在零样本和少样本上下文学习设置下评估LLM的推理能力，并与传统机器学习、深度学习、表格基础模型及现有CKD筛查工具进行对比。
AI.result: LLM仅需少量样本即可达到具有竞争力的性能，在低数据设置下经常匹配或优于传统方法；但其性能仍取决于具体模型，且随着输入复杂度的增加而变得不太稳定。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型可作为数据受限场景下慢性肾病筛查的灵活补充方法，但在稳定性和复杂输入处理上仍存在局限。
AI.translation: 慢性肾病（CKD）的早期筛查对于及时干预至关重要，然而大多数机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）方法需要标记数据和模型训练，限制了其在现实世界筛查场景中的应用。本研究评估了大语言模型（LLM）在零样本和少样本上下文学习设置下进行CKD筛查的有效性，并将其与传统的ML和DL方法进行了比较。我们提出了一个框架，利用临床筛选的表格特征和结构化的提示模板，使基于LLM的推理无需进行特定于任务的训练。我们在多种提示风格、特征配置和数据设置下评估了LLM的性能，并与标准的ML、DL、表格基础模型（TFM）基线以及现有的CKD筛查工具进行了比较。结果表明，LLM仅使用少量示例就可以实现有竞争力的性能，在低数据设置下通常匹配或优于传统方法。然而，随着输入复杂度的增加，它们的性能仍然依赖于模型且不够稳定。相比之下，ML、DL和TFM模型随着训练数据的增加表现出更一致的改进。总体而言，研究结果突出了数据效率与稳定性之间的权衡，表明在标记数据有限时，LLM可以作为CKD筛查的灵活补充方法。
AI.summary: 该研究评估了大语言模型在零样本和少样本设置下进行早期慢性肾病筛查的效果，提出了一种基于结构化提示词的LLM推理框架，结果表明LLM在数据有限时表现出色，但在处理复杂输入时稳定性不足。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 慢性肾病, 早期筛查, 上下文学习, 机器学习
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了大语言模型（LLM）在慢性肾病（CKD）早期筛查中的应用，重点关注其在零样本和少样本条件下的表现，揭示了大模型在数据稀缺时的潜力及面对复杂输入时的不稳定性。

title: InSituMeasure: Probing Situated Measurement Grounding in Industrial Scenes with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: For trained operators, gauge reading requires little specialized knowledge, low cognitive effort, and high repeatability. Yet Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remain unreliable in continuous-valued measurement despite strong results on general multimodal benchmarks. Existing benchmarks expose this weakness but isolate measurement from realistic, knowledge-grounded settings, with limited situated context, specialized instruments, real-world noise, and matched diagnostic annotations, reducing realism and constraining root-cause analysis. We introduce InSituMeasure to evaluate situated measurement grounding. It contains 2,922 real industrial monitoring scenes across eight functional categories of professional engineering instruments, with dense gauge-attribute annotations and noise tags for failure diagnosis. We define metrics for numerical accuracy under predefined tolerances and unit consistency, rejection of fake or unanswerable tasks, and alignment between model failures and annotated error factors. Across 24 state-of-the-art MLLMs, the best model reaches only 25.7\% joint value-unit accuracy and 51.8\% confidence-diagnosis F1, revealing a substantial gap between general multimodal competence and reliable situated measurement. Further analysis identifies failures from text-induced shortcuts, overconfident responses, and authentic industrial noise, including mixed disturbances, viewpoint deviation, occlusion, and environmental interference.

AI.title_translation: InSituMeasure：利用多模态大模型探测工业场景中的情境测量基础
AI.tldr: 本文推出了工业测量多模态大模型评估基准InSituMeasure，揭示了当前顶级模型在真实工业场景测量任务中的巨大性能鸿沟与不可靠性。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大模型（MLLMs）在通用多模态基准上取得了强劲表现，但在连续值测量上仍然不可靠，且现有的基准缺乏现实的、基于知识的设置、情境上下文、专业仪器、真实噪声和匹配的诊断注释，限制了对真实工业场景下测量能力的评估和根因分析。
AI.method: 引入了InSituMeasure基准，包含2922个真实工业监测场景、8个专业工程仪器类别以及密集的仪表属性注释和故障诊断噪声标签；定义了数值准确度、单位一致性、拒绝不可回答任务及模型失败与错误因素对齐等评估指标，并对24个当前最先进的MLLM进行了全面评估与分析。
AI.result: 在24个最先进的MLLM评估中，表现最好的模型仅达到了25.7%的联合值-单位准确率和51.8%的置信度-诊断F1分数；分析发现模型主要受文本诱导捷径、过度自信响应以及真实工业噪声（如混合干扰、视点偏差、遮挡和环境干扰）的影响而失败。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态大模型在真实工业场景的 situated measurement（情境化测量）中表现出严重不足，InSituMeasure基准的提出为未来开发更具鲁棒性、可解释性和工业适用性的MLLM指明了方向。
AI.translation: 对于经过培训的操作员来说，仪表读数只需要很少的专业知识、较低的认知努力和较高的可重复性。然而，尽管多模态大模型（MLLMs）在通用多模态基准上取得了强劲的成果，但在连续值测量方面仍然不可靠。现有的基准暴露了这一弱点，但它们将测量与现实的、基于知识的设置隔离开来，缺乏情境上下文、专业仪器、真实世界噪声和匹配的诊断注释，从而降低了真实性并限制了根本原因分析。我们引入了InSituMeasure来评估情境测量的基础（grounding）。它包含来自八个专业工程仪器功能类别的2,922个真实工业监控场景，具有密集的仪表属性注释和用于故障诊断的噪声标签。我们定义了预定义容差和单位一致性下的数值准确度、拒绝虚假或不可回答任务、以及模型故障与注释错误因素之间对齐的评估指标。在24个最先进的MLLM中，最好的模型仅达到了25.7%的联合值-单位准确率和51.8%的置信度-诊断F1值，这揭示了通用多模态能力与可靠情境测量之间存在巨大差距。进一步的分析找出了由文本诱导的捷径、过度自信的回答以及真实的工业噪声（包括混合干扰、视点偏差、遮挡和环境干扰）导致的失败原因。
AI.summary: 本文提出了InSituMeasure，这是一个用于评估多模态大模型在真实工业场景中情境化测量能力的新基准。通过包含2,922个带有噪声标签和属性注释的工业场景，评估发现当前顶尖的MLLM在连续值测量上表现极差，暴露出模型在面对真实工业噪声和复杂测量任务时的局限性。
AI.keywords: Multimodal Large Language Models, Industrial Measurement, Situated Grounding, Benchmark, Failure Diagnosis
AI.comments: 该论文针对多模态大模型在工业场景下的连续值测量能力不足这一痛点，构建了一个高质量、真实且包含丰富噪声与诊断注释的基准数据集InSituMeasure。论文通过严谨的实验揭示了当前顶尖大模型在实际工业测量中表现的巨大缺陷（如幻觉、过度自信、受文本捷径干扰等），对推动具身智能和工业级MLLM的可靠性研究具有重要意义。

title: A Black Box for Agentic Processes: Blockchain-Anchored Evidence for AI Agent Communication, Human Oversight, and GRC Audits
summary: Autonomous AI agents increasingly communicate with other agents, invoke tools, exchange intermediate results, and request human approvals. These workflows create a new auditability problem: organizations must reconstruct what happened, when it happened, which agent or human was involved, which control or policy applied, and whether records were modified afterwards. Motivated by the 2026 OpenAI/Hugging Face incident, this position and architecture paper proposes a product- and vendor-neutral black-box architecture for agentic processes. The architecture creates blockchain-anchored cryptographic commitments for selected agent communications, human-in-the-loop approvals, tool calls, and process artifacts without placing sensitive content on-chain. We define an evidence model that distinguishes temporal anchoring and artifact integrity from event ordering, capture authenticity, authorized anchoring, and causal traceability. The latter properties require additional architectural controls. We then discuss practical use for Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), including compliance testing, risk-based evidence selection, monitoring evidence streams, incident reconstruction, and regulatory reporting readiness under the EU AI Act, NIS2, and the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA). This position and architecture paper does not present an empirical performance or security evaluation. The approach does not prevent agent misbehavior or prove semantic truth. Rather, it strengthens the evidentiary basis for later verification of critical process traces.

AI.title_translation: 代理流程的黑盒：用于AI代理通信、人工监督和GRC审计的区块链锚定证据
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于区块链的黑盒架构，为AI代理的通信、人工监督及工具调用提供安全、不可篡改的证据链，以应对复杂的GRC审计与合规挑战。
AI.motivation: 随着自主AI agents的广泛应用，组织面临着重建复杂交互流程、明确责任归属以及确保记录未被篡改的审计难题，传统的审计方法难以满足日益增长的合规需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种产品和供应商中立的黑盒架构，利用区块链创建加密承诺来记录代理通信、人工审批、工具调用和流程人工制品，并定义了涵盖时间锚定、工件完整性、事件排序、捕获真实性、授权锚定及因果可追溯性的证据模型。
AI.result: 提出了一种不依赖特定供应商的架构和证据模型，支持治理、风险和合规（GRC）的实际应用，包括合规测试、风险驱动的证据选择、事件重建以及满足欧盟AI法案、NIS2和网络韧性法案（CRA）的监管报告准备。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的区块链锚定黑盒架构为AI代理流程、人工监督和GRC审计提供了强有力的证据基础，有助于满足日益严格的监管合规要求。
AI.translation: 自主AI代理越来越多地与其他代理通信、调用工具、交换中间结果并请求人工审批。这些工作流带来了一个新的可审计性问题：组织必须重构发生了什么、何时发生、涉及哪个代理或人类、适用了哪个控制或策略以及记录是否随后被修改。受2026年OpenAI/Hugging Face事件的启发，这篇立场与架构论文提出了一种针对代理流程的产品和供应商中立的黑盒架构。该架构为选定的代理通信、人工回路审批、工具调用和流程工件创建了基于区块链锚定的密码学承诺，而无需将敏感内容置于链上。我们定义了一个证据模型，该模型将时间锚定和工件完整性与事件排序、捕获真实性、授权锚定以及因果可追溯性区分开来。后几种属性需要额外的架构控制。然后，我们讨论了其在治理、风险和合规（GRC）方面的实际应用，包括合规性测试、基于风险的证据选择、监控证据流、事件重构以及在欧盟AI法案、NIS2和网络韧性 Act (CRA)下的监管报告准备就绪。这篇立场与架构论文没有展示实证性能或安全评估。该方法不能阻止代理的不当行为或证明语义上的真实性。相反，它为随后验证关键流程轨迹加强了证据基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种区块链锚定的黑盒架构与证据模型，用于记录AI代理通信、人工监督和工具调用，从而解决了多代理工作流中的审计难题，并增强了GRC（治理、风险和合规）审计的证据基础。
AI.keywords: AI代理, 区块链锚定, 审计与合规, 证据模型, 治理风险与合规 (GRC)
AI.comments: 该论文针对自主AI代理工作流的审计难题，提出了一种基于区块链锚定的黑盒架构，创新性地在不暴露敏感内容的前提下实现加密承诺和因果可追溯性，对欧盟AI法案等合规监管具有重要意义。不过，论文目前属于观点与架构设计性质，缺乏实证评估。

title: A location-invariant estimator of extremal quantile treatment effects for heavy-tailed distributions
summary: Quantile treatment effects (QTEs) measure the effect of a treatment on the distribution of an outcome, and their estimation at extreme quantile levels is of central interest in applications where the target quantiles lie far beyond the range of the data. For heavy-tailed potential outcomes, existing extremal QTE estimators rely on extrapolation combined with a causal extreme value index (EVI) estimator, but the resulting estimator is not invariant under a common location shift of the potential outcome distributions, even though the population QTE is. We address this issue in two steps. First, we adapt the location-invariant Fraga estimator of the EVI to the causal setting using inverse propensity score weighting. Second, we replace the original extrapolation formula with a difference-based scheme, under which the location parameter cancels when quantile differences are taken. The resulting QTE estimator is therefore location invariant. We establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the proposed extremal QTE estimators, and provide a consistent variance estimator, leading to asymptotically valid inference. A simulation study confirms the location invariance, the stability with respect to the threshold, and the coverage of the proposed methods.

title: FLY-EVAL++: An Evidence-Driven Evaluation Protocol for Safety-Constrained Flight Prediction with Large Language Models
comments: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) in safety-critical, physics-governed environments requires more than accuracy-based metrics, because predictions that are numerically close to the ground truth can still violate operational constraints, combine fields in physically inconsistent ways, or fail to produce usable structured outputs. Existing evaluation protocols do not measure these failure modes reliably. We propose FLY-EVAL++, an evidence-driven evaluation protocol that combines deterministic verification of protocol compliance, physical feasibility, and safety constraints with fixed rubric-guided aggregation into interpretable multi-dimensional scores. We instantiate FLY-EVAL++ for Flight Trajectory and Attitude Prediction (FTAP) by extending the PilotBench setting with history-conditioned and multi-step prediction tasks. Across 66 LLMs, safety compliance is the most discriminative dimension of model behavior: models with comparable predictive performance differ by more than 28 points in safety score, and we observe recurrent failures including safety violations under physically plausible predictions and instability in multi-step rollouts. These results show that evaluation in safety-critical domains should measure constraint satisfaction and structured validity explicitly rather than rely on accuracy-centric reporting alone.
comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026

title: Representational alignment yields generalizable safety in language models
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) is essential for their safe deployment. Current alignment methods mainly optimize observable responses, yet models remain vulnerable when the same harmful intent is recast in unfamiliar or adversarial forms that humans can easily recognize. Prototype theory offers an account of this adaptability. Human concepts are represented around central cases, and new instances are categorized according to their graded typicality relative to these prototypes. Here we show that such categorization of moral concepts is weakly preserved in current LLMs. Across 23 LLMs, models often failed to distinguish opposed moral categories or preserve fine-grained typicality within each category. These deficits persist across parameter sizes and alignment stages. We developed representational similarity optimization, which directly aligns the latent representations in LLMs with the categorization expressed in human moral judgements, without supervising generated responses. In matched experiments using the same 251,334 moral annotations, standard behavioral alignment learned the intended moral judgements at the response level while leaving the categorization structure largely unchanged and increasing vulnerability across adversarial evaluations. Reorganizing moral categorization produced more modest gains in explicit judgements but consistently improved adversarial robustness across model scales on diverse benchmarks and attack strategies. Our findings provide functional support for the view that prototype-based categorization contributes to behavioral adaptability. They also show that transferring this representational principle to LLMs yields generalizable safety under adversarial conditions.

title: Instruction Duplication as an Inference-Time Control Primitive
comments: 7 pages, 2 tables. Code and frozen reproduction artifacts: https://github.com/victorlavrenko/answer-engineering/releases/tag/instruction-duplication-arxiv-v1
summary: Procedural instruction following is a basic requirement for controllable language-model systems, especially when generated trajectories are inspected or repaired downstream. We introduce instruction duplication, a minimal black-box inference-time control that repeats only the procedural instruction, without retraining or decoding changes. Across seven instruction-tuned models, 300 medical multiple-choice questions, eight placement conditions, and 16,800 scheduled generations, moving from one to two copies raises the deterministic All-8 diagnostic--responses passing all eight observable tests--from 90.22% to 93.17% (+2.95 percentage points), eliminating 30.2% of the failures remaining after one copy. Pre-provisional TF-IDF recall rises from 73.44% to 74.81% (+1.38 points; Holm-adjusted p < .001), while final-answer accuracy remains exactly 60.21%. Premature commitment increases from 1.52% to 2.30% (p_Holm = .00536). A blinded challenge audit yields 10/30 directional confirmations, 20/30 perceptual ties, and no reversals; its prespecified 28/30 confirmation criterion is not met. Yet this distinction can matter operationally when a downstream system acts on the generated trajectory. In Answer Engineering (AE), where explicit trajectory state determines local repair, the published reason-first no-editing SSNHL endpoint was 25.1%; system-only AE was later reproduced at 84.2%, and the same trailing duplicate raised it to 97.1%. For conductive diagnostic branch preservation, the corresponding values are 58.9% published without editing, 78.6% with reproduced AE, and 73.8% with AE plus duplication--a within-AE decrease, but still 14.9 points above the no-editing baseline. Instruction duplication is therefore a low-complexity, placement-sensitive control whose practical value can emerge through the downstream system that consumes the exposed trajectory.
comment: 7 pages, 2 tables. Code and frozen reproduction artifacts: https://github.com/victorlavrenko/answer-engineering/releases/tag/instruction-duplication-arxiv-v1

title: Stable and Scalable Bundle Adjustment of Holistic 3D Structures
comments: To appear at ECCV 2026. Code available as part of the LIMAP toolbox at https://github.com/cvg/limap/
summary: Bundle Adjustment (BA) is a cornerstone of 3D computer vision and has benefited from decades of advances in sparse optimization and numerical methods. It was originally developed for jointly optimizing camera intrinsics, poses and sparse 3D points. While extensions incorporate lines and other primitives, integrating richer geometric structures such as parallelism, coplanarity, or wireframes often introduces significantly increased computational cost and reduced numerical stability. In this paper, we propose a unified framework that extends bundle adjustment to jointly optimize geometric features and higher-order relations. We first introduce a taxonomy that distinguishes scalable geometric features with direct 2D measurements (e.g., points and lines), from groups encoding higher-order relations (e.g., coplanarity, parallelism, etc.), where we show that groups can be modeled as camera-like entities within the bundle adjustment framework. Building on this formulation, we propose that both group constraints and cross-feature relations (i.e., point-line associations) can be expressed through 2D reprojection measurements. By formulating group-induced and cross-feature reprojection errors, we preserve the sparsity structure of classical point-based BA under Schur elimination, while avoiding direct 3D regularization that degrades the conditioning and stability. Experiments on both real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate runtime performance comparable to classical point-only bundle adjustment, while producing significantly richer 3D structures and improved geometric accuracy.
comment: To appear at ECCV 2026. Code available as part of the LIMAP toolbox at https://github.com/cvg/limap/

title: Influence of Extruded Filament Shape on Buildability in 3D Concrete Printing: A Geometry-Informed Deep Learning-FEM Approach
summary: The geometric morphology of deposited filaments can significantly influence the structural performance and stability of 3D concrete-printed (3DCP) structures. However, most finite element (FEM)-based approaches for buildability assessment represent printed layers as simplified rectangles, potentially limiting predictive accuracy. This study proposes a geometry-informed modelling framework that integrates the deep-learning-based filament shape prediction tool ShapeGen3DCP with a layer-activation FEM approach to investigate the effect of realistic filament geometries on buildability. The framework generates geometry-aware numerical models directly from material and process parameters, eliminating the need for experimental filament characterization or computationally intensive fluid-flow simulations. Validation against experimental data and a parametric study of rectilinear walls demonstrate that extrusion parameters and the resulting filament geometry can significantly influence buildability predictions. Realistic filament representations are particularly important for free-flow deposition, whereas layer-pressing strategies are less sensitive to geometric simplifications. Among the investigated representations, an elliptical approximation provides an effective balance between geometric fidelity and modelling simplicity. When rectangular representations are preferred to enable regular computational meshes for faster simulations, defining their dimensions based on volume conservation improves prediction reliability compared with calibrating them using either the maximum filament width or the interlayer contact width. Overall, the proposed methodology demonstrates the importance of incorporating filament geometry into 3DCP simulations and provides practical guidance for selecting efficient and accurate geometric representations for buildability assessment.

title: IRWOZ 2.0: A Large Language Model-driven Dialogue Dataset for Industrial Robot Conversations
summary: IRWOZ has improved industrial human-robot interaction (HRI) dialogue systems through domain-specific annotations. However, its initial version contains substantial noise in dialogue states and utterances, limiting state-tracking accuracy. We introduce IRWOZ 2.0, which addresses these limitations through large language model (LLM) enhanced generation (Mistral/Claude-3.5) and quality refinements. Our improved dataset expands to 390 dialogues across 4 industrial domains (Assembly, Delivery, Position, Relocation), featuring manual corrections and automated typo removal. Benchmark experiments on dialogue state tracking demonstrate significant improvements, with GPT-2's BLEU-4 score increasing from 0.1651 to 0.5604 compared to original IRWOZ. To support industrial HRI research, we publicly released IRWOZ 2.0 dataset at https://ieee-dataport.org/documents/irwoz-20-large-language-model-driven-dialogue-dataset-industrial-robot-conversations

title: DSAQuant: Denoising-Stage-Aligned Quantization-Aware Training for Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion models (VDMs) have achieved impressive progress in text-to-video generation, but their high memory and computational costs hinder practical deployment. Quantization-aware training (QAT) is an effective solution for compressing and accelerating advanced generative models without runtime overhead at inference. However, existing QAT methods suffer from a distinctive challenge in VDMs: while they often preserve prompt semantics, global layout, and coarse motion, the quantized model severely degrades visual details, texture fidelity, and sharpness. In this paper, we trace this degradation to the timestep-agnostic design of conventional quantization pipelines, which overlooks the stage-wise functionality of video denoising. In VDMs, early denoising steps mainly establish global structure and motion, whereas middle and late steps refine local appearance and high-frequency details. Based on this insight, we propose DSAQuant, a Denoising-Stage-Aligned Quantization-aware training framework for VDMs. During training, Denoising-Stage Oriented Supervision preserves teacher distillation in early steps for stable structure planning, while shifting later steps toward target-driven optimization to enhance detail reconstruction. During inference, Denoising-Stage Gated Guidance disables CFG in the final denoising steps to prevent it from amplifying quantization-induced errors into high-frequency artifacts. Extensive experiments on the Wan and CogVideoX families under W4A4 and W3A3 settings show that DSAQuant consistently outperforms the SOTA QAT baseline, improving the VBench average score by up to 6.60 under aggressive W3A3 quantization while preserving strong text-video alignment. These results demonstrate that effective VDM quantization requires not only reducing quantization error, but also aligning quantization training and inference with the stage-wise nature of video diffusion.

title: Editable Visual Design
summary:
While diffusion base models such as GPT-Image-2 and Nano-Banana exhibit remarkable visual expressiveness, their end-to-end generation inherently yields flattened bitmaps with error-prone text, precluding layer-wise post-editing. Conversely, code-based visual generation via Coding Agents provides precise layout control and decoupled layers, yet remains constrained by a lack of global aesthetic intuition and the difficulty of coding complex visual assets.
  To address this, we propose Editable Visual Design, a new paradigm driven by a Coding Agent. We designate the VLM as the ``creative brain'' for requirement comprehension, task planning, and aesthetic judgment, while utilizing the image generation model as an on-demand ``visual world simulator'' to synthesize standalone visual assets. Operating under an ``imagine first, then act'' closed-loop workflow, the agent generates isolated assets, writes native HTML/CSS, and iteratively refines the design against visual rendering feedback.
  Furthermore, Agent Design Replay faithfully reproduces the creative and reasoning trajectory akin to that of professional human designers. Ultimately, the system delivers editable artifacts with decoupled layers and real text, enabling users to perform intuitive mouse dragging and layout adjustments on a graphical user interface. Validations on posters, infographics, and other scenarios show that this paradigm successfully achieves both refined aesthetics and production-grade editability.

title: Confidence-Gated Admission for Hardware Prefetching: When the Gate Matters More Than the Predictor
summary: Learned cache prefetchers are typically evaluated against classical predictors that always issue requests, confounding the prediction model with the admission policy. We disentangle these variables with matched controls: the same admission gate is applied to both a 257-parameter online MLP and a classical stride predictor. The neural advantage vanishes; the MLP is indistinguishable from gated stride on random traffic and slower on most regular streams. The gate itself is architecturally useful independent of the predictor: on twenty SPEC CPU2017 programs in native ChampSim, it removes 35% of prefetches and improves accuracy from 11% to 15%, but DRAM reads change by only 0.07% demonstrating that proxy metrics do not predict endpoint behavior. We prove gate-closed execution reproduces the no-prefetch baseline exactly. The gate matters more than the predictor, and better proxies do not imply better endpoints.

title: Extending concurrent separation logic to the hardware level to verify the xv6 OS kernel on RISC-V with AI agents
summary:
MachCSL is a framework for verifying systems software, such as an OS kernel, on top of low-level semantics of a RISC-V computer, based on the Sail RISC-V semantics. The key idea behind MachCSL is to adapt concurrent separation logic, based on Iris, to reasoning about low-level hardware execution at the sub-instruction level: page-table translation, TLB, privilege levels, configuration registers, instruction fetch/decode/execute, traps and interrupts, DMA, shared memory, power failures, etc. Reasoning at this level of detail ensures that the system software correctly manages all of the hardware details.
  Verifying software at this low level of abstraction is tedious, but LLM-based agents are capable of reasoning about such low-level details. As a case study, we verify the xv6 OS kernel (6,593 lines of C and assembly code), which provides a traditional Unix system call interface (processes, file system, file descriptors, and preemptive scheduling) and has substantial internal concurrency (multi-core support with fine-grained locking, shared memory, interrupts, DMA, etc.). In the verification process, we uncovered nine bugs in the xv6 implementation, as well as one bug in the Sail RISC-V semantics. The verification effort took us 77 days, including the time to develop the MachCSL framework.

title: The Head Complexity of Boolean Functions in Single-Layer Attention
summary:
What can a single layer of self-attention compute? We study head complexity: the minimum number of attention heads required to compute a function in a one-layer attention-only model. We establish an exact hierarchy under this measure: $k$ heads compute $k$-bit parity but cannot compute $(k+1)$-bit parity.
  The lower bound is unconditional in the two resources a transformer might otherwise exploit; it holds at unbounded embedding dimension and unbounded numerical precision. The proof rests on an alternating-sum obstruction: after clearing the softmax denominators, every monomial in the resulting decision polynomial omits at least one of the $k+1$ input bits, forcing its correlation with parity to vanish. The same obstruction yields lower bounds for related tasks, including the well-studied multi-hop induction-head task.
  We also establish compactness bounds for embedding dimension and numerical precision. Specifically, a compactness theorem shows that any function computable at all can be computed with embedding dimension and precision bounded by the discrete data of the task, namely, head count, alphabet size, and length. Thus, potentially unbounded dimension or precision provably cannot substitute for heads. Finally, we derive nearly matching universal bounds for general binary functions: $2^n$ heads suffice to compute every $n$-bit binary function, with one head per monomial in its multilinear expansion, while a counting argument shows almost all such functions require $Ω(2^n/n^2)$ heads. This lower bound matches the upper bound to within a $\operatorname{poly}(n)$ factor, even when dimension and precision are unbounded. Together, these results characterize head requirements for Boolean computation in this model.

title: The Dice Roll Method: A Standardized Protocol for Repeated-Query Auditing of Large Language Model Brand Recommendations
comments: 30 pages, 2 figures, 19 tables. Substantially revised; supersedes the Research Square preprint 10.21203/rs.3.rs-8883056/v1. Includes a pre-registered external validation on three independent corpora (Motoki et al., Rozado, llm-stability)
summary: Background: Researchers increasingly use repeated identical prompts to audit stochastic variation in large language model (LLM) brand recommendations, yet no standardized protocol exists for setting iteration counts, selecting stability metrics, or establishing reliability thresholds. Objective: We formalize the Dice Roll Method as a reusable protocol for repeated-query auditing of LLM brand recommendations, grounded in a generative model of temperature-scaled nucleus sampling. Methods: Total response variance is decomposed into sampling, prompt-phrasing, run-to-run, and model-version components. The stack: a negative-binomial mixed model with iterations as repeated measures; Cliff's delta as the distribution-free effect size; dependence-preserving bootstrap; simulation-based power; a generalizability-theory decomposition; drift diagnostics on pinned snapshots. We reanalyse five brand-recommendation auditing studies: approximately 190,000 observations, 270+ brands, 6 languages, iteration counts 5 to 40. Results: Three tiers of iteration guidance emerge from the D-study: exploratory (n = 5, G = 0.58), confirmatory (n = 10, G = 0.74), and rigorous (n = 15, G = 0.81), tied to effect-size and generalizability targets. The four metric families (count, set, embedding, fairness-adjusted PASOR) are complementary, motivating a compact metric battery over single indicators. A pre-registered external validation on three independent corpora (Motoki et al., 100-round; Rozado, 24 models; llm-stability) reproduces the D-study reliability prediction in 37 of 39 cells with no failures and the n = 5 power value to two decimals; the fixed tiers do not transfer, supporting a pilot-then-solve reading. Conclusion: The protocol gives repeated-query auditing of LLM brand recommendations a statistically principled footing under the conditional, non-Gaussian structure of real autoregressive generation.
