title: Tempting the Agent: The Economics of Reputation without Persistent Identity in AI Agent Markets
summary:
Reputation is a fundamental mechanism through which markets sustain trust when service quality cannot be perfectly assessed ex ante, constituting a form of intertemporal economic capital by attracting future demand. Its effectiveness as a disciplinary mechanism depends not only on past interactions but also on the persistence of the identity to which reputation is attached. When identities can be abandoned and recreated cheaply, reputational capital may itself become an object of opportunistic exploitation.
  This paper develops a dynamic economic framework to study when reputation is sufficient to discipline autonomous agents. We model reputation as capital attracting future economic activity. At each point, an agent chooses between operating honestly, investing in quality to preserve future gains, or executing a one-shot deviation to extract its reputation's value and restart from a penalized identity. Our analysis relates the temptation to opportunistic behavior to identity-reset costs, reputation persistence, demand sensitivity, and enforcement design, deriving comparative statics on optimal quality provision.
  Autonomous AI-agent operating on the blockchain are a relevant application: infrastructures such as ERC-8004, ERC-8183, and x402 combine reputation, identity, and payments in permissionless markets. Nonetheless, our framework applies to any environment where reputation generates future business and identities are replaceable.

title: Advances in Machine Learning for Directed Evolution: A Five-Year Retrospective
summary: The last five-plus years have seen many protein engineering disciplines transformed by advances in machine learning (ML), but the same cannot be said for directed evolution. Reflecting on a previously co-authored perspective, I discuss why I believe this to be the case, arguing that a disconnect between the goals of machine-learning-assisted directed evolution (MLDE) researchers--"identify an optimal protein"--and the goals of directed evolution more broadly--"identify a sufficient protein given time and resource constraints"--is a principal culprit. As an example, I highlight how nearly all current MLDE methods neglect to account for the cost of DNA synthesis, resulting in strategies that have limited practical applicability regardless of the underlying models' capabilities. I close by discussing recent works that are exceptions to this overarching trend, and emphasize that the last five years of efforts in ML-assisted protein engineering and the prescribed reframe of MLDE objectives need not be mutually exclusive.

title: Distinctness threshold for pseudorandom unitaries
summary: Pseudorandomness is increasingly recognized as a key property of ensembles in quantum information theory, statistical mechanics, and quantum many-body physics. Yet it appears in two conceptually different forms: statistical pseudorandomness, embodied by unitary designs, and computational pseudorandomness captured by pseudorandom unitaries (PRUs). The relationship between these two forms of pseudorandomness remains surprisingly poorly understood. Existing PRU constructions reveal this interplay where a statistically randomizing ingredient, a unitary design, is combined with classical cryptographic primitives to produce computational pseudorandomness. We show that statistical pseudorandomness is not necessary for computationally pseudorandom unitaries. We do this by replacing the unitary $2$-design layer in the existing constructions with ensembles that are not even state $1$-designs, yet are sufficiently {\em distinct}, a property we identify to be necessary for any PRU. This yields new non-adaptively secure PRU ensembles whose computational pseudorandomness is obtained without an underlying statistically pseudorandom quantum ensemble, such as a $2$-design. We characterize distinctness via an entangled analogue of anticoncentration and use it to show that distinctness already captures constraints on coherence and imaginarity of PRUs, while identifying broad classes of inputs for which the latter obstruction disappears, enabling real-valued PRUs even for certain (maximally) entangled states. As an application, we use lack of distinctness to constrain the conjectured pseudorandomness of the random phase-Hadamard ensemble to form a PRU.

title: Discrete Gromov-Wasserstein Duality: Algorithms and Isomorphism Testing
summary: The Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distance provides a principled framework for aligning metric measure (mm) spaces based solely on their intrinsic structure. Its ability to identify isomorphic representations of distributions across spaces renders it valuable for comparing data where equality up to isomorphism occurs naturally such as in graphs or, more generally, distributions on graphs. Recently, a type of dual form for the GW distance between Euclidean distributions with the squared Euclidean or inner product costs was derived, spurring the development of new statistical and algorithmic results for this setting. This work furnishes a novel duality result for GW distances with and without entropic regularization that is applicable to all finitely supported mm spaces. Leveraging this result, we derive the sample complexity of empirical GW distances between finite mm spaces, as well as limit distributions under proper centering and scaling. Furthermore, we propose new algorithms for solving the regularized GW problem which are subject to formal convergence guarantees. These statistical and algorithmic advancements give rise to a principled and efficient framework for testing whether two distributions on the set of graphs with a fixed number of nodes are isomorphic based on samples.

AI.title_translation: 离散Gromov-Wasserstein对偶性：算法与同构测试
AI.tldr: 本文提出了有限支集度量测度空间上的离散Gromov-Wasserstein对偶理论，据此给出了样本复杂度、极限分布、收敛可保的算法及图同构检验框架。
AI.motivation: 此前针对GW距离的对偶理论主要局限于采用平方欧氏或内积代价函数的欧氏分布，缺乏适用于一般有限支集度量测度空间的对偶理论，限制了其在统计性质分析、算法收敛性保证以及图分布同构检验等场景中的应用。
AI.method: 针对带与不带熵正则化的有限支集度量测度空间GW距离，推导了新型离散对偶形式；基于该对偶性分析了经验GW距离的样本复杂度与中心化缩放后的极限分布；设计了具有理论收敛保证的正则化GW新求解算法，并构建了图分布同构测试统计框架。
AI.result: 成功建立了适用于所有有限支集mm空间的新型GW对偶框架；获得了经验GW距离的样本复杂度及其渐近极限分布；提出了具备形式化收敛保障的正则化GW算法；提出了一种基于样本检验固定节点数图分布是否同构的有效原则性框架。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的离散GW对偶理论为有限度量测度空间的比较提供了坚实的理论基石，催生了具备收敛保证的高效算法，并成功应用于基于样本的图同构假设检验。
AI.translation: Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）距离提供了一个纯粹基于内在结构来对齐度量测度（mm）空间的原则性框架。其识别跨空间分布同构表征的能力，使其在自然存在同构等价性的数据比较中极具价值，例如图或更一般的图上分布。近期，针对具有平方欧几里得代价或内积代价的欧几里得分布，研究者推导了一种GW距离的对偶形式，推动了该设定下新统计与算法成果的发展。本文针对带与不带熵正则化、适用于所有有限支集mm空间的GW距离，提出了一种全新的对偶性结果。利用该结果，我们推导了有限mm空间之间经验GW距离的样本复杂度，以及在适当中心化和缩放下的极限分布。此外，我们提出了求解正则化GW问题的新算法，并给出了形式化的收敛保证。这些统计和算法上的进展构建了一个原则性且高效的框架，用于根据样本检验固定节点数的图集合上的两个分布是否同构。
AI.summary: 本文建立了适用于任意有限支集度量测度空间的新型离散Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）距离对偶理论（包含带与不带熵正则化情形）。利用这一对偶结果，作者刻画了经验GW距离的样本复杂度与极限分布，提出了具有严格收敛保证的正则化GW求解算法，并构建了用于测试图分布同构性的高效统计框架。
AI.keywords: Gromov-Wasserstein距离, 对偶性, 样本复杂度, 熵正则化, 图同构检验
AI.comments: 该工作的重要创新在于突破了此前欧氏空间特定成本函数对偶性的限制，将GW距离对偶理论推广至任意有限支集度量测度空间，不仅补全了统计渐近性质（极限分布与样本复杂度），还给出了收敛可保的求解算法和图同构检验应用。局限在于该理论仅针对离散/有限支集空间，未涉及连续非欧空间。

title: Beyond Blur: A Semantic Tri-view Pipeline for Teledermatology Gradability via Skin Micro-relief
summary: Smartphone skin photographs are indispensable to teledermatology, yet assessing the diagnostic suitability of submitted cases (gradability) remains a critical bottleneck in mobile care workflows. Dermatologists routinely review multiple photographic views (regional, angled, and close-up) to identify consistent textural detail rather than relying on a single image. We present the Semantic Tri-view Pipeline, an interpretable architecture for automated teledermatology gradability screening that formalizes epidermal micro-relief as a computable biomarker of image quality. Using an expert-annotated subset of the public SCIN dataset, we train a lightweight DeepLabV3+ model to segment micro-relief fidelity. These spatial masks are then aggregated across up to three case views with a logistic regression classifier, leveraging viewpoint redundancy to support robustness under uncontrolled smartphone acquisition. This approach learns context-aware, clinically intelligible heuristics, such as penalizing high-fidelity texture in regional distance views. Evaluated at a predefined 90% sensitivity operating point, the system's apparent errors largely reflect subjective clinical variance on borderline cases where clinicians rely on non-visual metadata. On SCIN, performance improves from an AUC of 0.81 (80.6% PPV) on variance-heavy majority-consensus cases to 0.96 (97.7% PPV) on optically unambiguous unanimous cases. Overall, this work delivers an interpretable, privacy-by-design, edge-ready system that can provide real-time feedback during case submission to filter ungradable photo sets before review.

AI.title_translation: 超越模糊：一种基于皮肤微浮雕的远程皮肤病学可分级性语义三视图管道
AI.tldr: 开发了一种语义三视图管道，通过皮肤微浮雕自动化评估远程皮肤病学图像的可分级性，以过滤不合格照片。
AI.motivation: 智能手机皮肤照片在远程皮肤病学中不可或缺，但评估提交病例的诊断适用性（可分级性）仍然是移动护理工作流程中的一个关键瓶颈。皮肤科医生通常需要审查多个摄影视图（区域、倾斜和特写）来识别一致的纹理细节，而不是仅仅依赖一张图像。
AI.method: 本文提出了语义三视图管道，一个可解释的架构，用于自动化远程皮肤病学可分级性筛选。它将表皮微浮雕形式化为可计算的图像质量生物标志物。利用专家标注的公共SCIN数据集子集，训练了一个轻量级的DeepLabV3+模型来分割微浮雕保真度。这些空间掩码随后通过逻辑回归分类器在多达三个病例视图中聚合，利用视图冗余来支持在不受控智能手机采集下的鲁棒性。该方法学习了上下文感知、临床上可理解的启发式规则，例如惩罚区域远距离视图中的高保真纹理。
AI.result: 在预定义的90%敏感性操作点进行评估，该系统明显的错误主要反映了临床医生在需要依赖非视觉元数据的边缘病例上的主观临床差异。在SCIN数据集上，从方差较大的多数共识病例的AUC 0.81（80.6% PPV）提高到光学上明确的一致病例的AUC 0.96（97.7% PPV）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可解释、隐私设计、边缘就绪的系统，可以在病例提交期间提供实时反馈，以便在审查前过滤掉不可分级的照片集。
AI.translation: 智能手机皮肤照片对于远程皮肤病学来说不可或缺，但评估提交病例的诊断适用性（可分级性）仍然是移动护理工作流程中的一个关键瓶颈。皮肤科医生通常会审查多个摄影视图（区域、倾斜和特写）以识别一致的纹理细节，而不是仅仅依赖一张图像。我们提出了语义三视图管道，这是一种可解释的架构，用于自动化远程皮肤病学可分级性筛选，它将表皮微浮雕形式化为一种可计算的图像质量生物标志物。利用公共SCIN数据集的专家标注子集，我们训练了一个轻量级的DeepLabV3+模型来分割微浮雕保真度。这些空间掩码随后通过逻辑回归分类器在多达三个病例视图中聚合，利用视图冗余来支持在不受控智能手机采集下的鲁棒性。这种方法学习了上下文感知、临床上可理解的启发式规则，例如惩罚区域远距离视图中的高保真纹理。在预定义的90%敏感性操作点进行评估，该系统明显的错误主要反映了临床医生在需要依赖非视觉元数据的边缘病例上的主观临床差异。在SCIN数据集上，性能从方差较大的多数共识病例的AUC 0.81（80.6% PPV）提高到光学上明确的一致病例的AUC 0.96（97.7% PPV）。总的来说，这项工作提供了一个可解释的、隐私设计、边缘就绪的系统，可以在病例提交期间提供实时反馈，以便在审查前过滤掉不可分级的照片集。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“语义三视图管道”，一个用于远程皮肤病学图像可分级性自动筛选的可解释系统。该系统将皮肤微浮雕作为图像质量的生物标志物，通过DeepLabV3+模型分割微浮雕保真度，并结合多视图（区域、倾斜、特写）图像的逻辑回归分类器进行聚合。该方法在SCIN数据集上表现出良好性能，尤其是在光学明确的病例中，并能提供实时反馈以过滤不合格照片，从而解决远程皮肤病学中图像诊断适用性评估的瓶颈。
AI.keywords: 远程皮肤病学, 图像质量, 微浮雕, 语义三视图, 可分级性
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于将皮肤微浮雕作为图像质量的可计算生物标志物，并结合多视图分析来提高远程皮肤病学图像可分级性评估的鲁棒性和准确性。其可解释性、隐私设计和边缘就绪的特性使其在实际临床应用中具有重要潜力，能够有效提高远程医疗的工作效率和诊断质量。

title: Occupancy-based Quantile Risk Control
summary: Conformal risk control is an emerging framework for the safe deployment of machine learning models with finite-sample guarantees. To accommodate a broader class of risk notions, quantile risk control extends this framework to quantile-based risk measures. However, existing methods either suffer from excessive conservatism or lack rigorous finite-sample guarantees. To address these limitations, we introduce Occupancy-based Quantile Risk Control (OQRC), a novel method that provides tight risk control bounds with finite-sample validity. Our key idea is to formulate risk control as a finite-occupancy problem by partitioning the loss space with the ordered calibration losses. Specifically, we estimate the distribution of test losses across the resulting bins and upper-bound the risk by the maximum loss attained within each bin. We then select the parameter $λ$ such that this upper bound does not exceed a predefined threshold $α$ with high probability $1-δ$. Theoretically, we establish a finite-sample guarantee showing that OQRC yields tight risk control bounds that converge to the optimal bounds at a provable rate of $\mathcal{O}_ p(n^{-1/2})$. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, reducing the risk gap by up to 78.64\% on common benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 基于占用率的分位数风险控制
AI.tldr: OQRC是一种新的方法，通过将损失空间划分为有限的占用问题，为机器学习模型提供具有有限样本保证的紧密分位数风险控制，并显著减少了风险差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的分位数风险控制方法存在过度保守或缺乏严格的有限样本保证的问题，限制了其在机器学习模型安全部署中的应用。
AI.method: OQRC通过将风险控制表述为一个有限占用问题，利用有序校准损失划分损失空间。具体来说，它估计测试损失在每个分区中的分布，并以每个分区中达到的最大损失作为风险上限。然后选择参数λ，使得该上限以高概率1-δ不超过预设阈值α。
AI.result: 理论上，OQRC提供了紧密的风险控制界限，并以$\mathcal{O}_ p(n^{-1/2})$的可证明速率收敛到最优界限。实验表明，该方法在常见基准测试上将风险差距减少了高达78.64%。
AI.conclusion: OQRC通过引入基于占用率的方法，成功解决了现有分位数风险控制方法的局限性，提供了具有有限样本有效性和紧密风险控制界限的解决方案，并在实践中表现出显著的风险差距减少。
AI.translation: 一致性风险控制是机器学习模型安全部署的一个新兴框架，具有有限样本保证。为了适应更广泛的风险概念，分位数风险控制将此框架扩展到基于分位数的风险度量。然而，现有方法要么过于保守，要么缺乏严格的有限样本保证。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了基于占用率的分位数风险控制（OQRC），这是一种提供具有有限样本有效性的紧密风险控制界限的新方法。我们的核心思想是通过有序校准损失划分损失空间，将风险控制表述为一个有限占用问题。具体来说，我们估计测试损失在由此产生的区间内的分布，并通过每个区间内达到的最大损失来上限定风险。然后，我们选择参数λ，使得这个上限以高概率1-δ不超过预定义的阈值α。理论上，我们建立了有限样本保证，表明OQRC产生紧密的风险控制界限，并以$\mathcal{O}_ p(n^{-1/2})$的可证明速率收敛到最优界限。广泛的实验证明了我们方法的有效性，在常见基准测试上将风险差距减少了高达78.64%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为OQRC（基于占用率的分位数风险控制）的新方法，旨在解决现有分位数风险控制方法在机器学习模型安全部署中存在的过度保守和缺乏严格有限样本保证的问题。OQRC通过将风险控制表述为有限占用问题，利用有序校准损失划分损失空间，并估计测试损失分布来设定紧密的风险控制界限。理论分析表明OQRC具有有限样本保证和最优收敛速率，实验结果也验证了其在降低风险差距方面的显著有效性。
AI.keywords: 分位数风险控制, 有限样本保证, 占用率, 风险控制, 机器学习
AI.comments: OQRC的创新点在于将风险控制问题转化为有限占用问题，并通过对损失空间的精细划分和最大损失上限估计，实现了对分位数风险的紧密控制。这不仅提供了严格的有限样本保证，而且在实践中显著优于现有方法，对于机器学习模型的安全性和可靠性部署具有重要意义。

title: Skolem-Mahler-Lech in rings of positive characteristic: a shorter proof and a multi-dimensional generalization
summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $f(a_1, \ldots, a_n) = \sum_{i=1}^k r_{i1}^{a_1} \cdots r_{in}^{a_n} m_i$ be a linear-exponential map over an $R$-module $M$. Dong and Shafrir (2026) showed that, when $\ell M = 0$ for some $\ell \in \mathbb{N}_{>0}$, the zero set of $f$ is the intersection of effectively computable $p$-normal sets, where $p$ ranges over the prime divisors of $\ell$. This generalizes an earlier theorem of Derksen and Masser (2012) on the solution set of $S$-unit equations over fields of positive characteristic. The purpose of this paper is twofold. First, we give a shorter proof of Dong and Shafrir's result, using the theorem of Derksen-Masser as a blackbox. Our proof also yields a decomposition of the zero set as a positive Boolean combination of affine transformations of zero sets of linear-exponential equations over fields. Second, we prove a multi-dimensional generalization of the Skolem-Mahler-Lech theorem over rings of finite characteristic. Specifically, we show that the zero set of every $n$-dimensional linear recurrence sequence over an $R$-module $M$ satisfying $\ell M = 0$ is the intersection of effectively computable $p$-normal sets (in $\mathbb{N}^n$), where $p$ ranges over the prime divisors of $\ell$. For example, this gives a decision procedure for whether two classical linear recurrence sequences have a common value over a ring of characteristic $p^a$ or $p^a q^b$, where $p$ and $q$ are primes.

AI.title_translation: 正特征环中的Skolem-Mahler-Lech定理：一个更短的证明和多维推广
AI.tldr: 本文为Dong和Shafrir关于正特征环中线性指数映射零集的结果提供了一个更短的证明，并将其零集分解为仿射变换的正布尔组合。此外，本文还将Skolem-Mahler-Lech定理推广到有限特征环上的多维线性递推序列。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在为Dong和Shafrir (2026) 关于正特征环中线性指数映射零集的结果提供一个更短的证明，并在此基础上将Skolem-Mahler-Lech定理推广到有限特征环上的多维线性递推序列。
AI.method: 本文首先将Derksen和Masser (2012) 的定理作为一个黑盒，给出了Dong和Shafrir结果的一个更短的证明，该证明同时提供了零集分解。其次，本文通过证明在满足特定条件的R-模上的n维线性递推序列的零集是有效可计算的p-正规集的交集，实现了Skolem-Mahler-Lech定理的多维推广。
AI.result: 本文提供了一个更短的Dong和Shafrir结果的证明，该证明将零集分解为域上线性指数方程零集仿射变换的正布尔组合。此外，本文还证明了Skolem-Mahler-Lech定理的多维推广：在满足$\ell M = 0$ 的R-模M上，每个n维线性递推序列的零集是有效可计算的p-正规集（在$\mathbb{N}^n$中）的交集，其中p遍历$\ell$ 的素因子。这为判断两个经典线性递推序列在特征为$p^a$或$p^a q^b$的环上是否具有共同值提供了一个判别过程。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地提供了一个已存在定理的更简洁证明，并显著地将Skolem-Mahler-Lech定理推广到多维设置和有限特征环中。这些结果对于理解这些背景下零集的结构至关重要，并提供了实用的判别过程。
AI.translation: 设 $R$ 是一个交换环，$f(a_1, \ldots, a_n) = \sum_{i=1}^k r_{i1}^{a_1} \cdots r_{in}^{a_n} m_i$ 是一个在 $R$-模 $M$ 上的线性指数映射。Dong 和 Shafrir (2026) 表明，当对于某个 $\ell \in \mathbb{N}_{>0}$ 有 $\ell M = 0$ 时，$f$ 的零集是有效可计算的 $p$-正规集的交集，其中 $p$ 遍历 $\ell$ 的素因子。这推广了 Derksen 和 Masser (2012) 早期关于正特征域上 $S$-单位方程解集的定理。本文的目的是双重的。首先，我们给出了 Dong 和 Shafrir 结果的一个更短的证明，将 Derksen-Masser 定理作为一个黑盒使用。我们的证明还给出了零集分解为域上线性指数方程零集仿射变换的正布尔组合。其次，我们证明了有限特征环上 Skolem-Mahler-Lech 定理的多维推广。具体来说，我们表明，在满足 $\ell M = 0$ 的 $R$-模 $M$ 上，每个 $n$ 维线性递推序列的零集是有效可计算的 $p$-正规集（在 $\mathbb{N}^n$ 中）的交集，其中 $p$ 遍历 $\ell$ 的素因子。例如，这提供了一个判别过程，用于判断两个经典线性递推序列是否在特征为 $p^a$ 或 $p^a q^b$ 的环上具有共同值，其中 $p$ 和 $q$ 是素数。
AI.summary: 本文包含两项主要贡献：一是为Dong和Shafrir关于正特征环中线性指数映射零集的结果提供了一个更短的证明，该证明利用了Derksen-Masser定理并给出了零集的分解。二是将Skolem-Mahler-Lech定理多维推广到满足特定条件的R-模上的线性递推序列，表明其零集是有效可计算的p-正规集的交集，这对判断线性递推序列的共同值具有实际意义。
AI.keywords: Skolem-Mahler-Lech, 正特征, 线性指数映射, 线性递推序列, 零集
AI.comments: 本文通过提供一个更高效的证明和将一个基本定理（Skolem-Mahler-Lech）推广到多维和有限特征环的背景，展现了其创新性。这项工作对于深入理解这些数学结构中的零集特征至关重要，并为相关问题提供了实用的决策程序，具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: A Closed-Form Formula for Consistent Lipschitz Regression on Metric Spaces with Sparse Neural Network Realizations
summary:
Several classical machine-learning methods, such as KRRs and SVRs, are both computationally and analytically tractable since their estimators either admit closed-form expressions or are obtained by minimizing convex training objectives; neither feature is generally available for deep neural networks. We address this by introducing a simple closed-form ``two-stage'' compositional formula $\hat{f}$ for reconstructing an unknown Lipschitz function $f:\mathcal{X}\to \mathbb{R}$ on a metric space $(\mathcal X,ρ)$ from $N$ i.i.d. noisy observations.
  Our main result is a high-probability uniform ($L^{\infty}$) recovery guarantee that jointly controls approximation and statistical errors while enjoying an optimization error of zero; in particular, we do not assume oracle access to an approximate ERM. Our secondary main results establish the optimality of our formula in three complementary senses. 1) Function space: On Ahlfors-regular metric spaces, the hypothesis class parameterized by our formula attains the optimal fat-shattering dimension. 2) Parameter space: Its dependence on the parameters is maximally numerically stable, in the sense that a smaller approximation error cannot be achieved with a smaller Lipschitz dependence on the model parameters. 3) Forward pass: Its dependence on the input is maximally regular, matching the Lipschitz constant of the target function $f$. When $\mathcal X=[0,1]^d$ is equipped with the $\ell^\infty$ norm, $\hat{f}$ admits algorithmic ReLU-MLP and exact ReLU-multi-head transformer realizations of depth $\mathcal{O}(\log(N))$ with $\mathcal{O}(N)$ nonzero parameters.

AI.title_translation: 度量空间上一致Lipschitz回归的闭式公式及其稀疏神经网络实现
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于度量空间Lipschitz回归的闭式公式，兼具零优化误差与多重理论最优性，并能以稀疏神经网络高效实现。
AI.motivation: 核岭回归（KRR）和支持向量回归（SVR）等经典机器学习方法具有闭式解或凸优化目标，易于计算和理论分析，而深度神经网络通常缺乏这两种特性且面临复杂的非凸优化难题。
AI.method: 提出了一种简单的闭式“两阶段”复合回归公式，用于从带有噪声的独立同分布样本中重构度量空间上的Lipschitz函数，并在特定空间下设计了深度为 $\mathcal{O}(\log(N))$、非零参数量为 $\mathcal{O}(N)$ 的ReLU-MLP与精确ReLU多头Transformer的稀疏神经网络实现。
AI.result: 获得了高概率一致（$L^\infty$）恢复误差界，同时控制逼近误差与统计误差且优化误差为零；并在假设空间的Fat-shattering维度、参数依赖的数值稳定性以及输入依赖的正则性（严格匹配目标函数的Lipschitz常数）三个维度上证明了该公式的最优性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种具备闭式表达式、零优化误差且具有三项最优性保证的度量空间Lipschitz回归方法，并能通过深度为对数级别、参数稀疏的神经网络架构实现，为深度模型的分析与求解提供了新路径。
AI.translation: 几种经典的机器学习方法（如KRR和SVR）在计算和分析上都是易于处理的，因为它们的估计量要么具有闭式表达式，要么通过最小化凸训练目标得到；而深度神经网络通常不具备这两种特性。针对这一问题，我们引入了一种简单的闭式“两阶段”复合公式 $\hat{f}$，用于从 $N$ 个独立同分布的含噪观测中，重构度量空间 $(\mathcal X, ρ)$ 上的未知Lipschitz函数 $f:\mathcal{X}\to \mathbb{R}$。我们的主要结果是一个高概率的一致（$L^{\infty}$）恢复保证，该保证在优化误差为零的同时联合控制了逼近误差和统计误差；特别是，我们无需假设存在近似经验风险最小化（ERM）的预言机访问权限。我们的次要主要结果在三个互补的层面上确立了该公式的最优性：1）函数空间：在Ahlfors正则度量空间上，由我们公式参数化的假设类达到了最优的fat-shattering维度；2）参数空间：其对参数的依赖具有最大数值稳定性，即更小的逼近误差无法在对模型参数具有更小Lipschitz依赖的情况下实现；3）前向传播：其对输入的依赖具有最大正则性，与目标函数 $f$ 的Lipschitz常数相匹配。当 $\mathcal X=[0,1]^d$ 配备 $\ell^\infty$ 范数时，$\hat{f}$ 允许深度为 $\mathcal{O}(\log(N))$、非零参数量为 $\mathcal{O}(N)$ 的算法化ReLU-MLP以及精确ReLU多头Transformer实现。
AI.summary: 本文针对度量空间上的未知Lipschitz函数回归问题，提出了一种无需复杂优化的闭式复合估计公式。该方法不仅消除了深度学习中的优化误差，提供一致的理论恢复保证，还在函数空间复杂度、参数稳定性和输入正则性上达到了最优，并可无缝映射为对数深度、参数稀疏的MLP与Transformer网络。
AI.keywords: Lipschitz回归, 闭式解, 度量空间, 稀疏神经网络, 统计一致性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于避开了深度神经网络极其复杂的非凸优化求解过程，直接提出了具有闭式解的复合回归公式，并实现了零优化误差。同时在稀疏神经网络（ReLU-MLP和Transformer）中给出结构化实现，兼具强大的统计理论保证与计算可行性。局限性在于其网络构造主要依赖于特定的理论设定（如度量空间与特定的激活函数），在复杂大规模实际任务中的经验表现和泛化能力仍需进一步实证检验。

title: Structural Compatibility and Uniform Stability of Temporally Degenerate Parabolic Systems
summary: Modern feedback design for distributed parameter systems presupposes that the closed-loop dynamics define a well-posed evolution problem. This presupposition becomes nontrivial for temporally degenerate parabolic systems, where temporal degeneracy affects not only the analytical properties of the evolution equation but also the mathematical formulation of the feedback interconnection itself. It is shown that admissible feedback interconnections for temporally degenerate parabolic systems are completely characterized by an operator compatibility condition linking the singular reaction operator with the actuator and observation operators. This characterization removes the singular component of the closed-loop dynamics and reduces the degenerate evolution equation to a regular evolution equation. Building upon this regularized formulation, a critical--residual decomposition yields a uniform exponential stability certificate, which is subsequently extended to the original infinite-dimensional evolution through a finite-to-infinite lifting theorem. A constructive static output feedback synthesis is finally obtained as a consequence of these results. Numerical experiments illustrate the regularization mechanism, validate the stability certificate, and confirm the finite-to-infinite lifting.

AI.title_translation: 时间退化抛物型系统的结构相容性与一致稳定性
AI.tldr: 该论文解决了时间退化抛物型系统的反馈控制与一致稳定性问题，提出了基于算子相容性的正则化方法和构造性输出反馈综合。
AI.motivation: 现代分布式参数系统的反馈设计依赖于良定演化问题的闭环动力学，然而这一假设对于时间退化抛物型系统而言并不显然，因为其时间退化不仅影响演化方程的解析性质，还影响反馈互连本身的数学表述。
AI.method: 利用算子相容性条件刻画容许反馈互连以消除奇异分量，通过关键-残差分解获取一致指数稳定性证明，并借助有限-无限提升定理将其扩展至无限维演化，最终实现静态输出反馈综合。
AI.result: 建立了完全刻画容许反馈互连的算子相容性条件，将退化演化方程转化为正则演化方程，给出了系统的一致指数稳定性证明，并实现了构造性的静态输出反馈综合，数值实验验证了正则化机制、稳定性证书和提升定理。
AI.conclusion: 通过算子相容性条件成功解决了时间退化抛物型系统的反馈互连与稳定性问题，并给出了静态输出反馈的构造性综合方法，数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.translation: 分布式参数系统的现代反馈设计预设了闭环动力学定义了一个良定的演化问题。对于时间退化抛物型系统，这种预设并非显而易见，因为时间退化不仅影响演化方程的解析性质，还影响反馈互连本身的数学表述。研究表明，时间退化抛物型系统的容许反馈互连完全由将奇异反应算子与执行器和观测器算子联系起来的算子相容性条件所刻画。这种刻画消除了闭环动力学的奇异分量，并将退化演化方程简化为正则演化方程。在此正则化公式的基础上，关键-残差分解产生了一个一致指数稳定性证书，随后通过有限-无限提升定理将其扩展到原有的无限维演化。最后，作为这些结果的结果，获得了构造性的静态输出反馈综合。数值实验说明了正则化机制，验证了稳定性证书，并证实了有限-无限提升。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了时间退化抛物型系统的结构相容性与一致稳定性。通过引入算子相容性条件消除闭环动力学中的奇异分量，将退化方程转化为正则方程，进而利用关键-残差分解和有限-无限提升定理证明了一致指数稳定性，并完成了构造性静态输出反馈综合。
AI.keywords: 时间退化抛物型系统, 算子相容性, 闭环动力学, 一致指数稳定性, 输出反馈综合
AI.comments: 该论文针对时间退化抛物型系统，深入探讨了其反馈设计中良定性与稳定性问题，通过算子相容性条件消除了奇异分量，并结合关键-残差分解与有限-无限提升定理，实现了构造性静态输出反馈综合，具有较强的理论创新性与应用价值。

title: Equilibria for Networks of Linear Translational Springs
summary: We use tools from nonlinear algebra to study the equilibria of small linear translational spring networks. Specifically we use the techniques of homotopy continuation, monodromy, and parameter homotopy (a.k.a. cheater homotopy) to solve all rigid linear translational spring networks up to $5$ nodes in both $2$ and $3$ dimensions. We describe a method of implementing parameter homotopy that arises naturally from the physical structure of the system. We give precise total degree bounds on the maximum number of solutions for general planar spring networks. We discuss further efficiency gains obtained from polyhedral homotopy methods. We compare the computation efficiency of these techniques against a baseline of Newton's method.

AI.title_translation: 线性平移弹簧网络的平衡态
AI.tldr: 本研究应用非线性代数与同伦方法，成功求解了二维和三维中5节点以内所有刚性线性平移弹簧网络的全部平衡态，并给出了平面网络解数的精确界限。
AI.motivation: 研究小型线性平移弹簧网络的平衡态求解问题，克服传统局部数值方法（如牛顿法）难以完备找出所有平衡解的局限。
AI.method: 利用非线性代数工具，包括同伦延拓法（homotopy continuation）、单值性（monodromy）以及源自系统物理结构的参数同伦法（parameter homotopy / cheater homotopy）；进一步探讨了多面体同伦方法，并以牛顿法作为基准对比计算效率。
AI.result: 成功求解了二维和三维空间中所有节点数不超过5的刚性线性平移弹簧网络；给出了通用平面弹簧网络最大解数的精确全次数界；证明了基于物理结构的参数同伦及多面体同伦方法能够进一步提升计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 利用非线性代数中的同伦延拓与参数同伦等方法，能够有效且完备地求解低节点数刚性线性平移弹簧网络的所有平衡态，多面体同伦方法可进一步提高计算效率。
AI.translation: 我们利用非线性代数的工具来研究小型线性平移弹簧网络的平衡态。具体而言，我们采用同伦延拓法、单值性以及参数同伦（又称作欺骗同伦）技术，求解了在二维和三维空间中节点数不超过5个的所有刚性线性平移弹簧网络。我们描述了一种自然产生于系统物理结构的参数同伦实现方法。我们给出了通用平面弹簧网络最大解数的精确全次数界。我们还讨论了通过多面体同伦方法获得的进一步效率提升，并将这些技术的计算效率与牛顿法基准进行了对比。
AI.summary: 本文运用非线性代数方法研究小型线性平移弹簧网络的平衡状态。作者利用同伦延拓、单值性和基于物理结构的参数同伦技术，完全求解了二维和三维中不超过5个节点的所有刚性网络，给出了平面网络最大解数的精确界，并通过多面体同伦方法进一步提升了相对于牛顿法的计算效率。
AI.keywords: 平移弹簧网络, 平衡态, 非线性代数, 同伦延拓, 参数同伦
AI.comments: 本研究将非线性代数几何工具（同伦延拓法）成功应用于经典力学中的弹簧网络平衡态求解问题，不仅在理论上给出了平面网络解数的精确全次数界，还通过结合物理结构参数同伦与多面体同伦大幅提升了计算效率，相较于传统的牛顿法能更可靠、完备地找到所有平衡解。局限在于目前研究范围仍局限于较小规模（不超过5个节点）的网络。

title: Improving Clinical Target Volume Segmentation Accuracy using Anatomical Priors and Active Learning for the AGITG TOPGEAR Clinical Trial
summary:
Training deep learning-based medical image segmentation models is challenging with limited curated datasets. For AGITG TOPGEAR, a gastric cancer trial, the Clinical Target Volume (CTV) is complex and defined by multiple anatomical landmarks, making upfront training data preparation difficult for an automated contour QA segmentation model. We investigate anatomical priors, derived from surrounding organ segmentations, to provide spatial context and improve TOPGEAR CTV segmentation accuracy. We also evaluate active learning, iteratively expanding the training dataset by selecting cases expected to improve performance.
  One hundred TOPGEAR CT scans were retrospectively analyzed. An initial set of 10 expert-contoured cases was used to train an nnU-Net model. TotalSegmentator generated a voxel-wise anatomical prior map from surrounding structures as an additional input channel. Active learning was simulated over four iterations, selecting cases by model uncertainty and segmentation performance. All models used five-fold cross-validation for an ensemble uncertainty measure. Evaluation used a hold-out testing set of 50 cases.
  The anatomical prior improved CTV segmentation accuracy, increasing mean Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) from 0.84 to 0.86. Active learning similarly improved performance to 0.86, with greatest benefit in the final round. Combining the anatomical prior with active learning achieved the highest accuracy, with a DSC of 0.87. Model uncertainty correlated with DSC, supporting its use in identifying suboptimal predictions and guiding active learning.
  Anatomical priors and active learning each improved CTV segmentation accuracy and generalizability, with their combination achieving the best performance, supporting integration into segmentation model development for automated contour QA in radiotherapy clinical trials.

AI.title_translation: 利用解剖先验与主动学习提升AGITG TOPGEAR临床试验的临床靶区分割精度
AI.tldr: 结合周围器官解剖先验与主动学习策略，能够有效克服小样本标注瓶颈，显著提高胃癌放疗复杂临床靶区（CTV）的自动分割精度与质控能力。
AI.motivation: 在医学图像分割中，高质量精选数据集极为有限。针对胃癌试验（AGITG TOPGEAR），临床靶区（CTV）解剖结构复杂且依赖多个解剖标志，导致用于自动化轮廓质控（QA）模型的初始训练数据准备极为困难。
AI.method: 回顾性分析100例TOPGEAR患者的CT影像。以10例专家标注数据为初始集训练nnU-Net；利用TotalSegmentator基于周围器官结构生成体素级解剖先验图，作为网络附加输入通道；采用五折交叉验证集成不确定性度量，通过模型不确定性和分割表现进行4轮主动学习病例筛选与迭代扩充；在独立的50例测试集上进行验证。
AI.result: 解剖先验将CTV分割的平均Dice相似系数（DSC）从0.84提升至0.86；主动学习同样将DSC提升至0.86；二者结合取得了最高精度，DSC达到0.87。此外，模型不确定性与DSC显著相关，证实其可有效识别次优预测并指导主动学习。
AI.conclusion: 解剖先验与主动学习均可提升CTV分割的精度与泛化能力，二者结合效果最佳；该方法为放疗临床试验中自动化轮廓质控（QA）模型的开发提供了有力支持。
AI.translation:
在标注数据集有限的情况下，训练基于深度学习的医学图像分割模型极具挑战。针对胃癌试验AGITG TOPGEAR，临床靶区（CTV）非常复杂且由多个解剖标志共同界定，这使得开发用于自动轮廓质控（QA）分割模型的前期训练数据准备工作十分困难。本研究探讨了从周围器官分割中提取解剖先验以提供空间上下文信息，从而提高TOPGEAR CTV分割精度的可行性。同时，我们评估了主动学习通过挑选预期能提升模型性能的病例来迭代扩充训练数据集的效果。
本研究回顾性分析了100例TOPGEAR CT扫描数据。使用包含10例专家勾画病例的初始数据集训练nnU-Net模型。利用TotalSegmentator从周围结构生成体素级解剖先验图，作为额外的输入通道。在4轮迭代中模拟了主动学习，依据模型不确定性和分割表现来筛选病例。所有模型均采用五折交叉验证以获取集成不确定性度量。评估使用包含50例病例的独立预留测试集。
结果显示，解剖先验提高了CTV分割精度，平均Dice相似系数（DSC）从0.84提升至0.86。主动学习同样将分割性能提升至0.86，并在最后一轮迭代中获益最大。将解剖先验与主动学习相结合获得了最高的精度，DSC达到0.87。模型不确定性与DSC相关，支持将其用于识别次优预测及指导主动学习。
解剖先验与主动学习各自均提升了CTV分割的精度与泛化性，二者结合达到了最佳性能，这支持将该方案整合到放疗临床试验中用于自动轮廓质控的分割模型开发中。
AI.summary: 本研究针对胃癌临床试验（AGITG TOPGEAR）中复杂的临床靶区（CTV）分割标注困难问题，提出了融合解剖先验（基于周围器官自动分割图）与主动学习策略的nnU-Net分割框架。实验表明，引入解剖先验与主动学习均可提升分割精度（DSC由0.84分别提升至0.86），二者联合后DSC达到0.87，并验证了基于不确定性评估质控的可行性。
AI.keywords: 解剖先验 (Anatomical Priors), 主动学习 (Active Learning), 临床靶区分割 (Clinical Target Volume Segmentation), nnU-Net, 轮廓质控 (Contour QA)
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将现有的全身器官自动分割先验（TotalSegmentator）与主动学习结合，针对放疗中极具挑战性的复杂胃癌临床靶区（CTV）分割提出了行之有效的数据高效型解决方案。不仅显著减少了专家标注成本，而且模型不确定性指标可直接用于放疗临床试验中自动轮廓质控（QA），实用价值极高。局限在于仅基于单一试验的100例数据进行回顾性验证，更大规模及跨中心泛化性仍需进一步评估。

title: Generative Nested Sampling of Atomistic Thermodynamic Landscapes
summary: Nested sampling (NS) resolves the thermodynamics of an atomistic system from a single simulation, but its practical reach is limited by the Markov-chain updates needed to decorrelate walkers within each likelihood-constrained ensemble. Flow-based NS has removed this bottleneck for gravitational-wave (GW) inference, yet its transfer to atomistic systems is not merely a change of application. Comparing a GW150914-like binary-black-hole likelihood with an eight-particle two-dimensional Lennard-Jones (LJ) system of comparable dimensionality, we show that the two landscapes differ fundamentally: atomistic multimodality is discrete and combinatorial, generated by particle permutations separated by hard collision walls, and its coordinate coupling is dense and collective, whereas the GW posterior exhibits smooth degeneracies and localized parameter coupling. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce NS-Flows: a single conditional normalizing flow, conditioned on the NS energy bound and trained on a sliding window of recent live sets, that replaces MCMC by direct parallel draws corrected by importance-weighted rejection resampling. Live sets supply data self-consistently, allowing flow training without structured priors or a pre-existing dataset. For LJ disks in PBC, the algorithm reduces energy evaluations by over two orders of magnitude and wall-clock time by roughly one third, an advantage that becomes increasingly favorable as the cost of the potential grows. The flow's generation efficiency further acts as a physical diagnostic: it varies non-monotonically along the annealing trajectory, is lowest in the dense disordered regime, and is quantitatively captured by the constrained ensemble's internal mode complexity together with target drift across the training window, identifying liquid-like ensembles, rather than prior-target separation, as the hard case for current flow architectures.

AI.title_translation: 原子热力学景观的生成式嵌套采样
AI.tldr: 本文提出了NS-Flows方法，利用条件归一化流替代传统MCMC，显著提升了原子系统嵌套采样的效率。
AI.motivation: 传统的嵌套采样（NS）在研究原子系统热力学时受限于马尔可夫链更新的瓶颈，虽然基于流的NS已成功应用于引力波推断，但原子系统具有离散、组合式的多模态以及稠密且集体的坐标耦合，这与引力波后验分布有本质不同，因此需要开发针对原子系统的专用生成式嵌套采样方法。
AI.method: 引入了NS-Flows方法，这是一种基于单个条件归一化流的算法，以嵌套采样的能量边界为条件，在最近活跃集的滑动窗口上进行训练，通过重要性加权拒绝重采样直接进行并行抽取，从而替代了MCMC。
AI.result: 对于PBC下的LJ圆盘系统，该算法将能量评估次数减少了两个多月，计算墙钟时间减少了约三分之一，且随着势能计算成本的增加，优势将更加明显。
AI.conclusion: NS-Flows方法有效克服了原子级嵌套采样中MCMC更新的瓶颈，显著减少了能量评估次数和计算时间，为探索复杂的原子热力学景观提供了一种强大而通用的新工具。
AI.translation: 嵌套采样（NS）可以通过单次模拟解析原子系统的热力学性质，但其应用范围受到在每个似然约束系综内对行走者进行去相关所需的马尔可夫链更新的限制。基于流的NS已经消除了引力波（GW）推断的这一瓶颈，但将其转移到原子系统并非单纯的应用改变。通过将类似于GW150914的双黑洞似然与维度相当的八粒子二维Lennard-Jones（LJ）系统进行比较，我们发现两个景观有根本的不同：原子多模态是离散且组合式的，由硬碰撞壁隔开的粒子排列生成，且其坐标耦合是密集和集体的，而GW后验则表现出平滑的简并性和局部的参数耦合。在这一诊断的指导下，我们介绍了NS-Flows：一个单一的条件归一化流，以NS能量界限为条件，并在最近活跃集的滑动窗口上进行训练，通过重要性加权拒绝重采样修正的直接并行抽取来代替MCMC。活跃集自洽地提供数据，使得无需结构化先验或预先存在的数据集即可进行流训练。对于PBC中的LJ圆盘，该算法将能量评估减少了两个数量级以上，墙钟时间减少了约三分之一，随着势能成本的增长，这一优势变得越来越有利。流的生成效率进一步充当了物理诊断：它沿退火轨迹非单调变化，在致密无序状态下最低，并通过约束系综的内部模式复杂性以及整个训练窗口的目标漂移定量捕获，这表明液态样系综（而不是先验-目标分离）是当前流架构的难点。
AI.summary: 该论文针对原子系统复杂的能量景观，提出了NS-Flows方法。通过自适应的条件归一化流替代传统的MCMC更新，该算法显著提高了原子级嵌套采样的效率，大幅减少了能量评估次数和计算时间，并为理解流模型在分子模拟中的性能限制提供了物理诊断。
AI.keywords: Nested Sampling, Normalizing Flows, Atomistic Thermodynamics, Molecular Simulation, Machine Learning
AI.comments: 该论文成功将基于流的模型引入原子级嵌套采样中，通过自适应条件归一化流替代了传统的MCMC方法，大幅提升了采样效率，并揭示了原子热力学景观与引力波推断景观的根本差异，对计算物理和机器学习在分子模拟中的应用具有重要意义。

title: Improving precipitation forecasts in an AI weather model using observational data
summary: Artificial intelligence weather prediction (AIWP) systems now surpass state-of-the-art physical models for medium-range weather forecasting. Current global AIWP models are trained almost exclusively using one reanalysis dataset, ERA5, but it has known biases, particularly for precipitation. Here we fine-tune a graph-transformer architecture with IMERG precipitation data at 0.25° resolution. The resulting model improves medium-range continuous ranked probability scores by up to 19%, while also demonstrating superior skill for tropical storms and drizzle events. Our model exceeds the Brier skill score of state-of-the-art operational models on extreme rainfall prediction by 57% globally; however, a physics-based operational model remains more reliable for the heaviest precipitation events. Our results demonstrate that incorporating observations-based precipitation data directly into training can substantially improve precipitation forecasts.

AI.title_translation: 使用观测数据改进AI天气模型中的降水预报
AI.tldr: 通过引入IMERG观测数据微调图-Transformer天气模型，显著提升了AI模型的降水预报与极端降雨预测能力。
AI.motivation: 当前全球人工智能天气预测（AIWP）模型几乎完全使用存在已知降水偏差的单一再分析数据集（ERA5）进行训练，为了改善AI天气模型中的降水预报，需要引入观测数据。
AI.method: 使用IMERG降水数据（0.25°分辨率）对采用图-Transformer架构的全球AI天气预测模型进行微调。
AI.result: 微调后的模型在中期连续排序概率得分上提升了高达19%，在热带风暴和小雨事件上表现出更优的技巧，在全球极端降雨预测的Brier技巧得分上超越最先进的业务模型57%，不过物理业务模型在最大降水事件上依然更具可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 将基于观测的降水数据直接并入训练中可以显著改善人工智能天气模型的降水预报性能，为未来AI气象预报系统的发展提供了重要方向。
AI.translation: 人工智能天气预测（AIWP）系统目前在范围中期的天气预报方面已经超越了最先进的物理模型。当前的全球AIWP模型几乎全部使用单一再分析数据集（ERA5）进行训练，但该数据集存在已知的偏差，特别是在降水方面。在此，我们利用0.25°分辨率的IMERG降水数据对图-Transformer架构进行了微调。由此产生的模型将中期连续排序概率得分提高了多达19%，同时在热带风暴和小雨事件上也表现出了卓越的技巧。我们的模型在极端降雨预测的Brier技巧得分上超越了最先进的业务模型57%；然而，基于物理的业务模型在最强的降水事件上仍然更具可靠性。我们的结果表明，将基于观测的降水数据直接纳入训练可以显著改善降水预报。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种利用IMERG观测降水数据微调图-Transformer架构AI天气模型的方法，成功克服了传统基于ERA5训练的模型在降水预报上的偏差，显著提升了全球中长期及极端降水预报的准确性。
AI.keywords: 人工智能天气预测, 降水预报, 图神经网络, 观测数据, 极端降水
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将观测数据（IMERG）引入人工智能天气预测模型中进行微调，显著提升了降水预报的准确性及极端降水预报的技巧分数，填补了传统AI气象模型高度依赖单一再分析数据集（ERA5）的空白。然而，物理模型在极端强降水事件的可靠性上仍具优势。

title: What is Smoothness?
summary: Smoothness of a function on the real line is reflected in the decay of its Fourier transform, which suggests that smoothness of a function in $L^2(G)$ for a group $G$ should mean concentration of the Fourier coefficients at low frequency. Such a reading presupposes an ordering of the irreducible representations of $G$, but for non-abelian $G$, no ordering is canonical. Given a symmetric generating set $S$, the Laplacian of the associated Cayley graph is block diagonal over the dual, and we order the irreps by the mean of the eigenvalues in each block. This produces an ordering function $ω:\widehat{G}\to\mathbb{R}$ that depends only on the pair $(G,S)$. This function is bounded between zero and two, vanishing only at the trivial representation and achieving the upper bound exactly when the Cayley graph is bipartite. We then ask how much freedom the construction has. Within the class of operators satisfying natural axioms, the induced orderings are exactly the real functions on the dual vanishing at the trivial representation and agreeing on conjugate pairs, and the orderings coming from inversion orbits of conjugacy classes form a basis for them. We cut the freedom down further by requiring two additional inputs: nonnegativity of the class weights and a declaration of which group elements count as uniform incremental changes, which pins the operator to the Cayley-Laplacian up to positive scale. We observe that the construction persists for compact groups even though the Cayley graph does not, and we extend the theory to finite sets carrying a transitive group action, where the acting group selects which frequencies exist and the generating set orders them. The answer to the title question is therefore that smoothness is a property of a function together with a choice of group and generating set, not of the function alone.

AI.tldr: 平滑度不是函数单独的属性，而是函数、群以及生成集共同选择的结果。文章通过凯莱图拉普拉斯算子特征值的均值，为非阿贝尔群的不可约表示提供了一种自然的排序方法，从而推广了平滑度的定义。
AI.motivation: 在实数轴上，函数的平滑度反映在其傅里叶变换的衰减上，这暗示了群 $G$ 上 $L^2(G)$ 中函数的平滑度应意味着傅里叶系数在低频处的集中。然而，对于非阿贝尔群，不可约表示没有标准的排序方式，因此需要寻找一种规范的排序方法来定义广义的平滑度。
AI.method: 利用对称生成集对应的凯莱图拉普拉斯算子在对偶空间上的块对角性质，通过每个块中特征值的平均值对不可约表示进行排序，并研究满足自然公理的算子及其自由度。
AI.result: 导出了一个仅依赖于对 $(G,S)$ 的排序函数 $\omega$，该函数有界且能准确反映群和生成集的特性；同时证明了所构建的算子在满足特定公理时的自由度，并成功将理论扩展到紧群和带有传递群作用的有限集。
AI.conclusion: 平滑度并不是函数自身的固有属性，而是函数与特定群以及生成集共同作用的结果。作者通过构建基于图拉普拉斯算子的排序函数，成功将傅里叶分析中的平滑度概念推广到了非阿贝尔群、紧群以及带有传递群作用的有限集上。
AI.translation: 实数轴上函数的平滑度反映在其傅里叶变换的衰减上，这表明群 $G$ 上 $L^2(G)$ 中函数的平滑度应该意味着傅里叶系数在低频处的集中。这种理解前提是对 $G$ 的不可约表示进行排序，但对于非阿贝尔群 $G$，没有规范的排序。给定一个对称生成集 $S$，相关凯莱图的拉普拉斯算子在对偶上是块对角的，我们通过每个块中特征值的平均值来对不可约表示进行排序。这产生了一个仅取决于对 $(G,S)$ 的排序函数 $\omega:\widehat{G}\to\mathbb{R}$。该函数在零和二之间有界，仅在平凡表示处消失，并且在凯莱图是二分图时精确达到上限。然后我们探讨了该构造的自由度。在满足自然公理的算子类中，导出的排序恰好是对偶上在平凡表示处消失并在共轭对上一致的实函数，来自共轭类求逆轨道的排序构成了它们的基。通过引入两个额外的输入（类权重的非负性和声明哪些群元素算作均匀增量变化），我们将自由度进一步缩小，从而将算子固定到正比例下的凯莱-拉普拉斯算子。我们观察到，即使凯莱图不存在，该构造对于紧群仍然持续存在，并且我们将该理论扩展到了承载传递群作用的有限集，其中作用群选择存在哪些频率，生成集对它们进行排序。因此，对标题问题的回答是：平滑度是函数与群和生成集的选择共同具有的属性，而不是函数单独具有的属性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了非阿贝尔群及其他结构上函数的“平滑度”定义问题。由于非阿贝尔群的不可约表示缺乏规范排序，作者利用凯莱图拉普拉斯算子的特征值均值提出了一种自然的排序方法，进而将平滑度界定为函数、群与生成集三者结合的属性，并将该理论扩展到了紧群和有限集。
AI.keywords: 平滑度, 傅里叶变换, 凯莱图, 不可约表示, 群论
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了一个深刻且基础的数学问题——非阿贝尔群或更一般结构上的“平滑度”究竟是什么。作者通过引入凯莱图的拉普拉斯算子和特征值的平均值，巧妙地解决了非阿贝尔群中不可约表示缺乏规范排序的问题，并将平滑度定义为函数与群及生成集的相对属性，这为调和分析和图论的交叉研究提供了新的视角和深刻的理论基础。

title: Certified Spherical MUSIC for 3D Localization under Adversarial Subspace Perturbations
summary:
We study an oracle subspace-perturbation model in which the 3D localization procedure is given an \(s\)-dimensional subspace \(\widetilde{\mathcal U}\) and a deterministic error bound $\eps_{\rm sub}$ measuring the sine-theta distance between $\widetilde{\mathcal U}$ and an $s$-dimensional subspace $\cU$ of far-field patterns with wavenumber $κ$.
  Under explicit arbitrary-cloud separation and conditioning hypotheses, we prove that the perturbed spherical MUSIC objective \[
  \widetilde q(\bz)
  =
  1-\|P_{\widetilde{\mathcal U}}\varphi_\bz\|_2^2 \] has a unique strongly convex well in each ball \(B_{γ/κ}(x_j)\) and the objective has a uniform value gap outside the union of the certified wells. A fixed-step gradient map with \(h\asympκ^{-2}\) leaves every certified well invariant and converges linearly to its unique minimizer. Consequently, thresholding on an \(O(κ^{-1})\)-mesh, followed by gradient descent from all accepted grid points and duplicate removal, recovers all relevant minima.
  The arbitrary-cloud frame analysis gives the sufficient condition \[
  κδ_X\gtrsim s^{2/3} \] through an absolute coherence row sum and Gershgorin's theorem. We also construct lower-frame counterexamples below the \(s^{1/6}\) scale, upper-frame counterexamples below the \(s^{1/3}\) scale, and examples showing that the exponent \(2/3\) is optimal for the absolute-row-sum argument. The latter is a sharpness result for the proof method and is not a spectral necessity claim. Finally, for parameter classes containing a uniformly admissible one-point displacement path, we prove that the deterministic oracle localization modulus is \[
  \mathfrak R(\eps)
  \asymp
  \frac{\eps}κ. \]

AI.title_translation: 对抗性子空间扰动下用于3D定位的认证球面MUSIC算法
AI.tldr: 本文证明了在对抗性子空间扰动下，球面MUSIC算法结合网格搜索和梯度下降可以实现3D信号的精确鲁棒定位，并给出了严格的理论保证与收敛性分析。
AI.motivation: 研究在对抗性子空间扰动下3D定位的鲁棒性与理论保证，解决现有球面MUSIC算法在面对子空间误差时的性能可认证性问题。
AI.method: 采用神谕子空间扰动模型，利用Gershgorin定理和绝对相干行和进行任意点云框架分析，证明了扰动球面MUSIC目标函数在每个球体内具有唯一的强凸极小值及全局值间隙，并结合固定步长梯度映射实现线性收敛。
AI.result: 证明了 perturbed 球面MUSIC目标函数在 certified wells 内具有唯一强凸性，固定步长梯度映射可线性收敛到唯一极小值，给出了充分条件 $κδ_X\gtrsim s^{2/3}$，并确定了确定性神谕定位模量为 $\mathfrak R(\eps)\asymp \frac{\eps}κ$。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了在对抗性子空间扰动下球面MUSIC算法的理论完备性，证明了其在网格搜索加梯度下降下的精确恢复能力，并给出了扰动模量。
AI.translation: 我们研究了一个神谕子空间扰动模型，其中3D定位过程被给定一个 $s$ 维子空间 $\widetilde{\mathcal U}$ 和一个确定性误差界 $\eps_{\rm sub}$，用于衡量 $\widetilde{\mathcal U}$ 与具有波数 $\kappa$ 的远场模式的 $s$ 维子空间 $\mathcal U$ 之间的 sine-theta 距离。在明确的任意点云分离和条件假设下，我们证明了受扰动的球面MUSIC目标函数在每个球体 $B_{\gamma/\kappa}(x_j)$ 中具有唯一强凸的极小区域（well），且该目标函数在认证极小区域的并集之外具有统一的值间隙。具有 $h\asymp\kappa^{-2}$ 的固定步长梯度映射使每个认证极小区域保持不变，并线性收敛到其唯一的极小值。因此，在 $O(\kappa^{-1})$ 网格上进行阈值处理，然后从所有接受的网格点开始进行梯度下降并去除重复项，可以恢复所有相关的极小值。任意点云框架分析通过绝对相干行和与 Gershgorin 定理给出了充分条件 $\kappa\delta_X\gtrsim s^{2/3}$。我们还构造了低于 $s^{1/6}$ 尺度的下框架反例、低于 $s^{1/3}$ 尺度の上框架反例，以及表明绝对行和论证的指数 $2/3$ 是最优的示例。后者是证明方法的尖锐性结果，并非谱的必要性声明。最后，对于包含一致容许的单点位移路径的参数类，我们证明了确定性神谕定位模量为 $\mathfrak R(\eps)\asymp \frac{\eps}{\kappa}$。
AI.summary: 本文研究了对抗性子空间扰动下3D定位的认证球面MUSIC算法，证明了其目标函数在特定区域内的唯一强凸性和全局值间隙，分析了梯度下降的收敛性，并给出了分辨率和扰动模量的理论界。
AI.keywords: 3D定位, 球面MUSIC, 对抗性扰动, 子空间扰动, 强凸性
AI.comments: 该论文在对抗性子空间扰动下，对3D定位中的球面MUSIC算法进行了严格的认证分析，不仅给出了局部的强凸性与全局的值间隙保证，还对网格搜索和梯度下降的有效性以及充分条件的最优性进行了深入探讨，具有很高的理论价值。

title: Generalized Hankel/Toeplitz matrix for array signal processing
summary: In this paper, we introduce generalized Hankel/Toeplitz matrices (GHM/GTM) and the associated generalized Vandermonde decomposition for nonuniform array signal processing and multi-dimensional super-resolution. The proposed framework was discovered from the study of resolution limit theory and extends the classical Hankel/Toeplitz structure by allowing substantially more flexible sampling geometries while preserving the underlying low-rank Vandermonde factorization. Through devising an optimal algorithm based on this GHM framework, we derive the state-of-the-art upper bound estimate for the computational resolution limit (CRL) of source-number detection in general $d$-dimensional super-resolution problems. For segmented sampling sets, whose geometry is closely related to sparse and distributed arrays, we establish deterministic lower bounds for the minimum singular values of the associated generalized Vandermonde matrices and derive corresponding stability and number-detection guarantees for multi-clump source configurations. To address the computational bottleneck of conventional multi-level Hankel constructions in high dimensions, we further introduce randomized GHM constructions whose matrix dimensions scale with the effective degrees of freedom rather than with the full tensor-product grid, together with deterministic recovery guarantees conditional on the realized Vandermonde factors. We also extend the framework to source localization by developing GHM-based MUSIC algorithms for nonuniform measurements, with stability characterized through the conditioning of the generalized Vandermonde factors. Numerical experiments on synthetic data demonstrate that the proposed GHM-based methods achieve competitive resolution and recovery accuracy while substantially reducing matrix size and computational cost, especially in high-dimensional settings.

AI.title_translation: 用于阵列信号处理的广义Hankel/Toeplitz矩阵
AI.tldr: 本文提出广义Hankel/Toeplitz矩阵（GHM/GTM）框架，解决了非均匀阵列信号处理和高维超分辨率中的计算瓶颈与理论限制，兼具高精度与高计算效率。
AI.motivation: 传统Hankel/Toeplitz结构和多级构造在处理非均匀阵列信号和高维超分辨率问题时受到采样几何受限和高维计算瓶颈的制约，需要更具灵活性且能保持低秩Vandermonde分解的广义数学框架来扩展应用并优化计算。
AI.method: 引入广义Hankel/Toeplitz矩阵（GHM/GTM）及其关联的广义Vandermonde分解，设计最优算法推导计算分辨率极限（CRL）的上界估计，针对分段采样集建立最小奇异值的确定性下界，提出随机GHM构造以缓解高维计算瓶颈，并开发基于GHM的MUSIC算法用于非均匀测量下的源定位。
AI.result: 理论上得出了广义Vandermonde矩阵最小奇异值的确定性下界、源数检测的CRL上界及确定性恢复保证；数值实验证明GHM方法在非均匀测量和高维设置下能够以极低的矩阵尺寸和计算成本实现具有竞争力的分辨率和恢复精度。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的GHM/GTM及广义Vandermonde分解框架，有效解决了非均匀阵列信号处理和多维超分辨率中的计算瓶颈和理论分析难题，在保证高分辨率和稳定性的同时实现了极高的计算效率。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们引入了广义Hankel/Toeplitz矩阵（GHM/GTM）及相关联的广义Vandermonde分解，用于非均匀阵列信号处理和多维超分辨率。所提出的框架是在研究分辨率极限理论的过程中发现的，它扩展了经典的Hankel/Toeplitz结构，允许更加灵活的采样几何形状，同时保留了底层的低秩Vandermonde因式分解。通过设计基于该GHM框架的最优算法，我们推导出了通用$d$维超分辨率问题中源数检测的计算分辨率极限（CRL）的最先进上界估计。对于其几何形状与稀疏和分布式阵列密切相关的分段采样集，我们为关联的广义Vandermonde矩阵的最小奇异值建立了确定性下界，并为多簇源配置导出了相应的稳定性和源数检测保证。为了解决传统多级Hankel构造在高维中的计算瓶颈，我们进一步引入了随机GHM构造，其矩阵维数随有效自由度而不是完整的张量积网格进行缩放，同时附带了以实现的Vandermonde因子为条件的确定性恢复保证。我们还将该框架扩展到源定位，通过为非均匀测量开发基于GHM的MUSIC算法，并通过广义Vandermonde因子的条件数来表征稳定性。合成数据上的数值实验表明，所提出的基于GHM的方法在大幅减小矩阵尺寸和计算成本的同时，实现了具有竞争力的分辨率和恢复精度，特别是在高维设置中。
AI.summary: 本文提出了广义Hankel/Toeplitz矩阵（GHM/GTM）及其广义Vandermonde分解，用于解决非均匀阵列信号处理和多维超分辨率问题。该框架在保持低秩特性的同时允许灵活的采样几何。文章通过该框架导出了分辨率极限上界、奇异值下界和随机GHM构造，并将其扩展至MUSIC源定位算法中。实验表明，该方法在大幅降低计算成本的同时保持了优秀的恢复精度。
AI.keywords: 广义Hankel/Toeplitz矩阵, 阵列信号处理, 多维超分辨率, 广义Vandermonde分解, 计算分辨率极限
AI.comments: 本文提出的广义Hankel/Toeplitz矩阵（GHM/GTM）框架成功将传统的均匀采样低秩结构推广到了非均匀采样和多维超分辨率场景，在保持低秩Vandermonde分解的同时大幅降低了计算复杂度和矩阵尺寸，具有很强的理论创新性和实际应用价值。

title: Geometric Ergodicity of Affine Invariant Ensemble Langevin and its Discrete Time Variants
summary: Affine-invariant ensemble samplers are widely used in Bayesian applications. However, their quantitative convergence theory, in particular geometric ergodicity, remains a basic open question. We study the affine invariant ensemble Langevin dynamics, an interacting particle system that uses the empirical covariance of the whole ensemble as a preconditioner. While effective in practice, theoretical understanding of this method is not available beyond plain qualitative convergence in total variation; a central difficulty is that the empirical covariance can approach singularity. This paper addresses this challenge. For potentials with bounded Hessian that are strongly convex outside a ball, we prove geometric ergodicity using a novel Lyapunov function that combines an inverse-covariance barrier with a coercive exponential energy. We then show that directly applying the Euler--Maruyama scheme can diverge with positive probability, even for a one-dimensional Gaussian target. This motivates a covariance-trace time regularization. We prove geometric ergodicity of the regularized diffusion and, for sufficiently small step size, of its unadjusted Euler--Maruyama discretization. We also show that the invariant distributions of the discretization converge weakly to the product target distribution as the step size tends to zero.

AI.title_translation: 仿射不变系综朗之万及其离散时间变体的几何遍历性
AI.tldr: 本文解决了仿射不变系综朗之万动力学及其离散形式的几何遍历性这一公开难题，通过引入新型Lyapunov函数与时间正则化方法，证明了其在强凸势能下的收敛性。
AI.motivation: 尽管仿射不变系综采样器在贝叶斯应用中广泛使用，但其定量收敛理论（特别是几何遍历性）仍是未解决的公开问题，且经验协方差可能趋于奇异带来了核心理论挑战。
AI.method: 引入了一种结合逆协方差势垒与强制性指数能量的新型Lyapunov函数来证明连续时间动力学的几何遍历性；针对标准欧拉-丸山格式可能发散的问题，提出了协方差迹时间正则化方法，并证明了正则化扩散及其离散化格式的几何遍历性。
AI.result: 证明了在强凸势能下连续动力学和正则化离散格式的几何遍历性，并证明了当步长趋近于零时，离散化的不变分布弱收敛至乘积目标分布。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功建立了仿射不变系综朗之万动力学及其时间正则化离散格式的几何遍历性理论，并证明了离散不变分布弱收敛到目标分布，填补了该领域定量收敛理论的空白。
AI.translation: 仿射不变系综采样器在贝叶斯应用中被广泛使用。然而，它们的定量收敛理论，特别是几何遍历性，仍然是一个基本的公开问题。我们研究了仿射不变系综朗之万动力学，这是一个使用整个系综的经验协方差作为预条件子的相互作用粒子系统。虽然在实践中很有效，但在总变差中的普通定性收敛之外，该方法的理论理解仍然是空白；一个核心难点是经验协方差可能接近奇异。本文解决了这一挑战。对于在球体外部强凸且Hessian有界的势能，我们通过结合逆协方差势垒和强制性指数能量的新型Lyapunov函数，证明了几何遍历性。然后我们证明了直接应用Euler--Maruyama格式可能会以正概率发散，即使对于一维高斯目标也是如此。这促使我们引入协方差迹时间正则化。我们证明了正则化扩散及其在足够小步长下的未调整Euler--Maruyama离散化的几何遍历性。我们还证明了当步长趋于零时，离散化的不变分布弱收敛于乘积目标分布。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了仿射不变系综朗之万动力学及其离散变体的几何遍历性。通过设计新型Lyapunov函数克服了经验协方差趋于奇异的困难，并针对离散化发散问题提出了时间正则化方案，最终证明了正则化后的连续与离散算法的几何遍历性及收敛性。
AI.keywords: 几何遍历性, 仿射不变系综, 朗之万动力学, 贝叶斯推断, 欧拉-丸山格式
AI.comments: 该论文首次解决了仿射不变系综朗之万动力学及其离散形式的几何遍历性这一长期未决的公开问题，在理论分析上具有重要创新，特别是在处理经验协方差可能趋于奇异的挑战时引入了新颖的Lyapunov函数和时间正则化方案。

title: Introducing SINFONIA: Symplectic, slimplectic and Magnusian (Neural) Flows for Orbital Numerical Integration and Acceleration
summary: Long-duration gravitational-wave modelling must resolve fast orbital motion together with slow dissipative evolution while preventing small numerical errors from accumulating into secular phase drift. Here we ask whether the finite-time evolution map itself can be learned as an explicit, differentiable, structure-preserving object and then repeatedly composed through a complete inspiral. We construct three neural-flow architectures: a symplectic and slimplectic flow on Galley's doubled phase space, [SINFONIA-J0]; a Taylor-anchored flow, [SINFONIA-J1]; and a Magnusian flow that learns the finite-time dissipative correction in the interaction picture, [SINFONIA-J2]. Applied to a 2.5PN neutron-star inspiral, all three expose the same controlling mechanism: long-time accuracy is governed not by pointwise map error alone, but by its signed projection onto a single secular channel fixed by energy--angular-momentum balance. Encoding this structure allows the learned maps to remain accurate through $10^{2}$--$10^{5}$ window compositions to coalescence at timesteps of a full orbital period and beyond, reaching chained phase errors orders of magnitude below a benchmark slimplectic integrator at lower cost. The same secular structure can also be exploited for physics inference: when the channel is left unconstrained, the accumulated phase retains enough information to recover an un-modelled dynamical-friction-like force, both parametrically and as a learned function of separation. Network-off controls isolate the contribution of learning from the analytic structure already built into each map. These results establish a proof of concept for structure-preserving learned evolution maps as tools for fast long-duration integration and physics inference in gravitational-wave source modelling.

AI.title_translation: 介绍 SINFONIA：用于轨道数值积分与加速的辛、准辛与 Magnusian（神经）流
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 SINFONIA 的结构保持神经流方法，用于高效、准确地模拟引力波长期轨道演化并进行物理推断。
AI.motivation: 长持续时间引力波建模需要解决快速轨道运动与慢速耗散演化的结合，同时防止微小的数值误差积累成长期的相位漂移，因此探索能否将有限时间演化映射学习为显式、可微且保持结构的物体。
AI.method: 构建了三种神经流架构（SINFONIA-J0、SINFONIA-J1、SINFONIA-J2），分别基于辛/准辛流、泰勒锚定流以及在相互作用图景中学习耗散修正的Magnusian流。
AI.result: 所有三种架构通过能量-角动量平衡固定在单个长期通道上的符号投影来控制长期准确性，能够承受 $10^{2}$ 到 $10^{5}$ 次窗口组合直到合并，且链式相位误差远低于基准积分器。
AI.conclusion: 结构保持的神经流架构为引力波源建模中的快速长期积分和物理推断提供了可行的概念验证。
AI.translation: 长持续时间的引力波建模必须解决快速轨道运动与慢速耗散演化的结合，同时防止微小的数值误差积累为长期的相位漂移。在此，我们探讨是否可以将有限时间的演化映射本身学习为显式、可微、结构保持的物体，并在整个旋进过程中进行重复组合。我们构建了三种神经流架构：基于Galley双相空间的辛和准辛流[SINFONIA-J0]；泰勒锚定流[SINFONIA-J1]；以及在相互作用图景中学习有限时间耗散修正的Magnusian流[SINFONIA-J2]。将其应用于2.5PN中子星旋进时，这三种流都暴露出相同的控制机制：长期准确性不仅由逐点的映射误差决定，还由其对由能量-角动量平衡固定的单个长期通道的带符号投影决定。编码这种结构使得学习到的映射在经过 $10^{2}$ 到 $10^{5}$ 次窗口组合直至合并的过程中（时间步长为一个完整轨道周期及以上）依然保持准确，达到了比基准准辛积分器低几个数量级的链式相位误差，且成本更低。相同的长期结构也可用于物理推断：当通道不受约束时，积累的相位保留了足够的信息来恢复未建模的类似动力学摩擦力，既可按参数恢复，也可作为分离的函数进行学习。网络关闭控制孤立了学习对每种映射中已经内置的解析结构的贡献。这些结果为将结构保持的学习演化映射作为引力波源建模中快速长期积分和物理推断的工具建立了概念验证。
AI.summary: 论文引入了名为SINFONIA的三种结构保持神经流架构，用于引力波中的轨道数值积分与加速，通过编码能量-角动量平衡等底层物理结构，成功实现了长持续时间、高精度的轨道演化预测及未建模力的物理推断。
AI.keywords: 引力波建模, 神经流, 辛积分器, 耗散演化, 物理推断
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出将结构保持与神经网络结合，用于引力波建模中的轨道数值积分，有效解决了长期演化中的相位漂移问题，在计算效率和准确性上取得了显著突破。

title: Large-Language Models as a Cognitive Virus
summary: Large-language models (LLMs) are rapidly becoming part of human culture, reshaping how information is produced, transmitted, and used. Here we propose that their diffusion can be understood through a viral analogy, with LLM use spreading through populations, becoming embedded in cognitive and cultural practices. We model transitions among uncoupled, coupled, and persistently dependent users, and show that the interplay between social transmission, recovery, and collective reinforcement can generate tipping points and technological lock-in. A central consequence is the possibility of runaway dynamics: once a critical threshold is crossed, small increases in adoption can trigger rapid population-level shifts toward persistent dependence, with abrupt losses in cognitive competence. The same framework, however, identifies conditions for cognitive immunization, based on reducing transmission and facilitating reversibility. Our results highlight how LLM adoption may involve nonlinear collective transitions with important consequences for cognitive autonomy.

title: ALRA: Adaptive Local Relational Alignment for Logit-Based Pre-training Distillation of Autoregressive Language Models
summary: Logit-based knowledge distillation for autoregressive language models usually aligns teacher and student next-token distributions over the entire vocabulary. However, this global objective overlooks relative preferences among likely token alternatives. Existing local approaches often select candidate tokens from either the teacher or the student alone. Teacher-only selection can miss tokens that the student considers likely, while student-only selection can rely on an inaccurate ranking early in training. We propose Adaptive Local Relational Alignment (ALRA), a position-specific framework combining student proposals with teacher guidance. At each valid prediction position, the student proposes likely tokens, while the teacher's most probable token is included as an anchor. ALRA adjusts the number of selected tokens according to how broadly the teacher distributes probability within this candidate set relative to the current batch. Adaptive Local Divergence retains the mass-matching term and separately matches the relative token distributions within the selected and remaining vocabulary regions. Unlike the exact full-vocabulary decomposition, it replaces the teacher-mass coefficients of the two conditional terms with unit coefficients, preventing either term from being downweighted solely because its region has low teacher probability. Student-Weighted Pairwise Relational Alignment emphasizes high-probability token pairs with small student probability gaps and gives less weight to unlikely or clearly separated pairs. Experiments on The Pile with randomly initialized 200M- and 500M-parameter students across nine zero-shot benchmarks yield average accuracies of 36.62% and 37.40%. ALRA exceeds the strongest competing distillation baseline by 0.94 and 0.83 percentage points and improves over pre-training without distillation by 2.31 and 2.91 points, respectively.

title: Grassmann--Plücker Parametrization of Convolutional Filter Subspaces: Regularity and Closed Embeddings
comments: 24 pages; includes a symbolic computational example using Singular
summary: We propose a geometric parametrization of the filters in a single convolutional layer: the parameter is no longer an ordered family of filter vectors, but a fixed-dimensional subspace of the filter space. For one-dimensional finite-stride convolution, the filter-to-convolution-operator correspondence gives an injective linear map $\mathcal{C}:\mathcal{K}\to H$. This map sends filter subspaces in $\mathrm{Gr}(q,\mathcal{K})$ to operator subspaces in $\mathrm{Gr}(q,H)$; composing it with the Plücker embedding yields a projective parametrization $Φ:\mathrm{Gr}(q,\mathcal{K})\to\mathbb{P}(\bigwedge^q H)$. Using $T_U\mathrm{Gr}(q,\mathcal{K})\cong\mathrm{Hom}(U,\mathcal{K}/U)$, we compute the differential of the induced Grassmannian map and show that the differential of $Φ$ is injective at every point. We then use the vanishing equations for Plücker coordinates and standard affine coordinates on a Grassmannian to prove that $\mathrm{Gr}(q,\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{K}))\hookrightarrow\mathrm{Gr}(q,H)$ is a closed embedding, and hence that $Φ$ is a closed embedding. Consequently, the parameter space is isomorphic to its projective image, the parametrization is finite and birational onto its image, every fiber is a singleton, and the resulting projective neural variety is smooth. For $k=4$ and $q=2$, we also use Singular to recover the image ideal and check its dimension, degree, chart rank, and smoothness. This computation illustrates, rather than replaces, the general proof. Finally, we discuss possible connections with filter redundancy and low-rank convolution, while distinguishing the proved geometric results from application proposals requiring numerical validation.
comment: 24 pages; includes a symbolic computational example using Singular

title: SurgeGen: A Hybrid Generative Diffusion Framework for Storm Surge Scenario Synthesis
summary: Predicting storm surge induced by landfalling tropical cyclones is crucial for flood mitigation and coastal risk management. Traditionally, physics-based numerical models simulate storm surge by solving the Navier--Stokes equations using numerical methods, but these simulations are computationally expensive. Generative models are promising for storm surge emulation because they can generate diverse realizations rather than producing a single deterministic prediction. However, their use for storm surge emulation remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we leverage diffusion models for storm surge surrogate modeling, combining a baseline prediction stage with conditional generation to provide a more interpretable modeling framework. We develop SurgeGen, a two-stage generative framework for generating storm surge scenarios conditioned on hypothetical storms with parameters defined in a continuous space. First, a baseline model produces a coarse estimate of the storm surge height. This estimate then conditions a diffusion model, which generates refined storm surge scenarios that better capture spatial patterns and variability. We demonstrate that our approach can generate realistic and diverse storm surge scenarios under conditions both within and outside the training distribution.

title: Computing stable configurations of confined smectic liquid crystals with a deep variational framework
summary: Smectic liquid crystals are layered liquid-crystalline phases characterized by orientational order and periodic density modulation. Although their structures can be modeled using continuum theories, computing stable configurations remains challenging in complex geometries, particularly when the high-frequency density modulations associated with smectic layering should be resolved. We propose a deep variational framework (DVF) for computing these configurations within the modified Landau--de Gennes model, in which the coupled orientational and positional order parameters are represented on a regular reference domain while physical confinement is incorporated through coordinate mappings. A warmup penalty mitigates the spectral bias of neural networks toward smooth, nonlayered fields, enabling robust recovery of oscillatory smectic states. Comparisons with a neural-network baseline and finite-difference relaxation demonstrate the essential role of this penalty and the numerical stability of the resulting layered states. The DVF reproduces experimentally established smectic-A defect structures and layer morphologies across diverse confinement geometries and further predicts a chevron-like smectic-C state in a tangent-anchored sphere. Together, these results demonstrate the applicability of the DVF to computing stable smectic configurations across experimentally relevant confinement geometries and anchoring conditions.

title: Override and Update in Restriction Categories
summary: We study the override and update operators on partial functions from the perspective of restriction categories. We propose a definition of override restriction categories, in which both of the operators in question exist. We prove a number of results concerning these operators and their relationship to the structure of the ambient restriction category, as well as relating them to the existing literature on the override and update operators. We provide various examples of override restriction categories and in particular show that every classical restriction category is an override restriction category.

title: Geometric Ceilings on Time-Frequency Masking for Single-Channel Separation
comments: Submitted to Signal Processing (Elsevier), manuscript SIGPRO-D-26-03635. 33 pages, 6 figures. Companion paper: "What Selects, What Reconstructs" (submitted to IEEE/ACM TASLP)
summary: Most single-channel separators estimate a source by applying a real gain to the mixture in each time-frequency bin. The optimum of that format, which the oracle masks used as bounds do not attain, is the orthogonal projection of the source onto the line spanned by the mixture, its residual set by the angle between them. Locating an estimator reduces to the block structure of a real-linear operator on stacked spectra, giving a chain of four nested classes whose three larger terms match three assumptions on the prior: zero means, circularity and absence of inter-frequency coupling. Held fixed the chain is a cascade of four orthogonal projections; refitted per frame it collapses onto its first term, attributing the whole residual to one missing real parameter per bin, the phase. When the phase posterior is symmetric about the mixture direction, the minimum mean-square estimate falls back onto the line, with gain the posterior mean of the oracle gain and excess error its variance. On MUSDB18 a posterior mean under a non-circular Gaussian-mixture prior leaves the class yet stays 11.44 dB under the per-frame ceiling, which four times as many components and 7.5x the data do not close; a closed-form gate attributes some 70% of it, in decibels, to the predicted variance. The widest fixed class stays 6.70 dB under the same ceiling. Leaving the class and minimising squared error are conflicting requests: the barrier lies in the criterion rather than in the prior.

title: Towards a Statistical Understanding of Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures increase model capacity by combining a collection of expert predictors through input-dependent routing, while often activating only a small subset of experts for each input. Despite their growing importance in modern large-scale models, the statistical roles of their design choices, especially routing, sparse activation, and shared experts, remain only partially understood, as existing theory has largely focused on parametric or correctly specified MoE models. In this paper, we view MoE as a form of localized aggregation and show how this localization reshapes the approximation-estimation-computation tradeoff. We derive oracle risk bounds for learning dense and sparse routing with evolving experts, separating approximation, expert-learning, and router-estimation errors, and characterize how sparse Top-K routing can retain the benefits of localized aggregation while controlling per-input computation. We also interpret gating through the geometry of input space, relating routing performance to regions of local expert advantage, and show how shared experts, as adopted in architectures such as DeepSeekMoE, can extract common predictive structure so that routed experts focus on residual local variation. Together, these results provide a unified statistical framework for understanding MoE through input-dependent expert aggregation, in which expert specialization and computational tradeoffs are governed by local predictive structure.

title: On the Complexity of Recognizing SDP Exactness for the Maximum Cut Problem
summary: The Semidefinite Programming (SDP) relaxation of the Maximum Cut (Max-Cut) problem is exact when its optimal value equals the integer maximum cut, geometrically corresponding to a rank-1 optimal solution. While the pioneering work of Delorme and Poljak established that recognizing exactness is NP-hard, their reduction relied on exponentially scaling edge weights. This established only weak NP-hardness and explicitly left open the complexity for simple, unweighted graphs. In this paper, we resolve the computational complexity of the exactness property. First, we prove that deciding SDP exactness for weighted graphs is strongly NP-hard by constructing a sum-of-squares dual certificate with polynomially bounded integer weights. Second, we extend this hardness to simple, unweighted graphs via a geometric embedding of restricted Not-All-Equal 4-SAT into edge-disjoint clique structures. Both proofs utilize geometric locking mechanisms that force the continuous SDP relaxation to an absolute global minimum, decoupling the continuous bounds from the underlying combinatorial hardness.

title: Beyond Higher-Pulse Rectification: Operational Harmonic Coordination in Renewable P2H Systems
summary: Thyristor rectifiers (TRs) are cost-effective electrolysis power supplies for renewable power-to-hydrogen (ReP2H) systems, but their harmonics may violate grid-code limits. In contrast to conventional solutions that rely on higher-pulse (such as 24-pulse) rectifiers, this paper proposes an operational harmonic coordination scheme that enables low-cost 12-pulse TRs to meet harmonic requirements through coordinated operation. First, a harmonic model quantifies the effects of rectifier transformer (RCT) tap positions and electrolytic currents, enabling harmonic cancellation among multiple electrolyzers (ELZs). A two-layer framework then coordinates hydrogen production and harmonic mitigation. Hourly scheduling determines ELZ commitment within the harmonic feasible region under renewable uncertainty using stochastic programming and a modified progressive hedging algorithm, while minute-level dispatch tracks renewable power and mitigates harmonics. A decomposition algorithm separates production dispatch from harmonic mitigation to improve computational efficiency. Case studies based on real-life projects show that the proposed method increases profit by 31% over current-only regulation. Annual simulations further show that coordinated 12-pulse TRs can replace 24-pulse rectifiers for harmonic compliance by exchanging additional RCT tap actions for lower transformer investment, reducing rectification-stage cost by 37.5%.

title: Correlated initialization of deep residual networks
summary:
We study the large-depth behavior of residual networks whose weights are correlated across layers at initialization. Our results confirm and extend a conjecture of Marion et al. [2025], according to which correlated initializations should interpolate continuously between the Brownian stochastic differential equation arising from independent initialization and the ordinary differential equation arising from perfectly correlated initialization.
  When the initialization is obtained from the application of a feature function to a stationary Gaussian sequence with regularly varying correlation, we prove that there exists a unique critical scaling such that the infinite-depth limit is the solution of a Young differential equation driven by a Hermite process. Hermite processes reduce to the fractional Brownian motion if the feature function generating the initialization has Hermite rank one, which is the case for the identity function, for example. We show that the critical scaling and asymptotic limit are uniquely determined by the decay of correlations together with the Hermite rank of the feature function. Consequently, the correlation structure and Hermite rank of the initialization represent meaningful hyperparameters in the asymptotic regime. By contrast, under finite-variance iid initialization, the asymptotic driver is universally Brownian up to normalization regardless of the choice of distribution.
  Our proofs rely on a collection of novel results establishing a robust stability theory for Young differential equations in Banach spaces.

title: ToolDF: Tool-Integrated Reasoning for Mixed-Authenticity Audio Deepfake Detection
comments: To appear in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Audio deepfake detection is commonly formulated as clip-level binary classification of single-domain audio. However, real-world manipulated audio can exhibit mixed authenticity, where genuine and manipulated cues coexist across temporal transitions, overlapping sources, or both. This setting requires not only detecting manipulated audio but also localizing the components that provide evidence for the decision. We propose ToolDF, a tool-integrated reasoning framework for mixed-authenticity audio deepfake detection. ToolDF employs an audio large language model as an orchestrator trained with supervised tool-use trajectories. It adaptively analyzes the audio scene, selectively performs source separation, routes components to domain-specific experts, and aggregates their evidence into an interpretable verdict. We further introduce a mixed-authenticity ADD benchmark covering temporal transitions, acoustic overlaps, and hybrid mixtures. Experimental results show that ToolDF achieves the best overall performance on composite-type detection, achieving macro-F1 gains of 3.72 and 14.39 points over the strongest monolithic baseline and a fixed pipeline, respectively, while providing interpretable evidence localized to temporal regions and acoustic sources. Our source code and dataset are publicly available online.
comment: To appear in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026

title: Dynamic probabilistic decision networks
summary: A new type of decision networks is suggested and its operation is analyzed. The network nodes are represented by intelligent agents who can denote either some biological beings, like humans, or neurons of the brain, or the nodes of artificial intelligence. The specifics of the network are in the following: It is probabilistic in the sense that the choice, accomplished by each agent, is characterized by the related probability. It is dynamic, with the probabilities varying in time due to the exchange of information between the agents. It is affective, because the agents choose between alternatives by taking account of utility as well as of biases and emotions. In general, it is heterogeneous, being composed of the groups of agents with different properties, for instance having long-term memory and short-term memory. The network dynamics, caused by the information exchange, results in decision error decrease. The network operation is illustrated by the example starting with the Allais paradox, its resolution, and the decision error diminution in the process of decision dynamics with information exchange. Resorting to machine-learning techniques it is possible to regulate the behavior of the network agents forcing them to choose particular alternatives.

title: Symmetries and Causality: Causal Effect Identification Beyond IID Data
summary: In the natural sciences, symmetries and cause-effect relationships are ubiquitous. Yet for complex machine-learning tasks, like world-modeling in reinforcement learning, they appear difficult to harness. We propose a formal description of statistical systems based on symmetries in data leaving causal mechanisms invariant. The result is an abstract, simple and general mathematical language for causal reasoning. This paper provides formal descriptions of models and queries, setting up this language, and the formal infrastructure and strategies for their mathematically rigorous identification from data within this formalism. This approach reproduces and matches standard theoretical results on IID data and transport of experimental and non-experimental data. But its main purpose is to unify and substantially extend the scope of causal reasoning, in going beyond IID data and in approaching complex causal queries not captured by do- or soft-interventions. This new perspective on causally relevant aspects of data-modeling additionally sheds new light on well-known structures like c-components or hedges but also includes aspects of missing data and is inherently well-suited for the description of transfer and robustness properties.

title: An existence result of a functional integral equation via Darbo type theorem and an iterative algorithm to solve it
summary: In our study, Darbo's fixed point theorem and the coupled fixed point theorem have been extended. The two theorems were generalized using $C-class$ mapping. Using the Darbo type theorem, we gave an existence result for a functional integral equation along with an appropriate illustration. In addition, we explored the numerical solution of a given functional integral problem using modified homotopy perturbation.

title: The half-rate linear programming bound for binary codes is $\frac12-\frac1π$
summary:
In their work on sphere packing and the conformal bootstrap, Afkhami-Jeddi, Cohn, Hartman, de Laat, and Tajdini conjectured the exact high-dimensional exponent of the Cohn--Elkies sphere-packing linear program. OpenAI's Chapter 1 subsequently proved their conjecture by establishing that both Fourier sign-uncertainty radii are $(1/π+o(1))\sqrt d$. We prove the binary coding analogue: the half-rate point of the asymptotic binary Delsarte linear program is $1/2-1/π$; equivalently, \[
  R_D\!\left(\frac12-\frac1π\right)=\frac12. \] We also formulate the two Krawtchouk sign-uncertainty problems and determine both of their asymptotics. If $A^{\mathrm K}_{\pm}(n)$ denotes the first radial layer after which an origin-vanishing Krawtchouk $(\pm1)$-eigenfunction can be nonnegative, then \[
  \frac{A^{\mathrm K}_{\pm}(n)}n\longrightarrow
  \frac12-\frac1π. \] The common lower bound is the Hamming space counterpart of the mass-concentration principle in the Chapter 1 proof.
  The upper bound has a different source. It is the binary-code counterpart of the final spherical-code construction in OpenAI's Chapter 2. Gay, Jeronimo, and Liu improved the resulting binary bound and suggested the functional $Φ$ used here, but explicitly evaluated only a few low levels of the corresponding hierarchy. We construct and evaluate compatible binary certificates at every level, attaining the upper bound in the limit. The construction uses an $N$-qubit generalization of the pure-state channel of Alrabiah and Guruswami.

title: Quantisation of Abstract Data Types
summary: In this paper, we introduce a notion of abstract quantum data type within the framework of universal algebra. This notion provides an algebraic foundation for describing data abstraction in quantum programming. We formally define a quantisation of classical data types and show that their equational specifications can be soundly lifted to the quantum setting. Two standard quantisation methods for classical functions, namely the bit oracle and the phase oracle, arise as special cases of this general construction. We illustrate the framework with applications to quantum arrays and quantum error-correcting codes, showing how they can be understood through the lens of data-type quantisation. We further establish conditions under which quantisation preserves structural relationships and constructions of classical data types, including embeddings, isomorphisms, and products.

title: Quantum Query Complexity of Finding a Tarski Fixed Point on a High-Dimensional Grid
summary:
The Knaster-Tarski fixed-point theorem states that every monotone function over a complete lattice has a fixed point. Beyond its fundamental role in order theory, the theorem and its algorithmic variants have found broad applications in areas such as economics, game theory, and programming languages. While the query complexity of finding a Tarski fixed point has been extensively studied in classical models, comparatively little is known in the quantum setting.
  We prove an $Ω(k\log n)$ quantum query lower bound for finding a fixed point of a monotone function on $[n]^k$, using the nonnegative spectral adversary method. In the two extremal regimes $n = 2$ and $k = 1$, our quantum lower bound matches the previous classical lower bounds $Ω(k)$ and $Ω(\log n)$, respectively. For $n, k\geq 2$, our bound improves the best previous classical lower bound when $n < k$ and is within a factor of $\log n / \log k$ compared to the known classical lower bound when $n \geq k$. To construct the adversary matrix, we develop the Tree--Filtration Adversary Method. Besides yielding our lower bound, the method offers a more transparent combinatorial interpretation of the nonnegative spectral adversary method. When the hard instances of a problem admit a tree-like organization and suggest an intuition analogous to classical decision-tree lower bounds, our method provide a promising approach to establishing quantum complexity lower bounds.

title: New bounds for the support of input-output equations in differential-algebraic systems
summary:
Given a polynomial dynamical system $\mathbf{x}'=\mathbf{f}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{u})$ together with an observation function $y=g(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{u})$, where $\mathbf{x}=(x_1,\ldots,x_n)$, $\mathbf{u}=(u_1,\ldots,u_m)$ and $y$ are differential variables, and $\mathbf{f}=(f_1,\ldots,f_n)$, $g$ are polynomials with coefficients in a differential field, we study the problem of determining a minimal polynomial differential equation satisfied by the inputs $\mathbf{u}$ and the output $y$ which follows as a differential consequence of the system.
  We provide a characterization of a finite superset of the set of monomials appearing with non-zero coefficients in this input-output equation. Specifically, we establish an upper bound for the degree of the minimal polynomial and a family of inequalities that define a polytope containing its Newton polytope. These results extend recent work by Mukhina and Pogudin for systems with constant parameters, and enable the use of evaluation-interpolation techniques for the efficient computation of such eliminant polynomials.

title: Supersingular Elliptic Curves Without Inseparable Small Degree Endomorphisms
summary: For a fixed characteristic $p$, let $δ(p)$ denote the smallest degree needed to guarantee the existence of an isogeny from any supersingular curve $E$ to its Frobenius conjugate $E^{(p)}$. We translate existence questions concerning $δ(p)$ into questions about positive definite integral ternary quadratic forms and use Voronoi's theory of perfect forms in dimension three to characterize when $δ(p)$ is nearly maximal. For sufficiently large primes, we show that $δ(p)$ attains its upper bound precisely when $p$ is represented by one of nine explicit cubic polynomials, reducing the infinitude of such primes to whether one of these cubics takes prime values infinitely often. We also prove that, for almost all primes, $δ(p)$ lies at least $p^{1/6-o(1)}$ below its upper bound.

title: The Prime Clockwork: A Dynamic Representation of Modular and Multiplicative Arithmetic
comments: This manuscript develops a discrete dynamical-system representation of elementary number theory and uses it to give alternative proofs of classical results; it does not claim new theorems. We therefore selected History and Overview (math.HO) as the primary classification and Number Theory (math.NT) as a cross-list
summary:
The way numbers are represented strongly influences which arithmetic structures are easy to see. The \emph{prime clockwork} is a recursively growing discrete dynamical system: a list of autonomous two-hand clocks driven by one common $+1$ signal. No primes or primality labels are supplied. Starting empty, the process appends a clock of period $n$ whenever none already present rings; the primes are generated internally as its growth times. For each installed prime $p$, the seconds reading $R_p$ advances through $0,\ldots,p-1$, and each return to zero increments the minutes reading $M_p$, which counts completed $p$-cycles. The hands use only increment, comparison, reset, and carry, without explicit \texttt{mod} or \texttt{div} operations.
  At time $n$, $n=pM_p(n)+R_p(n)$. The valuation readout $V_p(n)=ν_p(n)$ is generated locally: it is zero when the seconds counter is non-zero (silent state) and otherwise (when the p-clock rings) one plus the earlier valuation addressed by the current minutes reading. The valuation vector gives the integer in unique prime-factorized form. Its coordinates add and subtract under multiplication and division, representing every positive rational uniquely; divisibility becomes weak componentwise order, and unique factorization is natural in this representation. Finite seconds arrays form Cartesian-product state spaces whose common orbit visits every joint state once before repeating; this \emph{grand cycle} is the order-sensitive dynamical counterpart of the Chinese remainder theorem. The same coordinates expose gcd, lcm, perfect powers, Bézout's identity, and Euler's totient. Rational valuation levels reach certain positive algebraic irrationalities, but not algebraic numbers in general.
