title: Data-efficient Kernel Methods for Learning Hamiltonian Systems
summary: Hamiltonian dynamics describe a wide range of physical systems. As such, data-driven simulations of Hamiltonian systems are important for many scientific and engineering problems. In this work, we propose kernel-based methods for identifying and forecasting Hamiltonian systems directly from trajectory data. We present two approaches: a 2-step method that reconstructs trajectories before learning the Hamiltonian, and a 1-step method that jointly infers both. Across several benchmark systems, including mass-spring dynamics, a nonlinear pendulum, and the Henon-Heiles system, we demonstrate that our framework achieves accurate, data-efficient predictions and outperforms 2-step kernel-based baselines, particularly in scarce-data regimes, while preserving the Hamiltonian structure. Moreover, we prove a priori error estimates, ensuring reliability of the learned models. We also provide a more general, problem-agnostic numerical framework that goes beyond Hamiltonian systems and can be used for data-driven learning of arbitrary dynamical systems.

title: Parameterized Hardness of Zonotope Containment and Neural Network Verification
summary: Neural networks with ReLU activations are a widely used model in machine learning. It is thus important to have a profound understanding of the properties of the functions computed by such networks. Recently, there has been increasing interest in the (parameterized) computational complexity of determining these properties. In this work, we close several gaps and resolve an open problem posed by Froese et al. [COLT '25] regarding the parameterized complexity of various problems related to network verification. In particular, we prove that, for all $\ell\ge 2$, deciding positivity (and thus surjectivity) of a function $f:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}$ computed by an $\ell$-layer ReLU network is W[$\ell-1$]-hard when parameterized by the input dimension $d$. The case $\ell=2$ implies that zonotope non-containment (a problem that is of independent interest in computational geometry, control theory, and robotics) is W[1]-hard with respect to the ambient dimension $d$. Moreover, we show that approximating the maximum within any multiplicative factor and computing the $L_p$-Lipschitz constant for $p\in(0,\infty]$ in $\ell$-layer networks is NP-hard and W[$\ell-1$]-hard with respect to $d$. For $\ell\ge 3$, approximating the $L_p$-Lipschitz constant is NP- and W[$\ell-2$]-hard. We further show that the above problems are NP- and W[$t$]-hard (for all $t\ge 1$) with respect to $\ell$ for constant $d$. Notably, our hardness results imply that the naive enumeration-based methods for these fundamental problems running in $n^{(\ell-1) d}\cdot\operatorname{poly}(N)$ time are all essentially optimal under the Exponential Time Hypothesis.

AI.title_translation: 全对称多胞体包含与神经网络验证的参数化困难性
AI.tldr: 本文解决了神经网络验证与Zonotope包含的参数化复杂度公开难题，证明了其属于W级困难，并确立了朴素枚举算法在ETH假设下的理论最优性。
AI.motivation: 深入理解ReLU神经网络计算函数的数学与几何性质，厘清网络验证及相关几何问题在参数化视角下的计算复杂性，并解决Froese等人（COLT '25）提出的公开难题。
AI.method: 运用参数化复杂度理论、细粒度归约方法以及指数时间假设（ETH），对网络层数与输入维度等参数展开计算下界证明。
AI.result: 证明了$\ell$层ReLU网络在以输入维度$d$为参数时，判定正定性是W[$\ell-1$]难的（$\ell=2$时对应Zonotope非包含问题为W[1]难）；逼近最大值和计算$L_p$-Lipschitz常数是NP难且为W[$\ell-1$]难；同时对于固定维度$d$，关于层数$\ell$在所有$t\ge 1$下均为W[$t$]难。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，关于ReLU神经网络的验证问题和Zonotope包含问题在参数化维度下具有高阶困难性，现有时间复杂度为 $n^{(\ell-1)d}\cdot\operatorname{poly}(N)$ 的朴素枚举算法在指数时间假设（ETH）下本质上已是理论最优。
AI.translation: 具有ReLU激活函数的神经网络是机器学习中广泛使用的模型。因此，深入理解此类网络计算出的函数的性质至关重要。近年来，关于判定这些性质的（参数化）计算复杂性引起了越来越多的关注。在本文中，我们填补了多项空白，并解决了Froese等人（COLT '25）提出的关于网络验证各类问题的参数化复杂性的公开问题。特别是，我们证明了对于所有 $\ell\ge 2$，以输入维度 $d$ 为参数时，判定由 $\ell$ 层ReLU网络计算的函数 $f:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}$ 的正定性（及满射性）是 W[$\ell-1$] 困难的。$\ell=2$ 的情形表明全对称多胞体（Zonotope）非包含问题（该问题在计算几何、控制论和机器人学中具有独立的理论价值）关于周围环境维度 $d$ 是 W[1] 困难的。此外，我们证明了在 $\ell$ 层网络中，在任意乘法因子内逼近最大值以及计算 $p\in(0,\infty]$ 的 $L_p$-Lipschitz 常数不仅是 NP 困难的，而且关于 $d$ 是 W[$\ell-1$] 困难的。对于 $\ell\ge 3$，逼近 $L_p$-Lipschitz 常数是 NP 难和 W[$\ell-2$] 难的。我们进一步证明，在常数 $d$ 下，上述问题关于 $\ell$ 对于所有 $t\ge 1$ 都是 NP 难和 W[$t$] 难的。值得注意的是，我们的困难性结果表明，在指数时间假设（ETH）下，解决这些基础问题且运行时间为 $n^{(\ell-1) d}\cdot\operatorname{poly}(N)$ 的朴素枚举方法本质上都是最优的。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了ReLU神经网络验证与Zonotope包含问题的参数化复杂度。作者证明了网络正定性判定、Lipschitz常数计算与极值逼近等核心问题在以输入维度为参数时具有W[$\ell-1$]困难性，并指出基于ETH假设，现存运行时间为 $n^{(\ell-1) d}\cdot\operatorname{poly}(N)$ 的朴素枚举算法已达到理论最优。
AI.keywords: 神经网络验证, 参数化复杂度, 全对称多胞体 (Zonotope), ReLU网络, 指数时间假设 (ETH)
AI.comments: 该研究在神经网络形式化验证理论领域具有重要突破，不仅彻底解决了COLT '25提出的公开问题，而且建立了网络层数$\ell$与参数化复杂度层级W[$\ell-1$]之间的优美对应关系。其在指数时间假设（ETH）下证明了朴素枚举算法的最优性，明确了在输入维度上追求固定参数可解（FPT）算法的理论局限，对计算几何与安全验证算法的设计具有深远的指导意义。

title: Extending Fill-In-the-Middle with Instructions for Steerable Code Completion
summary: Code completion models often fail when the developer's intent is under-specified in the code context. To mitigate this, developers frequently use natural language comments to clarify objectives. However, current code completion models fail to prioritize these directives effectively since they are merely pre-trained using the Fill-In-the-Middle (FIM) objective. On the one hand, the natural language instructions, mixed with the noisy code comments, are just treated as part of the background context within the prefix. On the other hand, the pre-training datasets for the FIM objective are mostly sourced from open-source repositories, which results in a scarcity of high-intent instruction-to-code pairings that reflect the developers' workflow in code completion. To bridge this gap, we propose Instruction-aware Fill-In-the-Middle (IFIM), a fine-tuning method that extends the FIM structure with a dedicated, structurally separated instruction section. Our evaluation shows that IFIM substantially improves adherence to developer intent, while leaving infilling performance unchanged when no instruction is given. The gains hold on an in-the-wild benchmark of 100 instructions written by real developers and across model scales from 1.5B to 7B. IFIM thus offers a backward-compatible upgrade path for existing FIM-based code completion systems at a modest training cost.

AI.title_translation: 通过指令扩展中间填充以实现可控代码补全
AI.tldr: 当前代码补全模型在处理开发者意图不明确的自然语言注释时表现不佳。本文提出了一种指令感知中间填充（IFIM）的微调方法，通过引入一个专门的、结构分离的指令部分，显著提高了模型对开发者意图的遵守，同时不影响无指令时的填充性能。
AI.motivation: 代码补全模型在开发者意图在代码上下文中不明确时经常失败。现有模型未能有效利用自然语言注释，因为它们被视为背景上下文，且预训练数据中缺乏高意图的指令-代码配对。
AI.method: 本文提出指令感知中间填充（IFIM），这是一种微调方法，它通过一个专门的、结构上分离的指令部分来扩展中间填充（FIM）结构。
AI.result: IFIM显著提高了模型对开发者意图的遵守，在没有给出指令时填充性能保持不变。这些改进在由真实开发者编写的100条指令的实际基准测试中，以及从1.5B到7B的模型规模中都得到了证实。
AI.conclusion: IFIM以适中的训练成本为现有的基于FIM的代码补全系统提供了一条向后兼容的升级路径，有效解决了结合开发者意图的问题。
AI.translation: 代码补全模型在开发者意图在代码上下文中不明确时经常失败。为了缓解这种情况，开发者经常使用自然语言注释来澄清目标。然而，当前的代码补全模型未能有效优先处理这些指令，因为它们仅仅使用中间填充（FIM）目标进行预训练。一方面，与嘈杂的代码注释混合的自然语言指令仅被视为前缀中的背景上下文的一部分。另一方面，FIM目标的预训练数据集主要来源于开源仓库，这导致了反映开发者在代码补全工作流中的高意图指令到代码配对的稀缺。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了指令感知中间填充（IFIM），这是一种微调方法，它通过一个专门的、结构上分离的指令部分扩展了FIM结构。我们的评估表明，IFIM在没有给出指令时保持填充性能不变的情况下，显著提高了对开发者意图的遵守。这些收益在由真实开发者编写的100条指令的“in-the-wild”基准测试中以及从1.5B到7B的模型规模中都得到了证实。因此，IFIM以适中的训练成本为现有的基于FIM的代码补全系统提供了一条向后兼容的升级路径。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了指令感知中间填充（IFIM），这是一种微调方法，通过增加一个专门的指令部分来增强传统的中间填充（FIM）代码补全模型。该方法解决了现有模型难以有效整合自然语言注释中表达的开发者意图的局限性。评估表明，IFIM在不同模型规模和真实场景下显著提高了对开发者意图的遵守，为当前的基于FIM的系统提供了一种经济高效且向后兼容的升级方案。
AI.keywords: 代码补全, 中间填充, 开发者意图, 自然语言指令, 微调
AI.comments: 该论文为代码补全领域的一个常见问题（即如何有效利用自然语言指令）提供了一个创新且实用的解决方案。通过结构化地分离指令，IFIM为模型更好地理解开发者意图提供了一条清晰的路径，使其成为可控代码补全的一个重要改进。其向后兼容性和适中的训练成本使其成为一个高度可采纳的升级方案。

title: The Popular Dimension of Matchings
summary:
We study popular matchings in three classical settings: the house allocation problem, the marriage problem, and the roommates problem. In the popular matching problem, (a subset of) the vertices in a graph have preference orderings over their potential matches. A matching is popular if it gets a plurality of votes in a pairwise election against any other matching. Unfortunately, popular matchings typically do not exist. So we study a natural relaxation, namely popular winning sets which are a set of matchings that collectively get a plurality of votes in a pairwise election against any other matching. The $\textit{popular dimension}$ is the minimum cardinality of a popular winning set, in the worst case over the problem class.
  We prove that the popular dimension is exactly $2$ in the house allocation problem, even if the voters are weighted and ties are allowed in their preference lists. For the marriage problem and the roommates problem, we prove that the popular dimension is between $2$ and $3$, when the agents are weighted and/or their preferences orderings allow ties. In the special case where the agents are unweighted and have strict preference orderings, the popular dimension of the marriage problem is known to be exactly $1$ and we prove the popular dimension of the roommates problem is exactly $2$.

AI.tldr: 研究了三种经典匹配问题中的流行匹配，由于流行匹配通常不存在，论文引入了流行获胜集及其流行维度，并计算了在不同条件下的流行维度。
AI.motivation: 由于流行匹配在图的顶点具有偏好排序的设置中通常不存在，因此需要研究一种自然的放宽形式，即流行获胜集，以解决这一挑战。
AI.method: 通过在房屋分配问题、婚姻问题和室友问题这三种经典设置中，定义并分析流行获胜集及其流行维度。论文通过数学证明，确定了在不同权重和偏好限制条件下的流行维度具体值或范围。
AI.result: 在房屋分配问题中，流行维度正好是2，即使投票者有权重且偏好列表允许平局。对于婚姻问题和室友问题，当代理人有权重且/或其偏好排序允许平局时，流行维度在2到3之间。在代理人无权重且具有严格偏好排序的特殊情况下，婚姻问题的流行维度已知正好是1，而室友问题的流行维度被证明正好是2。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为流行匹配在不同经典问题设置下的存在性挑战提供了解决方案。通过引入流行获胜集和流行维度，并精确量化了这些维度在各种复杂条件下的值，从而加深了对匹配理论的理解。
AI.translation:
我们研究了三种经典设置中的流行匹配：房屋分配问题、婚姻问题和室友问题。在流行匹配问题中，图中的（一部分）顶点对其潜在匹配对象有偏好排序。如果一个匹配在与任何其他匹配的成对选举中获得多数票，则它是流行的。不幸的是，流行匹配通常不存在。因此，我们研究了一种自然的放宽形式，即流行获胜集，它是一组匹配，在与任何其他匹配的成对选举中集体获得多数票。流行维度是在问题类别中最坏情况下的流行获胜集的最小基数。
我们证明了在房屋分配问题中，流行维度正好是2，即使投票者有权重且其偏好列表允许平局。对于婚姻问题和室友问题，我们证明了当代理人有权重且/或其偏好排序允许平局时，流行维度在2到3之间。在代理人无权重且具有严格偏好排序的特殊情况下，婚姻问题的流行维度已知正好是1，我们证明了室友问题的流行维度正好是2。
AI.summary: 这篇论文探讨了流行匹配在房屋分配、婚姻和室友问题中的概念。由于流行匹配通常不存在，作者引入了“流行获胜集”作为其放宽形式，并定义了“流行维度”作为流行获胜集的最小基数。研究结果表明，在房屋分配问题中，流行维度为2；在有权重或允许平局的婚姻和室友问题中，流行维度在2到3之间；而在无权重严格偏好的室友问题中，流行维度为2。
AI.keywords: 流行匹配, 流行维度, 流行获胜集, 房屋分配问题, 婚姻问题, 室友问题
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入“流行获胜集”和“流行维度”的概念，巧妙地解决了流行匹配通常不存在的挑战。其创新之处在于为理解和量化匹配问题的“流行性”提供了一个新的框架，并对不同经典匹配问题在不同约束条件下的流行维度进行了精确的数学分析。这对于理解和设计更公平、更可接受的匹配机制具有重要意义。

title: EasySteer: A Unified Framework for High-Performance and Extensible LLM Steering
comments: EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations. Code: https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/EasySteer Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rRGzZmhrXg
summary: Large language model (LLM) steering has emerged as a promising paradigm for controlling model behavior at inference time through targeted manipulation of hidden states, offering a lightweight alternative to expensive retraining. However, existing steering frameworks suffer from critical limitations: computational inefficiency, limited extensibility, and restricted functionality that hinder both research progress and practical deployment. We present EasySteer, a unified framework for high-performance, extensible LLM steering built on vLLM. Our system features modular architecture with pluggable interfaces for both analysis-based and learning-based methods, fine-grained parameter control, pre-computed steering vectors for eight application domains, and an interactive demonstration system. Through deep integration with vLLM's optimized inference engine, EasySteer achieves 10.8-22.3$\times$ speedup over existing frameworks. Extensive experiments demonstrate its effectiveness in overthinking mitigation, hallucination reduction, and other key applications. EasySteer transforms steering from research technique to production-ready capability, establishing critical infrastructure for deployable, controllable language models.
comment: EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations. Code: https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/EasySteer Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rRGzZmhrXg

AI.title_translation: EasySteer：一个用于高性能和可扩展LLM引导的统一框架
AI.tldr: EasySteer是一个基于vLLM的统一框架，用于高性能、可扩展的LLM引导，通过模块化架构和与vLLM的深度集成，实现了10.8-22.3倍的速度提升，并有效解决了过度思考和幻觉等问题，使LLM引导从研究技术转变为生产级能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）引导框架存在计算效率低下、可扩展性有限和功能受限等关键局限性，阻碍了研究进展和实际部署。LLM引导作为一种通过操纵隐藏状态在推理时控制模型行为的范式，是昂贵再训练的轻量级替代方案，但现有框架的不足限制了其潜力。
AI.method: EasySteer是一个基于vLLM构建的统一框架。它采用模块化架构，具有用于基于分析和基于学习方法的即插即用接口，支持细粒度参数控制，提供八个应用领域的预计算引导向量，并包含一个交互式演示系统。通过与vLLM优化推理引擎的深度集成，实现了性能提升。
AI.result: EasySteer在现有框架上实现了10.8-22.3倍的速度提升。广泛的实验证明了其在缓解过度思考、减少幻觉和其他关键应用中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EasySteer将LLM引导从一种研究技术转变为生产就绪的能力，为可部署、可控的语言模型建立了关键基础设施。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）引导已成为一种有前景的范式，通过有针对性地操纵隐藏状态，在推理时控制模型行为，为昂贵的再训练提供了一种轻量级替代方案。然而，现有的引导框架存在关键局限性：计算效率低下、可扩展性有限和功能受限，这些都阻碍了研究进展和实际部署。我们提出了EasySteer，一个基于vLLM构建的用于高性能、可扩展LLM引导的统一框架。我们的系统具有模块化架构，为基于分析和基于学习的方法提供可插拔接口，细粒度参数控制，针对八个应用领域的预计算引导向量，以及一个交互式演示系统。通过与vLLM优化推理引擎的深度集成，EasySteer比现有框架实现了10.8-22.3倍的速度提升。广泛的实验证明了其在缓解过度思考、减少幻觉和其他关键应用中的有效性。EasySteer将引导从研究技术转变为生产就绪的能力，为可部署、可控的语言模型建立了关键基础设施。
AI.summary: 本文提出了EasySteer，一个基于vLLM构建的统一框架，旨在解决现有大语言模型（LLM）引导框架在计算效率、可扩展性和功能上的局限性。EasySteer通过模块化架构、细粒度参数控制、预计算引导向量和与vLLM推理引擎的深度集成，实现了显著的性能提升（10.8-22.3倍加速）。实验证明，该框架能有效缓解过度思考和减少幻觉，从而将LLM引导从研究阶段推向生产级应用，为可控的语言模型提供了关键基础设施。
AI.keywords: LLM引导, EasySteer, vLLM, 模型控制, 性能优化
AI.comments: EasySteer的创新之处在于其统一的框架设计和与vLLM的深度集成，显著提升了LLM引导的计算效率和可扩展性。它将LLM引导从理论研究推向了实际部署，解决了现有技术在生产环境中的痛点。提供预计算引导向量和交互式演示系统也降低了使用门槛，对于推动可控LLM的发展具有重要意义。

title: Finite-Time Convergence of Single-Trajectory Chi-Square Robust Q-Learning With Linear Function Approximation
comments: The current version substantially improves the provable sample complexity compared to the earlier version
summary: Distributionally robust reinforcement learning seeks policies that remain effective when the deployment environment differs from the one that generated the training data. We study model-free robust Q-learning with $χ^2$ uncertainty sets and linear function approximation, using data from a single trajectory of an unknown nominal MDP. Evaluating the $χ^2$ robust Bellman target introduces the square root of a conditional second moment, which cannot be estimated unbiasedly from one transition, while the projected robust Bellman operator need not be contractive. We address these obstacles through a variational reformulation of the robust Bellman target and a blockwise frozen-target scheme, and establish a finite-time error bound relative to the optimal robust Q-function for every $γ\in(0,1)$. A neural-network experiment illustrates how the variational target can be used in a continuous-state nonlinear-control task.
comment: The current version substantially improves the provable sample complexity compared to the earlier version

AI.title_translation: 有限时间收敛的具有线性函数逼近的单轨迹卡方鲁棒Q学习
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种在单一轨迹数据下，使用卡方不确定性集和线性函数逼近的无模型鲁棒Q学习方法，解决了现有方法在估计鲁棒贝尔曼目标和算子收缩性方面的挑战，并建立了有限时间误差界限，最后通过一个神经网络实验验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的分布鲁棒强化学习方法在部署环境与训练环境不一致时，难以保证策略的有效性。本研究旨在解决在单一轨迹数据下，使用卡方不确定性集和线性函数逼近的无模型鲁棒Q学习方法中的挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种卡方鲁棒Q学习方法，通过变分重构鲁棒贝尔曼目标和采用分块冻结目标机制来解决估计鲁棒贝尔曼目标中的挑战，并建立了有限时间误差界限。
AI.result: 成功建立了相对于最优鲁棒Q函数在所有γ∈(0,1)下的有限时间误差界限。并通过一个神经网络实验展示了如何将变分目标用于连续状态非线性控制任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过变分重构鲁棒贝尔曼目标和分块冻结目标机制，成功克服了单轨迹数据下鲁棒Q学习的挑战，并建立了有限时间误差界限，为实际应用提供了理论基础。
AI.translation: 分布鲁棒强化学习旨在寻找在部署环境与生成训练数据的环境不同时仍然有效的策略。我们研究了具有 $χ^2$ 不确定性集和线性函数逼近的无模型鲁棒 Q 学习，使用来自未知标称 MDP 单一轨迹的数据。评估 $χ^2$ 鲁棒贝尔曼目标会引入条件二阶矩的平方根，该二阶矩无法从一次转移中无偏估计，而投影鲁棒贝尔曼算子不必是收缩的。我们通过鲁棒贝尔曼目标的变分重构和分块冻结目标机制来解决这些障碍，并为所有 $γ 	ext{ in } (0,1)$ 建立了相对于最优鲁棒 Q 函数的有限时间误差界限。神经网络实验说明了如何在连续状态非线性控制任务中使用变分目标。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种用于分布鲁棒强化学习的无模型鲁棒Q学习方法，该方法使用单一轨迹数据、卡方不确定性集和线性函数逼近。为了解决估计鲁棒贝尔曼目标和算子收缩性的挑战，研究采用了变分重构和分块冻结目标机制，并成功建立了相对于最优鲁棒Q函数的有限时间误差界限。此外，通过一个神经网络实验验证了该方法在连续状态非线性控制任务中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 分布鲁棒强化学习,鲁棒Q学习,卡方不确定性集,线性函数逼近,有限时间收敛
AI.comments: 该研究在分布鲁棒强化学习领域取得了重要进展，特别是在仅使用单一轨迹数据的情况下。通过引入变分重构和分块冻结目标机制，有效地解决了传统方法在估计鲁棒贝尔曼目标和算子收缩性方面的难题。建立的有限时间误差界限为该方法的实际应用提供了坚实的理论基础。然而，研究的局限性可能在于其对线性函数逼近的依赖性，以及在更复杂、非线性环境中的泛化能力有待进一步验证。未来的工作可以探索更通用的函数逼近方法，并评估该方法在更广泛的实际场景中的性能。

title: SPARC: Spine with Prismatic And Revolute Compliance for Faster Quadrupedal Bounding
summary: Quadruped mammals coordinate sagittal spinal bending with axial extension and compression during dynamic locomotion. Yet most robotic quadrupeds use rigid trunks, passively compliant spines with fixed properties, or actively controlled spines that track prescribed trajectories. Whether actively regulated spinal compliance can support faster dynamic locomotion remains unclear. We present SPARC, a compact 1.26-kg, 3-DoF sagittal-plane spine that combines revolute and prismatic motion with independently tunable task-space stiffness and damping. A floating-base impedance controller renders the desired task-space compliance, and benchtop tests show that the fitted axial stiffness matches commanded values within 1.5%. We integrate SPARC into an 8-DoF quadruped and evaluate it across 97 bounding trials under three spine configurations: impedance-controlled SPARC, the same SPARC module held near a fixed pose using position control, and a lightweight rigid spine. Impedance-controlled SPARC reaches 1.029 m/s, compared with 0.769 m/s for position-controlled SPARC and 0.673 m/s for the rigid spine. Impedance-controlled SPARC reaches higher speeds with larger axial motion and greater mechanical power exchange, while at matched speed it has a higher electrical cost of transport than the rigid spine, revealing an energetic trade-off. Code and hardware are available at: https://github.com/YueWang996/sparc

AI.title_translation: SPARC：用于实现更快速四足奔跳且兼具移动与转动顺应性的脊柱
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种兼具轴向伸缩与转动顺应性的主动调节四足机器人脊柱SPARC，成功将机器人的奔跳速度提升至1.029 m/s，验证了主动脊柱顺应性对提高奔跑速度的显著作用及其能耗代价。
AI.motivation: 四足哺乳动物在动态运动中会协同利用矢状面脊柱弯曲和轴向伸缩，而现有四足机器人多采用刚性躯干、固定参数的被动顺应脊柱或轨迹跟踪的主动脊柱，主动调节的脊柱顺应性是否能够支持更快速的动态运动仍不明确。
AI.method: 设计了一种质量为1.26 kg、具有3个自由度的矢状面脊柱模块SPARC，将转动与移动自由度相结合，并具备独立可调的任务空间刚度和阻尼；采用浮动基阻抗控制器进行顺应性渲染；将其集成于8自由度四足机器人，在阻抗控制SPARC、位置控制SPARC以及轻量刚性脊柱三种配置下开展了97次奔跳步态试验。
AI.result: 台架测试显示轴向刚度控制误差在1.5%以内；实机奔跳试验中，阻抗控制SPARC的速度达到1.029 m/s，明显高于位置控制SPARC（0.769 m/s）和刚性脊柱（0.673 m/s）；阻抗控制SPARC实现了更大的轴向运动与机械功率交换，但在相同运动速度下，其电能运输成本（CoT）高于刚性脊柱。
AI.conclusion: 主动调节的脊柱顺应性能够有效促进四足机器人的快速动态运动，通过更大的轴向形变和机械功率交换换取更高的奔跳速度，但同时也带来了更高的能量消耗代价。
AI.translation: 四足哺乳动物在动态运动过程中协同利用矢状面脊柱弯曲与轴向伸缩。然而，大多数四足机器人采用刚性躯干、具备固定特性的被动顺应脊柱，或跟踪预设轨迹的主动控制脊柱。主动调节的脊柱顺应性是否能支持更快速的动态运动尚不清楚。我们提出了SPARC，一种结构紧凑、重1.26千克的3自由度矢状面脊柱，它将转动和移动运动与独立可调的任务空间刚度和阻尼相结合。浮动基阻抗控制器渲染出所需的任务空间顺应性，台架测试表明拟合轴向刚度与指令值的吻合度在1.5%以内。我们将SPARC集成到一台8自由度四足机器人中，并在三种脊柱配置（阻抗控制SPARC、采用位置控制保持在固定姿态附近的同款SPARC模块，以及轻量刚性脊柱）下通过97次奔跳试验对其进行了评估。阻抗控制SPARC的速度达到1.029 m/s，相比之下，位置控制SPARC为0.769 m/s，刚性脊柱为0.673 m/s。阻抗控制SPARC通过更大的轴向运动和更大的机械功率交换达到了更高的速度，而在相同速度下其电能运输成本高于刚性脊柱，揭示了能量上的权衡。代码和硬件开源于：https://github.com/YueWang996/sparc
AI.summary: 针对主动脊柱顺应性能否提升四足运动速度的问题，本文研发了结合移动与转动顺应性的3自由度脊柱模块SPARC，并配备浮动基阻抗控制器。97次奔跳对比试验证明，阻抗控制SPARC将奔跳速度提升至1.029 m/s（较刚性脊柱提高超50%），展示了顺应性脊柱在高速动态运动中的动力学优势及能量权衡关系。
AI.keywords: 脊柱顺应性, 四足机器人, 阻抗控制, 奔跳步态, 移动与转动机构
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于突破了传统四足机器人仅关注转动关节或被动弹性的局限，提出了一种结合轴向伸缩与矢状面弯曲的主动阻抗调节脊柱（SPARC），并用严谨的台架与整机对比试验验证了其对奔跑速度极限的显著提升。局限性在于高速奔跑带来了更高的电能运输成本（CoT），展现出力学性能与能量效率之间的权衡，且目前主要验证于矢状面单一奔跳步态。

title: Greedy Thiele continued-fraction approximation on continuum domains in the complex plane
summary: We describe an adaptive greedy algorithm for Thiele continued-fraction (TCF) approximation of a function defined on a continuum domain in the complex plane. The algorithm iteratively selects interpolation nodes from an adaptively refined set of sample points on the domain boundary. We also present new algorithms for evaluating Thiele continued fractions and their accessory weights using only a single floating-point division. Numerical experiments comparing the greedy TCF method with the AAA algorithm on several challenging functions defined on the interval $[-1,1]$ and on the unit circle show that continuum TCF is consistently faster than AAA, by factors ranging from 8 to 40.

AI.title_translation: 复数域上连续域上的贪婪Thiele连分式逼近
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的贪婪算法，用于在复数域的连续域上进行Thiele连分式逼近，该算法通过自适应选择插值节点来提高效率。同时，还提出了新的Thiele连分式及其权重的计算方法，仅需一次浮点运算。实验表明，该方法在 $[-1,1]$ 区间和单位圆上的性能优于AAA算法，速度提升8到40倍。
AI.motivation: 为了在复数域的连续域上实现Thiele连分式逼近，并提高计算效率。
AI.method: 描述了一种自适应贪婪算法，该算法从域边界上自适应细化的样本点集中迭代选择插值节点。同时，提出了一种仅使用一次浮点除法即可计算Thiele连分式及其辅助权重的算法。
AI.result: 在 $[-1,1]$ 区间和单位圆上的数值实验表明，连续域上的Thiele连分式逼近方法比AAA算法快8到40倍。
AI.conclusion: 该贪婪Thiele连分式逼近算法在复数域的连续域上实现了高效逼近，并且计算速度显著优于现有算法。
AI.translation: 我们描述了一种用于逼近复平面中定义在连续域上的函数的自适应贪婪算法（Thiele continued-fraction, TCF）。该算法从域边界上自适应细化的样本点集中迭代选择插值节点。我们还提出了新的算法，仅使用一次浮点除法即可计算Thiele连分式及其辅助权重。将贪婪TCF方法与在区间 $[-1,1]$ 和单位圆上定义的几个挑战性函数上的AAA算法进行比较的数值实验表明，连续域TCF比AAA快，速度提升范围为8到40倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于复数域连续域上函数逼近的贪婪Thiele连分式（TCF）算法。该算法通过自适应选择插值节点来提高逼近效率，并提供了一种仅需一次浮点运算即可计算TCF及其权重的创新方法。数值实验证明，该方法在不同定义域上均显著优于AAA算法，速度提升明显。
AI.keywords: Thiele连分式, 贪婪算法, 复数域, 连续域逼近, AAA算法
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖且高效的Thiele连分式逼近算法，特别适用于复数域的连续域。算法的自适应节点选择和简化的计算方法是其主要创新点。与AAA算法的比较结果令人印象深刻，显示了该方法在速度上的巨大优势。然而，文章未提及算法在精度方面的表现，以及其在处理更复杂或高维域时的扩展性。

title: Vision-Based Tactile Sensing for the Perception of the Object's Compliance and Hardness
summary: Object compliance perception enables the identification of soft materials, supporting tasks such as fruit detection and assisted medical palpation. Compliance perception requires sensing an object's deformation and contact forces. Existing vision-based tactile sensing for compliance perception usually depends only on force or deformation. However, deformation-based approaches cannot reliably quantify object compliance, while force-based methods are overly sensitive to geometric variations. To address these limitations, this paper presents a framework that fuses temporal force sequences and deformation field information. Specifically, time-varying contact forces are inferred from tactile image sequences via a neural network, while deformation characteristics are encoded using depth maps. Crucially, the temporal force sequence is used as a dynamic force-response feature for compliance recognition. In standard experiments, the force prediction error reaches 0.06 N within a measurement range of 12 N. The proposed method achieves a 98.0% Shore-hardness classification accuracy for samples ranging from 10 HA to 80 HA. In practical scenarios, including abnormal fruit detection and soft matter, the overall accuracy exceeds 98.5%. This method improves the compliance perception ability of artificial tactile systems and facilitates their deployment in embodied perception applications.

title: WELD: The First Naturalistic Long-Period Small-Team Workplace Emotion Dataset for Ubiquitous Affective Computing
comments: WELD: 733,780 per-frame 7-class facial-expression probability records from 49 employees over 30.1 months (Nov 2021-May 2024). v2 corrects attrition metrics after removing leakage (binary AUC=0.79, survival C-index=0.52) and adds a FER fairness audit. 49 pp, 14 figs, 1 supp PDF
summary: Affective computing has matured rapidly in laboratory settings, yet no prior dataset combines (i) months-to-years of duration, (ii) a naturalistic workplace context, (iii) a stable small-team social structure, and (iv) a fully passive sensing protocol that survives institutional review. We introduce WELD, the first dataset to satisfy all four. WELD comprises 733,780 per-frame seven-class facial-expression probability vectors from 49 employees of a Chinese software company over 30.1 months (Nov 2021 - May 2024) -- the longest naturalistic in-the-wild emotion corpus and the only multi-year corpus supporting both within-individual longitudinal and within-team relational analyses on the same subjects. Data are released under a four-tier access model with only aggregated probabilities publicly downloadable. We validate the corpus by replicating three established phenomena (+43.1% weekend valence boost; 13:00-trough diurnal cycle; Shanghai 2022 lockdown effect d=-0.40), and report four novel findings: (1) variance decomposition attributes 19.3% of daily-valence variance to between-person differences and 29.8% to month seasonality -- a quantitative ceiling for future predictive models; (2) Hidden Markov decomposition reveals six emotional regimes with asymmetric negative-state dwell times (16-18 d vs 3 d); (3) leave-one-person-out turnover prediction reaches AUC=0.79 yet a Cox concordance index of only 0.52, exposing a metric-trap when AUC is reported without survival-aware baselines; (4) the corpus reveals systematic over-prediction of "angry" by an off-the-shelf FER model on neutral Asian faces (0.194 vs ~0.05 Western priors), making WELD valuable for FER fairness audits. A complex-systems analysis of the corpus appears as a companion preprint (arXiv:2510.16046).
comment: WELD: 733,780 per-frame 7-class facial-expression probability records from 49 employees over 30.1 months (Nov 2021-May 2024). v2 corrects attrition metrics after removing leakage (binary AUC=0.79, survival C-index=0.52) and adds a FER fairness audit. 49 pp, 14 figs, 1 supp PDF

title: Skyfall-GS: Synthesizing Immersive 3D Urban Scenes from Satellite Imagery
summary: Synthesizing large-scale, explorable, and geometrically accurate 3D urban scenes is a challenging yet valuable task for immersive and embodied applications. The challenge lies in the lack of large-scale and high-quality real-world 3D scans for training generalizable generative models. In this paper, we take an alternative route to create large-scale 3D scenes by leveraging readily available satellite imagery for realistic coarse geometry and open-domain diffusion models for high-quality close-up appearance synthesis. We propose Skyfall-GS, a novel hybrid framework that synthesizes immersive city-block scale 3D urban scenes by combining satellite reconstruction with diffusion refinement, eliminating the need for costly 3D annotations, and also featuring real-time, immersive 3D exploration. We tailor a curriculum-driven iterative refinement strategy to progressively enhance geometric completeness and photorealistic texture. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Skyfall-GS provides improved cross-view consistent geometry and more realistic textures compared to state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://skyfall-gs.jayinnn.dev/

title: Computing matrix functions associated with a Hermitian-definite pencil
summary: We consider the numerical evaluation of the quantity $Af(A^{-1}B)$, where $A$ is Hermitian positive definite, $B$ is Hermitian, and $f$ is a function defined on the spectrum of $A^{-1}B$. This problem is related to the Hermitian-definite matrix pencil $B-λA$. We study the conditioning of the problem, and we introduce several algorithms that combine the Schur decomposition with either the matrix square root or the Cholesky factorization. We study the numerical behavior of these algorithms in floating-point arithmetic, assess their computational costs, and compare their numerical performance. Our analysis suggests that the algorithms based on the Cholesky factorization will be more accurate and efficient than those based on the matrix square root. This is confirmed by our numerical experiments.

title: Evaluating Large Language Models on Urdu Idioms
summary: Idioms remain a persistent challenge in natural language processing due to their figurative and culturally grounded meanings, which distinguish them from literal expressions. Although recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have improved idiom handling across several languages, limited attention has been given to low resource languages such as Urdu. In this work, we present a comprehensive benchmark for Urdu to English idiomatic translation, consisting of a manually verified dataset of 4,000 aligned idiom sentence pairs in both Perso Arabic (native Urdu script) and Romanized Urdu. We evaluate multiple tasks, including translation, paraphrasing, idiom span detection, and back-translation, using diverse prompting strategies such as cultural prompting, idiomatic prompting, and few-shot learning. Our findings show that frontier LLMs consistently outperform traditional neural machine translation systems across all evaluation settings, particularly in preserving figurative and metaphorical meaning. While models demonstrate relatively stable performance on native Urdu script, the absence of standardized orthography in Romanized Urdu introduces substantial challenges for consistency and idiom span detection. This work establishes a high quality benchmark for cross script idiomatic evaluation in Urdu and underscores the importance of prompt engineering in preserving figurative language meaning across languages.

title: User Perceptions vs. Proxy LLM Judges: Privacy and Helpfulness in LLM Responses to Privacy-Sensitive Scenarios
comments: Published as a main conference paper at ACL 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly being adopted for tasks like drafting emails, summarizing meetings, and answering health questions. In these settings, users may need to share private information (e.g., contact details, health records). To evaluate LLMs' ability to identify and redact such information, prior work introduced real-life, scenario-based benchmarks (e.g., ConfAIde, PrivacyLens) and found that LLMs can leak private information in complex scenarios. However, these evaluations relied on proxy LLMs to judge the helpfulness and privacy-preservation quality of LLM responses, rather than directly measuring users' perceptions. To understand how users perceive the helpfulness and privacy-preservation quality of LLM responses to privacy-sensitive scenarios, we conducted a user study ($n=94$) using 90 PrivacyLens scenarios. We found that users had low agreement with each other when evaluating identical LLM responses. In contrast, five proxy LLMs reached high agreement, yet each proxy LLM had low correlation with users' evaluations. These results indicate that proxy LLMs cannot accurately estimate users' wide range of perceptions of utility and privacy in privacy-sensitive scenarios. We discuss the need for more user-centered studies to measure LLMs' ability to help users while preserving privacy, and for improving alignment between LLMs and users in estimating perceived privacy and utility.
comment: Published as a main conference paper at ACL 2026

title: From Leakage to Fidelity: Reliable Benchmarking for Temporal Cascade Prediction
summary: Temporal cascade prediction is widely studied, yet its empirical foundations remain fragile. Most existing works report results under random cascade splits that mix past and future signals, rely on datasets with limited features and no downstream conversion labels, and compare increasingly complex models without systematically examining whether benchmark conclusions are protocol-dependent. This paper argues that the field should move from leakage-prone evaluation toward fidelity-aware benchmarking. We introduce a protocol suite and renewed evaluation standard for temporal cascade prediction, centered on the Full Temporal protocol, overlap-based leakage diagnostics, and analyses of performance inflation and temporal drift. To broaden the scope of benchmark tasks, we also present Taoke, a real-world e-commerce cascade dataset with rich promoter/product features and observed purchase conversions, enabling both first-stage popularity forecasting and second-stage conversion forecasting under a shared benchmark asset. Finally, we include CasTemp as a lightweight reference method and additionally probe a larger same-task internal extension to verify that this pipeline remains operational at substantially greater scale. Together, these components turn cascade prediction from a protocol-sensitive leaderboard exercise into a more reliable analysis and benchmarking problem, while still providing a practical reference pipeline for large-scale evaluation and conversion-aware modeling.

title: BESS Siting and Sizing to Mitigate EV Charging-Induced Voltage Violations: A Planning Space Reduction Approach
summary: The rapid growth of electric vehicle (EV) charging can cause persistent voltage violations in distribution networks and increase the need for grid-side voltage support. This paper develops a proactive voltage management framework for planning battery energy storage systems (BESS) to mitigate EV charging-induced voltage violations. Annual EV charging profiles are generated through Monte Carlo simulation using probability distributions derived from real charging events and are incorporated into an annual voltage assessment to identify stressed operating conditions. An optimal expansion planning model then determines installation locations and capacities at minimum investment cost. To improve computational tractability, a planning space reduction (PSR) strategy combines critical period selection to reduce the chronological horizon with candidate bus screening to reduce the BESS siting space. The resulting investment decisions are evaluated through full-year operational validation on the IEEE 33-bus, IEEE 69-bus, and a 240-bus distribution system. Results show that PSR reduces solution time by up to 99.2% while matching the exhaustive benchmark in the 33-bus and 69-bus systems and limiting the objective deviation to 0.55% in the 240-bus system. The optimized BESS deployments eliminate the identified annual voltage violations and further reduce electricity purchase costs and network energy losses under increasing EV penetration.

title: A Quantitative Comparison of Centralised and Distributed Reinforcement Learning-Based Control for Soft Robotic Arms
comments: 7 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, accepted by RoboSoft 2026
summary: This paper presents a quantitative comparison between centralised and distributed multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) architectures for controlling a soft robotic arm modelled as a Cosserat rod in simulation. Using PyElastica and the OpenAI Gym interface, we train both a global Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) controller and a Multi-Agent PPO (MAPPO) under identical budgets. Both approaches are based on the arm having $n$ number of controlled sections. The study systematically varies $n$ and evaluates the performance of the arm to reach a fixed target in three scenarios: default baseline condition, recovery from external disturbance, and adaptation to actuator failure. Quantitative metrics used for the evaluation are mean action magnitude, mean final distance, mean episode length, and success rate. The results show that there are no significant benefits of the distributed policy when the number of controlled sections $n\le4$. In very simple systems, when $n\le2$, the centralised policy outperforms the distributed one. When $n$ increases to $4< n\le 12$, the distributed policy shows a high sample efficiency. In these systems, distributed policy promotes a stronger success rate, resilience, and robustness under local observability and yields faster convergence given the same sample size. However, centralised policies achieve much higher time efficiency during training as it takes much less time to train the same size of samples. These findings highlight the trade-offs between centralised and distributed policy in reinforcement learning-based control for soft robotic systems and provide actionable design guidance for future sim-to-real transfer in soft rod-like manipulators.
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, accepted by RoboSoft 2026

title: A Nesterov-Accelerated Byzantine-Robust Federated Learning
summary: We investigate robust federated learning, where a group of workers collaboratively train a shared model under the orchestration of a central server in the presence of Byzantine adversaries capable of arbitrary and potentially malicious behaviors. To simultaneously enhance communication efficiency and resilience against such adversaries, we propose a Byzantine-resilient Nesterov-accelerated federated learning (Byrd-NAFL) algorithm. Byrd-NAFL seamlessly integrates Nesterov's momentum into the federated learning process alongside Byzantine-resilient aggregation rules to achieve fast and safe convergence against gradient corruption. We establish a finite-time convergence guarantee for Byrd-NAFL under non-convex and smooth loss functions with relaxed assumptions on the aggregated gradients. Extensive numerical experiments validate the effectiveness of Byrd-NAFL and demonstrate the superiority over existing benchmarks in terms of convergence speed, accuracy, and resilience to diverse malicious attacks.

title: Shortest self-orthogonal embeddings of binary linear codes
summary: There has been recent interest in the study of shortest self-orthogonal embeddings of binary linear codes, since many such codes are optimal self-orthogonal codes. Several authors have studied the length of a shortest self-orthogonal embedding of a given binary code $\mathcal C$, or equivalently, the minimum number of columns that must be added to a generator matrix of $\mathcal C$ to form a generator matrix of a self-orthogonal code. In this paper, we use properties of the hull of a linear code to determine the length of a shortest self-orthogonal embedding of any binary linear code. We focus on the examples of Hamming codes and Reed-Muller codes. We show that a shortest self-orthogonal embedding of a binary Hamming code is self-dual, and propose two algorithms to construct self-dual codes from Hamming codes $\mathcal H_r$. Using these algorithms, we construct a self-dual $[22, 11, 6]$ code, called the shortened Golay code, from the binary $[15, 11, 3]$ Hamming code $\mathcal H_4$, and construct a self-dual $[52, 26, 8]$ code from the binary $[31, 26, 3]$ Hamming code $\mathcal H_5$. We use shortest SO embeddings of linear codes to obtain many inequivalent optimal self-orthogonal codes of dimension $7$ and $8$ for several lengths. Four of the codes of dimension $8$ that we construct are codes with new parameters such as $[91, 8, 42],\, [98, 8, 46],\,[114, 8, 54]$, and $[191, 8, 94]$.

title: DIAL-GS: Dynamic Instance Aware Reconstruction for Label-free Street Scenes with 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Urban scene reconstruction is critical for autonomous driving, enabling structured 3D representations for data synthesis and closed-loop testing. Supervised approaches rely on costly human annotations and lack scalability, while current self-supervised methods often confuse static and dynamic elements and fail to distinguish individual dynamic objects, limiting fine-grained editing. We propose DIAL-GS, a novel dynamic instance-aware reconstruction method for label-free street scenes with 4D Gaussian Splatting. We first accurately identify dynamic instances by exploiting appearance-position inconsistency between warped rendering and actual observation. Guided by instance-level dynamic perception, we employ instance-aware 4D Gaussians as the unified volumetric representation, realizing dynamic-adaptive and instance-aware reconstruction. Furthermore, we introduce a reciprocal mechanism through which identity and dynamics reinforce each other, enhancing both integrity and consistency. Experiments on urban driving scenarios show that DIAL-GS surpasses existing self-supervised baselines in reconstruction quality and instance-level editing, offering a concise yet powerful solution for urban scene modeling.

title: High-Altitude Balloon Station-Keeping with First Order Model Predictive Control
comments: Accepted to the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2026
summary: High-altitude balloons (HABs) are common in scientific research due to their wide range of applications and low cost. Because of their nonlinear, underactuated dynamics and the partial observability of wind fields, prior work has largely relied on model-free reinforcement learning (RL) methods to design near-optimal control schemes for station-keeping. These methods often compare only against hand-crafted heuristics, dismissing model-based approaches as impractical given the system complexity and uncertain wind forecasts. We revisit this assumption about the efficacy of model-based control for station-keeping by developing First-Order Model Predictive Control (FOMPC). By implementing the wind and balloon dynamics as differentiable functions in JAX, we enable gradient-based trajectory optimization for online planning. FOMPC outperforms a state-of-the-art RL policy, achieving a 24% improvement in time-within-radius (TWR) without requiring offline training, though at the cost of greater online computation per control step. Through systematic ablations of modeling assumptions and control factors, we show that online planning is effective across many configurations, including under simplified wind and dynamics models.
comment: Accepted to the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2026

title: Short-Window Sliding Learning for Real-Time Violence Detection via LLM-based Auto-Labeling
comments: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted paper for the IEIE (Institute of Electronics and Information Engineers) Fall Conference 2025. Presentation on Nov 27, 2025
summary: This paper proposes a Short-Window Sliding Learning framework for real-time violence detection in CCTV footages. Unlike conventional long-video training approaches, the proposed method divides videos into 1-2 second clips and applies Large Language Model (LLM)-based auto-caption labeling to construct fine-grained datasets. Each short clip fully utilizes all frames to preserve temporal continuity, enabling precise recognition of rapid violent events. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves 95.25\% accuracy on RWF-2000 and significantly improves performance on long videos (UCF-Crime: 83.25\%), confirming its strong generalization and real-time applicability in intelligent surveillance systems.
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted paper for the IEIE (Institute of Electronics and Information Engineers) Fall Conference 2025. Presentation on Nov 27, 2025

title: AnyBox: Efficient Zero-Shot 9DoF Pose Estimation of Boxes for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Recovering the 9D pose of objects, both their 6D pose and 3D dimensions, under clutter and occlusion is a core requirement for warehouse automation, logistics, and manufacturing. Model-based methods are accurate but assume an instance-specific CAD model for every object, which is costly to maintain as inventories change. Model-free and category-level methods relax this assumption, yet they remain vulnerable to the symmetry, weak texture, and heavy occlusion that characterize stacked storage boxes, and they ignore the strong structural priors such scenes provide. We present \textbf{AnyBox}, an efficient zero-shot framework that exploits the geometric regularity of boxes to jointly recover pose and dimensions from a single RGB-D observation. Starting from a canonical category template, AnyBox alternates between pose and scale estimation, using the discrepancy between the reprojected template and the observed mask to drive a binary search over box dimensions. Two lightweight components make this practical: a depth-consistency filter that rejects the implausible hypotheses induced by box symmetry, and an early-stopping rule that replaces the remaining search with a single closed-form update. On public benchmarks and an in-house warehouse dataset, AnyBox improves detection AP by up to 36 points, more than doubling the previous best, and approaches instance-level pipelines that have access to ground-truth CAD models. These gains transfer downstream, raising success by 28\% on a cluttered robotic box-shelving task.

title: TetraSDF: Analytic Isosurface Extraction with Multi-resolution Tetrahedral Grid
summary: Extracting an explicit surface that exactly matches the zero-level set of a neural signed distance function (SDF) remains challenging. Sampling-based isosurfacing methods such as Marching Cubes introduce discretization error. In contrast, continuous piecewise affine (CPWA) analytic approaches typically require plain ReLU MLPs, which limits the ability to learn high-frequency SDFs in practice. We present TetraSDF, an analytic isosurface extraction framework for SDFs that retains the expressiveness of grid-based encoders while enabling exact zero-level set extraction, by representing the SDF with a ReLU MLP composed with a multi-resolution tetrahedral positional encoder. Our positional encoder's barycentric interpolation preserves a global CPWA structure, allowing us to track ReLU linear regions within an encoder-induced polyhedral complex. We further introduce a fixed analytic input preconditioner derived from the encoder's metric to reduce directional bias, thereby stabilizing training. Across multiple benchmarks, TetraSDF matches or surpasses existing grid-based encoders in SDF reconstruction accuracy, while faithfully recovering the network's zero-level set as a triangle mesh.

title: Off the Planckian Locus: Using 2D Chromaticity to Improve In-Camera Color
comments: Accepted to ECCV 2026, Project page: https://ccmmlp.github.io
summary: Traditional in-camera colorimetric mapping relies on correlated color temperature (CCT)-based interpolation between pre-calibrated transforms optimized for Planckian illuminants such as CIE A and D65. However, modern lighting technologies such as LEDs can deviate substantially from the Planckian locus, exposing the limitations of relying on conventional one-dimensional CCT for illumination characterization. This paper demonstrates that transitioning from 1D CCT (on the Planckian locus) to a 2D chromaticity space (off the Planckian locus) improves colorimetric accuracy across various mapping approaches. In addition, we replace conventional CCT interpolation with a lightweight multi-layer perceptron (MLP) that leverages 2D chromaticity features for robust colorimetric mapping under non-Planckian illuminants. A lightbox-based calibration procedure incorporating representative LED sources is used to train our MLP. Validated across diverse LED lighting, our method reduces angular reproduction error by 22% on average in LED-lit scenes, maintains backward compatibility with traditional illuminants, accommodates multi-illuminant scenes, and supports real-time in-camera deployment with negligible additional computational cost.
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026, Project page: https://ccmmlp.github.io

title: Pressure-Robust Enriched Galerkin Methods for Navier-Stokes Equations
summary: This paper presents an enriched Galerkin (EG) finite element method for the incompressible Navier--Stokes equations. The method augments continuous piecewise linear velocity spaces with elementwise bubble functions, yielding a locally conservative velocity approximation while retaining the efficiency of low-order continuous elements. The viscous term is discretized using a symmetric interior penalty formulation, and the divergence constraint is imposed through a stable pressure space. To enhance the robustness of the velocity approximation with respect to the pressure, a reconstruction operator is introduced in the convective and coupling terms, resulting in a pressure-robust scheme whose accuracy does not deteriorate for small viscosities. Both Picard and Newton linearizations are formulated in a fully discrete manner, and the corresponding linear systems are assembled efficiently at each iteration. Optimal a~priori error estimates are established for the velocity in the mesh-dependent energy norm and for the pressure in the $L^2$ norm. Two representative numerical experiments are presented: a smooth manufactured solution and the lid-driven cavity flow. The numerical results confirm the theoretical convergence rates, demonstrating first-order convergence of the velocity in the energy norm, second-order convergence in the $L^2$ norm, and first-order convergence of the pressure. The proposed EG scheme accurately captures characteristic flow structures, illustrating its effectiveness and robustness for incompressible flow simulation.

title: VKnowU: Evaluating Visual Knowledge Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have become adept at recognizing objects, they often lack the intuitive, human-like understanding of the world's underlying physical and social principles. This high-level vision-grounded semantics, which we term visual knowledge, forms a bridge between perception and reasoning, yet remains an underexplored area in current MLLMs. To systematically evaluate this capability, we present VKnowU, a comprehensive benchmark featuring 1,680 questions in 1,249 videos, covering 8 core types of visual knowledge spanning both world-centric (e.g., intuitive physics) and human-centric (e.g., subjective intentions). Evaluation of 28 SOTA MLLMs reveals that leading models still fall short of human performance, with particularly notable gaps in the world-centric. To bridge this gap, we introduce a new dataset, VKnowQA, and VideoKnow+, a baseline model that explicitly incorporates visual knowledge into MLLMs. VideoKnow+ follows a structured See-Think-Answer paradigm and adopts reinforcement learning with visual knowledge reward, achieving a +3.7% improvement on VKnowU and consistent gains on MVBench (+5.4%), Video-MME (+7.0%), and MMVU (+5.7%). Our work highlights visual knowledge as a missing cornerstone for developing more generalizable MLLMs that can not only see but also truly understand our worlds.

title: Attention Trajectories as a Diagnostic Axis for Deep Reinforcement Learning
comments: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research: https://openreview.net/pdf?id=0aa9zthk7k
summary: The emergence and evolution of feature reliance in deep reinforcement learning agents remain poorly understood. Here, we introduce a methodological framework for analyzing the learning process through quantitative analysis of saliency maps. This approach aggregates saliency information at the object and modality level into hierarchical attention profiles, quantifying how agents allocate attention over time, thereby forming attention trajectories throughout training. These profiles are then compared across controlled conditions, connected to behavioral measurements and reproduced with different saliency methods to assess the robustness of the findings. Applied to Atari 2600 benchmarks, custom Pong environments, and biomechanical user simulations in visuomotor tasks, this framework uncovers algorithm-specific attention biases, diagnosed unintended reward-driven strategies, and overfitting to redundant sensory channels. These patterns correspond to measurable behavioral differences, demonstrating empirical links between attention profiles, learning dynamics, and agent behavior. The results establish attention trajectories as a promising diagnostic axis for tracing how feature reliance develops during training and for identifying biases and vulnerabilities invisible to performance metrics alone.
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research: https://openreview.net/pdf?id=0aa9zthk7k

AI.title_translation: 注意力轨迹作为深度强化学习的诊断轴
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种方法框架，通过对显著性图进行定量分析来追踪深度强化学习代理的注意力轨迹，以诊断特征依赖、偏差和漏洞，并揭示了注意力、学习动态和代理行为之间的联系。

AI.method: 研究引入了一个通过显著性图定量分析学习过程的方法框架。该方法将物体和模态层面的显著性信息聚合成层次化注意力配置文件，量化代理如何随时间分配注意力，从而在训练过程中形成注意力轨迹。这些配置文件在受控条件下进行比较，与行为测量相关联，并使用不同的显著性方法进行重现以评估结果的鲁棒性。该框架应用于Atari 2600基准、自定义Pong环境和视觉运动任务中的生物力学用户模拟。

AI.conclusion: 结果确立了注意力轨迹作为追踪训练过程中特征依赖如何发展以及识别仅凭性能指标无法发现的偏差和漏洞的有前景的诊断轴。

AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法框架，通过量化显著性图中的注意力轨迹来分析深度强化学习代理的特征依赖性。通过将显著性信息聚合成层次化注意力配置文件，该框架追踪代理如何随时间分配注意力。应用于各种环境时，它揭示了算法特有的偏差、意想不到的策略和过拟合，这些都与行为差异相关。这项研究确立了注意力轨迹作为理解学习动态和识别超越标准性能指标的漏洞的宝贵诊断工具。
AI.keywords: 深度强化学习, 注意力轨迹, 显著性图, 特征依赖, 诊断轴

title: Tree-cotree gauging for two-dimensional hierarchical splines
summary: In magnetostatics and eddy current problems, formulated in terms of the magnetic vector potential, the solution is not unique, because the addition of an irrotational function to the solution remains a valid solution. The tree-cotree decomposition is a gauging technique to recover uniqueness when using finite elements, which consists in considering the mesh as a graph, and building a spanning tree on that graph. The idea has been recently extended to isogeometric analysis, applying the construction of the spanning tree on the control mesh, or equivalently, on the Greville grid. In the present paper we extend the construction to hierarchical splines, a set of splines with multi-level structure for adaptive refinement, by constructing a spanning tree for each single level. Since for degree $p=1$ the spaces of finite elements and hierarchical splines coincide, the presented construction is also valid for quadrilateral finite element meshes with hanging nodes. To assess the correctness of the method, we present numerical results for Maxwell eigenvalue problem.

AI.title_translation: 二维分层样条的树-余树规范
AI.tldr: 本文将树-余树规范技术扩展到分层样条，以解决磁矢量势公式中解的非唯一性问题，并通过麦克斯韦特征值问题验证了其正确性。
AI.motivation: 在磁静力学和涡流问题中，用磁矢量势表示的解不是唯一的。现有的树-余树分解技术可以解决有限元和等几何分析中的唯一性问题，但尚未扩展到分层样条。
AI.method: 本文通过为每个单级构建一个生成树，将树-余树分解的构造扩展到具有多级结构用于自适应细化的分层样条。对于度p=1的情况，该构造也适用于带悬挂节点的四边形有限元网格。
AI.result: 通过麦克斯韦特征值问题的数值结果评估了方法的正确性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的树-余树规范方法对于分层样条是正确的，并且对于带悬挂节点的四边形有限元网格也有效。
AI.translation: 在磁静力学和涡流问题中，当用磁矢量势来表述时，解并不是唯一的，因为在解中添加一个无旋函数仍然是一个有效的解。树-余树分解是一种规范技术，用于在使用有限元法时恢复唯一性，它包括将网格视为一个图，并在该图上构建一个生成树。这个思想最近已扩展到等几何分析，将生成树的构造应用于控制网格，或者等效地应用于格雷维尔网格。在本文中，我们通过为每个单级构建一个生成树，将该构造扩展到分层样条，这是一种具有多级结构用于自适应细化的样条集合。由于对于度p=1，有限元空间和分层样条空间重合，因此所提出的构造也适用于带悬挂节点的四边形有限元网格。为了评估该方法的正确性，我们展示了麦克斯韦特征值问题的数值结果。
AI.summary: 本文将用于解决磁矢量势公式中解非唯一性问题的树-余树规范技术扩展到分层样条。通过为分层样条的每个级别构建一个生成树，实现了该扩展。该方法也适用于带悬挂节点的四边形有限元网格，并通过麦克斯韦特征值问题的数值结果验证了其正确性。
AI.keywords: 树-余树规范, 分层样条, 磁矢量势, 有限元, 麦克斯韦特征值问题
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将成熟的树-余树规范技术推广到更复杂的分层样条结构，这对于处理自适应细化问题具有重要意义。它还填补了现有方法在处理分层样条时的空白，并强调了其对特定有限元网格的适用性。

title: Mixed Data Clustering Survey and Challenges
summary: The advent of the big data paradigm has transformed how industries manage and analyze information, ushering in an era of unprecedented data volume, velocity, and variety. Within this landscape, mixed-data clustering has become a critical challenge, requiring innovative methods that can effectively exploit heterogeneous data types, including numerical and categorical variables. Traditional clustering techniques, typically designed for homogeneous datasets, often struggle to capture the additional complexity introduced by mixed data, underscoring the need for approaches specifically tailored to this setting. Hierarchical and explainable algorithms are particularly valuable in this context, as they provide structured, interpretable clustering results that support informed decision-making. This paper introduces a clustering method grounded in pretopological spaces. In addition, benchmarking against classical numerical clustering algorithms and existing pretopological approaches yields insights into the performance and effectiveness of the proposed method within the big data paradigm.

AI.title_translation: 混合数据聚类综述与挑战
AI.tldr: 针对混合数据聚类难题，提出了一种基于前拓扑空间的可解释层次聚类新方法，并通过基准测试验证了其在大数据范式下的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在大数据时代，混合数据（包含数值型与类别型变量）聚类成为关键挑战；传统针对同质数据的聚类方法难以处理混合数据的复杂性，因而急需专门设计的、具有层次性和可解释性的聚类算法以支持决策。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于前拓扑空间（pretopological spaces）的聚类方法，并与经典的数值聚类算法以及现有的前拓扑方法进行了基准对比测试。
AI.result: 通过与经典数值聚类算法及现有前拓扑方法的基准测试对比，验证了所提方法在大数据范式下的性能表现与有效性。
AI.translation: 大数据范式的到来彻底改变了各行各业管理和分析信息的方式，开启了数据体量、生成速度和多样性均空前未有的时代。在此背景下，混合数据聚类已成为一项关键挑战，需要能够有效利用包含数值型和类别型变量的异构数据类型的创新方法。通常针对同质数据集设计的传统聚类技术往往难以捕捉混合数据带来的额外复杂性，这突显了开发专门针对该场景的方法的必要性。在此背景下，层次化和可解释性算法尤为重要，因为它们能够提供结构化、可解释的聚类结果以支持明智的决策。本文介绍了一种基于前拓扑空间的聚类方法。此外，通过与经典数值聚类算法以及现有前拓扑方法进行基准对比，深入揭示了所提方法在大数据范式下的性能与有效性。
AI.summary: 本论文探讨了大数据环境下混合数据聚类的挑战与需求，针对传统算法难以有效处理数值与类别异构数据的局限，提出了一种基于前拓扑空间的聚类方法，并通过基准对比展示了该方法在有效性和性能上的优势。
AI.keywords: 混合数据聚类, 前拓扑空间, 大数据, 可解释性, 层次聚类
AI.comments: 该论文针对大数据背景下数值型与类别型混合数据的聚类难点，提出了一种基于前拓扑空间（pretopological spaces）的新型聚类方法，兼顾层次化与可解释性。局限在于摘要中未详细说明算法的具体数学构造以及在大规模数据集上的计算复杂度表现。

title: Fast-BEV++: Fast by Algorithm, Deployable by Design
summary: The advancement of vision-only BEV (Bird's-Eye-View) perception is hindered by the fundamental trade-off between perception accuracy and deployment efficiency. We introduce Fast-BEV++, resolving this tension through two principles: Fast by Algorithm and Deployable by Design. By decomposing view transformation into a hardware-oriented Index-Gather-Reshape pipeline, Fast-BEV++ eliminates custom kernels while achieving no less than 3 times speedup over baseline methods. Empirically, Fast-BEV++ establishes a new state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-off on nuScenes, achieving 0.488 NDS while sustaining real-time inference at over 134 FPS. In particular, depth supervision yields consistent and tangible performance gains, maintaining the highest accuracy among comparable methods. The decomposed architecture enables seamless real-time deployment on production-level platforms, eliminating hardware constraints without loss of efficiency. Code and models are released on the linked project page.

AI.tldr: Fast-BEV++通过将视角变换分解为硬件友好的流水线，解决了视觉BEV感知中的精度与效率权衡问题，实现了显著的速度提升和最先进的精度，并支持实时部署。
AI.motivation: 视觉专用鸟瞰图（BEV）感知的进展受限于感知精度和部署效率之间的根本性权衡。
AI.method: Fast-BEV++通过“算法快速”和“设计可部署”两个原则解决问题。它将视角变换分解为硬件导向的Index-Gather-Reshape流水线，消除了自定义内核，并利用深度监督。
AI.result: Fast-BEV++在nuScenes上实现了新的SOTA精度-速度权衡，达到0.488 NDS，并以超过134 FPS的速度进行实时推理，比基线方法提速至少3倍。深度监督带来了持续且显著的性能提升，保持了同类方法中的最高精度。
AI.conclusion: Fast-BEV++通过其分解架构，在解决视觉BEV感知中精度与效率权衡的同时，实现了显著的性能提升和无缝的生产级平台实时部署，消除了硬件限制且不损失效率。
AI.translation: 视觉专用鸟瞰图（BEV）感知的进步受限于感知精度和部署效率之间的根本性权衡。我们引入了Fast-BEV++，通过“算法快速”和“设计可部署”这两个原则解决了这一矛盾。通过将视角变换分解为硬件导向的Index-Gather-Reshape流水线，Fast-BEV++消除了自定义内核，同时实现了比基线方法至少3倍的速度提升。经验上，Fast-BEV++在nuScenes上建立了新的最先进的精度-速度权衡，实现了0.488 NDS，同时保持了超过134 FPS的实时推理。特别是，深度监督带来了持续且显著的性能增益，在同类方法中保持了最高精度。其分解架构使得在生产级平台上实现无缝实时部署成为可能，消除了硬件限制且不损失效率。代码和模型已在项目页面发布。
AI.summary: Fast-BEV++提出了一种解决视觉BEV感知中精度与部署效率权衡的新方法。它通过将视角变换分解为硬件友好的Index-Gather-Reshape流水线，消除了自定义内核，实现了显著的速度提升（比基线快3倍）。在nuScenes数据集上，Fast-BEV++达到了0.488 NDS的SOTA精度，并能以超过134 FPS的速度进行实时推理，同时深度监督进一步提升了性能。其分解架构确保了在生产级平台上的无缝实时部署。
AI.keywords: BEV感知, 实时推理, 精度-速度权衡, 视角变换, 深度监督
