title: Evolving Excellence: Automated Optimization of LLM-based Agents
summary:
Agentic AI systems built on large language models (LLMs) offer significant potential for automating complex workflows, from software development to customer support. However, LLM agents often underperform due to suboptimal configurations; poorly tuned prompts, tool descriptions, and parameters that typically require weeks of manual refinement. Existing optimization methods either are too complex for general use or treat components in isolation, missing critical interdependencies.
  We present ARTEMIS, a no-code evolutionary optimization platform that jointly optimizes agent configurations through semantically-aware genetic operators. Given only a benchmark script and natural language goals, ARTEMIS automatically discovers configurable components, extracts performance signals from execution logs, and evolves configurations without requiring architectural modifications.
  We evaluate ARTEMIS on four representative agent systems: the \emph{ALE Agent} for competitive programming on AtCoder Heuristic Contest, achieving a \textbf{$13.6\%$ improvement} in acceptance rate; the \emph{Mini-SWE Agent} for code optimization on SWE-Perf, with a statistically significant \textbf{10.1\% performance gain}; and the \emph{CrewAI Agent} for cost and mathematical reasoning on Math Odyssey, achieving a statistically significant \textbf{$36.9\%$ reduction} in the number of tokens required for evaluation. We also evaluate the \emph{MathTales-Teacher Agent} powered by a smaller open-source model (Qwen2.5-7B) on GSM8K primary-level mathematics problems, achieving a \textbf{22\% accuracy improvement} and demonstrating that ARTEMIS can optimize agents based on both commercial and local models.

AI.title_translation: 进化卓越：基于LLM的智能体的自动化优化
AI.tldr: ARTEMIS是一个无代码进化优化平台，通过语义感知的遗传算子自动优化LLM智能体的配置，显著提高了多种代理系统的性能。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体在自动化复杂工作流程方面潜力巨大，但由于配置不佳（提示词、工具描述、参数等），通常表现不佳，需要数周手动调优。现有优化方法要么过于复杂，要么孤立处理组件，忽略了关键的相互依赖性。
AI.method: 本文提出了ARTEMIS，一个无代码进化优化平台，通过语义感知的遗传算子联合优化智能体配置。它只需基准脚本和自然语言目标，就能自动发现可配置组件，从执行日志中提取性能信号，并在不修改架构的情况下进化配置。
AI.result: ARTEMIS在ALE智能体上使接受率提高13.6%；在Mini-SWE智能体上使性能提升10.1%（统计显著）；在CrewAI智能体上使评估所需token数量减少36.9%（统计显著）；在MathTales-Teacher智能体（基于Qwen2.5-7B）上使准确率提高22%。证明ARTEMIS可优化基于商业和本地模型的智能体。
AI.conclusion: ARTEMIS通过自动和联合优化LLM智能体配置，显著提高了其在多种复杂任务上的性能和效率，克服了手动调优的局限性和现有方法的不足，并支持不同规模的LLM。
AI.translation:
基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体AI系统在自动化复杂工作流程方面具有巨大潜力，从软件开发到客户支持。然而，LLM智能体由于配置不佳——例如调优不当的提示词、工具描述和参数，这些通常需要数周的手动精炼——往往表现不佳。现有的优化方法要么对一般使用来说过于复杂，要么孤立地处理组件，从而错过了关键的相互依赖性。
我们提出了ARTEMIS，一个无代码进化优化平台，它通过语义感知的遗传算子联合优化智能体配置。只需一个基准脚本和自然语言目标，ARTEMIS就能自动发现可配置组件，从执行日志中提取性能信号，并在无需架构修改的情况下进化配置。
我们在四个代表性的智能体系统上评估了ARTEMIS：用于AtCoder启发式竞赛的ALE智能体，接受率提高了13.6%；用于SWE-Perf代码优化的Mini-SWE智能体，实现了统计显著的10.1%的性能提升；以及用于Math Odyssey成本和数学推理的CrewAI智能体，实现了统计显著的评估所需token数量36.9%的减少。我们还评估了由较小的开源模型（Qwen2.5-7B）驱动的MathTales-Teacher智能体在GSM8K小学数学问题上的表现，实现了22%的准确率提升，并证明ARTEMIS可以优化基于商业模型和本地模型的智能体。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了ARTEMIS，一个无代码进化优化平台，旨在解决基于LLM的智能体因配置不佳而性能低下的问题。ARTEMIS通过语义感知的遗传算子，自动联合优化智能体的提示词、工具描述和参数，无需手动调优或架构修改。实验结果表明，ARTEMIS显著提升了多个代表性LLM智能体在编程、代码优化、数学推理等任务上的性能、效率和准确率，并支持商业及开源模型。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 自动化优化, 进化算法, ARTEMIS, 配置调优
AI.comments: ARTEMIS的创新之处在于其无代码、进化优化以及通过语义感知遗传算子联合优化LLM智能体配置的能力，解决了传统手动调优耗时且效果不佳的痛点。其能够从执行日志中提取性能信号并适应不同模型规模的特点，也增加了其实用性和重要性。

title: Adaptive Partitioning and Learning for Stochastic Control of Diffusion Processes
summary: We study reinforcement learning for controlled diffusion processes with unbounded continuous state spaces, bounded continuous actions, and polynomially growing rewards: settings that arise naturally in finance, economics, and operations research. To overcome the challenges of continuous and high-dimensional domains, we introduce a model-based algorithm that adaptively partitions the joint state-action space. The algorithm maintains estimators of drift, volatility, and rewards within each partition, refining the discretization whenever estimation bias exceeds statistical confidence. This adaptive scheme balances exploration and approximation, enabling efficient learning in unbounded domains. Our analysis establishes regret bounds that depend on the problem horizon, state dimension, reward growth order, and a newly defined notion of zooming dimension tailored to unbounded diffusion processes. The bounds recover existing results for bounded settings as a special case, while extending theoretical guarantees to a broader class of diffusion-type problems. Finally, we validate the effectiveness of our approach through numerical experiments, including applications to high-dimensional problems such as multi-asset mean-variance portfolio selection.

AI.title_translation: 扩散过程随机控制的自适应划分与学习
AI.tldr: 针对具有无界状态与多项式增长奖励的受控扩散过程，本文提出了一种自适应空间划分的模型强化学习算法，并给出了基于新型缩放维度的遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 金融、经济学和运筹学中的许多实际问题可建模为具有无界连续状态空间、有界连续动作空间以及多项式增长奖励的受控扩散过程，但在连续、高维且无界的空间中进行高效的强化学习面临极大的理论和算法挑战。
AI.method: 提出一种基于模型的强化学习算法，自适应地划分联合状态-动作空间；在每个分区内维护漂移项、波动率和奖励函数的估计器；当估计偏差超过统计置信度时细化网格，从而在无界空间中自适应平衡探索与近似误差。
AI.result: 理论上建立了取决于时间跨度、状态维度、奖励增长阶数及新型无界缩放维度的遗憾界，涵盖并推广了已有有界设置的结果；数值实验（如多资产均值-方差投资组合选择高维问题）验证了算法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的自适应划分学习框架成功解决了无界状态空间及多项式增长奖励下的受控扩散问题，不仅拓展了该领域的理论遗憾分析边界，还在高维实际应用中展现了良好的经验有效性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了具有无界连续状态空间、有界连续动作空间和多项式增长奖励的受控扩散过程的强化学习，这类设定在金融、经济学和运筹学中广泛存在。为了克服连续和高维区域带来的挑战，我们提出了一种基于模型的算法，该算法能够自适应地划分联合状态-动作空间。该算法在每个划分区域内维护漂移项、波动率和奖励的估计器，并在估计偏差超过统计置信度时细化离散网格。这种自适应方案平衡了探索与近似，从而能够在无界域中实现高效学习。我们的理论分析建立了依赖于时间跨度、状态维度、奖励增长阶数以及专为无界扩散过程量身定制的新“缩放维度（zooming dimension）”概念的遗憾界。该界在特例下能够复现现有的有界设定结果，同时将理论保证扩展到了更广泛的扩散型问题。最后，我们通过数值实验验证了该方法的有效性，包括在多资产均值-方差投资组合选择等高维问题上的应用。
AI.summary: 本文研究了具有无界状态空间和多项式增长奖励的受控扩散过程强化学习问题，提出了一种自适应划分状态-动作空间的模型学习算法。通过在估计偏差超出置信界时细化划分，该算法有效平衡了探索与近似，并推导了基于新型缩放维度的理论遗憾界，在高维金融投资组合控制等任务中得到了有效性验证。
AI.keywords: 受控扩散过程, 强化学习, 自适应划分, 遗憾界, 缩放维度
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于突破了传统连续控制中常见的状态空间有界及奖励有界的假设，将自适应空间离散化与模型学习相结合，并针对无界扩散过程提出了新的缩放维度以推导理论遗憾界。其重要性在于将理论保证推广到金融和经济学中更真实的连续时间随机控制问题；潜在局限性在于自适应空间划分在高维复杂动力学下的计算开销可能依然较大。

title: FADTI: Fourier and Attention Driven Diffusion for Multivariate Time Series Imputation
comments: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM 2026). 10 pages, 7 figures
summary: Multivariate time series imputation is fundamental in applications such as healthcare, traffic forecasting, and biological modeling, where sensor failures and irregular sampling lead to pervasive missing values. Existing Transformer- and diffusion-based imputers achieve strong performance, but they often rely mainly on time-domain modeling and lack adaptive spectral bias for recovering structured temporal gaps. We propose FADTI, a Fourier- and attention-driven diffusion framework for multivariate time series imputation. FADTI introduces a Fourier Bias Projection (FBP) module that injects learnable frequency-aware bias into intermediate hidden states during denoising. It projects intermediate hidden states onto Fourier bases, avoiding direct spectral estimation from masked or zero-filled inputs. With DFT, STFT, and FSST instantiations, FBP captures global periodicity, localized time--frequency variations, and non-stationary oscillatory patterns. By coupling FBP with self-attention and gated convolution, FADTI integrates frequency-domain guidance, temporal dependency modeling, and probabilistic denoising in a unified framework. Experiments on multiple benchmarks, including a new biological imputation benchmark, show that FADTI improves accuracy, uncertainty estimation, and sampling efficiency, especially under high missing rates and structured missing patterns. Code is available at https://github.com/RazeenLI/FADTI
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM 2026). 10 pages, 7 figures

AI.title_translation: FADTI：傅里叶和注意力驱动的多元时间序列插补扩散模型
AI.tldr: FADTI是一个结合傅里叶和注意力机制的扩散模型，用于多元时间序列插补，通过注入频率感知偏差来更好地处理结构化缺失数据。
AI.motivation: 多元时间序列插补在医疗保健、交通预测和生物建模等应用中至关重要，但传感器故障和不规则采样导致普遍的缺失值。现有的Transformer和扩散模型主要依赖时域建模，缺乏自适应频谱偏差来恢复结构化的时间序列缺失。
AI.method: 本文提出了FADTI，一个傅里叶和注意力驱动的多元时间序列插补扩散框架。FADTI引入了傅里叶偏置投影（FBP）模块，在去噪过程中向中间隐藏状态注入可学习的频率感知偏差。FBP通过将中间隐藏状态投影到傅里叶基上，避免从掩码或零填充输入中直接进行频谱估计。FBP通过DFT、STFT和FSST实现，捕获全局周期性、局部时频变化和非平稳振荡模式。FADTI通过将FBP与自注意力和门控卷积结合，在一个统一框架中整合了频域指导、时间依赖性建模和概率去噪。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试（包括一个新的生物插补基准）上，FADTI提高了准确性、不确定性估计和采样效率，特别是在高缺失率和结构化缺失模式下表现更优。
AI.conclusion: FADTI通过引入傅里叶偏置投影模块，有效地将频域指导与时域建模及概率去噪结合，显著提升了多元时间序列插补的性能，尤其在处理复杂缺失模式时表现出色。
AI.translation: 多元时间序列插补在医疗保健、交通预测和生物建模等应用中至关重要，这些领域中传感器故障和不规则采样导致普遍的缺失值。现有的基于Transformer和扩散的插补器虽然表现出色，但它们通常主要依赖时域建模，并且缺乏自适应频谱偏差来恢复结构化的时间序列缺失。我们提出了FADTI，一个傅里叶和注意力驱动的多元时间序列插补框架。FADTI引入了一个傅里叶偏置投影（FBP）模块，在去噪过程中向中间隐藏状态注入可学习的频率感知偏差。它将中间隐藏状态投影到傅里叶基上，避免从掩码或零填充输入中直接进行频谱估计。通过DFT、STFT和FSST的实例化，FBP捕获全局周期性、局部时频变化以及非平稳振荡模式。通过将FBP与自注意力和门控卷积相结合，FADTI在一个统一框架中整合了频域指导、时间依赖性建模和概率去噪。在多个基准测试（包括一个新的生物插补基准）上的实验表明，FADTI提高了准确性、不确定性估计和采样效率，特别是在高缺失率和结构化缺失模式下。代码可在https://github.com/RazeenLI/FADTI获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FADTI，一个结合傅里叶和注意力机制的扩散框架，用于多元时间序列插补。FADTI通过傅里叶偏置投影（FBP）模块向扩散模型的隐藏状态注入频率感知偏差，以有效捕获时间序列的周期性、时频变化和非平稳模式。FBP与自注意力及门控卷积相结合，实现了频域指导、时域依赖建模和概率去噪的统一。实验证明，FADTI在准确性、不确定性估计和采样效率方面优于现有方法，尤其在高缺失率和结构化缺失场景下表现突出。
AI.keywords: 多元时间序列插补, 扩散模型, 傅里叶分析, 注意力机制, 频谱偏差
AI.comments: FADTI的创新点在于将傅里叶分析的频域信息（通过FBP模块）巧妙地融入到扩散模型的去噪过程中，为处理时间序列数据中常见的结构化缺失模式提供了新的视角。它克服了现有方法主要依赖时域建模的局限性，通过自适应的频率感知偏差增强了模型的表达能力。这种结合频域与时域建模的混合方法对于提升时间序列插补的鲁棒性和准确性具有重要意义。

title: DuaDeep-SeqAffinity: Dual-Branch Deep Learning for Tri-Stream Sequence-Based Antibody--Antigen Affinity Prediction
summary: DuaDeep-SeqAffinity is a sequence-only deep learning framework that predicts antibody--antigen binding affinity directly from primary amino acid sequences, avoiding the cost and scarcity of resolved three-dimensional structures. The antigen and the antibody heavy and light chains are processed as three independent streams, each embedded with a frozen ESM-2 protein language model and passed through parallel Transformer and convolutional neural network (CNN) branches before late fusion, a decoupled design intended to preserve local complementarity-determining region (CDR) signal that monolithic encoders can dilute. On a sequence-disjoint split of the AbRank benchmark, the model achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.683, an R^2 of 0.460, and a pairwise ranking AUC of 0.895, significantly outperforming single-branch ablations (paired t-test, p < 0.05). Attention-map and gradient-based saliency analyses further show that the model preferentially attends to CDR loops and candidate epitope residues, supporting its use as a scalable, structure-free tool for high-throughput antibody screening.

AI.title_translation: DuaDeep-SeqAffinity：基于三流序列的抗体-抗原亲和力预测双分支深度学习方法
AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一种无需三维结构、基于蛋白质语言模型的三流深度学习框架（DuaDeep-SeqAffinity），用于高效、准确地预测抗体-抗原结合亲和力。
AI.motivation: 解决依赖三维结构的传统抗体-抗原亲和力预测方法成本高、结构数据稀缺的问题，以及单一编码器容易稀释局部互补决定区（CDR）信号的缺陷。
AI.method: 提出DuaDeep-SeqAffinity框架，将抗原以及抗体重链和轻链作为三个独立流处理，每个流嵌入冻结的ESM-2蛋白质语言模型，并通过并行Transformer和CNN分支进行后期融合。
AI.result: 在AbRank基准测试的序列不相交划分上，模型的Pearson相关系数达到0.683，R^2为0.460，成对排序AUC为0.895，显著优于单分支消融模型（p < 0.05），且注意力分析证实其能特异性关注CDR环和候选表位残基。
AI.conclusion: DuaDeep-SeqAffinity是一个高效且可扩展的免结构抗体-抗原亲和力预测工具，适合高通量抗体筛选。
AI.translation: DuaDeep-SeqAffinity是一个纯序列的深度学习框架，能够直接从一级氨基酸序列预测抗体-抗原结合亲和力，从而避免了解析三维结构的高昂成本和稀缺性。该框架将抗原以及抗体重链和轻链作为三个独立的流进行处理，每个流嵌入冻结的ESM-2蛋白质语言模型，并通过并行Transformer和卷积神经网络（CNN）分支进行后期融合。这种解耦设计旨在保留整体编码器可能会稀释的局部互补决定区（CDR）信号。在AbRank基准测试的序列不相交划分上，该模型的Pearson相关系数达到0.683，R^2为0.460，成对排序AUC为0.895，显著优于单分支消融模型（配对t检验，p < 0.05）。注意力图和基于梯度的显著性分析进一步表明，该模型优先关注CDR环和候选表位残基，支持其作为高通量抗体筛选的可扩展、无结构工具的应用。
AI.summary: DuaDeep-SeqAffinity是一种无需三维结构的序列深度学习框架，通过三流解耦架构和蛋白质语言模型，实现了高精度的抗体-抗原结合亲和力预测。
AI.keywords: 抗体-抗原亲和力预测, 深度学习, 蛋白质语言模型, 三流架构, 互补决定区 (CDR)
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于序列的双分支深度学习框架DuaDeep-SeqAffinity，用于抗体-抗原结合亲和力预测。通过采用解耦设计（将抗原、抗体重链和轻链作为三个独立流处理）并结合ESM-2语言模型、Transformer和CNN，有效避免了对3D结构的依赖，并在基准测试中展现出优异的预测性能与可解释性。

title: Security in the Age of AI Teammates: An Empirical Study of Agentic Pull Requests on GitHub
comments: Submitted to Information and Software Technology Journal, currently under minor revision
summary: Autonomous coding agents are increasingly deployed as AI teammates in modern software engineering, independently authoring pull requests (PRs) that modify production code at scale. This study aims to systematically characterize how autonomous coding agents contribute to software security in practice, how these security-related contributions are reviewed and accepted, and which observable signals are associated with PR rejection. We conduct a large-scale empirical analysis of agent-authored PRs using the AIDev dataset, comprising of over 33,000 curated PRs from popular GitHub repositories. Security-relevant PRs are identified using a keyword filtering strategy, followed by manual validation, resulting in 1,293 confirmed security-related agentic-PRs. We then analyze prevalence, acceptance outcomes, and review latency across autonomous agents, programming ecosystems, and types of code changes. Moreover, we apply qualitative open coding to identify recurring security-related actions and underlying intents, and examine review metadata to identify early signals associated with PR rejection. Security-related Agentic-PRs constitute a meaningful share of agent activity (approximately 4\%). Rather than focusing solely on narrow vulnerability fixes, agents most frequently perform supportive security hardening activities, including testing, documentation, configuration, and improved error handling. Compared to non-security PRs, security-related Agentic-PRs exhibit lower merge rates and longer review latency, reflecting heightened human scrutiny, with variation across agents and programming ecosystems. PR rejection is more strongly associated with PR complexity and verbosity than with explicit security topics.
comment: Submitted to Information and Software Technology Journal, currently under minor revision

AI.title_translation: AI队友时代的安全性：对GitHub上代理Pull Request的实证研究
AI.tldr: 本研究通过实证分析GitHub上AI智能体编写的PR，发现智能体在安全方面多从事支持性加固工作，虽然它们面临更严格的人类审查和更低的合并率，但PR被拒绝主要归因于复杂性和冗长性而非安全主题。
AI.motivation: 随着自主编码智能体作为AI队友在现代软件工程中的广泛部署，它们独立编写修改生产代码的PR。本研究旨在系统性地刻画这些智能体在实践中对软件安全的影响、其安全相关贡献的审查与接受情况，以及与PR拒绝相关的可观察信号。
AI.method: 利用AIDev数据集对超过33,000个GitHub上的智能体编写的PR进行了大规模实证分析。通过关键词过滤和人工验证筛选出安全相关的PR（1,293个），并结合定量分析（如合并率、审查延迟）与定性开放编码来研究智能体的安全动因及PR被拒绝的早期信号。
AI.result: 安全相关的代理PR占代理活动的约4%，主要从事支持性的安全加固活动（如测试、文档、配置和异常处理优化）。与非安全PR相比，安全PR的合并率更低、审查延迟更长，且PR被拒绝主要与PR的复杂性和冗长性高度相关，而非显式的安全主题。
AI.conclusion: 智能体在代码贡献中占据一定的安全相关份额，主要从事安全加固而非单纯的漏洞修复。尽管面临更高的审查难度和更低的合并率，其拒绝的主要驱动因素是复杂性和冗长性，而非安全议题本身。
AI.translation: 自主编码智能体正日益作为AI队友部署在现代软件 engineering 中，独立编写大规模修改生产代码的Pull Requests (PR)。本研究旨在系统性地刻画自主编码智能体在实践中如何对软件安全做出贡献，这些安全相关的贡献是如何被审查和接受的，以及哪些可观察的信号与PR的拒绝相关。我们使用AIDev数据集对智能体编写的PR进行了大规模实证分析，该数据集包含来自流行GitHub仓库的3,000多个策划PR。通过关键词过滤策略和人工验证，识别出1,293个经确认的安全相关代理PR。然后，我们分析了不同自主编码智能体、编程生态系统和代码变更类型下的流行度、接受结果和审查延迟。此外，我们应用定性开放编码来识别反复出现的安全相关动作和底层意图，并检查审查元数据以识别与PR拒绝相关的早期信号。安全相关的代理PR占代理活动的显著份额（约4%）。智能体最常执行支持性的安全加固活动（包括测试、文档、配置和改进的错误处理），而不仅仅局限于狭隘的漏洞修复。与非安全PR相比，安全相关的代理PR表现出更低的合并率和更长的审查延迟，反映了更高的严厉人类审查，且在不同的智能体和编程生态系统间存在差异。PR的拒绝与PR的复杂性和冗长性的关联，比与明确的安全主题的关联更强。
AI.summary: 本文通过对GitHub上超过33,000个代理编写的PR进行大规模实证研究，探讨了自主编码智能体在软件安全方面的贡献。研究发现，虽然安全相关的代理PR占比较小（约4%）且面临更严格的人类审查与更低的合并率，但它们主要从事支持性的安全加固，且其被拒绝的根本原因在于复杂性和冗长性而非安全本身。
AI.keywords: Autonomous coding agents, Software security, Empirical study, GitHub pull requests, AI teammates
AI.comments: 该研究首次对AI自主编程智能体在软件安全方面的贡献进行了大规模实证分析，揭示了智能体在代码贡献中的安全角色及人类审查的模式，对理解人机协作软件工程的安全性具有重要意义。

title: An Iterative Method with Asymptotic Orthogonality for Simultaneous Eigenpair Computation
summary: The simultaneous computation of a cluster of eigenpairs with mutually orthogonal eigenvectors is a basic task in scientific computing. We develop a predictor--corrector discretization of the quasi-Grassmannian gradient flow for simultaneous eigenpair computation. The proposed iteration requires neither orthogonal initial data nor any orthogonalization operation: the predictor preserves the current Gram matrix, whereas the corrector reduces the orthogonality error, so that the iterates approach orthogonality asymptotically. We establish well-posedness of the discrete scheme and prove invariant-subspace nonexpansion, asymptotic orthogonality, energy decrease, and convergence to the target eigenspace. Numerical experiments with the discrete equations solved approximately show that the numerical iterates converge to eigenpair approximations whose eigenvectors are numerically orthogonal to high accuracy, while the energy and gradient norm decrease over the iterations.

AI.title_translation: 具有渐近正交性的同时特征对计算迭代方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需显式正交化的渐近正交迭代方法，用于高效地同时计算一组特征对。
AI.motivation: 科学计算中同时计算具有相互正交特征向量的一组特征对是一项基础任务，但现有的方法通常需要正交的初始数据或显式的正交化操作，本文旨在开发一种无需这些限制的高效迭代方法。
AI.method: 开发了一种拟格拉斯曼梯度流的预测-校正离散化方法，其中预测器保持当前的格拉姆矩阵，校正器减小正交性误差，使迭代以渐近方式趋于正交。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，即使离散方程被近似求解，数值迭代也能收敛到特征对近似值，其特征向量在数值上具有高精度的正交性，且能量和梯度范数随迭代次数递减。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的预测-校正算法能够保证离散格式的适定性，并在渐近意义上实现正交性、能量递减以及向目标特征空间的收敛。
AI.translation: 同时计算一组具有相互正交特征向量的特征对是科学计算中的一项基础任务。我们开发了一种拟格拉斯曼梯度流的预测-校正离散化方法，用于同时计算特征对。所提出的迭代既不需要正交的初始数据，也不需要任何正交化操作：预测器保持当前的格拉姆矩阵，而校正器减小正交性误差，使得迭代以渐近方式接近正交。我们建立了离散格式的适定性，并证明了不变子空间非膨胀、渐近正交性、能量减少以及向目标特征空间的收敛性。对近似求解的离散方程进行的数值实验表明，数值迭代收敛于特征对近似值，其特征向量在数值上具有高度正交性，同时能量和梯度范数在迭代过程中不断减小。
AI.summary: 本文针对同时计算特征对的问题，提出了一种基于拟格拉斯曼梯度流的预测-校正迭代方法。该方法无需正交初始数据或显式正交化，通过渐近正交性实现了特征对的高效计算，并通过理论证明和数值实验验证了其收敛性和有效性。
AI.keywords: 特征对计算, 拟格拉斯曼梯度流, 渐近正交性, 预测-校正方法
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种无需初始正交或显式正交化操作的渐近正交迭代方法，通过预测-校正离散化拟格拉斯曼梯度流，在科学计算中具有较高的理论创新性和计算效率。

title: Towards Multi-modal Multi-turn Safety: From Agentic Interaction to Strategic Alignment
summary: Despite remarkable capability in multi-modal understanding, deploying Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in open-ended conversational scenarios introduces safety risks that remain poorly addressed by existing alignment methods. Unlike simple malicious visual question and answer (VQA) pairs , multi-turn interactions enable adversaries to incrementally reconstruct harmful intent across dialogues, progressively bypassing safety constraints in ways that are difficult to detect at any individual turn. Meanwhile, conventional reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) approaches are unsuitable for this situation: designed primarily for VQA tasks, they neither capture cross-turn risk dynamics nor scale efficiently without costly manual preference annotation. To close this gap, we introduce \textbf{MINT-Safe}, an open-source visual multi-turn training dataset comprising 11,270 multi-image dialogues and 500 refusal VQA pairs, constructed via multi-agent interaction with text-to-image (T2I) tool-call augmentation. Building on MINT-Safe, we propose \textbf{TAD-Align}, a dialogue safety alignment framework centered on a turn-aware dual-objective reward function. Rather than treating all dialogue turns uniformly, TAD-Align leverages rollout-based safety score variance to dynamically identify turns where the model exhibits inconsistent safety behavior, and adaptively up-weights these turns during optimization. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and LLaVA-NeXT-7B demonstrate reductions of over 10\% in Attack Success Rate (ASR), alongside improvements of at least 8\% in harmlessness and 13\% in helpfulness on multi-modal multi-turn safety benchmarks, while preserving general model capabilities.

AI.title_translation: 迈向多模态多轮安全：从智能体交互到战略对齐
AI.tldr: 提出MINT-Safe数据集和TAD-Align对齐框架，有效解决了多模态大模型在多轮对话中的渐进式安全风险，显著降低攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大模型对齐方法主要针对单轮视觉问答（VQA）任务，无法应对多轮交互中 adversary 渐进式构造恶意意图并绕过安全约束的风险，且传统RLHF无法捕捉跨轮风险动态且缺乏高效的扩展机制。
AI.method: 提出MINT-Safe开源多模态多轮训练数据集（通过多智能体交互与文生图工具构建），并设计了TAD-Align对话安全对齐框架，核心是采用基于回合感知的双目标奖励函数，动态提升模型安全表现不一致回合的优化权重。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和LLaVA-NeXT-7B上的实验表明，攻击成功率（ASR）降低了10%以上，无害性提升至少8%，有用性提升至少13%，同时保留了模型的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过MINT-Safe数据集与TAD-Align框架，模型能够在多模态多轮交互中有效防御渐进式攻击，显著降低攻击成功率并提升无害性与有用性，且不损失通用能力。
AI.translation: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在多模态理解方面表现出卓越的能力，但在开放式对话场景中的部署引入了现有对齐方法尚未充分解决的安全风险。与简单的恶意视觉问答（VQA）对不同，多轮交互使攻击者能够在对话中逐步重建有害意图，循序渐进地绕过在任何单个轮次都难以检测的安全约束。同时，常规的人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）方法并不适用于这种情况：它们主要为VQA任务设计，既无法捕捉跨轮风险动态，也无法在没有高昂人工偏好标注的情况下高效扩展。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了MINT-Safe，这是一个开源的视觉多轮训练数据集，包含11,270个多图像对话和500个拒绝VQA对，通过多智能体交互与文本到图像（T2I）工具调用增强构建。基于MINT-Safe，我们提出了TAD-Align，这是一个以回合感知双目标奖励函数为核心的对话安全对齐框架。TAD-Align没有对所有对话回合进行统一对待，而是利用基于rollout的安全得分方差来动态识别模型表现出不一致安全行为的回合，并在优化过程中自适应地提高这些回合的权重。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和LLaVA-NeXT-7B上的实验表明，攻击成功率（ASR）降低了10%以上，在多模态多轮安全基准测试中，无害性提升了至少8%，有用性提升了至少13%，同时保留了模型的一般能力。
AI.summary: 论文针对多模态大模型在多轮对话中的安全风险，推出了MINT-Safe数据集和TAD-Align对齐框架。该框架利用回合感知的双目标奖励函数动态加权不安全行为回合，有效降低了多轮交互中的攻击成功率，并在提升安全性的同时保持了模型的实用性和通用能力。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 多轮交互, 安全对齐, 多智能体, 强化学习
AI.comments: 本文针对多模态大语言模型在多轮交互中的安全性挑战，创新性地提出了MINT-Safe数据集与TAD-Align对齐框架。通过多智能体交互生成复杂对话，并利用turn-aware的双目标奖励函数动态调整优化权重，兼顾了安全性与模型通用能力，对未来多模态Agent的安全研究具有重要参考价值。

title: Quantum Implicit Neural Representations for Novel View Synthesis
comments: 30 pages, 15 figures, 12 tables; project page: https://4dqv.mpi-inf.mpg.de/3D-QISR/
summary: Quantum implicit neural representations have recently emerged as compact function approximators for continuous visual signals. In parallel, Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have become a dominant framework for novel-view synthesis by recovering continuous volumetric scene representations from posed 2D images, but often require substantial model capacity and intensive optimisation. We introduce 3D Quantum Implicit Scene Representation (3D-QISR), the first hybrid quantum-classical radiance-field model for novel-view synthesis from 2D observations. 3D-QISR replaces the classical NeRF backbone with parameterised quantum circuits that encode spatial and view-dependent information through quantum state transformations, enabling compact quantum-enhanced implicit representations while preserving compatibility with standard volumetric rendering. We propose two architectures: Full 3D-QISR, which maximises the representational role of a unified quantum state, and Dual-Branch 3D-QISR, which separates spatial and view-dependent quantum embeddings to introduce a task-aligned inductive bias, reduce state-preparation complexity, and improve scalability and hardware compatibility. Experiments on moderate-resolution novel-view synthesis benchmarks show that 3D-QISR executed on simulated quantum hardware matches or outperforms classical baselines while using fewer than half the trainable parameters. These results position quantum neural networks as compact and competitive building blocks for continuous volumetric scene representation, opening a new direction for quantum-enhanced implicit neural rendering.
comment: 30 pages, 15 figures, 12 tables; project page: https://4dqv.mpi-inf.mpg.de/3D-QISR/

AI.title_translation: 用于新视角合成的量子隐式神经表示
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为3D-QISR的混合量子-经典神经辐射场模型，它在减少一半以上参数的同时，实现了与经典NeRF相当或更好的新视角合成效果。
AI.motivation: 传统的神经辐射场（NeRF）虽然是新视角合成的主流框架，但通常需要巨大的模型容量和密集的优化。为了探索更紧凑的连续视觉信号函数逼近器，作者将量子隐式神经表示与NeRF相结合，旨在利用量子优势实现更高效的隐式表示。
AI.method: 引入3D量子隐式场景表示（3D-QISR），使用参数化量子电路替代经典的NeRF主干网络，通过量子状态变换编码空间和视角相关信息，并提出了全3D-QISR和双分支3D-QISR两种架构。
AI.result: 在适度分辨率的新视角合成基准测试中，模拟量子硬件上运行的3D-QISR在参数量不到经典基线一半的情况下，匹配或超越了经典基线的性能。
AI.conclusion: 3D-QISR证明了量子神经网络作为连续体积场景表示的紧凑且具有竞争力的构建模块的潜力，为量子增强隐式神经渲染开辟了新方向。
AI.translation: 量子隐式神经表示最近已成为连续视觉信号的紧凑函数逼近器。与此同时，神经辐射场（NeRF）通过从带姿态的2D图像中恢复连续的体积场景表示，已成为新视角合成的主导框架，但通常需要大量的模型容量和密集的优化。我们引入了3D量子隐式场景表示（3D-QISR），这是第一个用于从2D观测中进行新视角合成的混合量子-经典辐射场模型。3D-QISR用参数化量子电路替换了经典的NeRF主干网络，这些量子电路通过量子状态变换编码空间和视角相关信息，在保持与标准体积渲染兼容性的同时，实现了紧凑的量子增强隐式表示。我们提出了两种架构：完整3D-QISR，它最大化了统一量子状态的表示作用；双分支3D-QISR，它分离了空间和视角相关的量子嵌入，以引入任务对齐的归纳偏置，降低状态制备复杂度，并提高可扩展性和硬件兼容性。在中等分辨率新视角合成基准上的实验表明，在模拟量子硬件上执行的3D-QISR在使用不到一半的可训练参数的情况下，匹配或优于经典基线。这些结果将量子神经网络定位为连续体积场景表示的紧凑且有竞争力的构建模块，为量子增强隐式神经渲染开辟了新方向。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了3D量子隐式场景表示（3D-QISR），这是第一个用于2D观测新视角合成的混合量子-经典辐射场模型。通过用参数化量子电路替换经典NeRF主干网络，该方法在显著减少可训练参数的同时，实现了具有竞争力的合成效果。
AI.keywords: Quantum Neural Networks, Neural Radiance Fields, Novel View Synthesis, Implicit Neural Representations, Hybrid Quantum-Classical Model
AI.comments: 该论文首次将量子-经典混合神经辐射场模型（3D-QISR）引入新视角合成任务，通过参数化量子电路替代经典NeRF的主干网络，在参数量减半的情况下达到了与经典基线相当或更好的性能，为量子神经网络在隐式神经渲染中的应用开辟了新方向。

title: CHisAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Event Taxonomy Construction in Ancient Chinese Cultural Systems
summary: Despite strong performance on many tasks, large language models (LLMs) show limited ability in historical and cultural reasoning, particularly in non-English contexts such as Chinese history. Taxonomic structures offer an effective mechanism to organize historical knowledge and improve understanding. However, manual taxonomy construction is costly and difficult to scale. Therefore, we propose \textbf{CHisAgent}, a multi-agent LLM framework for historical taxonomy construction in ancient Chinese contexts. CHisAgent decomposes taxonomy construction into three role-specialized stages: a bottom-up \textit{Inducer} that derives an initial hierarchy from raw historical corpora, a top-down \textit{Expander} that introduces missing intermediate concepts using LLM world knowledge, and an evidence-guided \textit{Enricher} that integrates external structured historical resources to ensure faithfulness. Using the \textit{Twenty-Four Histories}, we construct a large-scale, domain-aware event taxonomy covering politics, military, diplomacy, and social life in ancient China. Extensive reference-free and reference-based evaluations demonstrate improved structural coherence and coverage, while further analysis shows that the resulting taxonomy supports cross-cultural alignment.

AI.title_translation: CHisAgent：一个用于中国古代文化系统中事件分类体系构建的多智能体框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了CHisAgent，一个多智能体大语言模型框架，能够自动构建高质量、大规模的中国古代历史事件分类体系，提升了模型对非英语历史文化的推理与组织能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在历史和文化推理能力（尤其是中文等非英语语境下的中国历史）方面表现有限，而手动构建历史知识分类体系成本高且难以扩展，因此需要一种自动化的框架来构建中国古代文化系统的事件分类体系。
AI.method: 提出CHisAgent多智能体框架，将分类体系构建分解为三个角色专业化阶段：自底向上的“归纳者”（Inducer）从原始语料库派生初始层次结构，自顶向下的“Expander”利用大语言模型的世界知识引入缺失的中间概念，以及证据引导的“Enricher”整合外部结构化历史资源以确保忠实度。
AI.result: 基于《二十四史》成功构建了一个涵盖中国古代政治、军事、外交和社会生活的大规模、领域感知的事件分类体系。广泛的无参考和有参考评估表明其在结构连贯性和覆盖率方面均有提升，且支持跨文化对齐。
AI.conclusion: CHisAgent是一个有效且可扩展的多智能体框架，能够利用大语言模型和外部历史资源自动构建高质量的中国古代历史事件分类体系，显著提升历史知识的组织与推理能力。
AI.translation: 尽管大语言模型在许多任务上表现出强大的性能，但在历史和文化推理方面能力有限，特别是在中文等非英语历史语境中。分类体系结构是组织历史知识和提高理解力的有效机制。然而，手动构建分类体系成本高昂且难以扩展。因此，我们提出了CHisAgent，这是一个用于中国古代历史语境中历史分类体系构建的多智能体大语言模型框架。CHisAgent将分类体系的构建分解为三个角色专业化的阶段：一个自底向上的“归纳者”（Inducer），从原始历史语料库中推导初始层次结构；一个自顶向下的“扩展者”（Expander），利用大语言模型的世界知识引入缺失的中间概念；以及一个证据引导的“丰富者”（Enricher），整合外部结构化历史资源以确保忠实度。利用《二十四史》，我们构建了一个涵盖中国古代政治、军事、外交和社会生活的大规模、领域感知的事件分类体系。广泛的无参考和有参考评估证明了其改进的结构连贯性和覆盖率，进一步的分析表明，由此产生的分类体系支持跨文化对齐。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CHisAgent，一个用于构建中国古代历史事件分类体系的多智能体大语言模型框架。该框架包含归纳、扩展和证据引导三个阶段，克服了传统方法成本高和LLM历史推理能力不足的问题。实验表明，基于《二十四史》构建的分类体系具有出色的结构连贯性、覆盖率和跨文化对齐能力。
AI.keywords: 多智能体框架, 历史分类体系, 中国古代文化系统, 大语言模型, 知识图谱
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的多智能体框架CHisAgent，用于构建中国古代历史事件分类体系。通过结合归纳、扩展和证据引导的多阶段策略，有效克服了大语言模型在非英语历史文化推理上的局限性。其创新之处在于自动化构建大规模历史知识分类体系，并展示了良好的结构连贯性和跨文化对齐能力，对数字人文领域的知识组织具有重要推动作用。

title: Cost and Accuracy of Long-Term Memory in Distributed Multi-Agent Systems Based on Large Language Models
summary: Long-term memory (LTM) is fundamental to large language model (LLM)-based agents in the emerging Internet of Agents (IoA), where distributed multi-agent systems (DMAS) span cloud and edge networks. Existing evaluations are typically published by framework providers and focus on token usage and latency, rarely accounting for system-level cost or deployment in DMAS. These gaps are addressed with an independent reproducible testbed that evaluates accuracy, latency, CPU time, peak RAM, disk I/O and network usage in a simulated cloud-edge environment. Three venture capital-funded frameworks spanning vector, graph, and hybrid architectures, namely mem0, Graphiti, and cognee, are compared alongside retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and full-context baselines on the LoCoMo benchmark under unconstrained and constrained network scenarios. Two clusters emerge: mem0, RAG, and full-context reach 77% to 81% accuracy, while Graphiti and cognee reach only 55% to 56%, a gap driven by retrieval incompleteness rather than reasoning failure. The RAG baseline matches the upper cluster at 8.4 times lower total cost of ownership (TCO) than mem0, and both are the only non-dominated backends on the Pareto frontier. Latency and bandwidth constraints as well as jitter leave retrieval quality unchanged for every backend, while vector-based LTM incurs a modest latency penalty of 4% to 5% under edge-cloud constraints. Compression precision rather than context volume determines LTM accuracy, as full-context forwarding underperforms mem0 despite supplying the entire conversation for each question.

AI.title_translation: 基于大语言模型的分布式多智能体系统中长期记忆的成本与准确性
AI.tldr: 本文独立评估了LLM分布式多智能体系统中各种长期记忆（LTM）框架的系统级成本与准确性，发现向量记忆与RAG表现最优，其中RAG成本效益最高，且记忆准确性主要取决于压缩精度而非上下文大小。
AI.motivation: 现有的长期记忆（LTM）评估通常由框架提供商发布，主要关注Token使用量和延迟，很少考虑系统级成本或在分布式多智能体系统（DMAS）中的部署情况，这导致缺乏独立、全面的基准评估。
AI.method: 开发了一个独立的、可复现的测试平台，在模拟的云边环境中评估了准确性、延迟、CPU时间、峰值RAM、磁盘I/O和网络使用情况；比较了mem0、Graphiti、cognee三种框架以及RAG和全上下文基线在LoCoMo基准测试（包含无约束和受限网络场景）下的表现。
AI.result: mem0、RAG和全上下文方法的准确率达到77%至81%，而Graphiti和cognee仅为55%至56%；RAG的总体拥有成本（TCO）比mem0低8.4倍，且两者是Pareto前沿上仅有的非劣效后端；网络延迟、带宽约束和抖动对检索质量无影响，而压缩精度（而非上下文体积）决定了LTM的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 在资源受限的云边分布式多智能体系统中，向量记忆（如mem0）和RAG在准确性上占据优势，但RAG具备显著更低的总体拥有成本（TCO）。压缩精度是决定LTM准确性的关键，而非上下文的单纯堆砌。
AI.translation: 长期记忆（LTM）是新兴智能体互联网（IoA）中基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体的基础，在IoA中，分布式多智能体系统（DMAS）跨越了云和边缘网络。现有的评估通常由框架提供商发布，主要关注Token使用量和延迟，很少考虑系统级成本或在DMAS中的部署。为了填补这些空白，本文提出了一个独立且可复现的测试平台，用于在模拟的云边环境中评估准确性、延迟、CPU时间、峰值RAM、磁盘I/O和网络使用情况。文章在无约束和受限网络场景下的LoCoMo基准测试中，对跨越向量、图和混合架构的三种获风投资助的框架（mem0、Graphiti和cognee）进行了评估，并与检索增强生成（RAG）和全上下文基线进行了比较。结果涌现出两个集群：mem0、RAG和全上下文方法的准确率达到了77%至81%，而Graphiti和cognee仅达到了55%至56%，这一差距是由检索不完整性而非推理失败导致的。RAG基线的总体拥有成本（TCO）比mem0低8.4倍，且两者是Pareto前沿上仅有的非劣效后端。延迟、带宽约束以及抖动对所有后端的检索质量均无影响；在边缘云约束下，基于向量的LTM会产生4%到5%的适度延迟惩罚。压缩精度（而非上下文体积）决定了LTM的准确性，因为尽管全上下文转发为每个问题提供了整个对话，但其表现仍不及mem0。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于大语言模型的分布式多智能体系统中的长期记忆（LTM）进行了独立的成本与准确性评估。通过构建可复现的云边测试平台，研究对比了多种LTM框架及基线在不同网络场景下的表现，发现基于向量的mem0和RAG在准确率上领先，但RAG的总体拥有成本显著更低，且证明了压缩精度是影响LTM准确性的核心因素。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 分布式多智能体系统, 长期记忆, 检索增强生成, 成本与准确性评估
AI.comments: 本文独立且全面地评估了基于大语言模型的分布式多智能体系统中长期记忆（LTM）的成本与准确性，填补了现有框架多由提供商发布、缺乏系统级成本评估的空白。实验设计严谨，涵盖了多种主流架构与资源受限的云边环境，对未来分布式智能体系统的架构选型具有重要的参考价值。

title: Imagine-then-Plan: Agent Learning from Adaptive Lookahead with World Models
summary: Recent advances in world models have shown promise for modeling future dynamics of environmental states, enabling agents to reason and act without accessing real environments. Current methods mainly perform single-step or fixed-horizon rollouts, leaving their potential for complex task planning under-exploited. We propose Imagine-then-Plan (\texttt{ITP}), a unified framework for agent learning via lookahead imagination, where an agent's policy model interacts with the learned world model, yielding multi-step ``imagined'' trajectories. Since the imagination horizon may vary by tasks and stages, we introduce a novel adaptive lookahead mechanism by trading off the ultimate goal and task progress. The resulting imagined trajectories provide rich signals about future consequences, such as achieved progress and potential conflicts, which are fused with current observations, formulating a partially \textit{observable} and \textit{imaginable} Markov decision process to guide policy learning. We instantiate \texttt{ITP} with both training-free and reinforcement-trained variants. Extensive experiments across representative agent benchmarks demonstrate that \texttt{ITP} significantly outperforms competitive baselines. Further analyses validate that our adaptive lookahead largely enhances agents' reasoning capability, providing valuable insights into addressing broader, complex tasks. Our code and data will be publicly available at https://github.com/loyiv/ITP.

AI.title_translation: 想象后规划：基于世界模型自适应前瞻的智能体学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于世界模型自适应前瞻的“想象后规划”(ITP)框架，显著提升了智能体在复杂任务中的推理与规划能力。
AI.motivation: 当前基于世界模型的方法主要进行单步或固定视角的推演，未能充分挖掘其在复杂任务规划中的潜力，且想象视界需要根据任务和阶段进行自适应调整。
AI.method: 提出Imagine-then-Plan (ITP) 统一框架，让策略模型与世界模型交互生成多步“想象”轨迹；引入自适应前瞻机制平衡最终目标与任务进度；将想象轨迹与当前观测融合，构建偏序可观察且可想象的马尔可夫决策过程以指导策略学习。
AI.result: 在多个代表性智能体基准测试中，ITP显著优于竞争基线，实验证明自适应前瞻机制大幅增强了智能体的推理能力。
AI.conclusion: ITP框架通过自适应前瞻的世界模型有效提升了智能体在复杂环境中的任务规划与推理能力，实验证明其显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.translation: 世界模型的最新进展在建模环境状态的未来动态方面显示出前景，使智能体能够在不接触真实环境的情况下进行推理和行动。当前方法主要执行单步或固定视角的推演，使得它们在复杂任务规划方面的潜力未被充分挖掘。我们提出了Imagine-then-Plan (ITP)，这是一个通过前瞻想象进行智能体学习的统一框架，其中智能体的策略模型与学到的世界模型交互，产生多步“想象”的轨迹。由于想象视界可能因任务和阶段而异，我们引入了一种新的自适应前瞻机制，通过权衡最终目标和任务进度来调整视界。由此产生的想象轨迹提供了关于未来后果（如实现的进展和潜在冲突）的丰富信号，这些信号与当前观测相融合，形成了一个部分可观察且可想象的马尔可夫决策过程，以指导策略学习。我们实例化了具有免训练和强化训练变体的ITP。在代表性智能体基准测试上的广泛实验表明，ITP显著优于竞争基线。进一步的分析验证了我们的自适应前瞻显着增强了智能体的推理能力，为解决更广泛、复杂的任务提供了有价值的见解。我们的代码和数据将在 https://github.com/loyiv/ITP 上公开可用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Imagine-then-Plan (ITP) 框架，利用世界模型进行多步想象并通过自适应前瞻机制平衡目标与进度，从而指导智能体在复杂环境中的策略学习和任务规划，实验验证了其优越性。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 智能体学习, 自适应前瞻, 任务规划, 马尔可夫决策过程
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种“先想象后规划”（ITP）的框架，通过自适应前瞻机制和世界模型的结合，解决了复杂任务中长短期规划的矛盾。其训练前和强化学习两种变体展现了极强的泛化能力和实用价值，为具身智能和强化学习领域提供了新的思路。

title: PaperScout: An Autonomous Agent for Academic Paper Search with Process-Aware Sequence-Level Policy Optimization
summary: Academic paper search is a fundamental task in scientific research, yet most existing approaches organize retrieval around predefined workflows or structured interaction protocols that struggle with complex, conditional queries. To address this limitation, we propose PaperScout, an autonomous agent that reformulates paper search as a sequential decision-making process. Unlike static workflows, PaperScout dynamically decides whether, when, and how to invoke search and expand tools based on accumulated retrieval context. However, training such agents presents a fundamental challenge: standard reinforcement learning methods, typically designed for single-turn tasks, suffer from a granularity mismatch when applied to multi-turn agentic tasks, where token-level optimization diverges from the granularity of sequence-level interactions, leading to noisy credit assignment and unstable training dynamics. We introduce Proximal Sequence Policy Optimization (PSPO), a process-aware, sequence-level policy optimization method that aligns optimization with agent--environment interaction. Comprehensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that PaperScout significantly outperforms strong structured retrieval and RL baselines in both recall and relevance, validating the effectiveness of our adaptive agentic framework and optimization strategy.

title: HOMURA: Taming the Sand-Glass for Time-Constrained LLM Translation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable strides in multilingual translation but are hindered by a systemic cross-lingual verbosity bias, rendering them unsuitable for strict time-constrained tasks like subtitling and dubbing. Current prompt-engineering approaches struggle to resolve this conflict between semantic fidelity and rigid temporal feasibility. To bridge this gap, we first introduce Sand-Glass, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate translation under syllable-level duration constraints. Furthermore, we propose Homura, a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly optimizes the trade-off between semantic preservation and temporal compliance. By employing a constrained reinforcement learning objective featuring a novel dynamic syllable-ratio reward, Homura effectively "tames" the output length. Experimental results demonstrate that Homura significantly outperforms strong baselines, achieving precise length control that respects linguistic density hierarchies without compromising semantic adequacy.

title: Relational Linearity is a Predictor of Hallucinations
summary: Hallucination is a central failure mode of language models (LMs). We focus on hallucinations in response to questions like: "Which instrument did Glenn Gould play?", but we ask these questions for synthetic entities designed to be unknown to the model. We find that LMs like Gemma-7B-IT frequently hallucinate, i.e., they have difficulty recognizing that the hallucinated fact is not part of their knowledge. Based on the idea of linear relational embeddings, we put forward the following hypothesis. (i) Due to the abstract scheme that is used to represent them, LMs can easily produce plausible objects for non-existing subjects of linear relations, which can lead to hallucinations. (ii) For nonlinear relations, this mechanism for producing an object is not available and so a hallucination is easier to avoid. To test this hypothesis, we create SynthHal, a synthetic unknown-entity benchmark for 15 relations. We find that across four instruction-tuned models, relational linearity is a strong predictor of models hallucinating an object for an unknown subject vs refusing to give an answer, with correlations $r \in [.58, .84]$. While this is not direct evidence for the hypothesized causal mechanism, it is suggestive and opens up a new line of inquiry into understanding LM hallucinations.

title: Highly Deformable Proprioceptive Membrane for Real-Time 3D Shape Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing the three-dimensional (3D) geometry of object surfaces is essential for robot perception, yet vision-based approaches degrade under low illumination or occlusion. This limitation motivates the design of a proprioceptive membrane that conforms to the surface of interest and infers 3D geometry by reconstructing its own deformation. Conventional deformation-aware membranes typically rely on resistive, capacitive, or magneto-sensitive mechanisms, but can suffer from structural complexity, limited compliance during large-scale deformation, and susceptibility to electromagnetic interference. This work presents a soft, flexible, and stretchable proprioceptive silicone membrane based on optical waveguide sensing. The membrane integrates edge-mounted LEDs and centrally-distributed photodiodes (PDs) within a multilayer elastomeric composite. Rich deformation-dependent light-intensity signals are decoded by a data-driven model to recover the membrane geometry. Real-time reconstruction is demonstrated on a customized 140 mm square membrane at an end-to-end update rate of 90 Hz, achieving an average reconstruction error of 1.307 mm for out-of-plane deformation of up to 25 mm. The proposed sensor also demonstrates accurate reconstruction under large in-plane deformation, achieving reliable shape recovery up to 75% strain with an average Chamfer distance of 1.214 mm. The proposed framework provides a scalable, robust, and low-profile solution for global shape perception in deformable robotic systems.

title: Linearized subspace refinement framework to expose hidden accuracy in trained neural networks
comments: Substantially revised version with updated title, abstract, and additional analyses
summary: Neural networks trained by gradient-based methods often exhibit optimization-induced accuracy plateaus in scientific machine learning tasks. We present Linearized Subspace Refinement (LSR), an architecture-agnostic post-training framework that exploits the local linearized model at a fixed trained state. By solving a reduced direct least-squares problem in a Jacobian-defined low-dimensional space, LSR computes a subspace-optimal linearized correction and yields a refined predictor with markedly improved accuracy. Across function approximation, data-driven operator learning, physics-informed operator fine-tuning, and noisy inverse problems, LSR shows that standard nonlinear training can remain far above this subspace-attainable error level. Similar accuracy plateaus persist even for the convex quadratic problem from local linearization when solved with standard iterative optimizers, identifying numerical ill-conditioning as a primary bottleneck. LSR frequently delivers order-of-magnitude error reductions, while the subspace rank provides an explicit capacity-control mechanism that balances correction strength, numerical stability, and noise sensitivity. Together, LSR exposes conditioning-limited attainable accuracy in trained-state linearized models and provides direct access to it.
comment: Substantially revised version with updated title, abstract, and additional analyses

title: JAXMg: A multi-GPU linear solver in JAX
summary: Solving large dense linear systems and eigenvalue problems is a core requirement in many areas of scientific computing, but scaling these operations beyond a single GPU remains challenging within modern programming frameworks. While highly optimized multi-GPU solver libraries exist, they are typically difficult to integrate into composable, just-in-time (JIT) compiled Python workflows. JAXMg provides distributed dense linear algebra for JAX, enabling linear solves and decompositions for matrices that exceed single-GPU memory limits. By interfacing JAX with NVIDIA's cuSOLVERMp through an XLA Foreign Function Interface, JAXMg exposes distributed GPU routines as JIT-compatible JAX primitives. This design allows scalable linear algebra to be embedded directly within JAX programs, preserving composability with JAX transformations and enabling multi-GPU and multi-node execution in end-to-end scientific workflows.

title: Deja Vu in Plots: Leveraging Cross-Session Evidence with Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Live Streaming Risk Assessment
summary: The rise of live streaming has transformed online interaction, enabling massive real-time engagement but also exposing platforms to complex risks such as scams and coordinated malicious behaviors. Detecting these risks is challenging because harmful actions often accumulate gradually and recur across seemingly unrelated streams. To address this, we propose CS-VAR (Cross-Session Evidence-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Detector) for live streaming risk assessment. In CS-VAR, a lightweight, domain-specific model performs fast session-level risk inference, guided during training by a Large Language Model (LLM) that reasons over retrieved cross-session behavioral evidence and transfers its local-to-global insights to the small model. This design enables the small model to recognize recurring patterns across streams, perform structured risk assessment, and maintain efficiency for real-time deployment. Extensive offline experiments on large-scale industrial datasets, combined with online validation, demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of CS-VAR. Furthermore, CS-VAR provides interpretable, localized signals that effectively empower real-world moderation for live streaming.

title: Detecting Multiple Semantic Concerns in Tangled Code Commits
comments: 28 pages, 8 figures. Substantially revised: updated dataset construction, model, experiments, and analysis. Submitted to Empirical Software Engineering (Springer)
summary: Code commits in a version control system (e.g., Git) should be atomic, i.e., focused on a single goal, such as adding a feature or fixing a bug. In practice, however, developers often bundle multiple concerns into tangled commits, obscuring intent and complicating maintenance. Recent studies have used Conventional Commits Specification (CCS) and Language Models (LMs) to capture commit intent, demonstrating that Small Language Models (SLMs) can approach the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) while maintaining efficiency and privacy within local infrastructure. However, they do not address tangled commits involving multiple concerns, leaving the feasibility of using LMs for multi-concern detection unresolved. In this paper, we frame multi-concern detection in tangled commits as a multi-label classification problem and construct a controlled dataset of artificially tangled commits based on real-world data. We then present an empirical study using SLMs to detect multiple semantic concerns in tangled commits, examining the effects of fine-tuning, concern count, commit-message inclusion, and header-preserving truncation under practical token-budget limits. Our results show that a fine-tuned 27B-parameter SLM outperforms a state-of-the-art LLM across all concern counts. In particular, including commit messages improves detection accuracy by up to 31% (in terms of Hamming Loss) with negligible latency overhead, establishing them as important semantic cues.
comment: 28 pages, 8 figures. Substantially revised: updated dataset construction, model, experiments, and analysis. Submitted to Empirical Software Engineering (Springer)

title: FlexMap: Robust HD Map Construction under Flexible Camera Configurations
summary: High-definition (HD) maps provide essential semantic information about road structures for autonomous driving, but existing HD map construction methods typically require calibrated multi-camera rigs and explicit 2D-to-BEV transformations. Such pipelines degrade when camera views are missing or pose estimates are inaccurate, limiting their use across heterogeneous fleet configurations. We introduce FlexMap, a vectorized HD mapping framework that adapts to varying camera configurations without architectural changes or per-configuration retraining and does not require camera parameters as model input. FlexMap replaces explicit geometric projection with a geometry foundation model that encodes cross-view 3D structure. A spatial-temporal enhancement module then separates cross-view spatial reasoning from temporal aggregation, while a camera-aware decoder uses the token produced for each input view to adapt its attention without camera poses. Experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 show that FlexMap outperforms pose-dependent baselines using estimated poses and maintains comparable accuracy across all evaluated camera configurations, including those with missing views.

title: Benchmarking Machine Translation on Chinese Social Media Texts
comments: Camera ready version, to appear in EMNLP 2026, Findings
summary: The prevalence of rapidly evolving slang, neologisms, and highly stylized expressions in informal user-generated text, particularly on Chinese social media, poses significant challenges for Machine Translation (MT) benchmarking. Specifically, we identify two primary obstacles: (1) data scarcity, as high-quality parallel data requires bilingual annotators familiar with platform-specific slang, and stylistic cues in both languages; and (2) metric limitations, where traditional evaluators like COMET often fail to capture stylistic fidelity and nonstandard expressions. To bridge these gaps, we introduce CSM-MTBench, a benchmark covering five Chinese-foreign language directions and consisting of two expert-curated subsets: Fun Posts, featuring context-rich, slang- and neologism-heavy content, and Social Snippets, emphasizing concise, emotion- and style- driven expressions. Furthermore, we propose tailored evaluation approaches for each subset: measuring the translation success rate of slang and neologisms in Fun Posts, while assessing tone and style preservation in Social Snippets via a hybrid of embedding-based metrics and LLM-as-a-judge. Experiments on over 20 models reveal substantial variation in how current MT systems handle semantic fidelity and informal, social-media-specific stylistic cues. CSM-MTBench thus serves as a rigorous testbed for advancing MT systems capable of mastering real-world Chinese social media texts.
comment: Camera ready version, to appear in EMNLP 2026, Findings

title: Complete Identification of Deep ReLU Networks through Łukasiewicz Logic
summary: Two deep ReLU networks can have entirely different architectures and parameters, yet realize the same function. We provide a complete characterization of this nonuniqueness. This is effected by building a symbolic calculus for deep ReLU networks, equivalence and simplification of networks becoming derivation of formulae, in close parallel to Shannon's analysis of switching circuits through Boolean logic. Inspired by Shannon, who turned circuit synthesis into the manipulation of Boolean formulae by the axioms of Boolean algebra, we turn ReLU network identification into the derivation of Łukasiewicz formulae by the axioms of many-valued (MV) logic. Two non-degenerate ReLU networks realize the same function on the unit cube if and only if one is obtained from the other by finitely many applications of the MV axioms for integer weights and biases, the divisible MV axioms for rational ones, and the Riesz MV axioms for real ones. The MV logic axioms characterize all symmetries of ReLU networks, the single-layer ones, which for tanh networks are the only kind, and the deep ones, spanning three or more layers. Our framework consists of three steps, an extraction algorithm turning a network into a substitution graph, whose represented formula has the network's input-output map as its truth function, a completeness theorem, by which functionally equivalent formulae are interderivable, and a construction algorithm returning from graphs to networks. The substitution graph is layered, carrying at each node a formula in the variables of the layer feeding it, encodes the network uniquely, and induces a new normal form for MV logic, compositional rather than flat as in the literature, hence retaining the algebraic structure of the network, with three local operations--node rewrite, layer collapse, layer expansion--realizing every derivation.

title: Not All Preferences Deserve Gradients: Understanding Gradient Utility in Offline Reasoning Alignment
summary: Offline preference optimization aligns reasoning models from fixed chosen--rejected pairs, yet standard methods apply gradient updates from every pair regardless of its training value under the current policy. We argue that this uniform treatment is wasteful and potentially harmful. From the perspective of gradient utility, we show that a pair's contribution depends jointly on informativeness and stability. Pair utility drifts as the policy evolves, high-gradient samples can coincide with high-curvature regions, leading to noisy and destabilizing updates, and the most effective supervision comes from stable confident errors where the model is reliably wrong yet curvature remains low. These findings motivate SAGE (Stability-Aware Gradient Efficiency), which maintains difficulty-stratified candidate pools refreshed during training and selects pairs within each pool by a forward-pass signal-to-curvature score. Only pairs with high current utility receive gradient computation; the rest are excluded from backpropagation. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks across multiple model scales, SAGE outperforms full-data and size-matched baselines while producing substantially smoother optimization trajectories.

title: MSign: An Optimizer Preventing Training Instability in Large Language Models via Stable Rank Restoration
summary: Training instability remains a critical challenge in large language model (LLM) pretraining, often manifesting as sudden gradient explosions that waste significant computational resources. We study training failures in a 5M-parameter NanoGPT model scaled via $μ$P, identifying two key phenomena preceding collapse: (1) rapid decline in weight matrix stable rank (ratio of squared Frobenius norm to squared spectral norm), and (2) increasing alignment between adjacent layer Jacobians. We prove theoretically that these two conditions jointly cause exponential gradient norm growth with network depth. To break this instability mechanism, we propose MSign, a new optimizer that periodically applies matrix sign operations to restore stable rank. Experiments on models from 5M to 3B parameters demonstrate that MSign effectively prevents training failures with a computational overhead of less than 7.0%.

title: Joint Network-and-Server Congestion in Multi-Source Traffic Allocation: A Convex Formulation and Price-Based Decentralization (Extended Version)
comments: 11 pages, 8 figures. Extended version of the WiOpt 2026 paper. The capacity formulation, distributed feasibility mechanism, fixed-point guarantee, and numerical evaluation have been revised; residual-based verification and a summary of changes have been added
summary: This paper studies an important rate allocation problem that arises in many networked and distributed systems: steady-state traffic rate allocation from multiple sources to multiple service nodes when both (i) the access-path delay on each source-node route is rate-dependent (capacity-constrained) and convex, and (ii) each service node (also capacity-constrained) experiences a load-dependent queueing delay driven by aggregate load from all sources. We show that the resulting flow-weighted end-to-end delay minimization is a convex program, yielding a global system-optimal solution characterized by KKT conditions that equalize total marginal costs (a path marginal access term plus a node congestion price) across all utilized routes. This condition admits a Wardrop-type interpretation: for each source, all utilized options equalize total marginal cost, while any option with strictly larger total marginal cost receives no flow. Building on this structure, we develop a lightweight distributed pricing-based algorithm in which each service node locally computes and broadcasts a scalar congestion price from its observed aggregate load, while each source updates its traffic split by solving a small separable convex allocation problem under the advertised prices. Numerical illustrations demonstrate convergence of the distributed iteration to the centralized optimum and highlight the trade-offs induced by jointly modeling access and service congestion.
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures. Extended version of the WiOpt 2026 paper. The capacity formulation, distributed feasibility mechanism, fixed-point guarantee, and numerical evaluation have been revised; residual-based verification and a summary of changes have been added

title: Temperature Scaling Attack Disrupting Model Confidence in Federated Learning
summary: Predictive confidence serves as a foundational control signal in mission-critical systems, directly governing risk-aware logic such as escalation, abstention, and conservative fallback. While prior federated learning attacks predominantly target accuracy or implant backdoors, we identify confidence calibration as a distinct attack objective. We present the Temperature Scaling Attack (TSA), a training-time attack that degrades calibration while preserving accuracy. By injecting temperature scaling with learning rate-temperature coupling during local training, TSA shifts model confidence while keeping predictive accuracy and common optimization signals close to benign training. We provide a convergence analysis under non-IID settings, showing that the coupling controls the primary update scale while leaving a bounded temperature-induced residual, yielding the standard non-convex FL convergence structure with an additional residual term. Across three benchmarks, TSA substantially shifts calibration (e.g., 145% error increase on CIFAR-100) with <2% accuracy change, and remains effective under robust aggregation and post-hoc calibration defenses. Case studies further show up to a 7.2x increase in missed verifications in healthcare and severe confidence-gating failures in autonomous driving, even when accuracy is unchanged. Overall, our results establish calibration integrity as a critical attack surface in federated learning.

title: F-GRPO: Don't Let Your Policy Learn the Obvious and Forget the Rare
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is commonly based on group sampling to estimate advantages and stabilize policy updates. In practice, computational limits often rule out very large groups, so training proceeds with finite rollout sets that can reinforce only the correct behavior they expose. At practical group sizes, updates can miss rare-correct trajectories while still containing mixed rewards, concentrating probability on more common sampled solutions. We derive the probability of such prompt-local tail-miss events as a function of group size, showing non-monotonic behavior, and in the categorical abstraction characterize how unsampled-correct mass can shrink even as total correct mass grows. Motivated by this analysis, we propose a difficulty-aware scaling coefficient, inspired by Focal loss, that down-weights updates on high-success sampled groups. Empirically, categorical simulation illustrates the same effect in the categorical setting, Maze provides a single-solution test, and LLM experiments include a representative GRPO group-size sweep together with fixed-$N$ transfer across GRPO, DAPO, and CISPO. On Qwen2.5-7B at $N{=}8$, our method improves average math pass@256 from 64.1 $\rightarrow$ 70.3 (GRPO), 69.3 $\rightarrow$ 72.5 (DAPO), and 73.2 $\rightarrow$ 76.8 (CISPO); OOD pass@256 also improves in all three cases, without increasing group size or computational cost.

title: Ex-Omni: Enabling 3D Facial Animation Generation for Omni-modal Large Language Models
summary: Omni-modal large language models (OLLMs) aim to unify multimodal understanding and generation, yet extending them to jointly produce speech and 3D facial animation remains largely underexplored. A key challenge is the mismatch between the discrete semantic reasoning of LLMs and the dense temporal dynamics required for 3D facial motion. We propose Expressive Omni (Ex-Omni), a framework that augments OLLMs with speech-accompanied 3D facial animation. Ex-Omni decouples semantic reasoning from temporal generation through a speech-unit generator with blendshape co-supervision and a non-autoregressive blendshape decoder, where speech units provide temporal scaffolding and hidden speech representations carry facially relevant cues. We further introduce a token-as-query gated fusion (TQGF) interface for controlled semantic injection, as well as InstructS2SF-1200K, a 1.2M-sample weakly supervised dataset for speech-accompanied facial animation. Extensive experiments show that Ex-Omni retains competitive speech QA capability while natively generating coordinated text, speech, and 3D facial animation, and approaches the Audio2Face-3D teacher cascade in synchronization and human preference.

title: Entropy-Generated Attention Beyond Softmax and Entmax: Kaniadakis and Reciprocal-Symmetric Abe Operators
comments: 10 pages and 1 figure. Substantially revised and expanded version. The previous numerical study has been removed, and the manuscript now develops a generalized entropy-to-attention framework,including Kaniadakis and reciprocal-symmetric Abe operators, Rényi and Sharma-Mittal projections, and a tangent-gradient criterion for operator equivalence. Title changed
summary: We derive two attention operators from generalized statistical entropies. Kaniadakis entropy yields an exact full-support normalization whose weights and low-score sensitivities decay algebraically, rather than exponentially as in Softmax or by exact truncation as in entmax. Classical Abe entropy yields an implicit reciprocal-symmetric operator. With $q=e^ε$, the involution $q\leftrightarrow q^{-1}$ removes every odd correction about Softmax; we obtain the normalized second- and fourth-order terms, including the deformation of the normalization multiplier. These stationary laws follow from a Fisher-metric Lagrangian on the probability simplex, whose Shannon sector recovers scaled dot-product Softmax. We also give a tangent-gradient test for deciding whether changing the entropy changes the attention profile or only its scale. Rényi and two-parameter Sharma--Mittal entropies retain the Tsallis--entmax inverse-gradient shape, but their global moments make the effective temperature input dependent when the external temperature is fixed. Distinguishing profile-shape equivalence from fixed-parameter operator equivalence separates new normalization shapes from adaptive rescalings and organizes the operators by support, tail behavior, and realization complexity.
