AI.title_translation: 面向无人机成像的轻量级多指标无参考图像质量评估框架
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合多种可解释物理失真特征的轻量级无参考图像质量评估框架MM-IQA，专用于无人机成像的高效质量筛选。
AI.motivation: 在无人机等自动采集大量图像的应用场景中，需要在后续分析前对图像进行筛选过滤；且在绝大多数实际场景中无法获取无失真的参考图像，因此亟需高效可靠的无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种轻量级无参考图像质量评估框架MM-IQA。该方法结合了模糊、边缘结构、低分辨率伪影、曝光失衡、噪声、雾霾以及频域内容等多维度可解释特征，最终计算出[0, 100]范围内的综合质量得分。算法仅存储有限的中间灰度图、滤波和频域表示，内存占用与图像尺寸呈线性关系。
AI.result: 在KonIQ-10k、LIVE Challenge、KADID-10k、TID2013和BIQ2021五个基准数据集上的SRCC值在0.647到0.830之间；在合成农业数据集上的特征表现一致；基于Python/OpenCV的实现每张图像平均处理时间约为1.97秒，且内存需求低。
AI.conclusion: MM-IQA能够以适度的计算成本和明确的失真感知特征，有效应用于无人机等自动化成像场景中的快速图像质量筛选。
AI.translation: 可靠的图像质量评估在大量自动采集且在深入分析前必须进行筛选的图像应用中至关重要。在许多实际场景中，原始参考图像往往不可用，这使得无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）尤为关键。本文提出了一种用于NR-IQA的轻量级多指标框架——多指标图像质量评估（MM-IQA）。它结合了与模糊、边缘结构、低分辨率伪影、曝光失衡、噪声、雾霾和频域内容相关的可解释线索，生成一个范围在[0, 100]之间的综合质量评分。MM-IQA在五个基准数据集（KonIQ-10k、LIVE Challenge、KADID-10k、TID2013和BIQ2021）上进行了评估，其SRCC值在0.647至0.830之间。在合成农业数据集上的额外实验表明所设计的特征线索表现一致。该方法的Python/OpenCV实现每幅图像仅需约1.97秒。此外，由于仅存储有限的中间灰度、滤波及频域表示，该方法内存需求适中，内存使用量与图像尺寸呈线性比例扩展。实验结果表明，MM-IQA可凭借明确的失真感知线索和适度的计算开销用于图像质量的快速筛选。
AI.summary: 本研究针对无人机自动成像缺少参考图像的问题，提出了一种轻量级无参考图像质量评估框架MM-IQA。该框架通过整合模糊度、噪声、曝光失衡等多种可解释的失真特征来生成最终质量得分，在多个标准基准上取得了良好的相关性评估结果，且具备内存开销小、计算效率高的特点，适用于图像快速筛选。
AI.keywords: 无参考图像质量评估, 无人机成像, 轻量级框架, 多指标融合, 图像失真特征
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将多种传统可解释的手工特征（模糊、噪声、频域、曝光等）融合成一个轻量级评估体系，避开了大型深度神经网络极高的计算与内存开销，非常适合无人机等计算受限的边缘平台进行自动化初筛。局限性在于处理时间约为每张图1.97秒，对于超高帧率的纯实时无人机视频流评估仍有优化空间，且基于规则特征的指标在极端复杂场景下的泛化表现可能略逊于最新的大规模预训练模型。

title: LLM4Log: A Systematic Review of Large Language Model-based Log Analysis
summary: Software systems generate massive, evolving, semi-structured logs that are central to reliability engineering and AIOps, yet difficult to analyze at scale under drift and limited labels. Recent advances in pretrained Transformer models and instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) have reshaped log analysis by enabling semantic generalization and cross-source evidence integration, but also introducing deployment risks such as context limits, latency and cost, privacy constraints, and hallucinations. This paper presents LLM4Log, a systematic review of LLM-based log analysis across the end-to-end pipeline, from upstream logging-statement generation and maintenance to log parsing/structuring and downstream tasks including anomaly detection, failure prediction, root cause analysis, and log summarization. Following a structured search and manual screening protocol, we completed literature collection in November 2025 and identified 145 unique papers across seven logging tasks. We organize the research area through a unified, task-driven taxonomy, summarize common design patterns (prompting/ICL, retrieval grounding, fine-tuning, tool/agent augmentation, and verification), and analyze evaluation practices, datasets, metrics, and reproducibility. Based on these cross-paper analyses, we summarize key lessons and open challenges for reliable real-world adoption. We emphasize robustness under drift and long-tail events, grounding and faithfulness for operator-facing outputs, and deployment-oriented designs with verifiable behavior.

AI.title_translation: LLM4Log：基于大语言模型的日志分析系统性综述
AI.tldr: 本文全面系统地综述了基于大语言模型（LLM）的日志分析研究，涵盖端到端管道、任务分类、设计模式及未来挑战。
AI.motivation: 软件系统生成的日志规模庞大且不断演变，传统分析方法在面对概念漂移和标签稀缺时存在局限性，而大语言模型虽能带来语义泛化能力，但也伴随上下文限制、延迟、成本、隐私和幻觉等部署风险，亟需进行系统性综述与梳理。
AI.method: 采用结构化检索与人工筛选协议，收集了截至2025年11月的145篇独立论文，并基于任务驱动的统一分类法、设计模式和评估实践进行了系统梳理与分析。
AI.result: 识别了涵盖七个日志任务的145篇论文，总结了五种常见的设计模式（提示/上下文学习、检索扎根、微调、工具/智能体增强、验证），并分析了评估实践、数据集、指标和复现性。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型重塑了日志分析领域，但在真实世界的落地中仍需应对鲁棒性、幻觉、上下文限制和部署成本等挑战。
AI.translation: 软件系统会产生大量、不断演变且呈半结构化的日志，这些日志对于可靠性工程和AIOps至关重要，但在存在概念漂移和标签有限的情况下，很难进行大规模分析。预训练Transformer模型和指令微调大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展通过实现语义泛化和跨源证据整合重塑了日志分析，但也带来了诸如上下文限制、延迟和成本、隐私限制以及幻觉等部署风险。本文提出了LLM4Log，这是一项对基于LLM的日志分析在端到端管道上的系统性综述，涵盖了从上游日志语句生成和维护到日志解析/结构化，再到下游任务（包括异常检测、故障预测、根本原因分析和日志摘要）。遵循结构化检索和人工筛选协议，我们在2025年11月完成了文献收集，在七个日志任务中识别出了145篇独特的论文。我们通过一个统一的、任务驱动的分类法来组织研究领域，总结了常见的设计模式（提示/上下文学习、检索扎根、微调、工具/智能体增强和验证），并分析了评估实践、数据集、指标和可复现性。基于这些跨论文分析，我们总结了可靠实现真实世界应用的关键经验教训和开放性挑战。我们强调了在概念漂移和长尾事件下的鲁棒性，面向操作员输出的扎根性与忠实度，以及具有可验证行为的面向部署的设计。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LLM4Log，这是首个关于基于大语言模型进行日志分析的系统性综述。文章覆盖了从上游日志语句生成到下游异常检测、故障预测、根因分析和日志摘要的端到端管道，总结了相关文献的任务分类、设计模式、评估实践及开放性挑战。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 日志分析, 系统性综述, 软件可靠性工程, AIOps
AI.comments: 该论文对基于大语言模型的日志分析进行了系统性综述，填补了该领域的文献空白，梳理了全流程的任务、设计模式与挑战，对AIOps和软件可靠性工程具有很高的参考价值。

title: On the volumes of the elliptope, metric polytope, and cut polytope
comments: Revised version adds co-author Antoine Deza and a number of new results
summary: In this paper, we investigate the relationships between the volumes of four convex bodies: the cut polytope, metric polytope, rooted metric polytope, and elliptope, defined on graphs with n vertices. After an affine change of coordinates for the elliptope, the cut polytope is contained in each of the other three, which, for optimization purposes, provide polynomial-time relaxations. It is therefore of interest to see how tight these relaxations are. Worst-case ratio bounds are well known, but these are limited to objective functions with non-negative coefficients. Volume ratios, pioneered by Jon Lee with several co-authors, give global bounds and are the subject of this paper. For the rooted metric polytope over the complete graph, we show that for large n its volume is much greater than that of the elliptope. For the metric polytope, for small values of n, we show that its volume is smaller than that of the elliptope; however, for large values, we prove that the converse is true. Volume estimates place the crossover near n = 13. We also give exact formulae for the volumes of several families of sparse cut polytopes. In particular, we give an exact formula for the volume of the elliptope of every cycle and show that its volume ratio with the corresponding cut polytope converges rapidly to one.
comment: Revised version adds co-author Antoine Deza and a number of new results

AI.title_translation: 关于椭圆体、度量多面体和割多面体体积的研究
AI.tldr: 本文利用体积比研究了割多面体、度量多面体与椭圆体松弛的紧致性，揭示了体积大小随图规模增长而反转的现象，并给出了环图等稀疏情形的精确体积公式。
AI.motivation: 割多面体包含在度量多面体、有根度量多面体以及经过仿射变换的椭圆体中，后者为组合优化提供了多项式时间松弛。已有的最坏情况近似比仅适用于非负目标函数，因此需要借助体积比来提供全局性的松弛紧致度度量。
AI.method: 基于 Jon Lee 等人开创的凸体体积比分析方法，对图上的割多面体、度量多面体及椭圆体进行体积渐近分析、数值估计及精确组合积分推导。
AI.result: 证明了在大 n 时完全图上的有根度量多面体体积远大于椭圆体；度量多面体在 n 较小时体积小于椭圆体，而在大 n 时反转大于椭圆体（交叉点约在 n=13 附近）；同时给出了若干稀疏割多面体族及任意环图椭圆体的精确体积公式，并证明环图椭圆体与割多面体的体积比迅速收敛于 1。
AI.conclusion: 凸松弛几何体之间的相对紧致性（由体积比刻画）显著依赖于图规模 n，且在大图与小图之间存在定性反转现象；此外，对于环图等稀疏图，椭圆体松弛能够以极高精度逼近割多面体。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们研究了定义在包含 n 个顶点的图上的四个凸体之间的体积关系：割多面体（cut polytope）、度量多面体（metric polytope）、有根度量多面体（rooted metric polytope）以及椭圆体（elliptope）。在对椭圆体进行仿射坐标变换后，割多面体被包含在其余三个凸体中，出于优化目的，这些凸体提供了多项式时间松弛。因此，了解这些松弛的紧致程度具有重要意义。最坏情况比率界限是众所周知的，但它们局限于具有非负系数的目标函数。由 Jon Lee 及其若干合作者开创的体积比提供了全局界限，这也是本文的研究主题。对于完全图上的有根度量多面体，我们证明了当 n 很大时，其体积远大于椭圆体的体积。对于度量多面体，当 n 较小时，我们证明其体积小于椭圆体；然而当 n 较大时，我们证明结论相反。体积估计显示该交叉点大约在 n = 13 附近。我们还给出了若干稀疏割多面体族的体积精确公式。特别地，我们给出了每个环图对应椭圆体体积的精确公式，并证明其与相应割多面体的体积比迅速收敛于 1。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了 n 顶点图上的割多面体、度量多面体、有根度量多面体和椭圆体之间的体积关系。作为衡量凸松弛紧致性的全局指标，研究发现大 n 时有根度量多面体体积远超椭圆体，而度量多面体与椭圆体的体积大小关系在 n 约等于 13 处发生反转。此外，论文给出了稀疏割多面体及环图椭圆体的精确体积公式，显示出稀疏情况下极高的松弛逼近质量。
AI.keywords: 割多面体, 度量多面体, 椭圆体, 凸松弛, 体积比
AI.comments: 本研究从几何体积比这一全局视角评估了组合优化中著名的凸松弛（包括线性松弛与半定松弛）的紧致度，弥补了传统最坏情况近似比局限于非负系数目标函数的不足。论文发现了度量多面体与椭圆体体积大小随顶点数增加而反转的有趣几何相变（交叉点约在 n=13），并在环图等特定族上给出了优雅的闭式解，对理解图多面体几何具有重要理论意义。

title: CASCADE: A Component Ablation and Corpus Audit of a Layered Local Defense for MCP-Based Systems
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) widens the prompt injection attack surface of large language model applications to tool descriptions, parameter schemas, and tool outputs. Defenses for it are appearing quickly, but their reported figures are not comparable: each is evaluated on a corpus of its authors' construction, under a decision convention that is rarely stated. This paper asks how much those choices decide, taking CASCADE, a fully local layered defense, as the case: three configurations on a frozen 5,000-sample corpus under a pinned revision and a fixed protocol, with that corpus audited in full. Four results follow. First, the aggregation convention dominates the headline metric: counting review referrals as positives reports an 11.70% false-positive rate where 1.51% of benign traffic would be denied without a human, and conceals that 68.5% of all traffic reaches a reviewer. Second, detection is not provenance-invariant: recall ranges from 86.20% on original material to 99.88% on template-generated material, and added false positives fall on original benign records at ten times the rate they fall on transformed ones. Third, the operating point that ran is not readable from the released configuration, which names four candidate thresholds, its deployment files selecting one that did not govern; it is recoverable from point masses the policy layer leaves in the score distribution, so record-level output is a stronger reproducibility guarantee than a parameter table. Fourth, a local review model invoked for 32.56% of requests at 2.51 s each changes no classification outcome: it returned 90 not-malicious verdicts and the policy stage admitted none, making that null a guard setting rather than a model property. The ablation is unsurprising -- the rule-based layer reaches 61.05% recall, the semantic stage 94.77% -- and that is what makes the other results the substance of the paper.

AI.title_translation: CASCADE：基于MCP系统的分层本地防御组件消融与语料库审计
AI.tldr: 本文通过对MCP本地防御系统CASCADE的消融和审计，揭示了评估准则、数据来源及配置透明度对防御性能测试结果的决定性影响。
AI.motivation: 由于MCP防御机制缺乏统一的评估语料和决策惯例，导致各防御方案报告的性能数据无法直接对比，因此需要探究评估选择对防御效果的影响。
AI.method: 以CASCADE分层本地防御为研究案例，在固定协议下的5,000样本语料库中采用三种配置进行消融实验和全面语料审计。
AI.result: 研究发现：聚合规则主导了整体指标；检测结果对数据溯源不具不变性；实际运行的操作点无法从公开配置中直接读出但可通过评分分布恢复；本地审查模型在分类中未改变任何结果。
AI.conclusion: 评估指标、数据溯源方式和配置透明度对MCP防御系统的评估结果具有决定性影响，必须在安全评估中予以规范。
AI.translation: 模型上下文协议（MCP）将大型语言模型应用程序的提示词注入攻击面扩展到了工具描述、参数模式和工具输出。针对该协议的防御机制层出不穷，但它们报告的数据却不具可比性：每个防御机制都在其作者自己构建的语料库上进行评估，且往往采用了未明确说明的决策惯例。本文以CASCADE（一种完全本地的分层防御机制）为例，探讨了这些选择所起到的决定性作用。我们在一个包含5000个样本的冻结语料库、固定修订版和固定协议下，对其进行了三种配置的测试，并对该语料库进行了全面审计。研究得出四个结果：首先，聚合惯例主导了核心指标：将人工复核转介计为阳性时，报告的误报率为11.70%（而在没有人工干预的情况下，1.51%的良性流量将被拒绝），同时隐瞒了68.5%的流量最终需要人工复核的事实。其次，检测结果对数据溯源不具不变性：原始材料的召回率为86.20%，而模板生成材料的召回率高达99.88%，且额外误报落在原始良性记录上的频率是转化记录的十倍。第三，运行时的操作点无法从发布的配置中直接读取（配置命名了四个候选阈值，而部署文件选择的却并未实际生效），但可以从策略层在得分分布中留下的点质量（point masses）中恢复，因此记录级输出比参数表更能保证可复现性。第四，针对32.56%的请求调用（每次耗时2.51秒）的本地审查模型并未改变任何分类结果：它返回了90个非恶意判定，但策略层没有接纳其中任何一个，这使得该无效性成为一种保护设置而非模型属性。消融实验的结果并不令人意外——基于规则的层达到了61.05%的召回率，语义层达到了94.77%——正是这一点使得其他结果成为了论文的核心实质。
AI.summary: 该论文通过对MCP分层本地防御系统CASCADE的组件消融和语料库审计，探讨了评估选择（如聚合惯例、数据来源和配置透明度）对大模型防御性能评估的重大影响，指出了当前防御评估中普遍存在的不可比拟和复现难题。
AI.keywords: Model Context Protocol, Prompt Injection, Local Defense, Component Ablation, Corpus Audit
AI.comments: 该论文对模型上下文协议（MCP）的分层本地防御进行了深入的消融实验和语料库审计，揭示了评估指标、数据溯源、配置复现以及模型冗余等关键问题，对大语言模型安全防御领域具有重要的警示和指导意义。

title: RUBICON: Agentic AI for Messy Enterprise Data
summary:
Enterprise data exists in many forms, such as tables, text, maps, e-mail, and CAD models, that are access-controlled and hidden behind bespoke interfaces. Current agentic AI systems delegate the entire query workflow to a frontier LLM: a single model interprets the request, selects sources or tools, integrates retrieved evidence, judges completeness, and generates an answer, with few constraints, limited use of schemas, and text as the primary representation throughout. We argue that this is an ineffective abstraction for enterprise data. Reliable agentic AI should instead require structure: a constrained query interface over each source and a table-centric integration layer driven by a query processor. We introduce RUBICON, a system that embodies this vision.
  RUBICON is based on two observations. First, text-to-SQL fails on real enterprise data and must be dramatically subsetted to achieve reliable results. Second, data integration across disparate corporate datasets is best performed using tables as the core abstraction rather than text-centric LLM pipelines.
  We evaluate RUBICON on two benchmarks: our enterprise-focused RUBICON-Bench, against agentic baselines, and SemBench, against LOTUS and Palimpzest. On RUBICON-Bench, where queries require coordination across heterogeneous enterprise sources, RUBICON achieves 100% end-to-end accuracy, while all agentic baselines, including single- and multi-agent ReAct systems, produce no correct answers. On SemBench, RUBICON surpasses both LOTUS and Palimpzest: it achieves 14.7% higher accuracy, reduces latency by 62.64%, and lowers token cost by 98.64%, demonstrating that a table-centric architecture better matches enterprise data while yielding significant efficiency gains.

AI.title_translation: RUBICON：面向混乱企业数据的智能体AI
AI.tldr: RUBICON是一个智能体AI系统，通过结构化查询接口和以表格为中心的集成层处理混乱的企业数据，在企业基准测试中表现出100%的端到端准确性，并显著优于现有系统。
AI.motivation: 当前的智能体AI系统在处理企业数据时，将整个查询工作流委托给单一大型语言模型，这种方式效率低下且缺乏结构。企业数据形式多样、访问受控且隐藏在定制接口后，需要更可靠的结构化方法。
AI.method: RUBICON系统基于两个观察：1) 文本到SQL在真实企业数据上表现不佳，需要严格子集化；2) 跨不同企业数据集的数据集成最好以表格作为核心抽象而非以文本为中心的大型语言模型管道。RUBICON采用结构化查询接口处理每个数据源，并通过一个查询处理器驱动的以表格为中心的集成层来整合数据。
AI.result: RUBICON在企业数据基准测试RUBICON-Bench上实现了100%的端到端准确性，而所有基于ReAct的智能体基线系统均未产生正确答案。在SemBench上，RUBICON比LOTUS和Palimpzest的准确性高14.7%，延迟降低62.64%，令牌成本降低98.64%。
AI.conclusion: 以表格为中心的架构能更好地匹配企业数据，并带来显著的效率提升。RUBICON通过引入结构化查询接口和表格中心集成层，有效解决了处理混乱企业数据的挑战。
AI.translation:
企业数据以多种形式存在，例如表格、文本、地图、电子邮件和CAD模型，这些数据受访问控制并隐藏在定制接口之后。当前的智能体AI系统将整个查询工作流委托给一个前沿大型语言模型：单个模型解释请求、选择来源或工具、整合检索到的证据、判断完整性并生成答案，但约束很少，模式使用有限，并且文本是主要的表示形式。我们认为这对于企业数据来说是一种无效的抽象。可靠的智能体AI应该要求结构：每个来源上的受约束查询接口以及由查询处理器驱动的以表格为中心的集成层。我们引入了RUBICON，一个体现这一愿景的系统。
RUBICON基于两个观察。首先，文本到SQL在真实企业数据上失败，必须大幅度子集化才能获得可靠结果。其次，跨不同公司数据集的数据集成最好使用表格作为核心抽象而不是以文本为中心的大型语言模型管道。
我们在两个基准上评估了RUBICON：我们以企业为中心的RUBICON-Bench（对照智能体基线）和SemBench（对照LOTUS和Palimpzest）。在RUBICON-Bench上，查询需要跨异构企业来源进行协调，RUBICON实现了100%的端到端准确性，而所有智能体基线，包括单智能体和多智能体ReAct系统，均未产生正确答案。在SemBench上，RUBICON超越了LOTUS和Palimpzest：它实现了14.7%更高的准确性，将延迟降低了62.64%，并将令牌成本降低了98.64%，表明以表格为中心的架构更好地匹配企业数据，同时带来了显著的效率提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出了RUBICON系统，一个用于处理混乱企业数据的智能体AI。针对现有智能体AI系统在处理多样化企业数据时效率低下且缺乏结构的问题，RUBICON引入了结构化的查询接口和以表格为中心的数据集成层。它基于文本到SQL在真实企业数据上的局限性以及表格作为数据集成核心抽象的优势。实验结果表明，RUBICON在企业级基准测试RUBICON-Bench上实现了100%的端到端准确性，并在SemBench上显著优于现有系统，展示了其在准确性、延迟和成本方面的优势，证明了以表格为中心的架构在企业数据处理中的有效性和高效性。
AI.keywords: 智能体AI, 企业数据, 数据集成, 表格中心架构, 结构化查询
AI.comments: RUBICON的创新点在于其以结构化和表格为中心的方法来处理复杂的企业数据，这与当前依赖单一LLM进行整个工作流的智能体AI系统形成对比。通过强调结构化查询和表格作为核心抽象，它解决了现有方法在准确性和效率上的局限性。在企业级基准测试中取得100%的准确性是其重要性的有力证明，这表明其在实际应用中具有很高的可靠性。该研究为未来智能体AI在企业数据管理领域的应用提供了新的思路和解决方案。

title: Towards Universal Tabular Embeddings: A Benchmark Across Data Tasks
summary: Tabular foundation models aim to learn universal representations of tabular data that transfer across tasks and domains, enabling applications such as table retrieval, semantic search and table-based prediction. Despite the growing number of such models, it remains unclear which approach works best in practice, as existing methods are often evaluated under task-specific settings that make direct comparison difficult. To address this, we introduce TEmBed, the Tabular Embedding Test Bed, a unified benchmark for systematically evaluating tabular embeddings across four representation levels: cell, row, column, and table. Evaluating a diverse set of tabular representation learning models, we show that which model to use depends on the task and representation level. Our results offer practical guidance for selecting tabular embeddings in real-world applications and lay the groundwork for developing more general-purpose tabular representation models.

AI.title_translation: 迈向通用表格嵌入：跨数据任务的基准测试
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了TEmBed基准测试，用于评估不同表格嵌入模型在不同表示层级（单元格、行、列、表）上的表现，发现模型选择取决于具体任务和层级，为实际应用提供指导。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型在特定任务下进行评估，难以直接比较，导致不清楚哪种方法在实践中效果最好。
AI.method: 引入TEmBed（表格嵌入测试平台），一个统一的基准测试，用于系统地评估表格嵌入模型在单元格、行、列和表四个表示层级上的表现。
AI.result: 评估了多种表格表示学习模型，结果表明，模型的选择取决于任务和表示层级。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为了解如何在实际应用中选择表格嵌入提供了实用的指导，并为开发更通用的表格表示模型奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 表格基础模型旨在学习通用的表格数据表示，这些表示可以跨任务和领域进行迁移，从而实现诸如表检索、语义搜索和基于表的预测等应用。尽管这类模型数量不断增长，但目前尚不清楚哪种方法在实践中效果最好，因为现有方法通常在特定任务的设置下进行评估，这使得直接比较变得困难。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了TEmBed（表格嵌入测试平台），一个统一的基准测试，用于系统地评估表格嵌入在单元格、行、列和表四个表示层级上的表现。通过评估各种表格表示学习模型，我们发现使用哪种模型取决于任务和表示层级。我们的研究结果为了解如何在实际应用中选择表格嵌入提供了实用的指导，并为开发更通用的表格表示模型奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了TEmBed基准测试，以解决表格基础模型评估不一致的问题。TEmBed在一个统一的框架下，跨越单元格、行、列和表四个层级，对多种表格嵌入模型进行了系统评估。研究发现，最佳模型的选择与具体任务和所关注的表示层级密切相关，为实际应用中的模型选择提供了指导，并促进了通用表格表示模型的发展。
AI.keywords: 表格嵌入,表示学习,基准测试,TEmBed,通用表示
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入TEmBed基准测试，有效地解决了表格表示学习领域中缺乏统一评估标准的问题。其最大的贡献在于提供了一个系统性的评估框架，能够跨越不同的表示层级和任务，为研究人员和实践者提供了宝贵的见解。研究结果表明，没有一种“万能”的表格嵌入模型，模型的选择需要根据具体应用场景进行权衡，这强调了领域适应性和任务导向性在模型设计中的重要性。未来，可以基于TEmBed进一步探索更鲁棒、更具泛化能力的表格表示学习方法，并将其应用于更广泛的下游任务。

title: When Chain-of-Thought Fails, the Solution Hides in the Hidden States
comments: To appear in Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Whether intermediate reasoning is computationally useful or merely explanatory depends on whether chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens contain task-relevant information. We present a mechanistic causal analysis of CoT on GSM8K using activation patching: transferring token-level hidden states from a CoT generation to a direct-answer run for the same question, then measuring the effect on final-answer accuracy. Across models, generating after patching yields substantially higher accuracy than both direct-answer prompting and the original CoT trace, revealing that individual CoT tokens can encode sufficient information to recover the correct answer, even when the original trace is incorrect. This task-relevant information is more prevalent in correct than incorrect CoT runs and is unevenly distributed across tokens, concentrating in mid-to-late layers and appearing earlier in the reasoning trace. Moreover, patching language tokens such as verbs and entities carry task-solving information that steers generation toward correct reasoning, whereas mathematical tokens encode answer-proximal content that rarely succeeds. Patched outputs are often shorter and yet exceed the accuracy of a full CoT trace, suggesting complete reasoning chains are not always necessary. Together, these findings demonstrate that CoT encodes recoverable, token-level problem-solving information, offering new insight into how reasoning is represented and where it breaks down.
comment: To appear in Findings of EMNLP 2026

AI.title_translation: 当思维链失败时，解决方案隐藏在隐藏状态中
AI.tldr: 思维链（CoT）生成的中间推理步骤包含可恢复的任务相关信息，即使原始推理链不正确，也能通过激活修复来提高最终答案的准确性。这些信息分布不均，主要集中在中后期层，并且语言标记比数学标记包含更多解决问题的有效信息。
AI.motivation: 判断思维链（CoT）的中间推理是否在计算上有用，或者仅仅是解释性的，关键在于CoT的token是否包含任务相关信息。
AI.method: 使用激活修复（activation patching）对GSM8K数据集上的CoT进行机械因果分析：将CoT生成过程中的token级隐藏状态转移到同一问题的直接答案运行中，然后测量最终答案的准确性。
AI.result: 激活修复后的生成比直接答案提示和原始CoT追踪具有更高的准确性。正确的CoT运行比不正确的CoT运行包含更多的任务相关信息，且信息分布不均，集中在中后期层。语言标记（如动词和实体）包含解决问题的有效信息，而数学标记则包含很少成功的答案相关内容。修复后的输出通常更短，但准确性超过完整的CoT追踪。
AI.conclusion: CoT编码了可恢复的、token级别的解决问题信息，这为理解推理的表征方式及其失败机制提供了新的视角。完整的推理链并非总是必需的。
AI.translation: 中间推理在计算上是否有用，还是仅仅是解释性的，取决于链式思考（CoT）的token是否包含任务相关信息。我们通过激活修复对GSM8K上的CoT进行了机械因果分析：将CoT生成过程中的token级隐藏状态转移到同一问题的直接答案运行中，然后测量最终答案的准确性。在各种模型上，修复后的生成比直接答案提示和原始CoT追踪都具有显著更高的准确性，这表明即使原始追踪不正确，单个CoT token也包含足够的信息来恢复正确答案。这种任务相关信息在正确的CoT运行中比在不正确的CoT运行中更普遍，并且在token之间分布不均，集中在中后期层，并且在推理追踪中更早出现。此外，修复语言标记（如动词和实体）可以传递解决问题的有效信息，从而引导生成走向正确的推理，而数学标记则编码了很少成功的答案相关内容。修复后的输出通常更短，但准确性超过了完整的CoT追踪，这表明完整的推理链并非总是必需的。总之，这些发现表明CoT编码了可恢复的、token级别的解决问题信息，为理解推理的表征方式及其失败机制提供了新的见解。
AI.summary: 本研究通过激活修复技术，揭示了链式思考（CoT）生成的中间token隐藏状态中蕴含着可恢复的、对解决任务至关重要的信息。即使原始的CoT推理路径存在错误，通过将这些隐藏状态信息迁移到直接答案生成过程中，也能显著提高答案的准确性。研究发现，这些关键信息并非均匀分布，而是集中在中后期模型层，并且语言类标记比数学类标记更能引导正确的推理过程。这表明，完整的CoT推理链并非总是必要，其核心的解题信息可能被压缩在特定的token中。
AI.keywords: 链式思考, 激活修复, 隐藏状态, 推理机制, 信息表征
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地运用激活修复技术，深入探究了CoT机制的内在工作原理，揭示了中间生成状态中蕴含的丰富信息。研究结果不仅挑战了“CoT仅为解释性”的观点，也为理解和改进大型语言模型的推理能力提供了新的方向，尤其是在处理复杂问题和提高模型鲁棒性方面具有重要意义。然而，该方法在不同模型和任务上的普适性仍需进一步验证。

title: RCProb: Probabilistic rule extraction from classification tree ensembles
comments: Figure 1 improved; supersedes v2. 52 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to ESWA
summary: Tree ensembles provide strong classification performance but usually behave as black-box models. Post-hoc interpretability techniques such as RuleCOSI+ extract a small ruleset that approximates the ensemble, but this simplification can leave the probabilities attached to the extracted rules unreliable. In particular, RuleCOSI+ assigns empirical class probabilities to the extracted rules and repeatedly uses those rule statistics during its greedy combination and simplification procedure. We present RCProb, a probabilistic extension that uses smoothed atomic class-conditional evidence for the expensive search stages and a support-adaptive mixture with an ensemble-informed m-estimate for the final rule probabilities. The method is evaluated on 18 binary and 5 multiclass datasets using random forest (RF) and gradient boosting machine (GBM) ensembles. Relative to RuleCOSI+, the median paired log-loss reduction is 71.9% for RF and 62.5% for GBM, with both differences remaining significant after Holm correction. The number of rules decreases by 38.7% for RF and 38.5% for GBM, while the primary tests do not detect a macro-F1 difference. Confidence-ECE also decreases for both ensembles, with statistical support for RF after correction. A separate controlled experiment with dedicated calibration data shows that native RCProb probabilities are competitive with RuleCOSI+ followed by temperature scaling, although additional post-hoc calibration can still improve RCProb. The results show that probability estimation is an important part of rule extraction and not only a post-processing step.

title: h-Adaptive FV Subcell Shock-Capturing for DGSEM on Heterogeneous Curvilinear Meshes
summary: High-order methods offer superior dispersion and dissipation properties compared to low-order schemes but require robust stabilization for discontinuities. To ensure stability, local artificial viscosity is common, but often degrades sub-element resolution. Conversely, subcell resolution preserving limiting strategies such as the finite volume subcell method are typically restricted to uniform topologies, such as purely hexahedral or simplex meshes, or linear elements. This leaves a significant gap in treating the hybrid-element topologies necessary for complex engineering geometries. To bridge this gap, we introduce a robust shock-capturing approach for the discontinuous Galerkin spectral element method on mixed curvilinear meshes containing hexahedral, prismatic, tetrahedral, and pyramid elements. Non-hexahedral elements are handled via collapsed coordinate transformations. The proposed method utilizes an $h$-adaptive finite volume subcell scheme with an arbitrary subcell resolution up to $2\mathcal{N}+1$. Special care is taken to ensure conforming subcell distributions across different element types. Crucially, discrete conservation is proven theoretically and verified numerically, alongside validations for high-order convergence and robust shock capturing. Finally, the method's applicability to complex configurations is demonstrated through a simulation of the flow around a NACA 0012 airfoil.

title: Selfie-Capture Dynamics as an Auxiliary Signal Against Deepfakes and Injection Attacks for Mobile Identity Verification
summary: Mobile remote identity verification (RIdV) systems are exposed to attacks that manipulate or replace the facial video stream, including presentation attacks, real-time deepfakes, and video injection. Recent European requirements, including ETSI TS 119 461 and CEN/TS 18099, motivate evidence channels beyond camera-based presentation-attack detection. This paper studies whether passive motion traces recorded during selfie capture provide auxiliary evidence for spoof screening and user verification. We introduce CanSelfie, a dataset of 375 bona fide multi-sensor sequences collected at 50 Hz from 30 participants using a commercial mobile RIdV application, together with stationary, handheld, and temporally shifted attack-proxy scenarios. We benchmark 7 multivariate time-series classifiers and 8 whole-series anomaly detectors across sensor configurations and temporal windows. For spoof screening, accelerometer-only ROCKAD obtains 0.00% FRR and 43.8% FAR, while QUANT+3-NN obtains the lowest FAR of 32.0% at 2.37% FRR; both reject all stationary proxies. For same-device and same-session user verification, WEASEL+MUSE reaches 1.07% EER using 9 channels. Raw acceleration is the most informative modality, and closed-set accuracy alone does not imply good verification because threshold calibration depends on score distributions. The findings support selfie-capture motion as a low-friction auxiliary signal, while leaving cross-device, cross-session, and real injection-attack evaluation as necessary next steps. Code and data available at: https://github.com/Ergzar/Selfie-Motion-AD-TSC.

title: Sim-FA: A GPGPU Simulator Framework for Fine-Grained Asynchronous Pipeline Analysis

summary:
To efficiently support Large Language Models (LLMs), modern GPGPU architectures have introduced new features and programming paradigms, such as warp specialization. These features enable temporal overlap between the producer and consumer, as well as between matrix multiplication and activation function operations, substantially improving performance. To conduct effective AI infrastructure and computer architecture research, cycle-accurate simulators that support these new features, together with analytical models that faithfully capture workload characteristics, are essential.
  However, existing academic tools provide limited support for these emerging requirements. Existing cycle-accurate simulators do not incorporate new NVIDIA GPU features, such as the Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA), in a timely manner. Moreover, existing analytical models can misestimate DRAM traffic under certain configurations.
  In this paper, we build Sim-FA, a cycle-accurate simulation framework for Hopper TMA/WGMMA pipelines. We first develop an operator-agnostic trace frontend that instruments kernels at the Triton TTGIR level and validates it on 23 GEMM shapes, achieving 5.49\% MAPE against H800, confirming that the simulator core is not tied to any single operator. Because FlashAttention-3 introduces additional complexity beyond standard TMA/WGMMA kernels (asymmetric producer-consumer pipelines, softmax, ping-pong synchronization), we further build an FA3-specialized frontend that achieves 5.7\% MAPE with a maximum error of 12.7\%. Within the same framework, SimFA-python serves as an analytical fast path for large-scale design-space exploration where cycle-accurate simulation is prohibitively slow; validated against cuTile kernels on Blackwell (GB10), it explains why existing analytical models can produce inaccurate traffic estimates.

title: Beyond Decodability: Reconstructing Language Model Representations with an Encoding Probe
summary: Probing is widely used to study which features can be decoded from language model representations. However, the common decoding probe approach has two limitations that we aim to solve with our new encoding probe approach: contributions of different features to model representations cannot be directly compared, and feature correlations can affect probing results. We present an Encoding Probe that reverses this direction and reconstructs internal representations of models using interpretable features. We evaluate this method on text and speech transformer models, using feature sets spanning acoustics, phonetics, syntax, lexicon, and speaker identity. Our results suggest that speaker-related effects vary strongly across different training objectives and datasets, while syntactic and lexical features contribute independently to reconstruction. These results show that the Encoding Probe provides a complementary perspective on interpreting model representations beyond decodability.

title: Univalence without function extensionality
summary: It is a well-known theorem of homotopy type theory, originally due to Voevodsky, that function extensionality holds inside any univalent universe. We consider a weaker variant of the univalence axiom, asserting that the wild category formed by the universe is univalent, which we call categorical univalence. We show that categorical univalence does not imply function extensionality by an analysis of Von Glehn's polynomial model construction, which produces models of Martin-Löf type theory that always refute function extensionality. We find in particular that when the base model has a univalent universe, its polynomial model has a universe that is categorically univalent but lacks function extensionality.

title: AEGIS: Risk-Budgeted Online Scheduling for Resilient Continuous Edge Inference
comments: This paper has been submitted to a conference
summary: Continuous edge inference requires sustained wireless and computing support across successive service instances. Under recurring channel degradation, transient edge overload, and multi-user contention, isolated deadline misses may accumulate into persistent service degradation. Existing schedulers mainly optimize instantaneous latency or per-timeslot utility and provide limited control over such cross-time effects. To address this issue, we propose AEGIS (Adaptive Exposure-Governed Inference Scheduling), a risk-budgeted online framework for service-level operational resilience. AEGIS regulates predicted deadline-risk exposure through dynamically replenished per-user risk budgets and establishes an explicit finite-horizon bound on cumulative admitted-risk exposure. One-step state estimation supports anticipatory delay and risk assessment, while the centralized bandwidth--computing allocation is transformed into an exact-potential formulation and solved through asynchronous coordinate updates. Simulation results demonstrate that AEGIS enhances timely-service continuity, contains persistent deadline violations, and improves post-stress recovery through adaptive cross-time risk regulation. Meanwhile, it effectively controls predicted-risk exposure while preserving competitive service performance, achieving a favorable balance between service resilience and risk control.

title: Set-like operations on propositional logic programs
summary: Composition and decomposition of logic programs have been studied extensively in the context of modularity, and decomposing a program along the dependency structure of its atoms --- by strata or strongly connected components in datalog, and by splitting sets in the non-monotonic setting of answer set programming --- is standard practice. All of these approaches operate on the level of rule sets: programs are cut along dependencies between atoms, while the internal structure of the individual rules remains untouched. In this paper, we complement this picture by a finer-grained algebra. We introduce set-like operations on (propositional Horn) logic programs --- body-union, body-intersection, body-complement, body-subtraction, body-symmetric-difference, and body-power-set --- which manipulate rule bodies in analogy to the corresponding set operations, and we study their algebraic laws and their interaction with sequential composition and the least model semantics. Our main technical result is a decomposition theorem in this algebra: every minimalist program --- containing at most one rule for each rule head --- is the body-union of Krom programs consisting only of rules with at most one body atom, in such a way that its least model is the intersection of the least models of these components; for arbitrary programs we obtain corresponding approximations. Since Krom programs are algebraically better behaved than arbitrary programs --- composition is associative and distributes from the left --- this may support decomposition-based reasoning and provides a basis for compositional program construction.

title: Entropy and Distributed Source Coding of Connected Soft Random Geometric Graphs
comments: Full version of paper accepted to ITW 2026
summary: We consider the distributed compression of Soft Random Geometric Graphs (SRGGs) above the connectivity threshold. We establish the Slepian-Wolf rate region for the SRGG in the setting where there are a finite number of encoders compressing sections of the graph independently. To do so, we prove novel limit theorems and asymptotic equipartition properties for the SRGG and its entropy, which allow us to use random binning techniques for distributed compression.

title: Traffic Chunk Sizing vs. Optical Switching Speed in Future All-Optical Satellite Networks
comments: we found some wrong parts after it was reviewed
summary: To enable efficient resource utilization under stringent Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) constraints through transparent and all-optical switched satellites transmission, various switching paradigms can be considered, including packet, burst, or circuit. To this end, the traffic assembly and algorithmic design for path computations at the ground stations play a key role in determining the switching fabric design. Generally, traffic can be buffered and assembled in chunks at the ground stations and forwarded over the pre-computed optical path in space, similar to terrestrial optical burst switching or fast circuit switching. Regardless of the chosen paradigm, the switching fabric must satisfy specific latency performance requirements. This paper studies the performance of all-optical satellite networks based on the maximum traffic chunk sizes that can be scheduled and the performance of optical switching fabrics in the future over all-optical constellations. We consider various optical switching technologies, including MEMS- and integrated photonic-based solutions, in the context of switching speed, power consumption, and insertion loss. Simulation results indicate that traffic chunk size critically impacts the performance required by optical switching fabrics onboard a satellite.

title: Sealing the Audit-Runtime Gap for LLM Skills
summary: Large language model (LLM) ecosystems such as Claude Code and ChatGPT increasingly rely on skills: packages of natural-language instructions and executable tools. Once in the LLM's context, skill content cannot be reliably separated from trusted instructions, and a skill's executable side can invoke privileged actions, exposing the skill supply chain to injection, tampering, and rug-pull attacks. Existing defenses are stage-bound: centralized signing, audit reports unbound from the runtime artifact, or policy engines that cannot attest to what was approved. We present SIGIL, the first framework that seals the audit-runtime gap for LLM skills. SIGIL delivers verifiable hosting through a tamper-evident, decentralized on-chain registry from which LLMs fetch skills directly. The registry admits four publication types, Transparent, Licensed, Sealed, and Committed, spanning plaintext public distribution, monetized access, custodial use, and off-chain workflows; before admission, every skill is vetted by a Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) audit committee that supports pluggable auditing methods under a stake-and-slash economic model. At load time, SIGIL delivers verified loading through a skill verification protocol executed by a Skill Verification Loader (SVL) embedded as the mandatory loading path: the SVL retrieves and decrypts the skill as its type requires, verifies its integrity against the on-chain record, and enforces its permission manifest before context injection. We evaluate SIGIL on a real-world deployment against 1,023 in-the-wild skills spanning six attack types. At load time, the SVL verifies each skill's integrity against its on-chain record and enforces its approved permission manifest, completing batched verification under 86 ms. Together, these results show that LLM skills can be cryptographically bound from publication through runtime at practical cost.

title: Causal Probing for Internal Visual Representations in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Despite the remarkable success of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) across diverse tasks, the internal mechanisms governing how they encode and ground distinct visual concepts remain poorly understood. To unravel these mechanisms, we propose a causal framework based on activation steering to actively probe and manipulate internal visual representations. Through systematic intervention across four visual concept categories, our results reveal a divergence in concept encoding: entity knowledge is distinctively localized, whereas abstract concepts are globally distributed across the network. Critically, this divergence uncovers a mechanistic driver of scaling laws: increasing model depth is indispensable for encoding distributed and complex abstract concepts, whereas entities maintain a consistently high degree of localization. Furthermore, reverse steering uncovers that blocking explicit output triggers a surge in latent activations, exposing a compensatory mechanism between perception and generation. Finally, by extending our analysis to visual reasoning, we expose a disconnect between perception and reasoning: although MLLMs successfully recognize geometric relations, they treat them merely as static visual features, failing to trigger the procedural execution necessary for solving problems.

title: Beyond Reproducibility: Towards Security-Aware Evaluation of Research Artifacts
summary: Research artifacts are widely shared to support reproducibility, and artifact evaluation (AE) has become common at many leading conferences. However, AE mainly checks whether artifacts work as claimed and can be reproduced. It does not aim at spotting or mitigitating potential security risks. Since these artifacts are publicly released and reused, they may unintentionally create opportunities for misuse and raise concerns about safe and responsible sharing. We study 1,388 research artifacts published between 2023 and 2025 at the top-4 security conferences, perform static analysis, and obtain 132,431 candidate security findings. We propose a taxonomy for context-aware security assessment and examine the findings to filter false positives and identify findings that represent plausible context-dependent security risks. We find that 44.80% of the reviewed findings are security-relevant. To support scalable analysis, we present SAFE (Security-Aware Framework for Artifact Evaluation), an autonomous framework that assesses tool-reported findings based on code semantics, execution context, and practical exploitability. SAFE achieves 94.40% accuracy and a 93.60% F1-score in distinguishing security-relevant from non-security findings, and 92.40% accuracy and an 81.10% F1-score in classifying security-risk types. Overall, our results show that context-aware security assessment is a practical complement to existing AE processes and can support safer and more responsible research artifact sharing. The source code for SAFE is available at: https://github.com/nanda-rani/SAFE

title: Observation-Aligned Two-Stage Domain Decomposition for Physics-Informed Traffic State Estimation with Sparse Fixed Sensors
comments: 52 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables. Revised after peer review and accepted for publication in Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies. The title and method name were updated, with additional classical TSE comparisons, sensitivity and component analyses, and decomposition-direction evaluation
summary: Traffic state estimation from sparse fixed sensors is challenging because physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) tend to over-smooth sharp transitions admitted by the Lighthill-Whitham--Richards (LWR) model. This study proposes Two-Stage Domain Decomposition Physics-Informed Neural Networks (TSDD-PINN), an observation-aligned framework for LWR-based offline speed-field reconstruction. The framework supports spatial, temporal, and space--time refinement. Matched direction analysis shows that spatial refinement has the lowest mean error and less than half the training time of space--time refinement in the tested setting, while temporal refinement is faster. A global parent PINN is first trained. In the controlled spatial implementation, its residual profile guides a deterministic partition for warm-started child networks. An optional operational safeguard retains Stage~1 when the prespecified screen does not activate. The primary I-24 MOTION evaluation spans five days, five sensor configurations, and ten seeds per configuration, yielding 1{,}500 runs. Controlled TSDD-PINN attains the lowest relative $L_2$ error in 18 of 25 configurations and 14 of 15 sparse-sensing cases, while training 2.4 times faster than the extended PINN (XPINN) baseline under the evaluated implementations and training budgets. Non-neural comparisons show that the advantage over interpolation is concentrated under sparse sensing, whereas dense sensing often favors interpolation. A separate 250-run operational evaluation finds infrequent activation and motivates the Stage-1-preserving safeguard. The residual is treated as an indicator of model difficulty rather than a validated shock detector. The evidence supports a sensing-density-dependent operating range rather than uniform improvement.

title: How Much Do Circuits Tell Us? Measuring the Consistency and Specificity of Language Model Circuits
summary: The circuits framework in mechanistic interpretability aims to identify sparse subgraphs of model components that are causally responsible for a behavior, typically evaluated by measuring necessity and sufficiency. But these criteria say little about whether a circuit consistently captures how a model performs a task, or if it is specific to that task. We study these two properties, consistency and specificity, across six tasks and five models, extracting circuits at the component level (attention heads and MLP blocks) and at the level of individual MLP neurons. We find that component-level circuits are highly consistent and causally important on most tasks, but they are not specific: ablating one task's circuit damages another task's performance about as much as that task's own circuit does. Neuron-level circuits, on the other hand, exhibit higher task-specificity but are far less consistent within tasks. This is explained by circuit overlap: component-level circuits share most of their components across all task pairs, related or not, while neuron-level circuits overlap only between closely related tasks. In a case study of the components shared by the task circuits of Llama-3.2-3B, we show that they consist mostly of MLP blocks, while the few attention heads within turn out to be generic attention-sink heads. Overall, our findings raise questions about the degree to which circuits can support targeted understanding of, and intervention on, model behavior.

title: Computer Science Conferences Should Require Nonrepudiable Experimental Results
summary: This position paper argues that computer science conferences should require tamper-evident, nonrepudiable attestations of experimental results. We name the underlying problem experiment nonrepudiation: a compliant protocol must bind the numbers in a paper to an actual executed computation in a way the author cannot later alter or deny. The current system relies on self-reported checklists, optional code sharing, and author-controlled logging. None of these mechanisms answer the question a reviewer cannot check: did the code the paper describes produce the numbers the paper reports? We define the problem formally, state the security properties any compliant protocol must satisfy, and describe a threat model that includes attacks current approaches do not prevent. We frame the mechanism that provides this property as a proof-of-compute layer, a general requirement that computed results be admitted as evidence only when accompanied by a verifiable record of the computation that produced them. To show that the problem is solvable, we built K-Veritas, a reference implementation in Go that produces signed reports without accessing training data. K-Veritas is a testbed, not a finished answer. We call on conferences and the community to treat nonrepudiation as a major requirement and to help build an open, independent standard for it.

title: Sparse Signal Recovery Using Log-Sum Regularization and Adaptive Smoothing
summary: We study sparse signal recovery from noisy linear observations using nonconvex log-sum regularization. The log-sum penalty reduces the shrinkage bias of $\ell_1$ regularization and more closely approximates the $\ell_0$ regularization, but its nonconvexity can make reconstruction algorithms unstable. To mitigate this instability, we use an adaptive smoothing strategy that determines the smoothing parameter so that the scalar proximal operator remains continuous. Using this proximal operator, we formulate the approximate message passing (AMP) algorithm and derive the corresponding state evolution (SE) recursion. The fixed point of the SE recursion predicts the final mean squared error (MSE) and, in the noiseless limit, the exact-recovery phase transition. To further investigate finite-dimensional reconstruction behavior, we implement an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) algorithm. In the noiseless setting, we find that the empirical success boundary of ADMM closely agrees with the SE-predicted phase transition. In the noisy setting, we observe that AMP closely follows the SE prediction, whereas ADMM qualitatively reproduces the SE-predicted dependence of the final MSE on the regularization parameter. A comparison with $\ell_1$ regularization shows that log-sum regularization is beneficial in low-density or high-measurement-rate regimes, whereas $\ell_1$ regularization remains preferable at higher densities and lower measurement rates.

title: ASIP-Planner: Adaptive Planning for UAV Surface Inspection in Partially Known Indoor Environments
summary: Indoor infrastructure inspection, such as tunnels and industrial facilities, requires systematic surface coverage to ensure that all inspection targets are properly observed. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) offer an alternative to manual inspection by conducting map-guided surface inspection using prior structural models. However, in practice, indoor inspection often relies on floorplan-derived reference maps that may not reflect unforeseen obstacles, such as temporary structures or equipment, leading to occluded viewpoints and degraded inspection quality. Existing coverage planning methods typically assume a fully known inspection environment and perform deterministic global viewpoint optimization based on accurate prior maps, making them vulnerable to environmental discrepancies during execution. This work presents an adaptive UAV inspection framework for partially known structured indoor environments. The proposed method integrates a segment-based global coverage planner with an inspection-oriented local view-angle adaptation module. The global planner organizes planar inspection targets into surface-aligned clusters to generate compact viewpoint sequences with improved orientation consistency. The local planner generates collision-free trajectories and adjusts the viewing direction online to mitigate occlusion-induced coverage loss while preserving the planned trajectory structure. The simulation results across randomized scene configurations demonstrate that the proposed global planner achieves near-complete coverage while reducing trajectory length compared to representative baselines. Real-world flight experiments further validate that the framework produces usable inspection data for downstream analysis. These results indicate that the proposed framework improves inspection efficiency and adaptability in partially known structured indoor environments.

title: Towards Affordable Energy: A Gymnasium Environment for Electric Utility Demand-Response Programs
summary: Extreme weather and volatile wholesale electricity markets expose residential consumers to catastrophic financial risks, yet demand response at the distribution level remains an underutilized tool for grid flexibility and energy affordability. While a demand-response program can shield consumers by issuing financial credits during high-price periods, optimizing this sequential decision-making process presents a unique challenge for reinforcement learning despite the plentiful offline historical smart meter and wholesale pricing data available publicly. Offline historical data fails to capture the dynamic, interactive feedback loop between an electric utility's pricing signals and customer acceptance and adaptation to a demand-response program. To address this, we introduce DR-Gym, an open-source, online Gymnasium-compatible environment designed to train and evaluate demand-response from the electric utility's perspective. Unlike existing device-level energy simulators, our environment focuses on the market-level electric utility setting and provides a rich observational space relevant to the electric utility. The simulator additionally features a regime-switching wholesale price model calibrated to real-world extreme events, alongside physics-based building demand profiles. For our learning signal, we use a configurable, multi-objective reward function for specifying diverse learning objectives. We demonstrate through baseline strategies and data snapshots the capability of our simulator to create realistic and learnable environments.

title: Identifying AI Web Scrapers Using Canary Tokens
summary: From pre-training to query-time augmentation, web-scraped data helps to improve the quality and contextual relevancy of content generated by large language models (LLMs). However, large-scale web scraping to feed LLMs can affect site stability and raise legal, privacy, or ethics concerns. If website owners wish to limit LLM-related web scraping on their site, due to these or other concerns, they may turn to scraper access control mechanisms like the Robots Exclusion Protocol. To be most effective, such mechanisms require site owners to first identify the scrapers that they wish to restrict (e.g., via User-Agent strings). Existing mechanisms to identify LLM-related scrapers rely on voluntary disclosure by companies, one-off experiments by researchers, or crowd-sourced reports -- methods that are neither reliable nor scalable. This paper proposes a novel technique for accurately and automatically inferring LLM-related scrapers. We host dynamic websites that serve unique canary tokens to each visiting scraper, then prompt LLMs for information about our sites. If an LLM consistently generates outputs containing tokens unique to a scraper, it provides evidence of exposure to that scraper. Via experiments across 22 production LLM systems, we demonstrate that our approach can reliably identify which scrapers feed which LLM, including several that are not publicly known or disclosed by the companies. Our approach provides a promising avenue for unprivileged third parties to infer which scrapers serve data to which LLMs, potentially enabling better control over unwanted scraping.

title: Generating HDR Video from SDR Video
summary: The high dynamic range (HDR) video ecosystem is approaching maturity, but the problem of upconverting legacy standard dynamic range (SDR) videos persists without a convincing solution. We propose a framework for HDR video synthesis from casual SDR footage by leveraging large-scale generative video models. We introduce a Multi-Exposure Video Model (MEVM) that can predict exposure-bracketed linear SDR video sequences from a single nonlinear SDR video input. We further propose a learnable Video Merging Model (VMM) that merges the predicted exposure-bracketed video into a high-quality HDR sequence while preserving detail in both shadows and highlights. Extensive experiments, quantitative and qualitative evaluation, and a user study demonstrate that our approach enables robust HDR conversion for in-the-wild examples from casual consumer videos and even iconic films. Finally, our model can support HDR synthesis pipelines built upon existing SDR generative video models. Output HDR videos can be viewed on our supplementary webpage: sdr2hdrvideo.github.io

title: Deep-Research Agents Can Be Poisoned via User-Generated Content
summary:
Deep-research agents are an alternative to conventional Web search. They use multi-agent pipelines to issue multiple Web searches related to user queries, retrieve relevant content from the answers, and generate detailed, evidence-based reports.
  We show that for many common search topics (including financial, medical, and product recommendations), agent-generated reports are consistently based on the same user-generated content (UGC) pages from platforms such as Reddit and Wikipedia. This retrieval overlap, combined with lax moderation and access controls for UGC, is an opportunity for subversion: an attacker who appends a short text to a single, frequently-retrieved page can cause agents to cite this text and promote attacker-chosen entities across many user questions.
  We evaluate this attack on representative deep-research systems across multiple topics, such as investment advice, antivirus software, restaurant recommendations, etc. Poisoning a single URL with as few as 13 words can be sufficient for the attacker's content to be retrieved in 57-76% of the agent executions for a given topic and cited in 38-51% of the generated reports. A more aggressive attack (poisoning an entire subreddit) achieves 30-53% citation rates even when the poison is only 0.5-4% of the retrieved content. The attacker does not need to know the phrasing of the user's question, nor the specific Web queries generated by the agent, nor the agent's internal retrieval and generation mechanisms.
  We then study defenses at different stages of the pipeline, including source-level filtering and output-based detection. Dropping UGC from retrieved content blocks the attack but degrades the quality of generated reports. We show that lightweight anomaly detection on inputs and outputs does not reliably identify poisoned content, nor the results of poisoning.

title: The Age of Curiosity Meets the Age of AI: Benchmarking Child Safety in Large Language Models
summary: Children increasingly have access to Large Language Models (LLMs), which may expose them to responses that are developmentally inappropriate or require age-sensitive safety, guidance, and boundaries. Existing LLM safety evaluations largely focus on general harmful-content avoidance and do not explicitly target child-facing safety. We introduce KIDBench, a benchmark for evaluating child-facing LLM safety for ages 7-11 using a LLM-as-a-Judge rubric grounded in developmental-psychology. KIDBench contains realistic child queries across ten categories, with single-turn prompts and multi-turn child-actor simulations. We compare no-cues prompts with no child context, implicit-cues prompts that suggest a child speaker, and explicit age instructions. Implicit-cues improve scores by 8.6-46.8% over no-cue, while explicit age provides an additional 9.9-30.4% improvement over implicit-cues. Cross-lingual and cultural evaluations show uneven safety behavior across languages and country contexts. Multi-turn simulations show peak quality drops of up to 0.959 points on the 1-5 scale. We also introduce KIDGuardLlama, a child-safety evaluator, and KIDLlama, a child-safe response model. Code, data, and evaluation resources are available at https://github.com/MichiganNLP/kidbench.

title: The Timing Dependencies of Trust: Speed, Accuracy, and cBCI Neuro-Decoupling in Human-AI Teams
comments: Work superceded by major revision, https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02436 Request by former authors to not be included on this paper. Please remove. Many Thanks
summary: The speed and accuracy of an artificial teammate fundamentally alter the failure states of Human-AI integration. While high-speed AI interventions risk inducing reflexive blind compliance, delayed interventions can induce ambiguous cognitive conflict. This study investigates how the fundamental characteristics of an in-task AI assistant, Fast/Less-Accurate (FLA-AI) versus Slow/Accurate (SA-AI) impact the synergy of Collaborative Brain-Computer Interface (cBCI) teams in a Virtual Reality drone task. Seventeen operators completed continuous search tasks under high cognitive workload while their spatial covariance was mapped using a 2D Adaptive Riemannian Oracle. The results mathematically demonstrate that AI timing dictates the mechanism of team failure. Fast AI induced instant, blind compliance; human accuracy under deception collapsed to 50.2%, and pure behavioural teams (N=8) failed to scale beyond 74.1%. In contrast, Slow AI induced delayed cognitive conflict; humans hesitated (61.1% accuracy), but N=8 behavioural teams eventually recovered to 100.0%. Crucially, the Riemannian Oracle mathematically adapted to these states: it heavily restricted temporal windows (< 0.8s) to intercept fast reflexive compliance, while widening windows (> 1.2s) to capture delayed cognitive conflict. Integrating these isolated veridical signals via Hybrid Fusion successfully rescued the Fast AI team (+7.6% at N=8) and significantly accelerated the recovery of smaller Slow AI teams (+6.9% at N=4). These findings prove that cBCI synergy is heavily contingent on the temporal dynamics of trust, providing a critical framework for designing dynamically gated Human-AI systems.

title: Is Position Bias in Dense Retrievers Built In-or Learned from Data?
summary: Dense retrievers exhibit positional bias, favoring documents whose query-relevant information appears near the beginning and degrading retrieval performance when the information appears later. While prior work on positional bias in dense retrievers has largely focused on architectural explanations, we study how the positional distribution of evidence in training data affects retrieval-level bias direction. To test this, we construct synthetic position-targeted training sets in which query-relevant evidence appears at the beginning, middle, or end of documents, and fine-tune eight architecturally diverse pretrained models under position-skewed and balanced training distributions. At the ranking level, we observe a strong directional pattern across the examined models: skewed training distributions favor evidence at the corresponding positions. Position-balanced training reduces positional sensitivity by 57--87\% on position-aware benchmarks, with competitive mean retrieval performance in our controlled setting. Representation-level analyses further suggest that fine-tuning often reshapes learned positional preferences, although pre-existing architectural or pretraining-specific tendencies persist in some models. These results identify training-position distribution as a major controllable factor in retrieval-level position bias and suggest balanced data curation as a practical mitigation strategy. Our code is available at https://github.com/sionic-ai/position-bias-dense-retrievers.

title: EmoDistill: Offline Emotion Skill Distillation for Language Model Agents in Adversarial Negotiation
summary: Post-trained LLMs are often optimized to produce helpful, polite, and accommodating responses. In adversarial negotiation, however, such behavior can become a vulnerability: emotionally framed language may influence an agent's bargaining decisions in ways that conflict with its user's objectives. We therefore introduce EmoDistill, an offline framework for distilling emotional negotiation skills from LLM-LLM interactions into smaller language-model agents. Here, an emotional negotiation skill is a state-conditioned behavior that determines which explicit emotion to invoke in a bargaining state and how to realize that emotion as an effective negotiation utterance. EmoDistill learns these two components separately: an Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) selector learns which emotion to express in each bargaining state, while a LoRA-adapted 7B policy learns emotion-conditioned expression through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Judge Policy Optimization (JPO). Across four emotion-sensitive negotiation domains, the full EmoDistill policy achieves competitive utility and improves over vanilla and IQL-only baselines in most settings. Emotion-free ablations show that removing the explicit emotion channel substantially reduces overall negotiation utility, while transfer experiments reveal partial, domain-dependent transfer and robustness to unseen LLM counterparties.

title: MIRA: A Bilingual Benchmark for Medical Information Response Audit
comments: Accepted to the Main Conference of EMNLP 2026
summary: Existing safety evaluations for large language models overlook whether responses preserve comparable medical information across different user phrasings of the same question. To address this, we introduce the Medical Information Response Audit (MIRA), a bilingual, controlled benchmark that assesses whether LLMs provide comparable medical information across user-side language, register, and health literacy signals. MIRA contains 4,320 prompts built from 60 medically reviewed, low-risk health questions. Across five mainstream LLMs, models answered all medical questions, but responses to low health-literacy signals consistently omitted more key information, provided fewer concrete next steps, and offered less support for independent judgment. We term this pattern Differential Information Dilution (DID). A comparison with 300 real-world health queries provides preliminary evidence of rank-order validity. A knowledge-guided mitigation prompt reduces information dilution for most models, with the largest reductions in underinformative simplification observed for Claude (~8%) and Qwen (~6%). Code and data are available at https://github.com/Rainxu09/MIRA.

AI.title_translation: MIRA：一个用于医疗信息响应审计的双语基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了医疗信息响应审计基准MIRA，发现大语言模型在面对低健康素养用户时存在信息稀释现象，并通过知识引导提示成功缓解了这一问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM安全评估忽视了模型在面对同一问题的不同用户表述时，是否能保留可比的医疗信息，特别是在用户的语言、语体和健康素养信号发生变化时。
AI.method: 构建了包含4,320个提示词的双语对照基准MIRA（基于60个低风险健康问题），评估了五种主流大模型，并提出了一种知识引导的缓解提示词来减少信息稀释。
AI.result: 实验发现模型对低健康素养信号的回答会持续遗漏更多关键信息、提供更少具体行动步骤以及较少支持独立判断（即差异化信息稀释DID）；同时，知识引导的缓解提示能够有效减少大多数模型的信息稀释。
AI.conclusion: MIRA基准成功揭示了现有LLM在处理低健康素养提示时存在信息严重稀释的问题（DID），而知识引导的提示词能有效缓解这一现象，促进医疗信息传递的公平性。
AI.translation: 现有的大语言模型安全评估忽视了响应是否能在同一问题的不同用户表述之间保留可比的医疗信息。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了医疗信息响应审计（MIRA），这是一个双语的对照基准，用于评估LLM在用户端语言、语体和健康素养信号变化时是否能提供可比的医疗信息。MIRA包含4,320个提示词，由60个经医学审查的低风险健康问题构建而成。在五种主流LLM中，模型回答了所有医疗问题，但对低健康素养信号的响应始终遗漏了更多关键信息、提供了更少的具体后续步骤，并对独立判断提供了较少支持。我们将这种模式称为差异化信息稀释（DID）。与300个真实世界健康查询的对比为排序有效性提供了初步证据。知识引导的缓解提示词减少了大多数模型的信息信息稀释，其中Claude（~8%）和Qwen（~6%）的信息不足简化现象减少最为明显。代码和数据可在https://github.com/Rainxu09/MIRA获取。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了MIRA——一个用于医疗信息响应审计的双语对照基准，用以评估大模型在不同健康素养和语言表述下是否能提供可比的医疗信息，并揭示了低健康素养会导致“差异化信息稀释”的现象。
AI.keywords: 医疗大模型, 信息审计, 双语基准, 健康素养, 差异化信息稀释
AI.comments: 该论文填补了大语言模型在医疗信息响应审计中的空白，创新性地提出了差异化信息稀释（DID）这一概念，并构建了双语对照基准MIRA，对于提升医疗大模型在不同健康素养用户面前的公平性和信息完整性具有重要意义。

title: RW-TTT: Batched Serving for Request-Owned Test-Time Training State
summary: Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM during generation by reading and updating request-owned state, such as fast weights, low-rank deltas, or streaming learner state. This breaks batched LLM serving, which assumes shared static weights: serial execution is correct but slow, while naive batching can corrupt request state. We formulate this problem as read-write TTT serving and present RW-TTT , which tags each decode step with its owner, version, and READ/WRITE effect, batches only compatible phases, and commits updates only to the owner. On one GPU with eight fast-weight InPlace-TTT streams, RW-TTT reaches 274.61 aggregate tok/s, 9.31x over sequential serving and 3.44x over per-stream replicas under the same memory budget. It preserves behavior on RULER, a long-context benchmark, and passes owner/version checks.

AI.title_translation: RW-TTT：面向请求私有测试时训练状态的批处理服务
AI.tldr: RW-TTT通过标记请求所有权与读写阶段来兼容批处理，在保障状态安全的前提下使TTT推理吞吐量提升高达9.31倍。
AI.motivation: 测试时训练（TTT）在生成阶段需要读写请求私有的状态（如快速权重、低秩增量等），这破坏了传统批处理服务对共享静态权重的假设；串行执行效率低下，而朴素批处理又会导致请求状态被破坏。
AI.method: 将该问题形式化为读写TTT服务，提出RW-TTT方案：为每个解码步骤标记其归属者（owner）、版本（version）以及读/写影响（READ/WRITE effect），仅对兼容阶段进行批处理，且仅向对应的归属者提交状态更新。
AI.result: 在单张GPU上运行8个快速权重InPlace-TTT流的实验中，RW-TTT实现了274.61 tok/s的聚合吞吐量，在相同内存预算下比串行服务快9.31倍，比单流副本快3.44倍；同时在长上下文基准RULER上保持了模型表现，并通过了归属者/版本检查。
AI.conclusion: RW-TTT成功解决了TTT在批处理推理时状态易受损的冲突问题，在保证状态正确性与模型性能的前提下，显著提升了大模型测试时训练的批处理服务吞吐量。
AI.translation: 测试时训练（TTT）通过读取和更新请求私有的状态（例如快速权重、低秩增量或流式学习器状态），在生成过程中对大语言模型进行自适应调整。这打破了假设共享静态权重的大模型批处理服务机制：串行执行虽然结果正确但速度缓慢，而朴素的批处理则可能损坏请求状态。我们将该问题形式化为读写TTT服务，并提出了RW-TTT。该方案为每个解码步骤标记其所有者、版本以及读/写（READ/WRITE）效应，仅对相互兼容的阶段进行批处理，并且仅向对应所有者提交更新。在单张GPU配备8个快速权重InPlace-TTT流的配置下，RW-TTT的聚合吞吐量达到了274.61 tok/s，在相同内存预算下是串行服务的9.31倍、按流副本方案的3.44倍。它在长上下文基准测试RULER上保持了原有的性能表现，并成功通过了所有者与版本检查。
AI.summary: 针对测试时训练（TTT）读写动态请求状态导致难以批处理的问题，本文提出了RW-TTT。该系统通过对解码步骤的状态所有权、版本及读写操作进行精细标记与兼容批处理，在严格保障请求状态隔离的同时，大幅提升了TTT的批处理推理吞吐量。
AI.keywords: 测试时训练 (TTT), 大语言模型服务, 批处理, 读写状态控制, 动态权重
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于将数据库与并发控制中的读写依赖思想引入大模型推理系统，解决了测试时训练（TTT）与批处理服务之间的根本冲突；其重要性体现在打通了TTT模型从算法创新走向实际高并发工程落地的关键瓶颈；局限在于摘要中仅展示了单GPU及特定数量流下的评测，更广泛的集群扩展性与调度开销有待进一步观察。

title: SuperValid: Capability-Aligned OOD Validation for Generalizable Downstream Scaling
summary: Scaling laws guide large language model training by relating compute to cross-entropy loss, and recent work further extends them to predict downstream benchmark performance. However, prior approaches face generalization limitations from two aspects: focusing on benchmark-level performance introduces scenario-specific artifacts, while relying on IID validation loss fails to track capability improvements when training distributions vary. In this work, we argue that downstream scaling should be studied at the capability level, which captures shared skill factors across related tasks while abstracting away benchmark-specific noise. We propose SuperValid, a framework that synthesizes OOD (out-of-distribution), capability-aligned validation data by distilling core concepts from benchmarks within a capability domain and expanding them into diverse, knowledge-rich texts. Extensive experiments spanning 16 benchmarks grouped into 6 capability domains show that SuperValid loss exhibits strong and stable correlation with downstream performance across models of different architectures, scales, and training data distributions. As a training-free metric computable during training without benchmark evaluation, SuperValid enables effective model selection, early stopping, and scaling decisions.

AI.title_translation: SuperValid：面向可泛化下游扩展的能力对齐OOD验证
AI.tldr: SuperValid提出了一种能力对齐的OOD验证框架，通过蒸馏核心概念并扩展为多样化文本，以实现对大型语言模型下游性能的准确、稳定预测，克服了现有方法在泛化性上的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在预测大型语言模型下游性能时存在泛化限制：关注基准级别性能引入了场景特异性伪影，而依赖IID验证损失无法在训练分布变化时跟踪能力提升。因此，需要一种在能力级别研究下游扩展的方法。
AI.method: 本研究提出了SuperValid框架，通过从能力领域内的基准中提炼核心概念，并将其扩展为多样化、知识丰富的文本，从而合成OOD（分布外）、能力对齐的验证数据。
AI.result: 在跨越6个能力领域分组的16个基准上进行的广泛实验表明，SuperValid损失与不同架构、规模和训练数据分布模型在下游性能上表现出强大且稳定的相关性。
AI.conclusion: SuperValid作为一种在训练期间无需基准评估即可计算的免训练指标，能够实现有效的模型选择、早期停止和扩展决策。
AI.translation: 扩展定律通过将计算量与交叉熵损失相关联来指导大型语言模型训练，最近的工作进一步将其扩展到预测下游基准性能。然而，先前的方法面临两个方面的泛化限制：关注基准级别性能引入了场景特异性伪影，而依赖IID验证损失无法在训练分布变化时跟踪能力提升。在这项工作中，我们认为下游扩展应该在能力级别进行研究，这捕捉了相关任务中共享的技能因素，同时抽象掉了基准特异性噪声。我们提出了SuperValid，一个框架，通过从能力领域内的基准中提炼核心概念并将其扩展为多样化、知识丰富的文本来合成OOD（分布外）、能力对齐的验证数据。跨越6个能力领域分组的16个基准的广泛实验表明，SuperValid损失与不同架构、规模和训练数据分布的模型在下游性能上表现出强大且稳定的相关性。作为一种在训练期间无需基准评估即可计算的免训练指标，SuperValid能够实现有效的模型选择、早期停止和扩展决策。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了SuperValid框架，旨在通过能力对齐的OOD验证数据解决大型语言模型下游性能预测中现有方法的泛化性问题。SuperValid通过从基准中提炼核心概念并扩展为多样化文本来合成验证数据，从而在能力级别捕捉模型性能。实验证明，SuperValid损失与模型下游性能具有强而稳定的相关性，为模型选择、早期停止和扩展决策提供了一种有效的免训练指标。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 能力对齐, OOD验证, 下游扩展, SuperValid
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“能力级别”的下游扩展研究视角，并设计了SuperValid框架来合成OOD、能力对齐的验证数据。这种方法克服了传统基准测试和IID验证的局限性，为大型语言模型的泛化性评估和训练决策提供了新的思路。其免训练、可计算的特性具有重要的实践价值，有助于提高模型开发效率。

title: Refusal Before Decoding: Detecting and Exploiting Refusal Signals in Intermediate LLM Activations
summary: In this paper, we investigate whether refusal behavior can be predicted from LLM intermediate activations before decoding using linear probes trained on residual stream activations at each transformer block. We find that refusal is linearly decodable well before the final layer, indicating that safety-relevant behavior is represented in intermediate activations before output generation. To test whether this signal is actionable, we introduce Mechanistic AutoDAN, a probe-guided variant of AutoDAN that replaces full-model fitness evaluation with partial forward passes and probe-based scoring inside a genetic prompt search loop. Across the evaluated models, our method achieves attack success rates competitive with vanilla AutoDAN while reducing per-iteration search time by up to 72%, and probe-guided prompts match or exceed AutoDAN's cross-model transfer in several configurations. We further find that the usefulness of probe guidance increases with model scale. Our results suggest that refusal-relevant information is decodable from intermediate activations and can serve as an effective search signal in an AutoDAN-style discrete jailbreak optimization loop, especially for larger and more robust models.

AI.title_translation: 解码前拒绝：检测和利用LLM中间激活中的拒绝信号
AI.tldr: 研究发现LLM拒绝行为可在最终层前通过中间激活预测，并提出Mechanistic AutoDAN，利用此信号加速越狱攻击，同时保持高成功率，尤其适用于大型模型。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在探究LLM的拒绝行为是否可以在解码前通过其中间激活进行预测，以了解安全相关行为在输出生成前如何表示。
AI.method: 研究通过在线性探测器在每个Transformer块的残差流激活上训练，来检测拒绝信号。进一步，引入了Mechanistic AutoDAN，这是一个探针引导的AutoDAN变体，它在遗传提示搜索循环中用部分前向传递和基于探针的评分取代了全模型适应度评估。
AI.result: 结果显示，拒绝行为在最终层之前就能被线性解码。Mechanistic AutoDAN在攻击成功率上与原始AutoDAN相当，同时将每次迭代的搜索时间减少了高达72%。探针引导的提示在某些配置中匹配或超过了AutoDAN的跨模型迁移能力。此外，探针引导的有效性随着模型规模的增加而提高。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，与拒绝相关的信息可以从中间激活中解码，并可以在AutoDAN风格的离散越狱优化循环中作为有效的搜索信号，特别是对于更大、更鲁棒的模型。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们研究了是否可以在解码前，使用在每个transformer块的残差流激活上训练的线性探针，从LLM的中间激活中预测拒绝行为。我们发现拒绝行为在最终层之前就可以被线性解码，这表明与安全相关的行为在输出生成之前就已在中间激活中表示。为了测试这个信号是否可操作，我们引入了Mechanistic AutoDAN，这是一个探针引导的AutoDAN变体，它在遗传提示搜索循环中用部分前向传递和基于探针的评分取代了全模型适应度评估。在所评估的模型中，我们的方法实现了与普通AutoDAN相当的攻击成功率，同时将每次迭代的搜索时间减少了高达72%，并且在几种配置中，探针引导的提示匹配或超过了AutoDAN的跨模型迁移能力。我们进一步发现，探针引导的有用性随着模型规模的增加而增加。我们的结果表明，与拒绝相关的信息可以从中间激活中解码，并且可以作为AutoDAN风格的离散越狱优化循环中的有效搜索信号，特别是对于更大、更鲁棒的模型。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了在大语言模型（LLM）中，拒绝行为是否可以在解码前通过中间激活进行预测。通过训练线性探针，研究发现拒绝信号在模型最终层之前即可被线性解码。基于此发现，研究提出了Mechanistic AutoDAN，一个探针引导的越狱攻击方法，它利用中间激活信号来加速提示搜索。实验结果表明，Mechanistic AutoDAN在保持与传统方法相当的攻击成功率的同时，显著减少了搜索时间，并且在模型规模越大时效果越显著，证明了中间激活在安全相关行为预测和优化中的潜力。
AI.keywords: LLM, 拒绝行为, 中间激活, Mechanistic AutoDAN, 越狱攻击
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于它首次证明了LLM的拒绝行为可以在输出生成前，通过中间激活被准确预测。通过将这一发现应用于越狱攻击，研究提出的Mechanistic AutoDAN显著提高了攻击效率，降低了计算成本，尤其是在大型模型上表现更佳。这不仅为理解LLM的内部工作机制提供了新的视角，也为开发更高效、更难以被检测的对抗性攻击提供了新的工具，同时也为未来的模型安全防御策略提供了新的研究方向。

title: Skill-Conditioned Gated Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
comments: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Findings. Code is available at https://github.com/walawalagoose/SGSD
summary: On-policy self-distillation (SD) improves LLM reasoning by using teacher-side privileged information (PI) to turn sparse verifier outcomes into dense token-level supervision. Existing methods usually assume trusted PI, such as reference answers or successful traces. We ask whether PI can instead come from an experience-derived skill bank, where retrieved skills are compact and reusable but may also be irrelevant or misleading. We propose Skill-Conditioned Gated Self-Distillation (SGSD), which formulates skill-based SD as teacher hypothesis validation rather than unconditional imitation. SGSD retrieves skill-mistake pairs, constructs a multi-teacher pool, and lets all skill-conditioned teachers score the same plain-prompt student rollout. The verifier validates each teacher's polarity: supporting a success or suppressing a failure gives positive supervision, while the opposite stance is reversed. A robust gated objective then distills informative teacher-student disagreements while suppressing uncertain or extreme signals. Experiments on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that SGSD consistently improves over GRPO and remains competitive with answer-conditioned OPSD under a weaker PI assumption. For example, on Qwen3-1.7B, SGSD outperforms GRPO by 6.2% and OPSD by 1.7% on average on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25.
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Findings. Code is available at https://github.com/walawalagoose/SGSD

AI.title_translation: 面向LLM推理的技能条件门控自蒸馏
AI.tldr: 现有的LLM推理自蒸馏方法依赖于可信的特权信息。本文提出了一种技能条件门控自蒸馏（SGSD）方法，利用经验导出的技能库作为特权信息，即使技能可能不相关或具有误导性，也能提高LLM的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的策略内自蒸馏（SD）方法通过使用教师端的特权信息（PI）将稀疏的验证器结果转化为密集的令牌级监督，从而改善LLM推理。这些方法通常假设PI是可信的，例如参考答案或成功的轨迹。本文旨在探讨PI是否可以来自经验导出的技能库，其中检索到的技能紧凑且可重用，但也可能不相关或具有误导性。
AI.method: 本文提出了技能条件门控自蒸馏（SGSD），它将基于技能的自蒸馏表述为教师假设验证，而非无条件模仿。SGSD检索技能-错误对，构建一个多教师池，并让所有技能条件教师对相同的普通提示学生推演进行评分。验证器验证每个教师的极性：支持成功或抑制失败提供正向监督，而相反的立场则被反转。一个鲁棒的门控目标随后蒸馏出信息丰富的师生分歧，同时抑制不确定或极端的信号。
AI.result: 在多个数学推理基准测试中，实验表明SGSD持续优于GRPO，并且在较弱的PI假设下与答案条件下的OPSD保持竞争力。例如，在Qwen3-1.7B上，SGSD在AIME24、AIME25和HMMT25上平均优于GRPO 6.2%，优于OPSD 1.7%。
AI.conclusion: SGSD有效利用了潜在噪声的基于技能的特权信息来改善LLM推理，为依赖可信特权信息的方法提供了一个鲁棒的替代方案。
AI.translation: 策略内自蒸馏（SD）通过使用教师端的特权信息（PI）将稀疏的验证器结果转化为密集的令牌级监督，从而改善LLM推理。现有方法通常假设PI是可信的，例如参考答案或成功的轨迹。我们探讨了PI是否可以来自经验导出的技能库，其中检索到的技能紧凑且可重用，但也可能不相关或具有误导性。我们提出了技能条件门控自蒸馏（SGSD），它将基于技能的SD表述为教师假设验证，而非无条件模仿。SGSD检索技能-错误对，构建一个多教师池，并让所有技能条件教师对相同的普通提示学生推演进行评分。验证器验证每个教师的极性：支持成功或抑制失败提供正向监督，而相反的立场则被反转。一个鲁棒的门控目标随后蒸馏出信息丰富的师生分歧，同时抑制不确定或极端的信号。在多个数学推理基准测试中，实验表明SGSD持续优于GRPO，并且在较弱的PI假设下与答案条件下的OPSD保持竞争力。例如，在Qwen3-1.7B上，SGSD在AIME24、AIME25和HMMT25上平均优于GRPO 6.2%，优于OPSD 1.7%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为技能条件门控自蒸馏（SGSD）的新方法，旨在通过利用经验导出的、可能包含不相关或误导性技能的技能库作为特权信息（PI）来改进大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。与依赖可信PI的传统自蒸馏不同，SGSD将基于技能的蒸馏框架为教师假设验证。该方法涉及检索技能-错误对，构建一个多教师池，并利用验证器来评估每个教师的贡献。一个鲁棒的门控目标用于过滤噪声，同时提取有用的信号。在数学推理基准上的实验结果表明，即使在较弱的PI假设下，SGSD也持续优于GRPO，并与OPSD具有竞争力。
AI.keywords: 自蒸馏, LLM推理, 技能条件, 门控目标, 特权信息
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于，它解决了传统自蒸馏方法对“可信特权信息”的依赖，转而利用可能包含噪声的经验导出的“技能库”作为指导。这种方法提高了自蒸馏在特权信息不完美或难以获取场景下的适用性。提出的“门控目标”机制对于从混合信号中鲁棒地提取有用信息至关重要，是其核心创新点之一。

title: Theoretical Foundations and Effective Algorithms for Policy-Aware Simulator Learning
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) agents typically learn world models by minimizing predictive loss. However, powerful RL optimizers inevitably exploit minor model inaccuracies, leading to simulator exploitation and a reality gap where policies succeed in simulation but fail in the real world. We propose that the objective for learning simulators should be strategic robustness rather than predictive accuracy, and formulate this as a zero-sum minimax game between a model player and an adversarial policy player. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis: (1) an online learning guarantee showing the game is learnable with sublinear regret bounds; (2) a tractable critic-based simplification bounding the global policy-value gap by the local critic's loss; and (3) an Error-MDP duality, proving that finding the worst-case policy is formally dual to a standard RL problem where the reward is the one-step critic error. This duality yields a provably convergent active data selection algorithm. Experiments on continuous control tasks demonstrate that our approach reduces prediction error in strategically important regions by $1.5$-$2.2\times$ and enables policies trained purely in simulation to match near-optimal real-world performance.

AI.title_translation: 面向策略的模拟器学习的理论基础与有效算法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的模型学习目标，即策略鲁棒性而非预测准确性，通过将其建模为零和极小极大博弈来解决模型基强化学习中的模拟器利用和现实差距问题，并在连续控制任务上实现了显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 模型基强化学习（MBRL）智能体通常通过最小化预测损失来学习世界模型。然而，强大的强化学习优化器不可避免地会利用模型中微小的误差，导致模拟器被利用，并产生一个“现实差距”，即策略在模拟中成功但在现实世界中失败。本文提出，学习模拟器的目标应该是策略鲁棒性而非预测准确性。
AI.method: 本文将模拟器学习的目标制定为战略鲁棒性，并将其建模为模型玩家与对抗性策略玩家之间的零和极小极大博弈。文章提供了全面的理论分析：(1) 在线学习保证，显示该博弈具有次线性遗憾界限是可学习的；(2) 基于评论员的可处理简化，通过局部评论员的损失来限制全局策略-价值差距；(3) 误差-MDP对偶性，证明寻找最坏情况策略与标准强化学习问题（其中奖励是一步评论员误差）是形式上的对偶。这种对偶性产生了一种可证明收敛的主动数据选择算法。
AI.result: 在连续控制任务上的实验表明，本文方法将策略重要区域的预测误差降低了1.5-2.2倍，并使纯粹在模拟中训练的策略能够匹配接近最优的真实世界性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将模拟器学习目标重新定义为战略鲁棒性，并利用零和极小极大博弈框架，有效地解决了模型基强化学习中的模拟器利用和现实差距问题，实现了在模拟中训练的策略在真实世界中达到接近最优的性能。
AI.translation: 模型基强化学习（MBRL）智能体通常通过最小化预测损失来学习世界模型。然而，强大的强化学习优化器不可避免地会利用模型中微小的误差，导致模拟器被利用，并产生一个“现实差距”，即策略在模拟中成功但在现实世界中失败。我们提出，学习模拟器的目标应该是策略鲁棒性而非预测准确性，并将其表述为模型玩家与对抗性策略玩家之间的零和极小极大博弈。我们提供了全面的理论分析：(1) 在线学习保证，显示该博弈具有次线性遗憾界限是可学习的；(2) 基于评论员的可处理简化，通过局部评论员的损失来限制全局策略-价值差距；(3) 误差-MDP对偶性，证明寻找最坏情况策略与标准强化学习问题（其中奖励是一步评论员误差）是形式上的对偶。这种对偶性产生了一种可证明收敛的主动数据选择算法。在连续控制任务上的实验表明，我们的方法将策略重要区域的预测误差降低了1.5-2.2倍，并使纯粹在模拟中训练的策略能够匹配接近最优的真实世界性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对模型基强化学习中模拟器利用导致的现实差距问题，提出了一种新的模拟器学习目标：战略鲁棒性而非预测准确性。通过将模型学习建模为一个零和极小极大博弈，并提供全面的理论分析（包括在线学习保证、基于评论员的简化和误差-MDP对偶性），本文开发了一种可证明收敛的主动数据选择算法。实验结果表明，该方法显著降低了策略关键区域的预测误差，并使得纯模拟训练的策略在真实世界中达到接近最优的性能。
AI.keywords: 模型基强化学习, 模拟器学习, 现实差距, 极小极大博弈, 策略鲁棒性
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新性的方法来解决模型基强化学习中的核心挑战——模拟器利用和现实差距。将模拟器学习重新定义为追求战略鲁棒性而非单纯预测准确性，并通过零和博弈的形式化，为构建更可靠的世界模型提供了坚实的理论基础和实用的算法。特别是其误差-MDP对偶性，为主动数据选择提供了一个优雅且可证明收敛的框架，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: HARP: Hadamard-Preconditioned Adaptive Rotation Processor for Extreme LLM Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is essential for deploying LLMs under memory and bandwidth constraints. However, extreme low-bit quantization remains highly sensitive to activation outliers and anisotropic weight curvature. Existing incoherence-based PTQ methods mitigate this issue with fixed randomized Hadamard transforms (RHTs), which improve quantization robustness but cannot adapt the rotated basis to the layer, calibration distribution, or quantizer. We introduce HARP (Hadamard-preconditioned Adaptive Rotation Processor), a learnable structured two-sided orthogonal processor that replaces fixed Hadamard mixing while preserving exact full-precision equivalence. HARP represents each rotation as a product of sparse butterfly-like block-orthogonal stages, supports non-power-of-two dimensions through Mixed-Radix schedules, and initializes to the RHT processor up to a fixed permutation. Fitted only on calibration data, HARP adapts the quantization basis to each layer and backend. Across 2--4-bit settings on Llama models from 1B to 70B, HARP consistently improves perplexity and yields its clearest zero-shot gains at 2 bits; a 2-bit Qwen3-8B experiment shows the same transfer beyond the Llama family. HARP also preserves deployment efficiency: on Llama 2 7B at 2 bits, it reaches 128 tok/s, retaining 90% of RHT throughput (142 tok/s) and running approximately $2.1\times$ faster than FP16 (61 tok/s).

AI.title_translation: HARP: 采用Hadamard预处理的自适应旋转处理器，用于极端LLM量化
AI.tldr: HARP是一种可学习的自适应旋转处理器，通过Hadamard预处理，在极端低比特LLM量化中显著提升了性能和部署效率。
AI.motivation: 在内存和带宽受限下部署大型语言模型（LLM）需要后训练量化（PTQ）。然而，极低比特量化对激活异常值和各向异性权重曲率高度敏感，现有方法（如固定随机Hadamard变换）无法适应层、校准分布或量化器。
AI.method: HARP（Hadamard预处理自适应旋转处理器）是一种可学习的结构化双边正交处理器，取代了固定的Hadamard混合，同时保持精确的全精度等效性。它将每个旋转表示为稀疏蝶形块正交阶段的乘积，支持通过混合基数调度实现非2的幂次维度，并初始化为RHT处理器。HARP仅在校准数据上进行拟合，使量化基适应每个层和后端。
AI.result: HARP在Llama模型（1B至70B）的2-4比特设置中持续改善困惑度，并在2比特时产生最明显的零样本增益。2比特Qwen3-8B实验也显示了Llama系列之外的相同迁移效果。HARP保持部署效率，在Llama 2 7B的2比特设置下，达到128 tok/s，保留了RHT吞吐量的90%，比FP16快约2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: HARP通过引入可学习的、自适应的旋转处理器，克服了现有PTQ方法在极端低比特LLM量化中的局限性，显著提高了性能和效率，使其成为LLM部署的有效解决方案。
AI.translation: 后训练量化（PTQ）对于在内存和带宽受限下部署大型语言模型（LLM）至关重要。然而，极低比特量化对激活异常值和各向异性权重曲率仍然高度敏感。现有基于不相干性的PTQ方法通过固定的随机Hadamard变换（RHT）来缓解这个问题，这提高了量化鲁棒性，但无法使旋转基适应层、校准分布或量化器。我们引入了HARP（Hadamard预处理自适应旋转处理器），这是一种可学习的结构化双边正交处理器，它取代了固定的Hadamard混合，同时保持了精确的全精度等效性。HARP将每个旋转表示为稀疏蝶形块正交阶段的乘积，通过混合基数调度支持非2的幂次维度，并初始化为RHT处理器，直至一个固定置换。HARP仅在校准数据上进行拟合，使量化基适应每个层和后端。在从1B到70B的Llama模型的2-4比特设置中，HARP持续改善困惑度，并在2比特时产生最明显的零样本增益；一项2比特Qwen3-8B实验显示了Llama系列之外的相同迁移效果。HARP还保持了部署效率：在Llama 2 7B的2比特设置下，它达到了128 tok/s，保留了RHT吞吐量的90%（142 tok/s），并且运行速度比FP16（61 tok/s）快约2.1倍。
AI.summary: HARP是一种新颖的Hadamard预处理自适应旋转处理器，旨在解决极端低比特LLM量化中的挑战。它通过学习适应层和后端，取代了传统固定的随机Hadamard变换，从而提高了量化鲁棒性。实验证明，HARP在Llama和Qwen模型上显著改善了困惑度，尤其是在2比特量化下，并保持了高效的部署速度。
